ar.back: You'll give birth to kings even if you're not a king.
ar.controlEnglish: I am not what I am.

ar.text: شاطئ في إيلورية تعصف به الرياح. تسحب Viola قبعة بحّار فوق شعرها القصير، وفي عينيها تتلألأ هويّتان توأمان، والبحر يهمس بأسرار أخيها المفقود.
ar.english: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.
ar.back: Viola pulls a sailor's hat over her short hair, twin identities gleam in her eyes, and the sea whispers the secrets of her missing brother.
ar.controlEnglish: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.

ar.text: لست ما أبدو عليه.
ar.english: I am not what I am.
ar.back: I'm not who I look like.
ar.controlEnglish: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them.

ar.text: حديقة مشمسة في ضيعة Olivia. يختال Malvolio بجوارب صفراء صارخة مربوطة بأشرطة متقاطعة، مبتسمًا، ويضمّ إلى صدره رسالة حب مزوّرة.
ar.english: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.
ar.back: A sunny garden at Olivia's manor. Malvolio is dressed in bright yellow robes tied with cross-stitched ribbons, smiling and attaching a fake love letter to his chest.
ar.controlEnglish: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.

ar.text: بعض الناس يولدون عظماء، وبعضهم ينالون العظمة، وبعضهم تفرض عليهم العظمة.
ar.english: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them.
ar.back: Some people are born great, some acquire greatness, and some are forced to be great.
ar.controlEnglish: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.

ar.text: كونتيسة في الحداد ترفع خمارها فيظهر جمال يخطف الأنفاس. تزهر حديقة Olivia بالياسمين والخزامى بينما يسرق الرسول المتنكّر قلبها.
ar.english: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
ar.back: Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and chamomile as the renegade apostle steals her heart.
ar.controlEnglish: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.

ar.text: الحب المطلوب حسن، لكن الحب الموهوب بلا طلب أحسن.
ar.english: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.
ar.back: Love requested is good, but love given without a request is better.
ar.controlEnglish: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.

ar.text: مجلس الشيوخ الروماني، وأعمدته الرخامية ملطّخة بالقرمزي. يقف بروتس بين المتآمرين ونصله ما زال يرتجف، وثقل الجمهورية يستقرّ على يديه الملطّختين بالدماء.
ar.english: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.
ar.back: Brutus stands between the conspirators, his hand still shaking, and the weight of the Republic resting on his blood-stained hands.
ar.controlEnglish: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.

ar.text: ليس لأني أحببت قيصر أقل، بل لأني أحببت روما أكثر.
ar.english: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.
ar.back: Not because I loved Caesar less, but because I loved Rome more.
ar.controlEnglish: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.

ar.text: زقاق روماني تضيئه المشاعل في منتصف الليل. يميل كاسيوس قريبًا ويهمس بالفتنة بنظرة هزيلة جائعة، ورسائل مزوّرة تنسكب من ثنايا ثوبه.
ar.english: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.
ar.back: Cassius soon leans over and whispers temptation with a faint hungry look, forged letters leaking out of the folds of his garment.
ar.controlEnglish: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.

ar.text: العيب يا عزيزي بروتس ليس في نجومنا، بل في أنفسنا.
ar.english: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.
ar.back: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.
ar.controlEnglish: Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!

ar.text: يضجّ المنتدى الروماني بالغضب. يرفع مرقس أنطونيوس عباءة قيصر الملطّخة بالدم أمام الجموع، وكلماته تحوّل الحزن نارًا. والجمهورية تتداعى مع كل مقطع.
ar.english: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.
ar.back: Mark Antony raises Caesar’s blood-stained cloak before the crowd, and his words turn grief into fire. The Republic melts with each cut.
ar.controlEnglish: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.

ar.text: أيها الأصدقاء، أيها الرومان، يا أبناء وطني، أعيروني آذانكم!
ar.english: Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!
ar.back: Friends, Romans, my compatriots, give me your ears!
ar.controlEnglish: Many a morning hath he there been seen, with tears augmenting the fresh morning dew.

ar.text: ضيعة آل مونتاغيو عند الفجر. يراقب السيد مونتاغيو من نافذة عالية ابنه وهو يهيم في البساتين الضبابية في الأسفل، عاشقًا متيّمًا لا سبيل إليه.
ar.english: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.
ar.back: From a high window, Mr. Montagu watches his son wander in the hazy gardens below, an unreachable and devoted lover.
ar.controlEnglish: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.

ar.text: كم من صباح شوهد هناك، يزيد بدموعه ندى الصباح الطري.
ar.english: Many a morning hath he there been seen, with tears augmenting the fresh morning dew.
ar.back: How many mornings have been seen there, adding tears to the wet morning dew.
ar.controlEnglish: Marry, that marry is the very theme I came to talk of.

ar.text: السيد مونتاغيو
ar.english: Lord Montague
ar.back: Mr. Montagu
ar.controlEnglish: Lady Capulet

ar.text: القاعة الكبرى لآل كابوليت مكسوّة بالحرير. ترتّب السيدة كابوليت مصير ابنتها كما تُرتَّب الأزهار في مزهرية، والطموح يتلألأ خلف كل ابتسامة لطيفة.
ar.english: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.
ar.back: The grand hall of the Capulet family is covered in silk. Madame Capulet arranges her daughter's fate as flowers are arranged in a bouquet, and ambition shines behind every sweet smile.
ar.controlEnglish: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.

ar.text: الزواج، إنه بعينه الموضوع الذي جئت أحدثك فيه.
ar.english: Marry, that marry is the very theme I came to talk of.
ar.back: Marriage, that's exactly what I came to tell you about.
ar.controlEnglish: Now cracks a noble heart. Good night, sweet prince.

ar.text: السيدة كابوليت
ar.english: Lady Capulet
ar.back: Ms. Capolet
ar.controlEnglish: Romeo's Ring

ar.text: أسوار إلسينور في الساعة الباردة قبل الفجر. يقف Horatio ساهرًا إلى جانب هاملت، الصديق الوفيّ الوحيد في بلاط من الأفاعي.
ar.english: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.
ar.back: The walls of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands awake beside Hamlet, the only faithful friend in a snake-filled courtyard.
ar.controlEnglish: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.

ar.text: الآن ينكسر قلب نبيل. طابت ليلتك أيها الأمير العذب.
ar.english: Now cracks a noble heart. Good night, sweet prince.
ar.back: Good night, sweet prince.
ar.controlEnglish: I have had a most rare vision. I have had a dream, past the wit of man.

ar.text: فسحة في الغابة يتوهّج فيها ضوء الجنيات. يضع Bottom رأس حمار بوقار حائر بينما تكلّله تيتانيا بالأكاليل، والجنيات يكتمن ضحكاتهن.
ar.english: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.
ar.back: A space in the forest where the light of elves glows. Bottom puts a head of a raging donkey on his shoulder while Titania kicks him, and the elves hide their laughter.
ar.controlEnglish: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.

ar.text: رأيت رؤيا عجيبة نادرة. رأيت حلمًا يفوق عقل الإنسان.
ar.english: I have had a most rare vision. I have had a dream, past the wit of man.
ar.back: I saw a rare and strange vision, a dream beyond the human mind.
ar.controlEnglish: These times of woe afford no time to woo.

ar.text: مقبرة كنيسة فيرونا عند الغروب. يضع الكونت باريس الأزهار على قبر جولييت غافلًا عن العاشق اليائس المقبل من الظلال.
ar.english: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.
ar.back: Count Paris is laying flowers on Juliet's grave, unaware of the desperate lover coming from the shadows.
ar.controlEnglish: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.

ar.text: أوقات الحزن هذه لا تترك وقتًا للغزل.
ar.english: These times of woe afford no time to woo.
ar.back: These times of grief leave no time to worry.
ar.controlEnglish: O brave new world, that has such people in it!

ar.text: شاطئ بكر على جزيرة بروسبيرو. ترى Miranda البحّارة الغرقى لأول مرة، وعيناها متّسعتان دهشةً أمام عالم لم تكن تعرف بوجوده.
ar.english: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.
ar.back: Miranda sees the drowned sailors for the first time, her eyes wide open in amazement at a world she had never known existed.
ar.controlEnglish: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.

ar.text: يا له من عالم جديد رائع، فيه أناس كهؤلاء!
ar.english: O brave new world, that has such people in it!
ar.back: What a wonderful new world, with people like these!
ar.controlEnglish: My bounty is as boundless as the sea, my love as deep.

ar.text: خاتم ذهبي على حافة شرفة حجرية يلتقط ضوء القمر. نُقش في داخله عهد يبقى بعد الموت نفسه، وبتلات الورد تدور حوله في ريح خفية.
ar.english: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.
ar.back: A golden ring on the edge of a stone porch catching moonlight, engraved with an afterlife itself, and rose petals swirling around it in a hidden breeze.
ar.controlEnglish: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.

ar.text: كرمي بلا حدود كالبحر، وحبي عميق مثله.
ar.english: My bounty is as boundless as the sea, my love as deep.
ar.back: My bounty is boundless as the sea, and my love deep as it.
ar.controlEnglish: All that glisters is not gold.

ar.text: خاتم روميو
ar.english: Romeo's Ring
ar.back: Romeo's ring.
ar.controlEnglish: Portia's Casket

ar.text: ثلاثة صناديق تلمع في حجرة تضيئها الشموع: ذهب وفضة ورصاص. يهمهم صندوق الرصاص بحقيقة هادئة، ويكافئ من أوتي من الحكمة ما يرى به ما وراء المظاهر.
ar.english: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.
ar.back: Three boxes shimmer in a candlelit room: gold, silver and lead. The lead box interests them with a quiet truth, and the wise one is rewarded with what he sees beyond appearance.
ar.controlEnglish: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.

ar.text: ليس كل ما يلمع ذهبًا.
ar.english: All that glisters is not gold.
ar.back: Not everything shines like gold.
ar.controlEnglish: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.

ar.text: صندوق بورشيا
ar.english: Portia's Casket
ar.back: Portia Fund
ar.controlEnglish: Macbeth's Crown

ar.text: تاج اسكتلندي باهت يستقرّ على وسادة ملطّخة بالدم. ينبض بطموح مظلم ويهمس بوعود المجد لكل يد تجرؤ على أن تمتدّ إليه.
ar.english: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
ar.back: A pale Scottish crown sits on a blood-stained pillow, pulsating with dark ambition and whispering promises of glory to every hand that dares reach for it.
ar.controlEnglish: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.

ar.text: قلقًا يرقد الرأس الذي يلبس التاج.
ar.english: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.
ar.back: Anxiously lies the head who wears the crown.
ar.controlEnglish: I'll drown my book.

ar.text: تاج ماكبث
ar.english: Macbeth's Crown
ar.back: Macbeth's crown.
ar.controlEnglish: The Tempest Codex

ar.text: كتاب قديم مجلّد بجلد أنهكه البحر يطفو فوق مذبح حجري. تتقلّب صفحاته من تلقاء نفسها، وكل صفحة تستدعي عاصفة مختلفة.
ar.english: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.
ar.back: An old book, bound in sea-stained leather, floating over a stone altar, its pages turning on their own, each page calling forth a different storm.
ar.controlEnglish: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.

ar.text: سأغرق كتابي.
ar.english: I'll drown my book.
ar.back: I'm gonna drown my book.
ar.controlEnglish: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.

ar.text: مخطوط العاصفة
ar.english: The Tempest Codex
ar.back: The Storm Manuscript
ar.controlEnglish: Cordelia's Tears

ar.text: قارورة من البلّور تحفظ دموعًا تتلألأ كضوء نجوم أسير. كل قطرة تحمل حزن ابنة أحبّت بصدق مفرط وتكلّمت بصراحة مفرطة.
ar.english: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.
ar.back: A crystal bottle holding tears shimmering like the light of captive stars, each drop carrying the sadness of a daughter he loved too sincerely and spoke too frankly.
ar.controlEnglish: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.

ar.text: يا أبي العزيز، إنما أسعى في شأنك أنت.
ar.english: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.
ar.back: My dear father, it's you that I care about.
ar.controlEnglish: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!

ar.text: دموع كورديليا
ar.english: Cordelia's Tears
ar.back: Cordelia's Tears
ar.controlEnglish: Bottom's Mask

ar.text: قناع برأس حمار معلّق على غصن مكسوّ بالطحلب في غابة الجنيات. من يلبسه يرى العالم بعيون مسحورة، ويصير فتنةً لا تقاوَم لملكات الجنيات.
ar.english: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.
ar.back: A donkey-head mask hanging from a seaweed-covered branch in the fairy forest, whoever wears it sees the world with enchanted eyes and becomes an irresistible temptation for fairy queens.
ar.controlEnglish: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.

ar.text: بوركت يا بوتوم! لقد تحولت!
ar.english: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!
ar.back: Blessed be, Botom!
ar.controlEnglish: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.

ar.text: قناع بوتوم
ar.english: Bottom's Mask
ar.back: Botom mask.
ar.controlEnglish: Mandrake Root

ar.text: جذر معقود على هيئة شخص يصرخ يُستخرج من التراب على ضوء الشموع. تتفتّت التربة عنه فتنكشف قوّته الملتوية العتيقة، والصيدلاني يمسكه بخشوع مرتجف.
ar.english: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.
ar.back: A root attached to a screaming man is pulled out of the dust in candlelight. The soil breaks apart, revealing its ancient twisted strength, and the pharmacist holds it with a trembling hand.
ar.controlEnglish: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.

ar.text: لا الخشخاش ولا اليبروح ولا كل أشربة النعاس في العالم.
ar.english: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.
ar.back: No poppy, no marijuana, no all the narcotic drugs in the world.
ar.controlEnglish: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.

ar.text: جذر اليبروح
ar.english: Mandrake Root
ar.back: Yeast root.
ar.controlEnglish: Oberon's Dew

ar.text: قطرة ندى عالقة بزهرة سحلبية تحت ضوء القمر، تتوهّج بضوء بنفسجي من عالم آخر. قطرة واحدة على جفنين نائمين، فيقع الحالم في حب أول مخلوق يراه.
ar.english: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.
ar.back: A dewdrop hanging from a spiral flower under the moonlight, glowing with violet light from another world. One drop on two sleeping eyelids, and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature he sees.
ar.controlEnglish: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.

ar.text: أحضر لي تلك الزهرة؛ العشبة التي أريتك إياها مرة.
ar.english: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.
ar.back: Bring me that flower, the grass I showed you once.
ar.controlEnglish: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.

ar.text: ندى أوبيرون
ar.english: Oberon's Dew
ar.back: Nada Oberon
ar.controlEnglish: Hemlock Tincture

ar.text: قارورة من الزجاج الأسود ينزّ منها بخار أخضر في رواق معتم. الصبغة التي فيها أسقطت ملوكًا وحطّمت سلالات، قطرةً صامتة بعد قطرة.
ar.english: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.
ar.back: A bottle of black glass rising green vapour in a dark hallway, the dye that has overthrown kings and shattered dynasties, silent drop after drop.
ar.controlEnglish: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.

ar.text: في ساعة أماني تسلل عمك، ومعه عصير الهيبونا الملعون في قارورة.
ar.english: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.
ar.back: At the hour of hope, your uncle sneaks in with a bottle of cursed hippo juice.
ar.controlEnglish: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.

ar.text: صبغة الشوكران
ar.english: Hemlock Tincture
ar.back: Sugarcane dye.
ar.controlEnglish: Mistletoe Extract

ar.text: حبّات شاحبة تلمع بين أوراق داكنة دائمة الخضرة، قُطفت تحت قمر الشتاء. ويهمهم المستخلص بسحر الطبيعة الهادئ الدائب.
ar.english: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.
ar.back: Pale grains shimmering among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under the winter moon.
ar.controlEnglish: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.

ar.text: في القدر اغلي واخبزي؛ عين سمندل وإصبع ضفدع.
ar.english: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.
ar.back: In the pot, boil and bake; almond eye and frog's finger.
ar.controlEnglish: Full fathom five thy father lies; of his bones are coral made.

ar.text: خلاصة الهدال
ar.english: Mistletoe Extract
ar.back: Summary of the idleness
ar.controlEnglish: Mermaid's Tears

ar.text: قارورة سدادتها لؤلؤة تحفظ سائلًا أزرق مضيئًا يتموّج كبحر حيّ. في داخلها تنمو تكوينات مرجانية صغيرة ثم تذوب، ورائحتها رائحة الملح والرحلات المنسية.
ar.english: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.
ar.back: A bottle with a pearl stopper holds a shimmering blue liquid that ripples like a living sea, inside which small coral formations grow and melt, smelling of salt and forgotten voyages.
ar.controlEnglish: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.

ar.text: على عمق خمس قامات يرقد أبوك؛ ومن عظامه صار المرجان.
ar.english: Full fathom five thy father lies; of his bones are coral made.
ar.back: At a depth of five feet lies my father; from his bones became the coral.
ar.controlEnglish: Put this in any liquid thing you will, and drink it off; and, if you had the strength of twenty men, it would dispatch you straight.

ar.text: دموع حورية البحر
ar.english: Mermaid's Tears
ar.back: Mermaid's Tears
ar.controlEnglish: Apothecary's Elixir

ar.text: دكّان صيدلاني يغطّيه الغبار في أفقر أحياء مانتوفا. إكسير يائس يتوهّج كهرمانيًا في قارورة مشقوقة، قويّ بما يكفي ليعبر الهوّة بين الحياة والموت.
ar.english: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
ar.back: A dusty pharmacist in the poorest neighborhoods of Mantua, a desperate potion electroluminescent in a cracked vial, strong enough to cross the gulf between life and death.
ar.controlEnglish: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.

ar.text: ضع هذا في أي سائل تشاء واشربه كله؛ ولو كانت لك قوة عشرين رجلًا لقضى عليك في الحال.
ar.english: Put this in any liquid thing you will, and drink it off; and, if you had the strength of twenty men, it would dispatch you straight.
ar.back: Put this in any liquid you like and drink it all; if you had the strength of twenty men I would kill you immediately.
ar.controlEnglish: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.

ar.text: إكسير الصيدلاني
ar.english: Apothecary's Elixir
ar.back: Pharmaceutical excipient
ar.controlEnglish: Yorick's Skull

ar.text: بساط من أزهار النرجس الذهبية يمتدّ على ضفاف بحيرة ساكنة. يسير ووردزوورث بينها ودفتره في يده، وتلال كمبرلاند ترتفع خلفه.
ar.english: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.
ar.back: A carpet of golden narcissus blooms on the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them with his pen in hand, and Cumberland hills rise behind him.
ar.controlEnglish: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.

ar.text: همت وحيدًا كسحابة تطفو عاليًا فوق الوديان والتلال.
ar.english: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.
ar.back: I'm alone like a cloud floating high above the valleys and hills.
ar.controlEnglish: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.

ar.text: سفينة ساكنة لا ريح تحرّكها تنجرف على محيط كأنه مرسوم. يحدّق البحّار العجوز في طائر القطرس المعلّق في عنقه بينما تنهض أطياف من البحر الزجاجي.
ar.english: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.
ar.back: The old sailor stares at the crocodile hanging around his neck as spectra rise from the glass sea.
ar.controlEnglish: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.

ar.text: ماء، ماء في كل مكان، ولا قطرة للشرب.
ar.english: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.
ar.back: Water, water everywhere, not a drop to drink.
ar.controlEnglish: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.

ar.text: حديقة في هامبستيد في الخريف. يجلس كيتس تحت شجرة برقوق يكتب بحمّى، وعندليب يغرّد من الأغصان التي يغشاها الظلام.
ar.english: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.
ar.back: A park in Hampstead in autumn. Keats sits under a tree, writing feverishly on a pen, and an orchid blooms from the darkened branches.
ar.controlEnglish: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.

ar.text: الشيء الجميل فرح إلى الأبد: بهاؤه يزداد.
ar.english: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.
ar.back: The beautiful thing rejoices forever: its glory grows.
ar.controlEnglish: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.

ar.text: قصر في البندقية عند منتصف الليل. يقف بايرون على الشرفة وعباءته تخفق في الريح، ويحدّق عبر القناة المظلمة، وخلفه مخطوطة لم تكتمل تحترق في المدفأة.
ar.english: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.
ar.back: A palace in Venice at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony with his cloak flapping in the wind, staring through the dark canal, behind him an unfinished manuscript burning in the stove.
ar.controlEnglish: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.

ar.text: تمشي في الجمال، كليل الأجواء الصافية والسماوات المرصعة بالنجوم.
ar.english: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.
ar.back: Walking in beauty, clear air and starry skies.
ar.controlEnglish: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.

ar.text: غرفة مكتب في جنيف تضيئها الشموع وسط عاصفة رعدية. تكتب ماري على وميض البرق بينما يتحرّك المخلوق في الظلال خلفها. يصير العلم والرعب شيئًا واحدًا.
ar.english: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.
ar.back: An office room in Geneva lit by candles in the midst of a thunderstorm. Mary writes on a flash of lightning while the creature moves in the shadows behind her.
ar.controlEnglish: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.

ar.text: احذر؛ فأنا لا أعرف الخوف، ولذلك أنا قوي.
ar.english: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.
ar.back: Be careful; I don't know fear, therefore I am strong.
ar.controlEnglish: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.

ar.text: حجرة خافتة يضيئها جمر يحتضر. يجلس بو منحنيًا على مكتبه بينما يحطّ غراب على تمثال بالاس النصفي، وتتردّد كلمة «Nevermore» في الظلال.
ar.english: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.
ar.back: Poe sits bent over at his desk as Grub lands on the Palace’s half-moon statue, and the word “Nevermore” rings in the shadows.
ar.controlEnglish: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.

ar.text: ذات مرة، في منتصف ليل كئيب، بينما كنت أتأمل، ضعيفًا متعبًا.
ar.english: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.
ar.back: Once, in the middle of a gloomy night, while I was meditating, weak and tired.
ar.controlEnglish: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.

ar.text: ورشة طباعة في لندن تتّقد بنور الرؤيا. يحفر بليك نمرًا على النحاس بينما يتجسّد الوحش من اللوح، متوهّجًا في غابات الليل.
ar.english: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.
ar.back: A print shop in London has a visionary light. Blake carves a circle on copper as the monster emerges from the plate, glowing in the woods of night.
ar.controlEnglish: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.

ar.text: أن ترى عالمًا في حبة رمل، وسماء في زهرة برية.
ar.english: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.
ar.back: To see a world in a grain of sand, and the sky in a wild flower.
ar.controlEnglish: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?

ar.text: قمة جرف إيطالي تعصف بها الريح. يواجه شيلي العاصفة فاتحًا ذراعيه، وريح الغرب تنتزع الصفحات من دفتره وتنثرها فوق البحر المتوسط.
ar.english: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.
ar.back: Chile faces the storm with open arms, and the west wind pulls pages from his notebook and scatters them over the Mediterranean.
ar.controlEnglish: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.

ar.text: إذا جاء الشتاء، فهل يكون الربيع بعيدًا؟
ar.english: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?
ar.back: If winter comes, is spring far away?
ar.controlEnglish: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.

ar.text: غرفة مشمسة في فلورنسا. تكتب إليزابيث عند نافذة تطلّ على نهر أرنو، وكلبها من فصيلة السبانيل عند قدميها، ورسائل حب من Robert مفتوحة على المكتب.
ar.english: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.
ar.back: A sunny room in Florence. Elizabeth is writing at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel dog at her feet, and love letters from Robert open on the desk.
ar.controlEnglish: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.

ar.text: كيف أحبك؟ دعني أعد الطرق.
ar.english: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
ar.back: How do I love you?
ar.controlEnglish: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.

ar.text: حديقة على طراز ما قبل الرفائيلية في ضوء الخريف الآفل. تجلس كريستينا بين الأوراق المتساقطة تنظم أبياتًا يوجعها الجمال والاستسلام الهادئ.
ar.english: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.
ar.back: A pre-Raphaelite garden in the light of autumn. Christina sits among falling leaves composing verses comforted by beauty and quiet surrender.
ar.controlEnglish: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.

ar.text: اذكرني حين أكون قد رحلت، رحلت بعيدًا إلى الأرض الصامتة.
ar.english: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.
ar.back: Remind me when I'm gone, gone away to the silent land.
ar.controlEnglish: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.

ar.text: جبل الأوليمب يشقّ السماء. يجلس زيوس على عرش من الغيوم والبرق يتقوّس بين أصابعه، وفي الأسفل يرتجف عالم البشر تحت نظرته.
ar.english: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.
ar.back: Mount Olympus rips through the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds and lightning whistles between his fingers, and beneath him the world of men shakes under his gaze.
ar.controlEnglish: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.

ar.text: أنا جامع الغيوم، سيد السماوات الواسعة.
ar.english: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.
ar.back: I am the gatherer of clouds, the lord of the vast skies.
ar.controlEnglish: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.

ar.text: البارثينون يتلألأ في ضوء ذهبي. تقف آثينا في كامل عدّتها الحربية وبومتها جاثمة على ترسها، وعيناها الرماديتان تنفذان من كل خداع بشري.
ar.english: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.
ar.back: The Parthenon shines in a golden light. Athena stands in her full armor, with her crown on her throne, her gray eyes running out of every human deception.
ar.controlEnglish: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.

ar.text: بومة الحكمة لا تطير إلا عند الغسق.
ar.english: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.
ar.back: The owl of wisdom flies only at dusk.
ar.controlEnglish: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.

ar.text: عربة ذهبية تسابق سماء الفجر. يعزف أبولو على قيثارته وضوء الشمس ينسكب من العجلات فيلوّن العالم.
ar.english: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.
ar.back: A golden chariot races through the dawn sky, Apollo plays his guitar and sunlight spills from the wheels to color the world.
ar.controlEnglish: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.

ar.text: أنا إله الغناء والشفاء والشمس المشرقة.
ar.english: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.
ar.back: I am the god of singing, healing and sunshine.
ar.controlEnglish: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.

ar.text: شواطئ قبرص عند الفجر. تنهض أفروديت من زبد البحر، والحمائم تحلّق فوقها، والأمواج تضع اللآلئ عند قدميها. والعالم يحبس أنفاسه.
ar.english: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.
ar.back: The beaches of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from the sea butter, flamingos fly over her, waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.
ar.controlEnglish: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.

ar.text: حتى الآلهة لا تستطيع مقاومة قوة الحب.
ar.english: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
ar.back: Even the gods can't resist the power of love.
ar.controlEnglish: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.

ar.text: ومضة من صنادل مجنّحة عبر السماء. ينساب هيرميز بين الصواعق، وفي إحدى يديه رسالة إلهية، وعلى وجهه ابتسامة لص.
ar.english: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.
ar.back: A flash of winged sandals through the sky, Hermes flowing among lightning, a divine message in one hand and a thief's smile on his face.
ar.controlEnglish: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.

ar.text: سريعًا كالفكر، أحمل كلمات الآلهة إلى آذان البشر.
ar.english: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.
ar.back: Fast as thought, I carry the words of the gods to the ears of men.
ar.controlEnglish: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.

ar.text: قاعة عرش العالم السفلي تضيئها أنهار من نار شاحبة. يجلس هاديس وسيربيروس عند قدميه، وخوذة الظلام على مسند ذراعه، والموتى يمرّون في صمت لا ينتهي.
ar.english: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.
ar.back: The throne hall of the underworld is lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades and Cerberus sit at his feet, the helmet of darkness on his armrest, and the dead walk in endless silence.
ar.controlEnglish: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.

ar.text: كل الأرواح تأتي إلي في النهاية. أنا صبور.
ar.english: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
ar.back: All souls come to me in the end.
ar.controlEnglish: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.

ar.text: عرش منقسم بين الربيع والظل. تمسك بيرسيفون رمّانة في يد وتاجًا من الأزهار في الأخرى، ملكةً على مملكتين.
ar.english: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.
ar.back: A throne divided between spring and shadow, Persephone holding a sword in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen over two kingdoms.
ar.controlEnglish: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.

ar.text: أكلت ست حبات، وربطت نفسي إلى الأبد بين عالمين.
ar.english: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.
ar.back: I ate six beans, and tied myself forever between two worlds.
ar.controlEnglish: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.

ar.text: سفينة أنهكتها العواصف تدور حول رأس صخري. يربط أوديسيوس نفسه إلى الصاري بينما تغنّي عرائس البحر من الجروف، وعيناه تتّقدان بذكرى إيثاكا.
ar.english: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.
ar.back: A storm-weary ship swims around a rocky headland. Odysseus ties himself to the sail as the sea maidens sing from the reefs, his eyes staring at Ithaca.
ar.controlEnglish: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.

ar.text: حدثيني يا ربة الشعر عن الرجل الكثير الحيل، الذي تاه بعيدًا.
ar.english: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.
ar.back: Tell me, hairdresser, about the tricky man who went away.
ar.controlEnglish: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.

ar.text: معبد خرب عند حافة العالم. تلتفت ميدوسا وشعرها من الأفاعي يفحّ، ومحاربون من حجر مبعثرون على الأرض، متجمّدون في هجمتهم الأخيرة.
ar.english: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.
ar.back: A temple in ruins at the edge of the world. Medusa turns and her hair of snakes whistles, stone warriors scattered on the ground, frozen in their final assault.
ar.controlEnglish: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.

ar.text: انظر إلي إن كنت تجرؤ. نظرتي آخر ما ستراه.
ar.english: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.
ar.back: Look at me if you dare.
ar.controlEnglish: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.

ar.text: سهول طروادة عند الفجر. ينقضّ أخيل في درع متوهّج وصيحة حربه تشقّ الهواء، وخلفه تحترق السفن الإغريقية على الشاطئ.
ar.english: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.
ar.back: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles falls in a glowing shield and his roar of war cracks the air, behind him the Greek ships are burning on the beach.
ar.controlEnglish: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.

ar.text: أفضل أن أعيش حياة قصيرة مجيدة على حياة طويلة منسية.
ar.english: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.
ar.back: I'd rather live a short, glorious life than a long, forgotten one.
ar.controlEnglish: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
