de.text: Eine große Bühne nimmt Gestalt an. The Sonnet Man tritt aus einem goldenen Scheinwerferlicht hervor, das Mikrofon in der Hand. Shakespeares Worte verwandeln sich in Hip-Hop-Zeilen, während die Menge jubelt.
de.english: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.
de.back: A large stage takes shape. The Sonnet Man emerges from a golden spotlight, the microphone in his hand, Shakespeare’s words turning into hip-hop lines as the crowd cheers.
de.controlEnglish: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.

de.text: Soll ich dich einem Sommertag vergleichen?
de.english: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
de.back: Should I compare you to a summer day?
de.controlEnglish: Now my charms are all o'erthrown.

de.text: Eine Balkonszene im Mondlicht entfaltet sich. Romeo streckt die Hand empor, während oben Julia erscheint. Rosenblätter treiben durch die Luft. Die Szene pulsiert in warmem, karmesinrotem Schein.
de.english: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.
de.back: A balcony scene unfolds in the moonlight. Romeo stretches out his hand, while Juliet appears above him. Rose petals float through the air. The scene pulses in a warm crimson glow.
de.controlEnglish: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.

de.text: Der Garten der Capulets blüht im Mondlicht. Julia steht zwischen Rosen, die Augen hell vor Trotz. In den Zweigen singt eine Nachtigall.
de.english: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.
de.back: The garden of the Capulets blooms in the moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance, and a nightingale sings in the branches.
de.controlEnglish: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.

de.text: Das Schloss Helsingör taucht aus dem Schatten auf. Hamlet steht auf den Zinnen, Yoricks Schädel schwebt neben ihm. Auf dem Wall darüber erscheint eine geisterhafte Gestalt.
de.english: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.
de.back: The castle of Helsingør emerges from the shadows. Hamlet is standing on the pinnacles, Yorick’s skull floating beside him, and a ghostly figure appears on the wall above it.
de.controlEnglish: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.

de.text: Ein sanfter Bach windet sich durch einen Weidenhain. Ophelia treibt zwischen Wildblumen und flüstert vergessene Verse. Blütenblätter kreisen in der Strömung.
de.english: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.
de.back: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wild flowers whispering forgotten verses, petals circling in the flow.
de.controlEnglish: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.

de.text: Eine Straße in Verona bricht ins Chaos aus. Mercutio tanzt zwischen den Klingen und lacht der Gefahr ins Gesicht. Funken sprühen vom klirrenden Stahl.
de.english: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.
de.back: A street in Verona bursts into chaos. Mercutio dances between the blades and laughs at the danger, sparks sprinkling from the rattled steel.
de.controlEnglish: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.

de.text: Der Zauberwald schimmert vor Schabernack. Puck huscht zwischen uralten Eichen umher und zieht Spuren von Feenstaub hinter sich her. Unten träumen schlafende Sterbliche seltsame Träume.
de.english: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.
de.back: The enchanted forest is shimmering with dust, and Puck hurrying around among ancient oaks leaves traces of fairy dust behind him. Below, sleeping mortals are dreaming strange dreams.
de.controlEnglish: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.

de.text: Ein Thron aus lebenden Ranken wächst aus dem Waldboden. Titania gebietet über ihren Feenhof, während Glühwürmchen das Blätterdach erhellen. Die Natur selbst beugt sich ihrem Willen.
de.english: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.
de.back: A throne of living vines grows from the forest floor. Titania rules over her fairy yard, while fireflies illuminate the canopy of leaves.Nature itself bows to her will.
de.controlEnglish: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.

de.text: Ein Schädel ruht auf Samt in einer düsteren Gruft. Geisterhaftes Lachen hallt wider, während Erinnerungen an den Hofnarren wie Kerzenlicht flackern.
de.english: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.
de.back: A skull rests on velvet in a gloomy tomb, ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court fools flicker like candlelight.
de.controlEnglish: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.

de.back: Yorick Skull

de.text: Ein knorriger Stab knistert vor arkaner Kraft. Der Sturm wirbelt um ihn, während Prospero seinen letzten Zauber flüstert. Ein Blitz spaltet den Himmel.
de.english: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.
de.back: A gnawing staff crackles with arcane power, the storm swirls around it as Prospero whispers his last spell, and lightning splits the sky.
de.controlEnglish: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.

de.text: Nun sind all meine Zauber dahin.
de.english: Now my charms are all o'erthrown.
de.back: Now all my spells are gone.
Prospero Stab

de.text: Ein leuchtendes Fläschchen pulsiert in rosenfarbenem Licht. Herzen steigen von seiner Oberfläche auf, während eine süße Melodie die Luft erfüllt.
de.english: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.
de.back: A luminous vial pulsates in pink light, hearts rise from its surface while a sweet melody fills the air.
de.controlEnglish: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.

de.back: Love potion

de.text: Ein brodelnder Kessel stößt grünen Rauch aus. Drei schattenhafte Gestalten umkreisen ihn mit Sprechgesang. Aus dem dunklen Wald dahinter glühen Augen.
de.english: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.
de.back: A simmering cauldron emits green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it with spoken song, and eyes shine from the dark forest behind it.
de.controlEnglish: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.

de.back: Hexengebräu

de.text: Der Prinz steht auf den Stufen des Palastes von Verona; seine Stimme gebietet der verfeindeten Menge Schweigen. Ein goldenes Zepter glüht vor Autorität.
de.english: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.
de.back: The prince stands on the steps of the palace of Verona; his voice commands silence to the hostile crowd, a golden scepter glowing with authority.
de.controlEnglish: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.

de.text: Eine Klosterzelle im Kerzenschein. Der Bruder pflegt seinen Garten aus Kräutern und Giften, die Weisheit ins wettergegerbte Gesicht geschrieben.
de.english: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.
de.back: A monastery cell in candlelight, the brother cares for his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom written on the weather-tanned face.
de.controlEnglish: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.

de.text: Eine warme Küche im Hause Capulet. Die Amme eilt mit grimmiger Hingabe umher, einen geheimen Brief in der Schürze verborgen.
de.english: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.
de.back: A warm kitchen in the house of Capulet, the nurse hurrying around with grim devotion, a secret letter hidden in her apron.
de.controlEnglish: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.

de.text: Eine Insel, vom Sturm umhüllt. Prospero hebt die Hände, während der Blitz seinem Willen gehorcht und das Meer auf seinen Befehl aufwallt.
de.english: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.
de.back: An island enveloped in storm, Prospero raises his hands as the lightning obeys his will and the sea rises at his command.
de.controlEnglish: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.

de.text: Ein schimmernder Geist löst sich in Wind und Licht auf und formt sich als Musik neu. Ariel tanzt zwischen dem Sichtbaren und dem Unsichtbaren.
de.english: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.
de.back: A shimmering spirit dissolves in wind and light, reshaping itself as music; Ariel dances between the visible and the invisible.
de.controlEnglish: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.

de.text: Ein Höhleneingang an einer wilden Küste. Caliban kauert zwischen den Felsen, die Augen brennend vor Groll und ursprünglicher Klugheit.
de.english: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.
de.back: A cave entrance on a wild coast, Caliban lurks between the rocks, his eyes burning with resentment and primitive wisdom.
de.controlEnglish: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.

de.text: Ein Platz in Verona bei Tagesanbruch. Benvolio steht zwischen gezogenen Schwertern; seine offenen Hände sind die einzige Waffe gegen den aufziehenden Sturm.
de.english: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.
de.back: A square in Verona at dawn, Benvolio stands between drawn swords; his open hands are the only weapon against the rising storm.
de.controlEnglish: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.

de.text: Eine Gasse in Verona, vom Fackelschein erhellt. Tybalt zieht seinen Degen mit tödlicher Anmut, die Augen auf seinen Feind geheftet.
de.english: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.
de.back: An alley in Verona, lit by a torchlight: Tybalt draws his dagger with deadly grace, eyes fixed on his enemy.
de.controlEnglish: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.

de.text: Der Thronsaal von Helsingör, in falschen Glanz gehüllt. Claudius umklammert die Krone, ein Fläschchen Gift in seinem Gewand verborgen.
de.english: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.
de.back: The throne hall of Helsingør, shrouded in false splendor, Claudius holding the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robe.
de.controlEnglish: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.

de.text: Eine mondbeschienene Lichtung tief im Zauberwald. Oberon tritt aus dem Schatten hervor; seine Geweihkrone fängt das silberne Licht.
de.english: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.
de.back: A moonlit clearing deep in the enchanted forest, Oberon emerges from the shadow; his crown of horns catches the silver light.
de.controlEnglish: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.

de.text: Ein geisterhafter Dolch schwebt in der Dunkelheit, von seiner Klinge tropft Phantomblut. Macbeths Hand greift danach und kann ihn doch nie fassen.
de.english: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.
de.back: A ghostly dagger floats in the dark, from its blade drips phantom blood; Macbeth's hand reaches for it and never can grasp it.
de.controlEnglish: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.

de.back: Dagger of Imagination

de.text: Eine zerdrückte purpurne Blume tropft schillernden Nektar in eine wartende Handfläche. Wohin er fällt, verwandeln sich die Augen, und die Herzen folgen.
de.english: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.
de.back: A crushed purple flower drips dazzling nectar into a waiting palm; wherever it falls, eyes change and hearts follow.
de.controlEnglish: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.

de.back: Puck's flower juice

de.text: Ein blutbefleckter Thronsaal in Dunsinane. Macbeth umklammert sein Schwert mit zitternden Händen, die Krone schwer auf der Stirn. Auf dem fernen Hügel regt sich der Wald von Birnam.
de.english: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.
de.back: A blood-stained throne hall in Dunsinane. Macbeth holds his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavily on his forehead, and on the distant hill the forest of Birnam is moving.
de.controlEnglish: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.

de.text: Ein Gemach im schottischen Schloss bei Kerzenlicht. Lady Macbeth schreitet über die kalten Steine und reibt sich eingebildete Blutflecken von den Händen. Schatten haften an ihr wie eine zweite Haut.
de.english: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.
de.back: A chamber in a Scottish castle under candlelight. Lady Macbeth walks over the cold stones and rubs imaginary blood stains from her hands, shadows stick to her like a second skin.
de.controlEnglish: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.

de.text: Eine neblige schottische Heide in der Dämmerung. Banquo steht unbeirrt, während drei geisterhafte Gestalten Schicksale in den Wind flüstern. Sein Geist wird die Lebenden heimsuchen.
de.english: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.
de.back: A misty Scottish heath at dusk. Banquo stands unmoved as three ghostly figures whisper destinies into the wind, and his spirit will haunt the living.
de.controlEnglish: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.

de.text: Eine windgepeitschte Küste Illyriens. Viola zieht eine Matrosenmütze über ihr kurz geschnittenes Haar; zwei Identitäten schimmern in ihren Augen. Das Meer flüstert Geheimnisse von ihrem verlorenen Bruder.
de.english: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.
de.back: A windswept coast of Illyria. Viola wears a sailor’s hat over her short-cut hair; two identities shimmer in her eyes, the sea whispering secrets about her lost brother.
de.controlEnglish: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.

de.text: Ein sonniger Garten auf Olivias Gut. Malvolio stolziert in grellgelben Strümpfen mit kreuzweise gebundenen Kniegürteln umher, grinsend, einen gefälschten Liebesbrief an die Brust gedrückt.
de.english: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.
de.back: A sunny garden on Olivia’s estate, Malvolio flaunts in bright yellow stockings with cross-tied knee belts, grinning, a fake love letter pressed to his chest.
de.controlEnglish: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.

de.text: Eine verschleierte Gräfin in Trauer hebt ihren Schleier und enthüllt atemberaubende Schönheit. Olivias Garten blüht von Jasmin und Lavendel, während der verkleidete Bote ihr Herz stiehlt.
de.english: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
de.back: A veiled Countess in mourning lifts her veil and reveals breathtaking beauty, Olivia’s garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
de.controlEnglish: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.

de.text: Der römische Senat, die Marmorsäulen karmesinrot befleckt. Brutus steht unter den Verschwörern, die Klinge zittert noch. Die Last der Republik ruht auf seinen blutigen Händen.
de.english: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.
de.back: The Roman Senate, the marble columns stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, the blade still trembling, the burden of the Republic resting on his bloody hands.
de.controlEnglish: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.

de.text: Eine römische Gasse um Mitternacht im Fackelschein. Cassius beugt sich nah heran und flüstert Aufruhr, mit hagerem, hungrigem Blick. Gefälschte Briefe quellen aus seiner Toga.
de.english: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.
de.back: A Roman alley at midnight in the torchlight. Cassius leans near and whispers tumult, with a hasty, hungry look, fake letters gushing out of his toga.
de.controlEnglish: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.

de.text: Das Forum Romanum bricht in Wut aus. Marcus Antonius hält Caesars blutigen Mantel vor der Menge empor; seine Worte verwandeln Trauer in Feuer. Mit jeder Silbe zerfällt die Republik.
de.english: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.
de.back: The Roman Forum bursts into fury, Marcus Antonius raises Caesar's bloody cloak in front of the crowd; his words turn grief into fire. With every syllable he utters, the Republic disintegrates.
de.controlEnglish: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.

de.text: Das Anwesen der Montagues bei Tagesanbruch. Graf Montague sieht von einem hohen Fenster zu, wie sein Sohn unten durch die nebligen Obstgärten irrt, liebeskrank und unerreichbar.
de.english: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.
de.back: Count Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders down through the misty orchards, love-sick and unreachable.
de.controlEnglish: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.

de.back: Earl Montague

de.text: Der große Saal der Capulets, mit Seide verhängt. Gräfin Capulet ordnet das Schicksal ihrer Tochter wie Blumen in einer Vase; hinter jedem huldvollen Lächeln glitzert der Ehrgeiz.
de.english: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.
de.back: The great hall of the Capulets, draped with silk. Countess Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase. Behind every gracious smile there is an ambition.
de.controlEnglish: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.

de.back: Countess Capulet

de.text: Die Zinnen von Helsingör in der kalten Stunde vor Tagesanbruch. Horatio hält Wache an Hamlets Seite, der eine wahre Freund an einem Hof voller Schlangen.
de.english: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.
de.back: The pinnacles of Helsingør in the cold hour before dawn, Horatio watches by Hamlet's side, a true friend in a courtyard full of snakes.
de.controlEnglish: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.

de.text: Eine Waldlichtung im Feenlicht. Zettel trägt einen Eselskopf mit verdutzter Würde, während Titania ihn mit Girlanden behängt. Die Feen unterdrücken ihr Lachen.
de.english: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.
de.back: A forest clearing in fairy light. Zettel wears a donkey's head with muffled dignity, while Titania covers it with garlands.The fairies suppress their laughter.
de.controlEnglish: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.

de.text: Der Kirchhof von Verona in der Abenddämmerung. Paris legt Blumen an Julias Gruft und ahnt nichts von dem verzweifelten Liebenden, der sich aus den Schatten nähert.
de.english: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.
de.back: The cemetery of Verona at dusk, Paris laying flowers at Juliet’s tomb, unaware of the desperate lover approaching from the shadows.
de.controlEnglish: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.

de.text: Ein unberührter Strand auf Prosperos Insel. Miranda sieht die Schiffbrüchigen zum ersten Mal, die Augen weit vor Staunen über eine Welt, von der sie nichts wusste.
de.english: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.
de.back: A pristine beach on Prospero's island, Miranda sees the shipwrecked for the first time, her eyes wide open in amazement at a world she knew nothing of.
de.controlEnglish: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.

de.text: Ein goldener Ring liegt auf der steinernen Brüstung eines Balkons und fängt das Mondlicht. Innen ist ein Schwur eingraviert, der den Tod selbst überdauert. Rosenblätter kreisen um ihn in einem unsichtbaren Wind.
de.english: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.
de.back: A golden ring lies on the stone parapet of a balcony, catching the moonlight. Inside it is engraved an oath that survives even death; rose petals circle around it in an invisible wind.
de.controlEnglish: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.

de.back: Romeo's Ring

de.text: Drei Kästchen schimmern in einem Gemach bei Kerzenlicht: Gold, Silber und Blei. Das bleierne Kästchen summt von stiller Wahrheit und belohnt jene, die weise genug sind, hinter den Schein zu blicken.
de.english: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.
de.back: Three boxes shimmer in a candlelit room: gold, silver and lead.The lead box buzzes with silent truth and rewards those who are wise enough to look beyond the glow.
de.controlEnglish: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.

de.back: Portias' box

de.text: Eine angelaufene schottische Krone liegt auf einem blutbefleckten Kissen. Sie pulsiert von dunklem Ehrgeiz und flüstert jeder Hand, die nach ihr zu greifen wagt, Versprechen von Ruhm zu.
de.english: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
de.back: A rusted Scottish crown lies on a blood-stained pillow, pulsating with dark ambition and whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
de.controlEnglish: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.

de.back: Macbeth's Crown

de.text: Ein uralter Foliant, in meergegerbtes Leder gebunden, schwebt über einem steinernen Altar. Seine Seiten blättern von selbst um, und jede ruft einen anderen Sturm herbei.
de.english: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.
de.back: An ancient folio, bound in sea-tanned leather, floats above a stone altar; its pages turn by themselves, each calling forth a different storm.
de.controlEnglish: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.

de.back: I want to drown my book.
de.controlEnglish: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.

de.back: The Storm Codex

de.text: Ein Kristallfläschchen birgt Tränen, die wie eingefangenes Sternenlicht schimmern. Jeder Tropfen trägt den Kummer einer Tochter, die zu wahr liebte und zu offen sprach.
de.english: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.
de.back: A crystal bottle holds tears shimmering like caught starlight, each drop bearing the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too openly.
de.controlEnglish: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.

de.back: Cordelia's Tears

de.text: Eine Maske mit Eselskopf hängt an einem moosigen Ast im Feenwald. Wer sie aufsetzt, sieht die Welt mit verzauberten Augen, und wird für Feenköniginnen unwiderstehlich.
de.english: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.
de.back: A mask with a donkey's head hangs on a mossy branch in the fairy forest; whoever puts it on sees the world with enchanted eyes and becomes irresistible for fairy queens.
de.controlEnglish: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.

de.back: Zettel's Mask

de.text: Eine knorrige Wurzel in Gestalt einer schreienden Figur wird bei Kerzenlicht ausgegraben. Die Erde bröckelt ab und gibt ihre verdrehte, uralte Kraft frei. Der Apotheker fasst sie mit zitternder Ehrfurcht an.
de.english: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.
de.back: A knotty root in the form of a screaming figure is dug up by candlelight. The earth crumbles and releases its twisted, ancient power; the pharmacist touches it with trembling awe.
de.controlEnglish: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.

de.back: Alraunwurzel

de.text: Ein Tautropfen haftet an einer mondbeschienenen Orchidee und glüht in überirdischem violettem Licht. Ein Tropfen auf schlafende Lider, und der Träumende verliebt sich in das erste Geschöpf, das er erblickt.
de.english: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.
de.back: A dewdrop sticks to a moonlit orchid and glows in an extraterrestrial violet light; one drop on sleeping eyelids, and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature he sees.
de.controlEnglish: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.

de.back: Tau Oberon

de.text: Ein Fläschchen aus schwarzem Glas verströmt grünen Dunst in einem dunklen Gang. Die Tinktur darin hat Könige gestürzt und Dynastien zerschlagen, einen lautlosen Tropfen nach dem anderen.
de.english: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.
de.back: A vial of black glass emits green mist in a dark corridor, the tincture has overthrown kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop after another.
de.controlEnglish: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.

de.back: Schierling tincture

de.text: Blasse Beeren glänzen zwischen dunklen, immergrünen Blättern, geerntet unter einem Wintermond. Der Extrakt summt von der stillen, beharrlichen Magie der Natur.
de.english: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.
de.back: Pale berries shimmering among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon, the extract buzzes of nature’s silent, persistent magic.
de.controlEnglish: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.

de.back: Mistletoe extract

de.text: Eine Flasche mit Perlenstöpsel birgt eine leuchtend blaue Flüssigkeit, die sich wie ein lebendiges Meer bewegt. Darin wachsen und vergehen winzige Korallengebilde. Sie riecht nach Salz und vergessenen Reisen.
de.english: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.
de.back: A bottle with pearl stoppers holds a bright blue liquid that moves like a living sea, in which tiny coral shapes grow and pass away. It smells of salt and forgotten journeys.
de.controlEnglish: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.

de.back: Tears of the mermaid

de.text: Eine staubige Apotheke im ärmsten Viertel von Mantua. Ein Elixier der Verzweiflung glüht bernsteinfarben in einem gesprungenen Fläschchen, stark genug, die Kluft zwischen Leben und Tod zu überbrücken.
de.english: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
de.back: A dusty pharmacy in the poorest neighborhood of Mantua, an elixir of despair glows amber in a cracked vial, strong enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
de.controlEnglish: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.

de.back: Elixir of the Pharmacist

de.text: Ein Teppich goldener Narzissen zieht sich am Ufer eines stillen Sees entlang. Wordsworth geht zwischen ihnen, das Notizbuch in der Hand; hinter ihm erheben sich die Berge von Cumberland.
de.english: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.
de.back: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a quiet lake, Wordsworth walking between them with his notebook in hand; behind him rise the mountains of Cumberland.
de.controlEnglish: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.

de.text: Ich wanderte einsam wie eine Wolke, die hoch über Täler und Hügel zieht.
de.english: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.
de.back: I wandered alone like a cloud that rises high over valleys and hills.
de.controlEnglish: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.

de.text: Ein Schiff in der Flaute treibt auf einem gemalten Ozean. Der alte Seemann starrt auf den Albatros um seinen Hals, während geisterhafte Gestalten aus der gläsernen See steigen.
de.english: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.
de.back: The old sailor stares at the albatross around his neck, while ghostly figures rise from the glassy sea; a ship floats on a painted ocean.
de.controlEnglish: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.

de.text: Wasser, Wasser überall, und kein Tropfen zu trinken.
de.english: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.
de.back: Water, water everywhere, and no drop to drink.
de.controlEnglish: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.

de.text: Ein Garten in Hampstead im Herbst. Keats sitzt unter einem Pflaumenbaum und schreibt fieberhaft, während eine Nachtigall aus den dunkelnden Zweigen singt.
de.english: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.
de.back: Autumn garden in Hampstead, Keats sitting under a plum tree writing feverishly while a nightingale sings from the darkening branches.
de.controlEnglish: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.

de.text: Ein Ding der Schönheit ist eine Freude für immer: Seine Lieblichkeit wächst.
de.english: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.
de.back: A thing of beauty is a joy forever: its loveliness grows.
de.controlEnglish: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.

de.text: Ein venezianischer Palazzo um Mitternacht. Byron steht auf dem Balkon, der Umhang bauscht sich, der Blick geht über den dunklen Kanal. Hinter ihm verbrennt ein halb fertiges Manuskript im Kamin.
de.english: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.
de.back: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron is standing on the balcony, his cloak bulging, his gaze overlooking the dark canal, and behind him a half-finished manuscript burning in the fireplace.
de.controlEnglish: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.

de.text: Sie geht in Schönheit, wie die Nacht wolkenloser Himmelsstriche und gestirnter Himmel.
de.english: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.
de.back: She goes in beauty, like the night of cloudless stripes and starry skies.
de.controlEnglish: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.

de.text: Ein Studierzimmer in Genf bei Kerzenlicht, während eines Gewitters. Mary schreibt im Schein der Blitze, während sich das Geschöpf in den Schatten hinter ihr regt. Wissenschaft und Grauen werden eins.
de.english: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.
de.back: A study in Geneva under candlelight, during a thunderstorm. Mary writes in the light of lightning while the creature moves in the shadows behind her.Science and horror become one.
de.controlEnglish: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.

de.text: Hüte dich; denn ich bin furchtlos und darum mächtig.
de.english: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.
de.back: Beware, for I am fearless and therefore mighty.
de.controlEnglish: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.

de.text: Ein düsteres Gemach, von einem erlöschenden Feuer erhellt. Poe sitzt gebeugt an seinem Schreibtisch, als sich ein Rabe auf der Büste der Pallas niederlässt. Das Wort „Nimmermehr“ hallt in den Schatten.
de.english: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.
de.back: A gloomy room lit by an extinguishing fire. Poe sits bent over at his desk as a raven settles on the bust of Pallas, and the word “never again” echoes in the shadows.
de.controlEnglish: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.

de.text: Eine Londoner Druckwerkstatt, von visionärem Licht durchflutet. Blake ätzt einen Tiger ins Kupfer, während das Tier aus der Platte hervortritt und hell lodert in den Wäldern der Nacht.
de.english: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.
de.back: A London print shop flooded with visionary light, Blake etches a tiger into copper as the animal emerges from the plate and flares brightly in the woods of night.
de.controlEnglish: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.

de.text: Eine Welt in einem Sandkorn sehen und einen Himmel in einer wilden Blume.
de.english: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.
de.back: See a world in a grain of sand and a sky in a wild flower.
de.controlEnglish: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.

de.text: Eine windgepeitschte italienische Klippe. Shelley stellt sich dem Sturm mit ausgebreiteten Armen, während der Westwind Seiten aus seinem Notizbuch reißt und sie über das Mittelmeer verstreut.
de.english: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.
de.back: A windswept Italian cliff, Shelley faces the storm with outstretched arms as the westwind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.
de.controlEnglish: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.

de.text: Ein sonniges Zimmer in Florenz. Elizabeth schreibt an einem Fenster mit Blick auf den Arno, ihr Spaniel zu ihren Füßen. Roberts Liebesbriefe liegen offen auf dem Schreibtisch.
de.english: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.
de.back: A sunny room in Florence. Elizabeth is writing at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet and Robert’s love letters lying open on the desk.
de.controlEnglish: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.

de.text: Wie ich dich liebe? Lass mich die Weisen zählen.
de.english: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
de.back: How I love you? Let me count the wise.
de.controlEnglish: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.

de.text: Ein präraffaelitischer Garten im schwindenden Herbstlicht. Christina sitzt zwischen gefallenen Blättern und dichtet Verse, die vor Schönheit und stiller Ergebung schmerzen.
de.english: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.
de.back: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in the fading autumn light, Christina sits among fallen leaves and poets verses that hurt with beauty and silent submission.
de.controlEnglish: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.

de.text: Gedenke mein, wenn ich gegangen bin, weit fort gegangen in das stille Land.
de.english: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.
de.back: Remember me when I am gone, gone far away into a quiet land.
de.controlEnglish: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.

de.text: Der Olymp spaltet den Himmel. Zeus sitzt auf einem Wolkenthron, Blitze springen zwischen seinen Fingern. Unten erzittert die Welt der Sterblichen unter seinem Blick.
de.english: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.
de.back: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a cloudy throne, lightning leaps between his fingers, and below the world of mortals trembled under his gaze.
de.controlEnglish: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.

de.text: Ich bin der Wolkensammler, Herr der weiten Himmel.
de.english: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.
de.back: I am the gatherer of clouds, Lord of the vast skies.
de.controlEnglish: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.

de.text: Der Parthenon glänzt in goldenem Licht. Athene steht in voller Rüstung, ihre Eule auf dem Schild, ihre grauen Augen durchschauen jede sterbliche Täuschung.
de.english: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.
de.back: The Parthenon shines in golden light, Athena stands in full armor, her owl on the shield, her gray eyes see through every mortal delusion.
de.controlEnglish: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.

de.text: Die Eule der Weisheit beginnt ihren Flug erst in der Dämmerung.
de.english: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.
de.back: The owl of wisdom begins its flight only at dusk.
de.controlEnglish: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.

de.text: Ein goldener Wagen jagt über den Morgenhimmel. Apollon spielt die Leier, während Sonnenlicht von den Rädern strömt und die Welt in Farbe taucht.
de.english: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.
de.back: A golden chariot chases through the morning sky, Apollo playing his lyre as sunlight shines from its wheels and the world is covered in colour.
de.controlEnglish: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.

de.text: Ich bin der Gott des Gesangs, der Heilung und der strahlenden Sonne.
de.english: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.
de.back: I am the God of singing, healing and the shining sun.
de.controlEnglish: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.

de.text: Die Küste Zyperns bei Tagesanbruch. Aphrodite steigt aus dem Meerschaum; Tauben kreisen über ihr, und die Wellen legen ihr Perlen zu Füßen. Die Welt hält den Atem an.
de.english: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.
de.back: The coast of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from the sea foam, doves circle over her and the waves lay pearls at her feet.The world holds its breath.
de.controlEnglish: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.

de.text: Selbst die Götter können der Macht der Liebe nicht widerstehen.
de.english: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
de.back: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
de.controlEnglish: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.

de.text: Ein Huschen geflügelter Sandalen am Himmel. Hermes schlängelt sich zwischen Donnerkeilen hindurch, eine göttliche Botschaft in der einen Hand und das Grinsen eines Diebes im Gesicht.
de.english: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.
de.back: Hermes winds his way through the wedges of thunder, a divine message in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.
de.controlEnglish: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.

de.text: Schnell wie der Gedanke trage ich die Worte der Götter an sterbliche Ohren.
de.english: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.
de.back: Fast as thought, I carry the words of the gods to mortal ears.
de.controlEnglish: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.

de.text: Der Thronsaal der Unterwelt, erhellt von Strömen bleichen Feuers. Hades thront mit Kerberos zu seinen Füßen, den Helm der Dunkelheit auf der Armlehne. Die Toten ziehen in endlosem Schweigen vorüber.
de.english: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.
de.back: The throne room of the underworld, illuminated by streams of pale fire. Hades sits with Kerberos at his feet, the helmet of darkness on the armrest, and the dead pass in endless silence.
de.controlEnglish: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.

de.text: Alle Seelen kommen am Ende zu mir. Ich bin geduldig.
de.english: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
de.back: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
de.controlEnglish: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.

de.text: Ein Thron, geteilt zwischen Frühling und Schatten. Persephone hält einen Granatapfel in der einen Hand und einen Blumenkranz in der anderen, Königin zweier Reiche.
de.english: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.
de.back: A throne divided between spring and shadow, Persephone holding a pomegranate in one hand and a wreath in the other, queen of two realms.
de.controlEnglish: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.

de.text: Sechs Kerne aß ich und band mich für immer zwischen zwei Welten.
de.english: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.
de.back: I ate six seeds and bound myself forever between two worlds.
de.controlEnglish: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.

de.text: Ein sturmgepeitschtes Schiff umrundet ein felsiges Kap. Odysseus bindet sich an den Mast, während die Sirenen von den Klippen singen. In seinen Augen brennt die Erinnerung an Ithaka.
de.english: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.
de.back: A storm-hit ship circles a rocky cape. Odysseus binds himself to the mast as the sirens sing from the cliffs, with the memory of Ithaca burning in his eyes.
de.controlEnglish: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.

de.text: Sage mir, o Muse, von dem Mann der vielen Wege, der weit umherirrte.
de.english: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.
de.back: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways who wandered far.
de.controlEnglish: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.

de.text: Ein verfallener Tempel am Rand der Welt. Medusa wendet sich um, ihr Schlangenhaar zischt. Steinerne Krieger bedecken den Boden, erstarrt in ihrem letzten Ansturm.
de.english: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.
de.back: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns around, her snake hair hissing, stone warriors covering the ground, frozen in their final assault.
de.controlEnglish: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.

de.text: Sieh mich an, wenn du es wagst. Mein Blick ist das Letzte, was du sehen wirst.
de.english: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.
de.back: Look at me if you dare, my gaze is the last thing you'll see.
de.controlEnglish: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.

de.text: Die Ebene von Troja bei Tagesanbruch. Achilleus stürmt in gleißender Rüstung voran, sein Kriegsschrei zerreißt die Luft. Hinter ihm brennen griechische Schiffe am Strand.
de.english: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.
de.back: The plain of Troy at dawn. Achilles rushing forward in glittering armor, his war cry tearing the air, behind him burning Greek ships on the beach.
de.controlEnglish: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.

de.text: Lieber lebe ich ein kurzes Leben voll Ruhm als ein langes in Vergessenheit.
de.english: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.
de.back: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long one in oblivion.
de.controlEnglish: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
