fr.text: Une grande scène se matérialise. The Sonnet Man s’avance hors d’un projecteur doré, micro en main. Les mots de Shakespeare se changent en rimes de hip-hop sous les acclamations de la foule.
fr.english: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.
fr.back: The Sonnet Man steps out of a golden spotlight, with a microphone in his hand. Shakespeare’s words change into hip-hop rhymes under the acclaim of the crowd.
fr.controlEnglish: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.

fr.text: Une scène de balcon au clair de lune se déploie. Roméo tend la main vers le haut tandis que Juliette paraît au-dessus. Des pétales de rose flottent dans l’air. La scène palpite d’une chaude lueur cramoisie.
fr.english: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.
fr.back: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo stretches his hand upwards while Juliet appears above him. Rose petals float in the air. The scene pulsates with a warm crimson glow.
fr.controlEnglish: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.

fr.text: Le jardin des Capulet fleurit au clair de lune. Juliette se tient parmi les roses, les yeux brillants de défi. Un rossignol chante dans les branches.
fr.english: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.
fr.back: The garden of the Capulets blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among the roses, her eyes shining with defiance, and a nightingale sings in the branches.
fr.controlEnglish: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.

fr.text: Le château d’Elseneur émerge de l’ombre. Hamlet se tient aux créneaux, le crâne de Yorick flottant à son côté. Une figure spectrale paraît sur les remparts.
fr.english: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.
fr.back: The castle of Elseneur emerges from the shadows. Hamlet is standing in the crenellations, Yorick’s skull floating beside him, and a spectral figure appears on the ramparts.
fr.controlEnglish: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.

fr.text: Un ruisseau paisible serpente dans un bois de saules. Ophélie flotte parmi les fleurs sauvages, murmurant des vers oubliés. Des pétales tournoient dans le courant.
fr.english: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.
fr.back: A peaceful stream winds through a willow forest. Ophelia floats among wild flowers, whispering forgotten worms, and petals swirl in the stream.
fr.controlEnglish: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.

fr.text: Une rue de Vérone sombre dans le chaos. Mercutio danse entre les lames, riant au nez du danger. Des étincelles jaillissent de l’acier qui s’entrechoque.
fr.english: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.
fr.back: A street in Verona plunges into chaos. Mercutio dances between the blades, laughing at the danger, sparks spring from the steel that collides with each other.
fr.controlEnglish: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.

fr.text: La forêt enchantée scintille de malice. Puck file entre les vieux chênes, laissant des traînées de poussière de fée. En bas, les mortels endormis font des rêves étranges.
fr.english: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.
fr.back: The enchanted forest sparkles with malice. Puck wanders through the old oaks, leaving trails of fairy dust behind him, and down below, sleeping mortals have strange dreams.
fr.controlEnglish: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.

fr.text: Un trône de lianes vivantes s’élève du sol de la forêt. Titania commande sa cour de fées tandis que les lucioles éclairent la voûte des arbres. La nature elle-même s’incline devant sa volonté.
fr.english: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.
fr.back: A throne of living lianas rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court, while fireflies illuminate the canopy of trees, and nature itself bows to her will.
fr.controlEnglish: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.

fr.text: Un crâne repose sur du velours dans une crypte obscure. Un rire fantomatique résonne tandis que les souvenirs du bouffon de la cour vacillent comme la flamme d’une bougie.
fr.english: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.
fr.back: A skull rests on velvet in a dark crypt, ghostly laughter echoes as the memories of the court buffoon waver like the flame of a candle.
fr.controlEnglish: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.

fr.text: Le crâne de Yorick
Un bâton noueux crépite d’une énergie occulte. La tempête tourbillonne autour de lui tandis que Prospero murmure son dernier sortilège. L’éclair fend le ciel.
fr.english: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.
fr.back: A knotted stick crackles with occult energy. The storm swirls around him as Prospero whisperes his last spell, and lightning splits the sky.
fr.controlEnglish: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.

fr.text: Le bâton de Prospero
Une fiole luisante palpite d’une lumière rose. Des cœurs s’élèvent de sa surface tandis qu’une douce mélodie emplit l’air.
fr.english: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.
fr.back: A shiny vial pulsates with pink light, hearts rise from its surface as a gentle melody fills the air.
fr.controlEnglish: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.

fr.text: Philtre d’amour
Un chaudron bouillonnant crache une fumée verte. Trois silhouettes sombres tournent autour en psalmodiant. Des yeux luisent dans les bois obscurs.
fr.english: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.
fr.back: A boiling cauldron spits green smoke. Three dark silhouettes turn around singing, eyes shining in the dark woods.
fr.controlEnglish: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.

fr.text: Breuvage des sorcières
Le Prince se tient sur les marches du palais de Vérone ; sa voix impose le silence à la foule ennemie. Un sceptre d’or brûle d’autorité.
fr.english: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.
fr.back: The Prince stands on the steps of the palace of Verona; his voice imposes silence on the enemy crowd, a golden scepter burns with authority.
fr.controlEnglish: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.

fr.text: Une cellule de monastère éclairée à la bougie. Le frère soigne son jardin d’herbes et de poisons, la sagesse gravée sur son visage buriné.
fr.english: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.
fr.back: In a candlelit monastery cell, the monk cares for his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom engraved on his burnished face.
fr.controlEnglish: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.

fr.text: Une cuisine chaleureuse dans la maison des Capulet. La nourrice s’affaire avec un dévouement farouche, une lettre secrète glissée dans son tablier.
fr.english: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.
fr.back: A warm kitchen in the house of the Capulets, the nanny busy with a fierce devotion, a secret letter slipped into her apron.
fr.controlEnglish: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.

fr.text: Une île enveloppée de tempête. Prospero lève les mains tandis que la foudre obéit à sa volonté et que la mer bouillonne à son commandement.
fr.english: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.
fr.back: An island enveloped in storm.Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will and the sea bubbles at his command.
fr.controlEnglish: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.

fr.text: Un esprit chatoyant se dissout en vent et en lumière, puis se reforme en musique. Ariel danse entre le visible et l’invisible.
fr.english: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.
fr.back: A shimmering spirit dissolves in wind and light, then reforms itself into music: Ariel dances between the visible and the invisible.
fr.controlEnglish: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.

fr.text: L’entrée d’une grotte sur un rivage sauvage. Caliban est tapi parmi les rochers, les yeux brûlants de rancune et d’une intelligence primitive.
fr.english: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.
fr.back: Caliban is lurking among the rocks, his eyes burning with resentment and a primitive intelligence.
fr.controlEnglish: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.

fr.text: Une place de Vérone à l’aube. Benvolio se tient entre les épées tirées ; ses mains ouvertes sont la seule arme contre l’orage qui monte.
fr.english: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.
fr.back: Benvolio stands between the drawn swords; his open hands are the only weapon against the storm that is rising.
fr.controlEnglish: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.

fr.text: Une ruelle de Vérone embrasée par les torches. Tybalt tire sa rapière avec une grâce mortelle, les yeux fixés sur son ennemi.
fr.english: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.
fr.back: An alley in Verona lit by the torches, Tybalt pulling his rapier with deadly grace, eyes fixed on his enemy.
fr.controlEnglish: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.

fr.text: La salle du trône d’Elseneur, drapée d’une fausse splendeur. Claudius serre la couronne, une fiole de poison cachée dans sa robe.
fr.english: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.
fr.back: The throne room of Elseneur, draped in false splendor; Claudius holding the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robe.
fr.controlEnglish: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.

fr.text: Une clairière au clair de lune, au fond de la forêt enchantée. Obéron surgit de l’ombre ; sa couronne de bois de cerf accroche la lumière d’argent.
fr.english: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.
fr.back: A moonlit clearing at the bottom of the enchanted forest. Oberon emerges from the shadows. His crown of deer wood catches the silver light.
fr.controlEnglish: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.

fr.text: Un poignard spectral flotte dans les ténèbres, sa lame dégouttant d’un sang fantôme. La main de Macbeth se tend, mais ne peut jamais le saisir.
fr.english: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.
fr.back: A spectral dagger floats in the darkness, its blade dripping with ghost blood; Macbeth’s hand reaches out but can never grasp it.
fr.controlEnglish: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.

fr.text: Le poignard de l’esprit
Une fleur pourpre écrasée laisse couler un nectar irisé dans une paume qui attend. Partout où il tombe, les yeux changent, et les cœurs suivent.
fr.english: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.
fr.back: A crushed purple flower lets an iridescent nectar flow into a waiting palm; wherever it falls, eyes change, and hearts follow.
fr.controlEnglish: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.

fr.text: Suc de la fleur de Puck
Une salle du trône tachée de sang à Dunsinane. Macbeth serre son épée de ses mains tremblantes, la couronne lourde sur son front. Le bois de Birnam remue sur la colline lointaine.
fr.english: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.
fr.back: A throne room stained with blood at Dunsinane. Macbeth holds his sword in his trembling hands, the heavy crown on his forehead, the wood of Birnam shaking on the distant hill.
fr.controlEnglish: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.

fr.text: Une chambre du château écossais, éclairée à la bougie. Lady Macbeth arpente les dalles froides, frottant sur ses mains des taches de sang imaginaires. Les ombres s’accrochent à elle comme une seconde peau.
fr.english: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.
fr.back: A candlelit room in a Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth walks through the cold tiles, rubbing imaginary blood stains on her hands, and shadows cling to her like a second skin.
fr.controlEnglish: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.

fr.text: Une lande écossaise brumeuse au crépuscule. Banquo se tient ferme tandis que trois figures spectrales murmurent des destins dans le vent. Son fantôme hantera les vivants.
fr.english: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.
fr.back: A misty Scottish moor at dusk. Banquo stands firm as three spectral figures whisper destinies in the wind, his ghost haunting the living.
fr.controlEnglish: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.

fr.text: Un rivage d’Illyrie battu par les vents. Viola enfonce un bonnet de marin sur ses cheveux coupés court ; deux identités miroitent dans ses yeux. La mer murmure les secrets de son frère perdu.
fr.english: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.
fr.back: A coast of Illyria beaten by the winds. Viola puts a sailor’s hat on her short-cut hair; two identities shine in her eyes, and the sea whisperes the secrets of her lost brother.
fr.controlEnglish: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.

fr.text: Un jardin ensoleillé dans le domaine d’Olivia. Malvolio se pavane en bas d’un jaune criard, jarretières croisées, tout sourire, serrant contre sa poitrine une fausse lettre d’amour.
fr.english: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.
fr.back: A sunny garden in Olivia’s estate, Malvolio flaunts himself under a screaming yellow, garters crossed, all smiling, holding against his chest a fake love letter.
fr.controlEnglish: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.

fr.text: Une comtesse en deuil soulève son voile et révèle une beauté à couper le souffle. Le jardin d’Olivia fleurit de jasmin et de lavande tandis que le messager déguisé lui vole son cœur.
fr.english: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
fr.back: A mourning countess lifts her veil and reveals a breathtaking beauty, Olivia’s garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
fr.controlEnglish: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.

fr.text: L’amour que l’on recherche est bon, mais donné sans qu’on le recherche, il est meilleur.
fr.english: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.
fr.back: The love we seek is good, but given without seeking it, it is better.
fr.controlEnglish: Marry, that marry is the very theme I came to talk of.

fr.text: Le Sénat romain, ses colonnes de marbre tachées de cramoisi. Brutus se tient parmi les conjurés, la lame encore tremblante. Le poids de la république repose sur ses mains ensanglantées.
fr.english: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.
fr.back: The Roman Senate, its marble columns stained with crimson. Brutus stands among the conjured, the blade still trembling, the weight of the republic resting on his blood-stained hands.
fr.controlEnglish: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.

fr.text: Une ruelle romaine à minuit, à la lueur des torches. Cassius se penche et murmure la sédition, l’air maigre et affamé. De fausses lettres s’échappent de sa toge.
fr.english: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.
fr.back: A Roman alley at midnight, in the glow of torches. Cassius leans over and whispers the sedition, looking skinny and hungry; fake letters escape from his toga.
fr.controlEnglish: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.

fr.text: Le Forum romain éclate de fureur. Marc Antoine brandit devant la foule le manteau ensanglanté de César ; ses mots changent le deuil en feu. La république s’effondre à chaque syllabe.
fr.english: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.
fr.back: The Roman Forum bursts out in fury. Marcus Antonius waves Caesar’s bloody cloak before the crowd; his words turn mourning into fire.The republic collapses at every syllable.
fr.controlEnglish: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.

fr.text: Le domaine des Montaigu à l’aube. Le seigneur Montaigu regarde d’une haute fenêtre son fils errer dans les vergers brumeux, malade d’amour et hors d’atteinte.
fr.english: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.
fr.back: From a high window, the lord of Montaigu watches his son wander through the misty orchards, sick of love and out of reach.
fr.controlEnglish: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.

fr.text: Seigneur Montaigu
La grande salle des Capulet, tendue de soie. Dame Capulet arrange le destin de sa fille comme des fleurs dans un vase ; l’ambition brille derrière chaque sourire gracieux.
fr.english: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.
fr.back: Lady Capulet arranges the fate of her daughter like flowers in a vase; ambition shines behind every graceful smile, and she is always ready to help.
fr.controlEnglish: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.

fr.text: Marier, justement : c’est de te marier que je venais te parler.
fr.english: Marry, that marry is the very theme I came to talk of.
fr.back: Marry, precisely: it is about marrying you that I came to talk to you.
fr.controlEnglish: O brave new world, that has such people in it!

fr.text: Dame Capulet
Les remparts d’Elseneur à l’heure froide qui précède l’aube. Horatio veille aux côtés de Hamlet, seul ami véritable dans une cour de serpents.
fr.english: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.
fr.back: The ramparts of Elseneur in the cold hour before dawn: Horatio watches over Hamlet, his only true friend in a court of snakes.
fr.controlEnglish: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.

fr.text: Une clairière baignée de lumière féerique. Bottom porte une tête d’âne avec une dignité perplexe tandis que Titania le couvre de guirlandes. Les fées étouffent leurs rires.
fr.english: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.
fr.back: A clearing bathed in fairy-like light. Bottom carries a donkey’s head with perplexed dignity while Titania covers it with garlands.
fr.controlEnglish: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.

fr.text: Le cimetière de Vérone au crépuscule. Pâris dépose des fleurs sur le tombeau de Juliette, ignorant l’amant désespéré qui approche dans l’ombre.
fr.english: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.
fr.back: Paris is laying flowers on Juliet’s grave, ignoring the desperate lover who is approaching in the shadows.
fr.controlEnglish: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.

fr.text: Une plage intacte sur l’île de Prospero. Miranda voit pour la première fois les naufragés, les yeux écarquillés d’émerveillement devant un monde dont elle ignorait l’existence.
fr.english: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.
fr.back: A pristine beach on Prospero’s island, Miranda sees the shipwrecked for the first time, her eyes wide open in wonder at a world she had never known existed.
fr.controlEnglish: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.

fr.text: Ô merveilleux nouveau monde, qui compte de pareils habitants !
fr.english: O brave new world, that has such people in it!
fr.back: O wonderful new world, with such inhabitants!
fr.controlEnglish: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.

fr.text: Un anneau d’or repose sur le rebord de pierre d’un balcon et accroche le clair de lune. À l’intérieur est gravé un serment qui survit à la mort même. Des pétales de rose tournoient autour de lui dans un vent invisible.
fr.english: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.
fr.back: A golden ring rests on the stone sill of a balcony and hangs in the moonlight. Inside is engraved an oath that survives even death, rose petals swirl around it in an invisible wind.
fr.controlEnglish: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.

fr.text: L’anneau de Roméo
Trois coffrets luisent dans une chambre éclairée à la bougie : or, argent et plomb. Le coffret de plomb vibre d’une vérité tranquille et récompense ceux qui savent voir au-delà des apparences.
fr.english: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.
fr.back: Three boxes shine in a candlelit room: gold, silver and lead.The lead box vibrates with a quiet truth and rewards those who know how to see beyond appearances.
fr.controlEnglish: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.

fr.text: Le coffret de Portia
Une couronne écossaise ternie repose sur un coussin taché de sang. Elle palpite d’une sombre ambition et murmure des promesses de gloire à toute main qui ose se tendre vers elle.
fr.english: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
fr.back: A tarnished Scottish crown rests on a blood-stained pillow, palpitating with dark ambition and whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
fr.controlEnglish: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.

fr.text: La couronne de Macbeth
Un grimoire ancien, relié d’un cuir patiné par la mer, flotte au-dessus d’un autel de pierre. Ses pages tournent toutes seules, et chacune appelle une tempête différente.
fr.english: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.
fr.back: An ancient grimoire, bound in leather patinated by the sea, floats above a stone altar; its pages turn on their own, each calling for a different storm.
fr.controlEnglish: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.

fr.text: Le codex de la tempête
Une fiole de cristal renferme des larmes qui scintillent comme une lumière d’étoiles captive. Chaque goutte porte le chagrin d’une fille qui aima trop sincèrement et parla trop franchement.
fr.english: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.
fr.back: A crystal vial contains tears that sparkle like captive starlight, each drop bearing the sorrow of a girl who loved too sincerely and spoke too frankly.
fr.controlEnglish: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.

fr.text: Les larmes de Cordélia
Un masque à tête d’âne pend à une branche moussue dans le bois des fées. Qui le revêt voit le monde avec des yeux enchantés, et devient irrésistible aux reines des fées.
fr.english: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.
fr.back: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood; whoever wears it sees the world with enchanted eyes, and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.
fr.controlEnglish: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.

fr.text: Le masque de Bottom

Une racine noueuse, en forme de silhouette hurlante, est déterrée à la lueur d’une bougie. La terre s’effrite et révèle sa puissance ancienne et tordue. L’apothicaire la manie avec un respect tremblant.
fr.english: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.
fr.back: A knotty root, in the shape of a howling silhouette, is dug up under the light of a candle. The earth crumbled and revealed its ancient and twisted power, and the pharmacist handled it with trembling respect.
fr.controlEnglish: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.

fr.text: Racine de mandragore

Une goutte de rosée s’accroche à une orchidée sous la lune et luit d’une lumière violette venue d’ailleurs. Une goutte sur des paupières endormies, et le dormeur s’éprend de la première créature qu’il voit.
fr.english: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.
fr.back: A drop of dew clings to an orchid under the moon and shines with a violet light coming from elsewhere; a drop on sleeping eyelids, and the sleeper gets in love with the first creature he sees.
fr.controlEnglish: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.

fr.text: Rosée d’Obéron
Une fiole de verre noir exhale une vapeur verte dans un couloir obscur. La teinture qu’elle contient a renversé des rois et brisé des dynasties, une goutte silencieuse après l’autre.
fr.english: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.
fr.back: A black glass vial exhales green vapor in a dark corridor, the dye it contains has overthrown kings and broken dynasties, one silent drop after another.
fr.controlEnglish: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.

fr.text: Teinture de ciguë
Des baies pâles luisent parmi de sombres feuilles persistantes, cueillies sous une lune d’hiver. L’extrait vibre de la magie calme et tenace du monde naturel.
fr.english: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.
fr.back: Pale berries gleam among dark evergreen leaves, picked under a winter moon.The extract vibrates with the calm and tenacious magic of the natural world.
fr.controlEnglish: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.

fr.text: Extrait de gui
Un flacon au bouchon de perle renferme un liquide bleu lumineux qui ondule comme une mer vivante. De minuscules coraux y poussent et s’y dissolvent. Il sent le sel et les voyages oubliés.
fr.english: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.
fr.back: A bottle with a pearl stopper contains a luminous blue liquid that waves like a living sea. Tiny corals grow and dissolve in it, it smells of salt and forgotten journeys.
fr.controlEnglish: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.

fr.text: Larmes de sirène

Une boutique d’apothicaire poussiéreuse dans le quartier le plus pauvre de Mantoue. Un élixir du désespoir luit, ambré, dans une fiole fêlée, assez puissant pour franchir l’écart entre la vie et la mort.
fr.english: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
fr.back: In a dusty pharmacy shop in the poorest district of Mantua, an elixir of despair shines amber in a cracked vial, powerful enough to cross the gap between life and death.
fr.controlEnglish: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.

fr.text: Élixir de l’apothicaire
Un tapis de jonquilles dorées s’étend le long des rives d’un lac immobile. Wordsworth marche parmi elles, carnet en main, les monts du Cumberland dressés derrière lui.
fr.english: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.
fr.back: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake, Wordsworth walking among them with his notebook in hand and the mountains of Cumberland standing behind him.
fr.controlEnglish: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.

fr.text: J’errais, solitaire comme un nuage qui flotte bien haut au-dessus des vallons et des collines.
fr.english: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.
fr.back: I would wander, lonely like a cloud that floats high above the valleys and hills.
fr.controlEnglish: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.

fr.text: Un navire encalminé dérive sur un océan peint. Le vieux marin fixe l’albatros pendu à son cou tandis que des figures spectrales montent de la mer de verre.
fr.english: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.
fr.back: The old sailor stares at the albatross hanging around his neck, while spectral figures rise from the sea of glass.
fr.controlEnglish: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.

fr.text: De l’eau, de l’eau partout, et pas une goutte à boire.
fr.english: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.
fr.back: Water, water everywhere, and not a drop to drink.
fr.controlEnglish: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.

fr.text: Un jardin de Hampstead en automne. Keats, assis sous un prunier, écrit fiévreusement tandis qu’un rossignol chante dans les branches qui s’assombrissent.
fr.english: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.
fr.back: Autumn garden in Hampstead, Keats sitting under a plum tree writing feverishly while a nightingale sings in the darkening branches.
fr.controlEnglish: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.

fr.text: Une chose de beauté est une joie pour toujours : son charme ne cesse de croître.
fr.english: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.
fr.back: A thing of beauty is a joy forever: its charm never ceases to grow.
fr.controlEnglish: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.

fr.text: Un palais vénitien à minuit. Byron se tient au balcon, la cape au vent, le regard perdu sur le canal obscur. Derrière lui, un manuscrit inachevé brûle dans la cheminée.
fr.english: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.
fr.back: A Venetian palace at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, his cape in the wind, gazing out over the dark canal, and behind him an unfinished manuscript burning in the fireplace.
fr.controlEnglish: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.

fr.text: Elle marche dans sa beauté, pareille à la nuit des climats sans nuages et des cieux étoilés.
fr.english: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.
fr.back: She walks in her beauty, like the night of cloudless climates and starry skies.
fr.controlEnglish: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.

fr.text: Un cabinet éclairé à la bougie, à Genève, pendant un orage. Mary écrit à la lueur des éclairs tandis que la créature remue dans l’ombre derrière elle. La science et l’horreur ne font plus qu’un.
fr.english: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.
fr.back: A candlelit office in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes in the glow of lightning while the creature moves in the shadows behind her.Science and horror are now one.
fr.controlEnglish: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.

fr.text: Une chambre sombre qu’éclaire un feu mourant. Poe est voûté sur son bureau lorsqu’un corbeau se pose sur le buste de Pallas. Le mot « Jamais plus » résonne dans l’ombre.
fr.english: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.
fr.back: A dark room lit by a dying fire. Poe is vaulted on his desk when a raven lands on Pallas’ bust and the word “Never Again” echoes in the shadows.
fr.controlEnglish: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.

fr.text: Un atelier d’imprimeur à Londres, embrasé d’une lumière visionnaire. Blake grave un tigre dans le cuivre tandis que la bête sort de la plaque, brûlant d’un vif éclat dans les forêts de la nuit.
fr.english: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.
fr.back: A printer’s workshop in London, lit by a visionary light: Blake engraves a tiger into copper as the beast emerges from the plate, burning with a bright glow in the forests of night.
fr.controlEnglish: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.

fr.text: Voir un monde dans un grain de sable et un ciel dans une fleur sauvage.
fr.english: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.
fr.back: See a world in a grain of sand and a sky in a wild flower.
fr.controlEnglish: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.

fr.text: Le sommet d’une falaise italienne battue par les vents. Shelley fait face à l’orage, les bras ouverts, tandis que le vent d’ouest arrache les pages de son carnet et les disperse sur la Méditerranée.
fr.english: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.
fr.back: Shelley faces the storm with her arms open, as the west wind tears away the pages of her notebook and scatters them over the Mediterranean Sea, but she can’t help but wonder if she will ever be able to read it again.
fr.controlEnglish: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.

fr.text: Une chambre ensoleillée à Florence. Elizabeth écrit près d’une fenêtre qui donne sur l’Arno, son épagneul à ses pieds. Les lettres d’amour de Robert sont ouvertes sur le bureau.
fr.english: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.
fr.back: A sunny room in Florence. Elizabeth is writing near a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet, and Robert’s love letters are open on the desk.
fr.controlEnglish: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.

fr.text: Comment je t’aime ? Laisse-moi en compter les façons.
fr.english: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
fr.back: How do I love you? Let me count the ways.
fr.controlEnglish: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.

fr.text: Un jardin préraphaélite dans la lumière déclinante de l’automne. Christina est assise parmi les feuilles mortes et compose des vers douloureux de beauté et de calme résignation.
fr.english: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.
fr.back: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in the fading light of autumn, Christina sits among fallen leaves and composes painful verses of beauty and quiet resignation.
fr.controlEnglish: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.

fr.text: Souviens-toi de moi quand je serai partie, partie au loin dans la terre du silence.
fr.english: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.
fr.back: Remember me when I'm gone, far away in the land of silence.
fr.controlEnglish: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.

fr.text: Le mont Olympe fend le ciel. Zeus siège sur un trône de nuages, la foudre jaillissant entre ses doigts. En bas, le monde des mortels tremble sous son regard.
fr.english: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.
fr.back: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning gushing between his fingers, and beneath him the world of mortals trembled before his eyes.
fr.controlEnglish: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.

fr.text: Je suis l’assembleur de nuées, seigneur des vastes cieux.
fr.english: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.
fr.back: I am the gatherer of clouds, Lord of the expanses of heaven.
fr.controlEnglish: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.

fr.text: Le Parthénon resplendit dans une lumière dorée. Athéna se tient en armure complète, sa chouette perchée sur son bouclier, ses yeux gris perçant toute tromperie mortelle.
fr.english: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.
fr.back: The Parthenon shines in a golden light, Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her gray eyes piercing every deadly deception.
fr.controlEnglish: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.

fr.text: La chouette de la sagesse ne prend son vol qu’au crépuscule.
fr.english: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.
fr.back: The owl of wisdom takes its flight only at dusk.
fr.controlEnglish: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.

fr.text: Un char d’or file dans le ciel de l’aube. Apollon joue de la lyre tandis que la lumière du soleil ruisselle des roues et peint le monde de couleurs.
fr.english: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.
fr.back: A golden chariot races through the dawn sky, Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight streams from the wheels and paints the world in colour.
fr.controlEnglish: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.

fr.text: Je suis le dieu du chant, de la guérison et du soleil radieux.
fr.english: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.
fr.back: I am the god of singing, healing and radiant sunshine.
fr.controlEnglish: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.

fr.text: Les rivages de Chypre à l’aube. Aphrodite surgit de l’écume ; des colombes tournoient au-dessus d’elle et les vagues déposent des perles à ses pieds. Le monde retient son souffle.
fr.english: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.
fr.back: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from the foam, doves swirl over her and waves drop pearls at her feet.The world holds its breath.
fr.controlEnglish: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.

fr.text: Même les dieux ne peuvent résister au pouvoir de l’amour.
fr.english: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
fr.back: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
fr.controlEnglish: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.

fr.text: Un éclair de sandales ailées traverse le ciel. Hermès se faufile entre les foudres, un message divin serré dans une main et un sourire de voleur aux lèvres.
fr.english: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.
fr.back: A lightning bolt of winged sandals crosses the sky, and Hermes sneaks between the thunderbolts with a divine message in one hand and a thief’s smile on his lips.
fr.controlEnglish: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.

fr.text: Rapide comme la pensée, je porte les paroles des dieux aux oreilles des mortels.
fr.english: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.
fr.back: Fast as thought, I carry the words of the gods to the ears of mortals.
fr.controlEnglish: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.

fr.text: La salle du trône des Enfers, éclairée par des fleuves de feu pâle. Hadès siège avec Cerbère à ses pieds, son casque de ténèbres posé sur l’accoudoir. Les morts défilent dans un silence sans fin.
fr.english: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.
fr.back: The throne room of the underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helmet of darkness resting on the armrest.The dead march in endless silence.
fr.controlEnglish: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.

fr.text: Toutes les âmes viennent à moi à la fin. Je suis patient.
fr.english: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
fr.back: All souls come to me at the end. I am patient.
fr.controlEnglish: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.

fr.text: Un trône partagé entre le printemps et l’ombre. Perséphone tient une grenade dans une main et une couronne de fleurs dans l’autre, reine de deux royaumes.
fr.english: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.
fr.back: A throne shared between spring and shadow, Persephone holding a pomegranate in one hand and a wreath of flowers in the other, queen of two kingdoms.
fr.controlEnglish: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.

fr.text: J’ai mangé six graines, et je me suis liée pour toujours entre deux mondes.
fr.english: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.
fr.back: I ate six seeds, and forever bound myself between two worlds.
fr.controlEnglish: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.

fr.text: Un navire battu par la tempête double un cap rocheux. Ulysse s’attache au mât tandis que les Sirènes chantent du haut des falaises. Le souvenir d’Ithaque brûle dans ses yeux.
fr.english: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.
fr.back: A storm-hit ship is passing a rocky cape. Odysseus attaches himself to the mast while the Sirens sing from the top of the cliffs, with the memory of Ithaca burning in his eyes.
fr.controlEnglish: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.

fr.text: Dis-moi, ô Muse, l’homme aux mille détours, qui erra si longtemps.
fr.english: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.
fr.back: Tell me, O Muse, the man of a thousand turns, who wandered so long.
fr.controlEnglish: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.

fr.text: Un temple en ruine au bord du monde. Méduse se retourne, sa chevelure de serpents sifflant. Des guerriers de pierre jonchent le sol, figés dans leur dernière charge.
fr.english: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.
fr.back: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns around, her snake-haired hair whistling, and stone warriors scatter the ground, frozen in their last charge.
fr.controlEnglish: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.

fr.text: Regarde-moi, si tu l’oses. Mon regard est la dernière chose que tu verras.
fr.english: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.
fr.back: Look at me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.
fr.controlEnglish: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.

fr.text: Les plaines de Troie à l’aube. Achille charge dans une armure flamboyante, son cri de guerre fendant l’air. Derrière lui, les navires grecs brûlent sur le rivage.
fr.english: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.
fr.back: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in flaming armor, his war cry rising through the air, and behind him the Greek ships are burning on the shore.
fr.controlEnglish: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.

fr.text: J’aime mieux vivre une courte vie de gloire qu’une longue vie d’oubli.
fr.english: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.
fr.back: I prefer to live a short life of glory than a long life of oblivion.
fr.controlEnglish: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.
