hi.text: एक भव्य मंच प्रकट होता है। The Sonnet Man हाथ में माइक्रोफ़ोन लिए सुनहरी स्पॉटलाइट से आगे बढ़ता है। शेक्सपीयर के शब्द हिप-हॉप की पंक्तियों में बदल जाते हैं और दर्शक जयकार करते हैं।
hi.english: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.
hi.back: A grand stage appears. The Sonnet Man moves forward from the golden spotlight with a microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words turn into hip-hop lines and the audience cheers.
hi.controlEnglish: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.

hi.text: क्या मैं तुम्हारी तुलना गर्मी के दिन से करूँ?
hi.english: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
hi.back: Should I compare you to a summer day?
hi.controlEnglish: But soft, what light through yonder window breaks?

hi.text: चाँदनी में नहाई बालकनी का दृश्य खुलता है। रोमियो ऊपर की ओर हाथ बढ़ाता है और ऊपर जूलियट प्रकट होती है। हवा में गुलाब की पंखुड़ियाँ तैरती हैं और पूरा दृश्य गर्म लाल आभा से धड़कता है।
hi.english: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.
hi.back: The view of the moonlit balcony opens. Romeo reaches up and Juliet appears above. Rose petals float in the air and the whole scene pulses with a warm red glow.
hi.controlEnglish: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.

hi.text: पर ठहरो, उस खिड़की से यह कैसा उजाला फूट रहा है?
hi.english: But soft, what light through yonder window breaks?
hi.back: But wait, what kind of light is coming out of that window?
hi.controlEnglish: What's in a name? That which we call a rose...

hi.text: चाँदनी में कैपुलेट परिवार का बाग़ खिल उठता है। जूलियट गुलाबों के बीच खड़ी है और उसकी आँखों में विद्रोह की चमक है। ऊपर की डालियों से एक बुलबुल गाती है।
hi.english: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.
hi.back: The Capulet garden blooms in the moonlight. Juliet stands among the roses with a gleam of rebellion in her eyes. A bubble sings from the top leaves.
hi.controlEnglish: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.

hi.text: नाम में क्या रखा है? जिसे हम गुलाब कहते हैं...
hi.english: What's in a name? That which we call a rose...
hi.back: What's in the name, that we call Rose...
hi.controlEnglish: To be, or not to be, that is the question.

hi.text: एल्सिनोर का क़िला अँधेरे से उभरता है। हैमलेट प्राचीर पर खड़ा है और योरिक की खोपड़ी उसके पास हवा में तैर रही है। ऊपर परकोटे पर एक प्रेत-सी आकृति दिखाई देती है।
hi.english: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.
hi.back: The castle of Elsinore emerges from the darkness. Hamlet is standing on the tower and Yorick's skull floats in the air near him. A ghost-like figure appears at the top.
hi.controlEnglish: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.

hi.text: जीना या न जीना, यही प्रश्न है।
hi.english: To be, or not to be, that is the question.
hi.back: To live or not to live, that's the question.
hi.controlEnglish: There's rosemary, that's for remembrance.

hi.text: एक कोमल धारा बेंत के कुंज से होकर बलखाती बहती है। ओफ़ीलिया जंगली फूलों के बीच तैरती है और भूले हुए छंद फुसफुसाती है। पंखुड़ियाँ धारा में चक्कर काटती हैं।
hi.english: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.
hi.back: A gentle stream gushes through the springs of Bent. Ophelia swims among wild flowers and whisperes forgotten verses. The petals twirl in the stream.
hi.controlEnglish: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.

hi.text: यह रोज़मेरी है, यह याद के लिए है।
hi.english: There's rosemary, that's for remembrance.
hi.back: It's rosemary, it's for remembering.
hi.controlEnglish: A plague on both your houses!

hi.text: वेरोना की एक गली में कोलाहल फूट पड़ता है। मरकूशियो तलवारों के बीच नाचता है और ख़तरे के सामने हँसता है। टकराते फ़ौलाद से चिंगारियाँ उड़ती हैं।
hi.english: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.
hi.back: In one of Verona's alleys, a tumult breaks out. Marcoussio dances among swords and laughs in the face of danger.
hi.controlEnglish: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.

hi.text: तुम दोनों घरानों पर महामारी पड़े!
hi.english: A plague on both your houses!
hi.back: May the plague befall you both families!
hi.controlEnglish: Lord, what fools these mortals be!

hi.text: जादुई वन शरारत से झिलमिलाता है। Puck प्राचीन बलूतों के बीच फुर्ती से दौड़ता है और पीछे परियों की धूल की लकीरें छोड़ जाता है। नीचे सोए हुए मनुष्य अजीब सपने देखते हैं।
hi.english: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.
hi.back: The magical forest sparkles with ferocity. Puck runs swiftly among the ancient blooms, leaving traces of fairy dust behind him. The sleeping men below have strange dreams.
hi.controlEnglish: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.

hi.text: हे प्रभु, ये नश्वर लोग कितने मूर्ख हैं!
hi.english: Lord, what fools these mortals be!
hi.back: O Lord, how foolish these mortals are!
hi.controlEnglish: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.

hi.text: वन की धरती से जीवित लताओं का एक सिंहासन उठता है। टाइटेनिया अपने परी-दरबार को आदेश देती है और जुगनू पेड़ों की छतरी को रोशन करते हैं। स्वयं प्रकृति उसकी इच्छा के आगे झुकती है।
hi.english: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.
hi.back: A throne of living lilies rises from the ground of the forest. Titania commands her fairy court, and jugnous trees illuminate the shade. Nature itself bows to her will.
hi.controlEnglish: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.

hi.text: आओ, इस पुष्पों की सेज पर विराजो।
hi.english: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.
hi.back: Come, bestow on this bouquet of flowers.
hi.controlEnglish: Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio.

hi.text: एक धुँधले तहख़ाने में मख़मल पर एक खोपड़ी रखी है। प्रेत-सी हँसी गूँजती है और दरबारी विदूषक की यादें मोमबत्ती की लौ की तरह टिमटिमाती हैं।
hi.english: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.
hi.back: A skull is placed on a carpet in a hazy attic. Ghostly laughter echoes and memories of the court magician twinkle like candle flames.
hi.controlEnglish: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.

hi.text: हाय, बेचारा योरिक! मैं उसे जानता था, होरेशियो।
hi.english: Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio.
hi.back: I knew him, Horacio.
hi.controlEnglish: Now my charms are all o'erthrown.

hi.text: योरिक की खोपड़ी
hi.english: Yorick's Skull
hi.back: Yorick's Skull
hi.controlEnglish: Prospero's Staff

hi.text: एक गाँठदार छड़ी रहस्यमयी ऊर्जा से चटचटाती है। उसके चारों ओर तूफ़ान घुमड़ता है और प्रॉस्पेरो अपना अंतिम मंत्र फुसफुसाता है। बिजली आकाश को चीर देती है।
hi.english: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.
hi.back: A knotted wand shakes with mysterious energy. A storm swirls around it and Prospero whisperes his final spell. Lightning tears the sky.
hi.controlEnglish: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.

hi.text: अब मेरे सारे मंत्र टूट चुके हैं।
hi.english: Now my charms are all o'erthrown.
hi.back: Now all my mantras are broken.
hi.controlEnglish: The course of true love never did run smooth.

hi.text: प्रॉस्पेरो की छड़ी
hi.english: Prospero's Staff
hi.back: Prospero's Wand
hi.controlEnglish: Love Potion

hi.text: एक चमकती शीशी गुलाबी रोशनी से धड़कती है। उसकी सतह से दिल ऊपर की ओर तैरते हैं और हवा में एक मीठी धुन भर जाती है।
hi.english: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.
hi.back: A sparkling glass beats with pink light, hearts float up from its surface and a sweet melody fills the air.
hi.controlEnglish: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.

hi.text: सच्चे प्रेम की राह कभी सीधी नहीं रही।
hi.english: The course of true love never did run smooth.
hi.back: The path of true love has never been straight.
hi.controlEnglish: Double, double toil and trouble.

hi.text: प्रेम औषधि
hi.english: Love Potion
hi.back: Love medication
hi.controlEnglish: Witches' Brew

hi.text: एक उबलती कड़ाही हरा धुआँ उगलती है। तीन धुँधली आकृतियाँ मंत्र गाती हुई उसके चारों ओर घूमती हैं। दूर अँधेरे जंगल से आँखें चमकती हैं।
hi.english: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.
hi.back: A boiling cauldron emits green smoke. Three hazy figures circle around it chanting mantras. Eyes shine from the dark forest in the distance.
hi.controlEnglish: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.

hi.text: दुगुनी, दुगुनी मेहनत और मुसीबत।
hi.english: Double, double toil and trouble.
hi.back: Double, double hard work and trouble.
hi.controlEnglish: If ever you disturb our streets again, your lives shall pay the forfeit of the peace.

hi.text: चुड़ैलों का काढ़ा
hi.english: Witches' Brew
hi.back: Sorcerer's Potion
hi.controlEnglish: Dagger of the Mind

hi.text: राजकुमार वेरोना के महल की सीढ़ियों पर खड़ा है और उसकी आवाज़ झगड़ती भीड़ को चुप करा देती है। एक सुनहरा राजदंड अधिकार से दहकता है।
hi.english: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.
hi.back: The prince is standing on the stairs of Verona's palace and his voice silenced the quarrelsome crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.
hi.controlEnglish: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.

hi.text: यदि तुमने फिर कभी हमारी गलियों की शांति भंग की, तो तुम्हारे प्राण उसका दंड भरेंगे।
hi.english: If ever you disturb our streets again, your lives shall pay the forfeit of the peace.
hi.back: If you ever disturb the peace of our streets again, your soul will pay for it.
hi.controlEnglish: These violent delights have violent ends.

hi.text: एक मठ की मोमबत्ती से रोशन कोठरी। संन्यासी जड़ी-बूटियों और विषों की अपनी बगिया सँभालता है, और उसके झुर्रियों भरे चेहरे पर बुद्धिमत्ता उकेरी हुई है।
hi.english: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.
hi.back: A monastery chamber lit by candles. The monk cares for his garden of herbs and poisons, and wisdom is engraved on his wrinkled face.
hi.controlEnglish: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.

hi.text: इन उग्र आनंदों का अंत भी उग्र होता है।
hi.english: These violent delights have violent ends.
hi.back: These violent pleasures also end in violence.
hi.controlEnglish: I am the drudge and toil in your delight.

hi.text: कैपुलेट घर की एक गर्म रसोई। धाय पूरे समर्पण के साथ भागदौड़ करती है और उसके एप्रन में एक गुप्त चिट्ठी छिपी है।
hi.english: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.
hi.back: A hot kitchen in the Capulet house. Dhai runs around with full devotion and hides a secret letter in her apron.
hi.controlEnglish: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.

hi.text: मैं तो दासी हूँ, तुम्हारी खुशी के लिए खटती हूँ।
hi.english: I am the drudge and toil in your delight.
hi.back: I am a slave, working hard for your pleasure.
hi.controlEnglish: We are such stuff as dreams are made on.

hi.text: तूफ़ान में लिपटा एक द्वीप। प्रॉस्पेरो अपने हाथ उठाता है और बिजली उसकी इच्छा मानती है, समुद्र उसके आदेश पर मथता है।
hi.english: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.
hi.back: An island enveloped in a storm, Prospero raises his hand and the lightning obeys his will, the sea melts at his command.
hi.controlEnglish: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.

hi.text: हम उसी पदार्थ के बने हैं जिससे सपने बनते हैं।
hi.english: We are such stuff as dreams are made on.
hi.back: We are made of the same substance that makes dreams.
hi.controlEnglish: All hail, great master! Grave sir, hail!

hi.text: एक झिलमिलाती आत्मा हवा और रोशनी में घुल जाती है और फिर संगीत बनकर लौटती है। Ariel दृश्य और अदृश्य के बीच नाचता है।
hi.english: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.
hi.back: A sparkling spirit melts into the air and light and then returns as music. Ariel dances between visible and invisible.
hi.controlEnglish: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.

hi.text: जय हो, महान स्वामी! गंभीर महोदय, जय हो!
hi.english: All hail, great master! Grave sir, hail!
hi.back: Hail, Great Master!
hi.controlEnglish: This island's mine, by Sycorax my mother.

hi.text: एक जंगली तट पर गुफा का मुहाना। Caliban चट्टानों के बीच दुबका बैठा है और उसकी आँखें आक्रोश और आदिम बुद्धि से जल रही हैं।
hi.english: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.
hi.back: At the mouth of a cave on a wild coast, Caliban sits dumbfounded among the rocks with his eyes burning with rage and primitive intelligence.
hi.controlEnglish: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.

hi.text: यह द्वीप मेरा है, मेरी माँ सिकोरैक्स से मिला।
hi.english: This island's mine, by Sycorax my mother.
hi.back: This island is mine, I got it from my mother Sicorax.
hi.controlEnglish: I do but keep the peace. Put up thy sword.

hi.text: भोर में वेरोना का एक चौक। बेनवोलियो खिंची हुई तलवारों के बीच खड़ा है; उमड़ते तूफ़ान के विरुद्ध उसके खुले हाथ ही उसका एकमात्र हथियार हैं।
hi.english: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.
hi.back: A square in Verona at dawn. Benvolio stands among drawn swords; his open hands are his only weapon against the rising storm.
hi.controlEnglish: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.

hi.text: मैं तो बस शांति बनाए रख रहा हूँ। अपनी तलवार म्यान में रखो।
hi.english: I do but keep the peace. Put up thy sword.
hi.back: I'm just keeping the peace, put your sword in its sheath.
hi.controlEnglish: What, drawn, and talk of peace? I hate the word.

hi.text: मशालों की रोशनी से दहकती वेरोना की एक गली। टाइबल्ट घातक कुशलता से अपनी तलवार खींचता है और उसकी नज़रें अपने शत्रु पर गड़ी हैं।
hi.english: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.
hi.back: The streets of Verona are lit with candles. Tiberius draws his sword with deadly skill and his eyes are fixed on his enemy.
hi.controlEnglish: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.

hi.text: क्या, तलवार खींचकर शांति की बात? मुझे इस शब्द से घृणा है।
hi.english: What, drawn, and talk of peace? I hate the word.
hi.back: What, sword drawn peace talk? I hate that word.
hi.controlEnglish: My words fly up, my thoughts remain below.

hi.text: एल्सिनोर का दरबार-कक्ष, झूठी शान-शौकत में लिपटा। क्लॉडियस मुकुट को जकड़े हुए है और उसके वस्त्रों में विष की एक शीशी छिपी है।
hi.english: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.
hi.back: Elsinore's courtroom, enveloped in false splendor, Claudius holding the crown and a vial of poison hidden in his garments.
hi.controlEnglish: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.

hi.text: मेरे शब्द ऊपर उड़ते हैं, मेरे विचार नीचे रह जाते हैं।
hi.english: My words fly up, my thoughts remain below.
hi.back: My words fly up, my thoughts stay down.
hi.controlEnglish: Ill met by moonlight, proud Titania.

hi.text: जादुई वन की गहराई में चाँदनी से भरा एक खुला मैदान। Oberon अँधेरे से प्रकट होता है और बारहसिंगे के सींगों से बना उसका मुकुट चाँदी-सी रोशनी पकड़ता है।
hi.english: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.
hi.back: Deep in the magical forest, an open field filled with moonlight. Oberon emerges from the darkness and his crown made of ivory horns catches silvery light.
hi.controlEnglish: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.

hi.text: चाँदनी में यह भेंट अशुभ है, घमंडी टाइटेनिया।
hi.english: Ill met by moonlight, proud Titania.
hi.back: This is an unfortunate encounter on the moon, haughty Titania.
hi.controlEnglish: Is this a dagger which I see before me?

hi.text: अँधेरे में एक प्रेत-सा खंजर तैरता है और उसके फल से माया का रक्त टपकता है। मैकबेथ का हाथ उसकी ओर बढ़ता है, पर उसे कभी पकड़ नहीं पाता।
hi.english: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.
hi.back: A ghostly dagger floats in the darkness, and from its fruit flows Maya's blood. Macbeth's hand reaches for it, but never gets hold of it.
hi.controlEnglish: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.

hi.text: क्या यह खंजर है जो मैं अपने सामने देखता हूँ?
hi.english: Is this a dagger which I see before me?
hi.back: Is this the dagger I see in front of me?
hi.controlEnglish: I'll put a girdle round about the earth in forty minutes.

hi.text: मन का खंजर
hi.english: Dagger of the Mind
hi.back: dagger of hearts
hi.controlEnglish: Puck's Flower Juice

hi.text: एक कुचला हुआ बैंगनी फूल प्रतीक्षा करती हथेली में इंद्रधनुषी मकरंद टपकाता है। जहाँ भी वह गिरता है, आँखें बदल जाती हैं — और दिल उनके पीछे चल पड़ते हैं।
hi.english: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.
hi.back: A crushed purple flower drops a rainbow dragonfly into the waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow them.
hi.controlEnglish: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.

hi.text: मैं चालीस मिनट में धरती के चारों ओर पट्टा बाँध दूँगा।
hi.english: I'll put a girdle round about the earth in forty minutes.
hi.back: I'll tie the belt around the earth in forty minutes.
hi.controlEnglish: I dare do all that may become a man; who dares do more is none.

hi.text: पक के फूल का रस
hi.english: Puck's Flower Juice
hi.back: The juice of a flower.
hi.controlEnglish: Lord Montague

hi.text: डनसिनेन का रक्त से सना दरबार-कक्ष। मैकबेथ काँपते हाथों से अपनी तलवार पकड़े है और मुकुट उसके माथे पर भारी है। दूर पहाड़ी पर बर्नम का जंगल हिलता है।
hi.english: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.
hi.back: The blood-stained courtroom of Dunsinane. Macbeth holds his sword in trembling hands and the crown is heavy on his forehead.
hi.controlEnglish: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.

hi.text: जो कुछ एक पुरुष को शोभा देता है, वह सब करने का साहस मुझमें है; जो उससे अधिक साहस करे, वह पुरुष नहीं।
hi.english: I dare do all that may become a man; who dares do more is none.
hi.back: I have the courage to do everything that befits a man; whoever dares more than that is not a man.
hi.controlEnglish: Come, you spirits that tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here.

hi.text: स्कॉटलैंड के क़िले का मोमबत्ती से रोशन एक कक्ष। लेडी मैकबेथ ठंडे पत्थरों पर बेचैनी से टहलती है और अपने हाथों से रक्त के माया-धब्बे मलती रहती है। परछाइयाँ दूसरी त्वचा की तरह उससे चिपकी हैं।
hi.english: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.
hi.back: A candlelit chamber in the Castle of Scotland. Lady Macbeth wanders anxiously on cold rocks and wipes magic stains of blood with her hands. Shadows stick to her like a second skin.
hi.controlEnglish: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.

hi.text: आओ, हत्या के विचारों की सेवा करने वाली आत्माओ, यहीं मेरा स्त्रीत्व छीन लो।
hi.english: Come, you spirits that tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here.
hi.back: Come, spirits serving the ideas of murder, take away my femininity here.
hi.controlEnglish: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.

hi.text: गोधूलि में धुंध से ढका स्कॉटलैंड का एक बंजर मैदान। बैंको अडिग खड़ा है और तीन प्रेत-आकृतियाँ हवा में भाग्य की बातें फुसफुसाती हैं। उसका प्रेत जीवितों को सताएगा।
hi.english: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.
hi.back: A barren plain of Scotland, covered in fog and smoke. Banko stands firmly and three ghost-figures whisper fateful words in the air. His ghost will haunt the living.
hi.controlEnglish: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.

hi.text: तू राजाओं को जन्म देगा, भले ही तू स्वयं राजा न हो।
hi.english: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.
hi.back: You will give birth to kings, even though you are not a king yourself.
hi.controlEnglish: I am not what I am.

hi.text: इल्लुरिया का हवाओं से घिरा एक तट। Viola अपने छोटे कटे बालों पर नाविक की टोपी खींच लेती है और उसकी आँखों में दो जुड़वाँ पहचानें झिलमिलाती हैं। समुद्र उसके खोए भाई के रहस्य फुसफुसाता है।
hi.english: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.
hi.back: A windswept shore of Illyria. Viola pulls a sailor's hat over her short cut hair and twin identities glimmer in her eyes. The sea whispers the mystery of her lost brother.
hi.controlEnglish: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.

hi.text: मैं वह नहीं हूँ जो दिखती हूँ।
hi.english: I am not what I am.
hi.back: I'm not who I look like.
hi.controlEnglish: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them.

hi.text: Olivia की जागीर में धूप से भरा एक बाग़। मालवोलियो भड़कीले पीले मोज़ों में, आड़ी पट्टियाँ बाँधे, मुस्कुराता हुआ अकड़कर चलता है और एक जाली प्रेम-पत्र को सीने से लगाए है।
hi.english: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.
hi.back: A sunny garden on Olivia's estate. Malvolio walks in bright yellow socks, ties horizontal stripes, grins and holds a fake love letter on his chest.
hi.controlEnglish: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.

hi.text: कुछ लोग महान जन्म लेते हैं, कुछ महानता पा लेते हैं, और कुछ पर महानता थोप दी जाती है।
hi.english: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them.
hi.back: Some people are born great, some attain greatness, and some have greatness imposed upon them.
hi.controlEnglish: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.

hi.text: शोक में डूबी एक काउंटेस अपना घूँघट उठाती है और साँसें थाम देने वाला सौंदर्य प्रकट होता है। Olivia का बाग़ चमेली और लैवेंडर से खिल उठता है और वेश बदले हुए दूत उसका दिल चुरा लेता है।
hi.english: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
hi.back: A mourning Countess lifts her wreath and a breathtaking beauty reveals herself. Olivia's garden blooms with chamomile and lavender, and an angel in disguise steals her heart.
hi.controlEnglish: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.

hi.text: माँगा हुआ प्रेम अच्छा है, पर बिना माँगे मिला प्रेम और अच्छा है।
hi.english: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.
hi.back: It's good to ask for love, but it's even better to get it without asking.
hi.controlEnglish: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.

hi.text: रोम की सीनेट, संगमरमर के खंभे लाल रंग से सने हुए। Brutus षड्यंत्रकारियों के बीच खड़ा है और उसकी तलवार अब भी काँप रही है। गणराज्य का भार उसके रक्त से सने हाथों पर टिका है।
hi.english: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.
hi.back: The Senate of Rome, the marble pillars stained with red. Brutus stands among the conspirators and his sword still trembles. The weight of the Republic rests on his blood-stained hands.
hi.controlEnglish: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.

hi.text: यह नहीं कि मैं सीज़र से कम प्रेम करता था, बल्कि यह कि मैं रोम से अधिक प्रेम करता था।
hi.english: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.
hi.back: It's not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.
hi.controlEnglish: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.

hi.text: आधी रात को मशालों से रोशन रोम की एक गली। कैसियस पास झुककर, दुबली और भूखी नज़रों के साथ, विद्रोह की बातें फुसफुसाता है। उसके टोगा से जाली चिट्ठियाँ गिर रही हैं।
hi.english: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.
hi.back: A street of Rome lit by candles in the middle of the night. Cassius bent over, with thin and hungry eyes, whispering rebellious words. Fake letters are falling from his toga.
hi.controlEnglish: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.

hi.text: दोष, प्रिय ब्रूटस, हमारे सितारों में नहीं, हम में ही है।
hi.english: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.
hi.back: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, it's in us.
hi.controlEnglish: Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!

hi.text: रोम का फ़ोरम क्रोध से भड़क उठता है। मार्कस आंतोनियस भीड़ के सामने सीसर का रक्त से सना लबादा ऊँचा उठाता है और उसके शब्द शोक को आग में बदल देते हैं। हर शब्द के साथ गणराज्य ढहता जाता है।
hi.english: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.
hi.back: The Forum of Rome bursts into fury. Marcus Antonius lifts up Caesar's blood-soaked robe in front of the crowd and his words turn mourning into fire. With each word, the Republic collapses.
hi.controlEnglish: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.

hi.text: मित्रो, रोमवासियो, देशवासियो, मुझे अपने कान उधार दो!
hi.english: Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!
hi.back: Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!
hi.controlEnglish: Many a morning hath he there been seen, with tears augmenting the fresh morning dew.

hi.text: भोर में मोंटेग्यू की जागीर। लॉर्ड मोंटेग्यू एक ऊँची खिड़की से अपने बेटे को नीचे धुंध भरे बग़ीचों में भटकते देखते हैं — प्रेम में बीमार, पहुँच से परे।
hi.english: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.
hi.back: Montagu's Manor at dawn. Lord Montagu watches through a high window as his son wanders down the misty gardens — ill in love, out of reach.
hi.controlEnglish: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.

hi.text: कितनी ही सुबह वह वहाँ देखा गया है, अपने आँसुओं से भोर की ताज़ा ओस बढ़ाते हुए।
hi.english: Many a morning hath he there been seen, with tears augmenting the fresh morning dew.
hi.back: How many mornings he has been seen there, raising the fresh dew of dawn with his tears.
hi.controlEnglish: Marry, that marry is the very theme I came to talk of.

hi.text: लॉर्ड मोंटेग्यू
hi.english: Lord Montague
hi.back: Lord Montagu
hi.controlEnglish: Lady Capulet

hi.text: रेशम से सजा कैपुलेट परिवार का बड़ा कक्ष। लेडी कैपुलेट अपनी बेटी की नियति को गुलदान में फूलों की तरह सजाती है और हर शालीन मुस्कान के पीछे महत्वाकांक्षा झिलमिलाती है।
hi.english: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.
hi.back: The large room of the Capulet family is decorated with silk. Lady Capulet adorns her daughter's destiny like flowers in a flowerpot, and behind every graceful smile there glitters ambition.
hi.controlEnglish: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.

hi.text: विवाह, इसी विवाह की बात करने तो मैं आई हूँ।
hi.english: Marry, that marry is the very theme I came to talk of.
hi.back: I'm here to talk about marriage.
hi.controlEnglish: Now cracks a noble heart. Good night, sweet prince.

hi.text: लेडी कैपुलेट
hi.english: Lady Capulet
hi.back: Lady Capulet
hi.controlEnglish: Romeo's Ring

hi.text: भोर से पहले की ठंडी घड़ी में एल्सिनोर की प्राचीर। होरेशियो हैमलेट के पास पहरे पर खड़ा है — साँपों के दरबार में एकमात्र सच्चा मित्र।
hi.english: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.
hi.back: The tower of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio is standing guard near Hamlet — the only true friend at the court of snakes.
hi.controlEnglish: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.

hi.text: अब एक महान हृदय टूटता है। शुभ रात्रि, प्यारे राजकुमार।
hi.english: Now cracks a noble heart. Good night, sweet prince.
hi.back: Now a great heart breaks. Good night, dear prince.
hi.controlEnglish: I have had a most rare vision. I have had a dream, past the wit of man.

hi.text: परियों की रोशनी से जगमगाता वन का एक खुला मैदान। बॉटम हैरान गरिमा के साथ गधे का सिर पहने है और टाइटेनिया उसे मालाओं से लाद देती है। परियाँ अपनी हँसी दबाती हैं।
hi.english: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.
hi.back: An open field in the forest glows with fairy lights. Bottom wears a donkey's head with amazed dignity and Titania loads him with wreaths. Fairies suppress their laughter.
hi.controlEnglish: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.

hi.text: मैंने एक बड़ा अनोखा दृश्य देखा है। मैंने एक सपना देखा है, जो मनुष्य की बुद्धि से परे है।
hi.english: I have had a most rare vision. I have had a dream, past the wit of man.
hi.back: I have seen a great and extraordinary sight, I have seen a dream beyond the understanding of man.
hi.controlEnglish: These times of woe afford no time to woo.

hi.text: संध्या समय वेरोना के गिरजाघर का क़ब्रिस्तान। काउंट पेरिस जूलियट की समाधि पर फूल रखता है, इस बात से अनजान कि परछाइयों से एक हताश प्रेमी आ रहा है।
hi.english: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.
hi.back: In the evening, in Verona's cathedral cemetery, Count Paris lays flowers on Juliet's tombstone, unaware that a desperate lover is coming from the shadows.
hi.controlEnglish: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.

hi.text: शोक के इन दिनों में प्रणय के लिए समय नहीं है।
hi.english: These times of woe afford no time to woo.
hi.back: There is no time for romance in these days of mourning.
hi.controlEnglish: O brave new world, that has such people in it!

hi.text: प्रॉस्पेरो के द्वीप का एक अछूता समुद्र-तट। मिरांडा पहली बार डूबे जहाज़ के नाविकों को देखती है और उसकी आँखें उस दुनिया पर अचरज से फैली हैं जिसके होने का उसे कभी पता ही न था।
hi.english: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.
hi.back: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the sailors of a sunken ship for the first time and her eyes are wide open in amazement at a world she never knew existed.
hi.controlEnglish: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.

hi.text: ओ अद्भुत नई दुनिया, जिसमें ऐसे लोग बसते हैं!
hi.english: O brave new world, that has such people in it!
hi.back: O wonderful new world, inhabited by such people!
hi.controlEnglish: My bounty is as boundless as the sea, my love as deep.

hi.text: पत्थर की बालकनी के किनारे सोने की एक अंगूठी रखी है जो चाँदनी पकड़ती है। उसके भीतर एक वचन खुदा है जो मृत्यु से भी आगे टिकता है। अनदेखी हवा में गुलाब की पंखुड़ियाँ उसके चारों ओर घूमती हैं।
hi.english: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.
hi.back: On the edge of a stone balcony is a gold ring that holds the moon. Inside it is a word of God that endures beyond death. Rose petals swirl around it in the unseen air.
hi.controlEnglish: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.

hi.text: मेरी उदारता सागर जैसी असीम है, मेरा प्रेम उतना ही गहरा।
hi.english: My bounty is as boundless as the sea, my love as deep.
hi.back: My generosity is as infinite as the ocean, my love as deep.
hi.controlEnglish: All that glisters is not gold.

hi.text: रोमियो की अंगूठी
hi.english: Romeo's Ring
hi.back: Romeo's Ring
hi.controlEnglish: Portia's Casket

hi.text: मोमबत्ती से रोशन एक कक्ष में तीन पेटियाँ चमकती हैं — सोना, चाँदी और सीसा। सीसे की पेटी शांत सत्य से गुनगुनाती है और उन्हें पुरस्कार देती है जो दिखावे के पार देख सकें।
hi.english: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.
hi.back: In a candlelit room, three boxes shine – gold, silver and lead. The lead box sings the quiet truth and rewards those who can see beyond appearance.
hi.controlEnglish: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.

hi.text: हर चमकती चीज़ सोना नहीं होती।
hi.english: All that glisters is not gold.
hi.back: Not everything that shines is gold.
hi.controlEnglish: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.

hi.text: पोर्टिया की पेटी
hi.english: Portia's Casket
hi.back: Portia's Box
hi.controlEnglish: Macbeth's Crown

hi.english: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
hi.back: A dusty Scottish crown is laid on a blood-stained pillow, beating with dark ambition and whispering promises of pride from every hand that dares to reach it.
hi.controlEnglish: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.

hi.text: मुकुट पहनने वाला सिर बेचैन सोता है।
hi.english: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.
hi.back: The crowned head sleeps restlessly.
hi.controlEnglish: I'll drown my book.

hi.text: मैकबेथ का मुकुट
hi.english: Macbeth's Crown
hi.back: Macbeth's Crown
hi.controlEnglish: The Tempest Codex

hi.text: समुद्र से घिसे चमड़े में बँधा एक प्राचीन ग्रंथ पत्थर की वेदी के ऊपर तैरता है। उसके पन्ने अपने-आप पलटते हैं और हर पन्ना एक अलग तूफ़ान बुलाता है।
hi.english: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.
hi.back: An ancient scripture, bound in sea-washed leather, floats above a stone altar. Its pages flip by themselves and each page calls forth a different storm.
hi.controlEnglish: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.

hi.text: मैं अपनी पुस्तक डुबो दूँगा।
hi.english: I'll drown my book.
hi.back: I'll sink my book.
hi.controlEnglish: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.

hi.text: तूफ़ान की पोथी
hi.english: The Tempest Codex
hi.back: Storm Book

hi.text: बिल्लौर की एक शीशी में ऐसे आँसू हैं जो क़ैद की हुई तारों की रोशनी की तरह झिलमिलाते हैं। हर बूँद में उस बेटी का दुख है जिसने बहुत सच्चा प्रेम किया और बहुत साफ़ बोली।
hi.english: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.
hi.back: There are tears in a glass of Billore that twinkle like the light of imprisoned stars. In every drop is the sadness of the daughter who loved so truly and spoke so clearly.
hi.controlEnglish: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.

hi.english: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.
hi.back: O dear Father, I am engaged in your work.
hi.controlEnglish: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!

hi.text: कॉर्डेलिया के आँसू
hi.english: Cordelia's Tears
hi.back: Cordelia's Tears

hi.back: In the fairy forest, a donkey-headed mask hangs from a thicket covered with moss. Whoever wears it sees the world through magical eyes — and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.
hi.controlEnglish: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.

hi.english: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!
hi.back: God bless you, Bottom!
hi.controlEnglish: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.

hi.english: Bottom's Mask
hi.back: Bottom Mask
hi.controlEnglish: Mandrake Root

hi.text: मोमबत्ती की रोशनी में चीख़ती आकृति जैसी एक गाँठदार जड़ खोदकर निकाली जाती है। मिट्टी झड़ती है और उसकी मुड़ी हुई, प्राचीन शक्ति सामने आती है। अत्तार उसे काँपती श्रद्धा से सँभालता है।
hi.english: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.
hi.back: In the light of a candle, a knotted root like a screaming figure is dug out. The soil falls off and its twisted, ancient power emerges. Attar cares for it with trembling devotion.
hi.controlEnglish: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.

hi.text: न अफ़ीम, न मैंड्रेक, न दुनिया के सारे नींद लाने वाले शरबत।
hi.english: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.
hi.back: No opium, no mandragora, no all the sleeping pills in the world.
hi.controlEnglish: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.

hi.text: मैंड्रेक की जड़
hi.english: Mandrake Root
hi.back: Root of Mandrake
hi.controlEnglish: Oberon's Dew

hi.text: चाँदनी में नहाए एक ऑर्किड से ओस की एक बूँद चिपकी है, जो किसी और लोक की बैंगनी रोशनी से चमकती है। सोई पलकों पर एक बूँद, और सपना देखने वाला पहले दिखे प्राणी से प्रेम कर बैठता है।
hi.english: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.
hi.back: A drop of dew sticks to a moon-bathed orchid, shimmering with the purple light of another world. A drop on sleepy eyelids, and the dreamer falls in love with the creature he first saw.

hi.english: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.
hi.back: Bring me that flower; the herb I once showed you.
hi.controlEnglish: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.

hi.text: ओबेरॉन की ओस
hi.english: Oberon's Dew
hi.back: Oberon's Ash
hi.controlEnglish: Hemlock Tincture

hi.english: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.

hi.english: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.

hi.english: Hemlock Tincture

hi.text: गहरी सदाबहार पत्तियों के बीच फीके रंग के बेर चमकते हैं, जो सर्दियों के चाँद के नीचे तोड़े गए हैं। यह सत्त प्रकृति के शांत, अटल जादू से गुनगुनाता है।
hi.english: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.
hi.back: Among the deep evergreen leaves, pale-coloured birch trees gleam, broken under the winter moon. It resonates with the quiet, enduring magic of pure nature.
hi.controlEnglish: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.

hi.text: कड़ाह में उबलो और पको; गोह की आँख और मेंढक का अँगूठा।
hi.english: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.
hi.back: Boil and cook in a cauldron; the eye of a deer and the finger of a frog.
hi.controlEnglish: Full fathom five thy father lies; of his bones are coral made.

hi.text: मिसलटो का सत्त
hi.english: Mistletoe Extract
hi.back: Set of Misalto
hi.controlEnglish: Mermaid's Tears

hi.text: मोती के डाट वाली एक कुप्पी में चमकता नीला द्रव है जो जीवित समुद्र की तरह हिलोरें लेता है। इसके भीतर छोटी-छोटी मूँगे की आकृतियाँ बनती और घुलती हैं। इसमें नमक और भूली हुई समुद्री यात्राओं की गंध है।
hi.english: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.
hi.back: A bottle with pearl dots is a shimmering blue liquid that swirls like a living sea. Tiny moons form and melt inside it. It smells of salt and forgotten sailing trips.
hi.controlEnglish: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.

hi.text: पाँच पुरसा गहरे तेरे पिता लेटे हैं; उनकी हड्डियों से मूँगा बना है।
hi.english: Full fathom five thy father lies; of his bones are coral made.
hi.back: Your father is lying five feet deep; his bones are made of horns.
hi.controlEnglish: Put this in any liquid thing you will, and drink it off; and, if you had the strength of twenty men, it would dispatch you straight.

hi.text: जलपरी के आँसू
hi.english: Mermaid's Tears
hi.back: Mermaid Tears
hi.controlEnglish: Apothecary's Elixir

hi.text: मैंटुआ के सबसे ग़रीब मोहल्ले में धूल से भरी अत्तार की एक दुकान। एक दरकी हुई शीशी में एक हताश अमृत कहरुबा-सा चमकता है, इतना शक्तिशाली कि जीवन और मृत्यु के बीच की खाई पाट दे।
hi.english: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
hi.back: In Mantua's poorest neighborhood, a dusty tea shop in a darkened glass glows like a desperate miraculous cup, powerful enough to bridge the gulf between life and death.
hi.controlEnglish: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.

hi.text: इसे जिस किसी तरल में चाहो डालो और पी जाओ; तुममें बीस आदमियों का बल भी हो, तो यह तुम्हें तुरंत निपटा देगा।
hi.english: Put this in any liquid thing you will, and drink it off; and, if you had the strength of twenty men, it would dispatch you straight.
hi.back: Put it in whatever liquid you want and drink it. If there are twenty men of your strength, it will get rid of you quickly.
hi.controlEnglish: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.

hi.text: अत्तार का अमृत
hi.english: Apothecary's Elixir
hi.back: Umr of Attar
hi.controlEnglish: Yorick's Skull

hi.text: एक शांत झील के किनारों पर सुनहरे डैफ़ोडिल फूलों का कालीन बिछा है। वर्ड्सवर्थ नोटबुक हाथ में लिए उनके बीच चलते हैं और उनके पीछे कम्बरलैंड की पहाड़ियाँ उठती हैं।
hi.english: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.
hi.back: A carpet of golden daffodils is laid out on the shores of a quiet lake. Wordsworth walks among them with his notebook in hand and the hills of Cumberland rise behind him.
hi.controlEnglish: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.

hi.text: मैं अकेला भटकता था, उस बादल की तरह जो घाटियों और पहाड़ियों के ऊपर ऊँचा तैरता है।
hi.english: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.
hi.back: I was wandering alone, like the cloud that floats high above valleys and hills.
hi.controlEnglish: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.

hi.text: हवा थमने से रुका एक जहाज़ चित्रित-से समुद्र पर बहता है। बूढ़ा नाविक अपने गले में लटके अल्बाट्रॉस को घूरता है और काँच-से समुद्र से प्रेत-आकृतियाँ उठती हैं।
hi.english: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.
hi.back: A ship, stopped by the wind, is pictured floating on the sea. The old sailor stares at the albatross hanging around his neck and ghost-figures rise from the sea through the glass.
hi.controlEnglish: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.

hi.text: पानी, पानी, हर तरफ़ समुद्र का पानी, पर पीने को एक बूँद नहीं।
hi.english: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.
hi.back: Water, water, seawater everywhere, but not a drop to drink.
hi.controlEnglish: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.

hi.text: पतझड़ में हैम्पस्टेड का एक बाग़। कीट्स आलूबुख़ारे के पेड़ के नीचे बैठे ज्वर-सी तीव्रता से लिखते हैं और अँधेरी होती डालियों से एक बुलबुल गाती है।
hi.english: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.
hi.back: A garden in Hampstead in autumn. Keith writes with feverish intensity sitting under a pear tree and a bubble sings from the darkening leaves.
hi.controlEnglish: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.

hi.text: सुंदर वस्तु सदा का आनंद है: उसकी मनोहरता बढ़ती जाती है।
hi.english: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.
hi.back: A beautiful object is always a pleasure: its beauty grows.
hi.controlEnglish: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.

hi.text: आधी रात को वेनिस का एक महल। बायरन बालकनी पर खड़े हैं, लबादा लहरा रहा है, और वे अँधेरी नहर के पार ताक रहे हैं। पीछे अँगीठी में एक अधूरी पांडुलिपि जल रही है।
hi.english: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.
hi.back: A palace in Venice at midnight. Byron is standing on the balcony, his robe waving, and gazing across a dark canal. An unfinished manuscript is burning in the candle behind him.
hi.controlEnglish: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.

hi.text: वह सौंदर्य में चलती है, निर्मेघ देशों और तारों भरे आकाश की रात की तरह।
hi.english: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.
hi.back: She walks in beauty, like cloudless lands and a night sky full of stars.
hi.controlEnglish: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.

hi.text: आँधी-तूफ़ान के बीच जिनेवा का मोमबत्ती से रोशन एक अध्ययन-कक्ष। मैरी बिजली की चमक में लिखती हैं और उनके पीछे परछाइयों में वह प्राणी हिलता है। विज्ञान और आतंक एक हो जाते हैं।
hi.english: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.
hi.back: A candlelit study in Geneva amidst storms. Mary writes in the flash of lightning and behind her the creature moves in the shadows. Science and terror become one.
hi.controlEnglish: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.

hi.text: सावधान; क्योंकि मैं निडर हूँ, और इसीलिए शक्तिशाली हूँ।
hi.english: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.
hi.back: Beware; for I am courageous, and therefore powerful.
hi.controlEnglish: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.

hi.text: बुझती आग से धुँधला रोशन एक कक्ष। पो अपनी मेज़ पर झुके बैठे हैं और एक कौआ पैलस की आवक्ष प्रतिमा पर आ बैठता है। परछाइयों में "Nevermore" शब्द गूँजता है।
hi.english: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.
hi.back: A room dimly lit by an extinguishing fire. Poe is bent over his desk and a crow sits on the statue of Pallas Athena. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.
hi.controlEnglish: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.

hi.text: एक बार एक उदास आधी रात को, जब मैं थका और निर्बल सोच में डूबा था।
hi.english: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.
hi.back: Once in a sad midnight, when I was tired and powerless to think.
hi.controlEnglish: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.

hi.text: लंदन की एक छपाई-कार्यशाला दिव्य दृष्टि की रोशनी से दहक रही है। ब्लेक ताँबे पर एक बाघ उकेरते हैं और वह पशु प्लेट से साकार हो उठता है, रात के जंगलों में धधकता हुआ।
hi.english: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.
hi.back: A print shop in London is burning with the light of a divine vision. Blake carves a tiger on copper and it emerges from an animal plate, throbbing through the forest at night.
hi.controlEnglish: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.

hi.text: रेत के एक कण में संसार देखना और एक जंगली फूल में स्वर्ग।
hi.english: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.
hi.back: Seeing the world in a grain of sand and heaven in a wild flower.
hi.controlEnglish: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?

hi.text: हवाओं से घिरी इटली की एक चट्टान की चोटी। शेली बाँहें फैलाए तूफ़ान का सामना करते हैं और पश्चिमी हवा उनकी नोटबुक से पन्ने नोचकर भूमध्य सागर पर बिखेर देती है।
hi.english: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.
hi.back: On a windswept peak in Italy, Shelley faces the storm with her arms outstretched and the western wind tears pages from her notebook over the Mediterranean Sea.
hi.controlEnglish: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.

hi.text: यदि शीत ऋतु आ गई है, तो क्या वसंत दूर हो सकता है?
hi.english: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?
hi.back: If winter has come, can spring be gone?
hi.controlEnglish: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.

hi.text: फ़्लोरेंस का धूप से भरा एक कमरा। Elizabeth आर्नो नदी की ओर खुलती खिड़की के पास लिखती हैं और उनका स्पैनियल कुत्ता उनके पैरों के पास है। मेज़ पर Robert के प्रेम-पत्र खुले पड़े हैं।
hi.english: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.
hi.back: A sunny room in Florence. Elizabeth is writing by a window overlooking the Arno River with her Spaniel dog at her feet. Robert's love letters are lying open on the table.
hi.controlEnglish: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.

hi.text: मैं तुमसे कैसे प्रेम करती हूँ? मुझे उसके ढंग गिनने दो।
hi.english: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
hi.back: How do I love you? Let me tell you how.
hi.controlEnglish: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.

hi.text: ढलती पतझड़ी रोशनी में प्री-रैफ़ेलाइट शैली का एक बाग़। Christina गिरे हुए पत्तों के बीच बैठी ऐसे छंद रचती हैं जिनमें सौंदर्य और शांत समर्पण की टीस है।
hi.english: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.
hi.back: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among the fallen leaves, composing verses with a hint of beauty and quiet devotion.
hi.controlEnglish: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.

hi.text: मेरा स्मरण करना जब मैं चली जाऊँ, दूर उस मौन देश में चली जाऊँ।
hi.english: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.
hi.back: Remember me when I'm gone, go away to that silent land.
hi.controlEnglish: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.

hi.text: ओलिंपस पर्वत आकाश को चीरता है। ज़्यूस बादलों के सिंहासन पर बैठे हैं और उनकी उँगलियों के बीच बिजली कौंधती है। नीचे मनुष्यों का संसार उनकी दृष्टि से काँपता है।
hi.english: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.
hi.back: Mount Olympus rips the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds and lightning thunders between his fingers. The world beneath trembles at his sight.
hi.controlEnglish: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.

hi.text: मैं बादलों को बटोरने वाला हूँ, विशाल आकाश का स्वामी।
hi.english: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.
hi.back: I'm going to split the clouds, Lord of the Great Sky.
hi.controlEnglish: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.

hi.text: सुनहरी रोशनी में पार्थेनन चमकता है। अथीना पूरे कवच में खड़ी हैं, उनका उल्लू उनकी ढाल पर बैठा है और उनकी धूसर आँखें हर मानवीय छल के पार देख लेती हैं।
hi.english: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.
hi.back: The Parthenon shines in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl sits on her shield and her gray eyes see through every human deception.
hi.controlEnglish: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.

hi.text: बुद्धि का उल्लू केवल साँझ को उड़ान भरता है।
hi.english: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.
hi.back: The owl of wisdom flies only in the evening.
hi.controlEnglish: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.

hi.text: एक सुनहरा रथ भोर के आकाश में दौड़ता है। अपोलो अपनी वीणा बजाते हैं और पहियों से धूप बरसती है, जो संसार को रंगों से भर देती है।
hi.english: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.
hi.back: A golden chariot races through the morning sky. Apollo plays his flute and the sun rain from its wheels, filling the world with colours.
hi.controlEnglish: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.

hi.text: मैं गीत का, आरोग्य का और दमकते सूर्य का देवता हूँ।
hi.english: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.
hi.back: I am the god of song, health and the shining sun.
hi.controlEnglish: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.

hi.text: भोर में साइप्रस के तट। ऐफ़्रोडाइटी समुद्री झाग से उठती हैं, ऊपर कबूतर मँडराते हैं और लहरें उनके चरणों में मोती रख देती हैं। संसार साँस थामे रहता है।
hi.english: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.
hi.back: The coast of Cyprus in the morning. Aphrodite rises from the sea mist, pigeons fly above and waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.
hi.controlEnglish: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.

hi.text: देवता भी प्रेम की शक्ति का सामना नहीं कर सकते।
hi.english: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
hi.back: Even gods can't stand the power of love.
hi.controlEnglish: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.

hi.text: आकाश में पंखों वाली चप्पलों की एक झलक। हरमीस वज्रों के बीच से बलखाते निकलते हैं — एक हाथ में दिव्य संदेश और चेहरे पर चोर-सी मुस्कान।
hi.english: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.
hi.back: A glimpse of winged shoes in the sky. The Hermites emerge from among the thunderstorms — a divine message in one hand and a thief's smile on their faces.
hi.controlEnglish: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.

hi.text: विचार की तरह तेज़, मैं देवताओं के वचन नश्वर कानों तक ले जाता हूँ।
hi.english: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.
hi.back: Fast as thought, I carry the word of the gods to mortal ears.
hi.controlEnglish: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.

hi.text: पाताल का दरबार-कक्ष, फीकी आग की नदियों से रोशन। हादेस बैठे हैं, सर्बेरस उनके चरणों में है और अंधकार का शिरस्त्राण हत्थे पर रखा है। मृतक अंतहीन मौन में पंक्तिबद्ध गुज़रते हैं।
hi.english: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.
hi.back: The court-room of the underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits, Cerberus is at his feet and holds the crown of darkness in his hand. The dead pass lined up in endless silence.
hi.controlEnglish: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.

hi.text: सारी आत्माएँ अंत में मेरे पास आती हैं। मैं धैर्यवान हूँ।
hi.english: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
hi.back: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
hi.controlEnglish: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.

hi.text: वसंत और छाया के बीच बँटा एक सिंहासन। पर्सिफ़ोनी एक हाथ में अनार और दूसरे में फूलों का मुकुट थामे हैं — दो लोकों की रानी।
hi.english: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.
hi.back: A throne divided between spring and shadow. Persephone holds an orange in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other — queen of two realms.
hi.controlEnglish: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.

hi.text: मैंने छह दाने खाए, और स्वयं को सदा के लिए दो लोकों के बीच बाँध लिया।
hi.english: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.
hi.back: I ate six grains, and bound myself between two realms forever.
hi.controlEnglish: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.

hi.text: तूफ़ानों से जूझता एक जहाज़ चट्टानी अंतरीप का चक्कर लगाता है। ओदुस्सेउस स्वयं को मस्तूल से बाँध लेते हैं और चट्टानों से साइरनें गाती हैं। उनकी आँखों में इथाका की याद जलती है।
hi.english: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.
hi.back: A ship struggling with storms circumnavigates the rocky inland. Odysseus binds himself to a mast and sings sirens from the rocks. His eyes are burning for Ithaca.
hi.controlEnglish: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.

hi.text: हे काव्य की देवी, मुझे उस अनेक युक्तियों वाले पुरुष की कथा सुनाओ जो दूर तक भटका।
hi.english: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.
hi.back: O goddess of poetry, tell me the story of a man with many tricks who went far away.
hi.controlEnglish: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.

hi.text: संसार के छोर पर एक खंडहर मंदिर। मेडुसा मुड़ती है और उसके सर्प-केश फुफकारते हैं। फ़र्श पर पत्थर के योद्धा बिखरे हैं, अपने अंतिम धावे में जमे हुए।
hi.english: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.
hi.back: A ruined temple at the end of the world. Medusa is turning and her snake hairs are blowing. Stone warriors are scattered on the floor, frozen in their final run.
hi.controlEnglish: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.

hi.text: साहस हो तो मुझे देखो। मेरी दृष्टि वह अंतिम चीज़ है जो तुम देखोगे।
hi.english: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.
hi.back: Have the courage to look at me. My vision is the last thing you will see.
hi.controlEnglish: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.

hi.text: भोर में ट्रॉय के मैदान। अखिल्लेउस दहकते कवच में धावा बोलते हैं और उनकी युद्ध-पुकार हवा को चीर देती है। उनके पीछे तट पर यूनानी जहाज़ जल रहे हैं।
hi.english: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.

id.text: Sebuah panggung megah menjelma. The Sonnet Man melangkah keluar dari sorot lampu keemasan, mikrofon di tangan. Kata-kata Shakespeare berubah menjadi bait-bait hip-hop sementara penonton bersorak.
id.english: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.
id.back: A grand stage appears, the Sonnet Man steps out of the golden lights, microphone in hand, Shakespeare's words turning into hip-hop lines as the audience cheers.
id.controlEnglish: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.

id.text: Haruskah kubandingkan engkau dengan hari di musim panas?
id.english: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
id.back: Should I compare you to a day in the summer?
id.controlEnglish: But soft, what light through yonder window breaks?

id.text: Adegan balkon di bawah sinar bulan terbentang. Romeo mengulurkan tangan ke atas saat Juliet muncul di atasnya. Kelopak mawar melayang di udara. Adegan itu berdenyut dengan cahaya merah tua yang hangat.
id.english: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.
id.back: The scene on the balcony under the moonlight spreads out. Romeo stretches his hand up as Juliet appears above him. Rose petals float in the air. The scene pulses with a warm, dark red light.
id.controlEnglish: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.

id.text: Tapi diam, cahaya apakah yang memancar dari jendela di sana?
id.english: But soft, what light through yonder window breaks?
id.back: But shut up, what kind of light is shining from the window over there?
id.controlEnglish: What's in a name? That which we call a rose...

id.text: Taman keluarga Capulet bermekaran di bawah sinar bulan. Juliet berdiri di antara mawar, matanya bersinar menantang. Seekor burung bulbul bernyanyi dari dahan.
id.english: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.
id.back: The Capulet family garden blossoms in the moonlight, Juliet stands among roses, her eyes shining defiantly, a bumblebee sings from the branches.
id.controlEnglish: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.

id.text: Apalah arti sebuah nama? Yang kita sebut mawar...
id.english: What's in a name? That which we call a rose...
id.back: What does a name mean?
id.controlEnglish: To be, or not to be, that is the question.

id.text: Kastel Elsinore muncul dari bayang-bayang. Hamlet berdiri di atas benteng, tengkorak Yorick melayang di sisinya. Sesosok hantu tampak di tembok di atasnya.
id.english: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.
id.back: Castle Elsinore emerges from the shadows, Hamlet stands on top of the fortress, Yorick's skull floating at his side, a ghost appears on the wall above it.
id.controlEnglish: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.

id.text: Ada atau tiada, itulah persoalannya.
id.english: To be, or not to be, that is the question.
id.back: Yes or no, that's the question.

id.text: Sungai kecil yang tenang berkelok melalui rumpun pohon dedalu. Ophelia mengapung di antara bunga liar, membisikkan sajak-sajak yang terlupakan. Kelopak bunga berputar dalam arus.
id.english: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.
id.back: A quiet little river winds through the thicket of a cedar tree, Ophelia floats among wild flowers, whispering forgotten poems, petals swirl in the stream.

id.text: Sebuah jalan di Verona pecah dalam kekacauan. Mercutio menari di antara bilah pedang, menertawakan bahaya. Bunga api memercik dari baja yang beradu.
id.english: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.

id.text: Kutukan atas kedua rumah kalian!

id.back: Cursed be your two houses!

id.text: Hutan ajaib berkilau penuh kejahilan. Puck melesat di antara pohon ek tua, meninggalkan jejak serbuk peri. Di bawah, manusia fana yang tertidur memimpikan mimpi-mimpi aneh.
id.english: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.

id.text: Tuhan, betapa bodohnya para manusia fana ini!

id.back: God, how stupid these mortals are!
id.controlEnglish: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.

id.text: Sebuah takhta dari sulur hidup menjulang dari lantai hutan. Titania memerintah istana perinya sementara kunang-kunang menerangi tajuk pepohonan. Alam sendiri tunduk pada kehendaknya.
id.english: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.
id.back: A throne of living spire rises from the forest floor, Titania rules her fairy palace while fireflies illuminate the treetops, nature itself obeys her will.

id.text: Mari, duduklah di ranjang penuh bunga ini.
id.english: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.
id.back: Come, sit on this bed full of flowers.
id.controlEnglish: Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio.

id.text: Sebuah tengkorak terbaring di atas beludru dalam ruang makam yang remang. Tawa hantu bergema sementara kenangan tentang badut istana berkelip seperti nyala lilin.

id.text: Aduhai, Yorick yang malang! Aku mengenalnya, Horatio.
id.english: Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio.
id.back: Poor Yorick, I know him, Horatio.
