id.text: Sebuah mahkota Skotlandia yang kusam terletak di atas bantal bernoda darah. Ia berdenyut dengan ambisi gelap, membisikkan janji kemuliaan kepada setiap tangan yang berani meraihnya.
id.english: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
id.back: A faded Scottish crown lies on a blood-stained pillow, pulsing with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to every hand that dares reach for it.
id.controlEnglish: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.

id.text: Gelisah berbaring kepala yang memakai mahkota.
id.english: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.
id.back: The head of the crown-bearer.
id.controlEnglish: I'll drown my book.

id.text: Mahkota Macbeth
id.english: Macbeth's Crown
id.back: Macbeth's Crown
id.controlEnglish: The Tempest Codex

id.text: Sebuah kitab kuno bersampul kulit yang lapuk oleh laut melayang di atas altar batu. Halaman-halamannya membalik sendiri, masing-masing memanggil badai yang berbeda.
id.english: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.
id.back: It's like an old book on a broken-skinned cover floating by the sea on a rock altar, its pages turning over themselves, each calling for another storm.
id.controlEnglish: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.

id.text: Akan kutenggelamkan kitabku.
id.english: I'll drown my book.
id.back: I'm gonna sink my book.
id.controlEnglish: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.

id.text: Kitab Badai
id.english: The Tempest Codex
id.back: The Storm Book
id.controlEnglish: Cordelia's Tears

id.text: Sebuah botol kristal menyimpan air mata yang berkilau seperti cahaya bintang yang tertangkap. Setiap tetes membawa duka seorang putri yang mencintai terlalu tulus dan berbicara terlalu terus terang.
id.english: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.
id.back: A crystal bottle holds tears shimmering like starlight caught, each drop brings the sorrow of a princess who loved too sincerely and spoke too openly.
id.controlEnglish: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.

id.text: O ayah tercinta, urusanmulah yang sedang kujalankan.
id.english: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.
id.back: O dear father, it is your business that I am doing.
id.controlEnglish: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!

id.text: Air Mata Cordelia
id.english: Cordelia's Tears
id.back: Air Mata Cordelia
id.controlEnglish: Bottom's Mask

id.text: Sebuah topeng berkepala keledai tergantung pada dahan berlumut di hutan peri. Siapa pun yang mengenakannya melihat dunia dengan mata yang tersihir, dan menjadi tak tertahankan bagi para ratu peri.
id.english: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.
id.back: A mask with a donkey's head hangs from the branches of a fairy forest, and whoever wears it sees the world with enchanted eyes, and becomes unbearable for fairies.
id.controlEnglish: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.

id.text: Diberkatilah engkau, Bottom! Engkau telah berubah wujud!
id.english: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!
id.back: Blessed be you, Bottom!
id.controlEnglish: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.

id.text: Topeng Bottom
id.english: Bottom's Mask
id.back: Bottom Mask
id.controlEnglish: Mandrake Root

id.text: Sebatang akar berbonggol yang berbentuk sosok menjerit digali dalam cahaya lilin. Tanah berguguran dan menyingkap kekuatannya yang terpilin dan purba. Sang apoteker memegangnya dengan takzim yang gemetar.
id.english: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.
id.back: A screaming figure-shaped bulky root is dug up in candlelight, the soil shakes and reveals its ancient power, the pharmacist holds it with a trembling tact.
id.controlEnglish: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.

id.text: Bukan candu, bukan mandragora, bukan pula segala sirop pelelap di dunia.
id.english: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.
id.back: Not opium, not mandragora, not all the magic syrups in the world.
id.controlEnglish: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.

id.text: Akar Mandrake
id.english: Mandrake Root
id.back: Mandrake Root
id.controlEnglish: Oberon's Dew

id.text: Setetes embun melekat pada anggrek yang disinari bulan, berpendar dengan cahaya ungu dari dunia lain. Satu tetes pada kelopak mata yang terlelap, dan si pemimpi jatuh cinta pada makhluk pertama yang dilihatnya.
id.english: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.
id.back: A drop of dew sticks to a moonlit orchid, shining with violet light from another world, one drop on a faint eyelid, and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature he sees.
id.controlEnglish: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.

id.text: Ambilkan aku bunga itu; tumbuhan yang pernah kutunjukkan padamu.
id.english: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.
id.back: Bring me that flower, the plant I showed you.
id.controlEnglish: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.

id.text: Embun Oberon
id.english: Oberon's Dew
id.back: Oberon
id.controlEnglish: Hemlock Tincture

id.text: Sebuah botol kaca hitam mengeluarkan uap hijau di lorong yang gelap. Tingtur di dalamnya telah menumbangkan raja-raja dan menghancurkan wangsa-wangsa, setetes sunyi demi setetes.
id.english: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.
id.back: A bottle of black glass, from which a green smoke emerges in a dark passageway; the infusion in it has overthrown kings and destroyed dynasty, drop by drop.
id.controlEnglish: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.

id.text: Pada saat aku lengah pamanmu menyelinap, membawa sari hebona terkutuk dalam sebuah botol kecil.
id.english: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.
id.back: As I was overlooking, your uncle sneaked in, carrying some damn hebona sari in a little bottle.
id.controlEnglish: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.

id.text: Tingtur Hemlock
id.english: Hemlock Tincture
id.back: Tincture of Hemlock
id.controlEnglish: Mistletoe Extract

id.text: Buah-buah beri pucat berkilau di antara daun hijau abadi yang gelap, dipanen di bawah bulan musim dingin. Sarinya bersenandung dengan sihir dunia alam yang tenang dan gigih.
id.english: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.
id.back: The fruits thereof are pale green, and the blossoms thereof are dark-green.
id.controlEnglish: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.

id.text: Dalam kuali rebus dan panggang; mata kadal dan jari katak.
id.english: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.
id.back: In a pot boiled and roasted; lizard eyes and frog fingers.
id.controlEnglish: Full fathom five thy father lies; of his bones are coral made.

id.text: Sari Benalu
id.english: Mistletoe Extract
id.back: Sari Benalu
id.controlEnglish: Mermaid's Tears

id.text: Sebuah labu bersumbat mutiara menyimpan cairan biru bercahaya yang bergerak seperti laut yang hidup. Di dalamnya, karang-karang mungil tumbuh dan luruh. Baunya seperti garam dan pelayaran yang terlupakan.
id.english: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.
id.back: It's like a coconut hidden in pearls, with blue water flowing like a sea of life, and small corals coming out and falling down, smelling like salt and forgotten sailing.
id.controlEnglish: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.

id.text: Lima depa dalamnya ayahmu terbaring; dari tulangnya karang terbentuk.
id.english: Full fathom five thy father lies; of his bones are coral made.
id.back: Five dungeons in which your father lay; reefs formed from his bones.
id.controlEnglish: Put this in any liquid thing you will, and drink it off; and, if you had the strength of twenty men, it would dispatch you straight.

id.text: Air Mata Putri Duyung
id.english: Mermaid's Tears
id.back: Mermaid's Tears
id.controlEnglish: Apothecary's Elixir

id.text: Sebuah toko obat berdebu di kawasan termiskin Mantua. Eliksir keputusasaan berpendar kuning sawo dalam botol yang retak, cukup ampuh untuk menjembatani jurang antara hidup dan mati.
id.english: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
id.back: A dusty drugstore in Mantua's poorest neighborhood, a shimmering yellow elixir of despair in a cracked bottle, powerful enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
id.controlEnglish: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.

id.text: Tuangkan ini ke dalam cairan apa pun yang kau mau, lalu minumlah; walau kau punya kekuatan dua puluh lelaki, ia akan langsung menghabisimu.
id.english: Put this in any liquid thing you will, and drink it off; and, if you had the strength of twenty men, it would dispatch you straight.
id.back: Pour this into whatever liquid you like, and drink; even if you have the strength of twenty men, it will kill you immediately.
id.controlEnglish: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.

id.text: Eliksir Sang Apoteker
id.english: Apothecary's Elixir
id.back: Elixir of the Pharmacist
id.controlEnglish: Yorick's Skull

id.text: Hamparan bunga bakung kuning keemasan membentang di sepanjang tepi danau yang tenang. Wordsworth berjalan di antaranya, buku catatan di tangan, perbukitan Cumberland menjulang di belakangnya.
id.english: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.
id.back: The golden-yellow spruce blossoms stretch along the shores of a calm lake, Wordsworth walking among them, notebook in hand, Cumberland hills towering behind him.
id.controlEnglish: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.

id.text: Aku mengembara sendirian bagai awan yang melayang tinggi di atas lembah dan bukit.
id.english: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.
id.back: I travel alone like clouds hovering high over valleys and hills.
id.controlEnglish: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.

id.text: Sebuah kapal yang terhenti tanpa angin hanyut di atas samudra bagai lukisan. Si Pelaut Tua menatap albatros di lehernya sementara sosok-sosok hantu bangkit dari laut yang bagai kaca.
id.english: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.
id.back: A ship standing still in the windless ocean like a painting, the old sailor staring at the albatross on his neck as ghosts rise from the glassy sea.
id.controlEnglish: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.

id.text: Air, air, di mana-mana, tapi setetes pun tak dapat diminum.
id.english: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.
id.back: Water, water, everywhere, but not a drop can be drunk.
id.controlEnglish: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.

id.text: Sebuah taman di Hampstead pada musim gugur. Keats duduk di bawah pohon prem, menulis dengan menggebu sementara burung bulbul bernyanyi dari dahan-dahan yang menggelap.
id.english: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.
id.back: A park in Hampstead in autumn, Keats sitting under a prem tree, writing with humming whilst bumblebees sing from the dark branches.
id.controlEnglish: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.

id.text: Sesuatu yang indah adalah sukacita selamanya: keelokannya kian bertambah.
id.english: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.
id.back: Something beautiful is a joy forever: its beauty increases.
id.controlEnglish: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.

id.text: Sebuah istana Venesia pada tengah malam. Byron berdiri di balkon, jubahnya berkibar, menatap ke seberang kanal yang gelap. Sebuah naskah setengah jadi terbakar di perapian di belakangnya.
id.english: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.
id.back: A Venetian palace in the middle of the night, Byron standing on a balcony, his robe glittering, gazing across a dark canal, a half-burnt manuscript burning in the fireplace behind him.
id.controlEnglish: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.

id.text: Ia berjalan dalam keindahan, laksana malam di negeri tak berawan dan langit berbintang.
id.english: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.
id.back: It walks in beauty, like a night in a cloudless land and a starry sky.
id.controlEnglish: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.

id.text: Sebuah ruang kerja yang diterangi lilin di Jenewa, di tengah badai petir. Mary menulis dalam kilat cahaya petir sementara sang makhluk bergerak di bayang-bayang di belakangnya. Ilmu dan kengerian menjadi satu.
id.english: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.
id.back: A candlelit office in Geneva, amidst a thunderstorm, Mary writing in the flashes of lightning while the creature moves in the shadows behind her, science and horror are one.
id.controlEnglish: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.

id.text: Waspadalah; sebab aku tak kenal takut, dan karena itu berkuasa.
id.english: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.
id.back: Beware; for I know no fear, and therefore am powerful.
id.controlEnglish: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.

id.text: Sebuah kamar remang yang diterangi api yang hampir padam. Poe duduk membungkuk di mejanya saat seekor gagak hinggap di patung dada Pallas. Kata "Tak akan lagi" bergema di bayang-bayang.
id.english: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.
id.back: A dark room lit by an almost extinguished fire, Poe sitting bent over at his desk as a crow dropped on Pallas' bust, the words "no more" echoing in the shadows.
id.controlEnglish: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.

id.text: Suatu ketika, pada tengah malam yang suram, saat aku merenung, lemah dan letih.
id.english: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.
id.back: Once upon a time, in the middle of a dark night, as I gazed, weak and tired.
id.controlEnglish: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.

id.text: Sebuah bengkel cetak di London yang menyala oleh cahaya penglihatan. Blake mengukir seekor harimau pada tembaga sementara binatang itu menjelma dari pelat, menyala terang di hutan-hutan malam.
id.english: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.
id.back: A print shop in London lit by visible light Blake carved a tiger on copper as the animal emerged from the plate, shining brightly in the night forests.
id.controlEnglish: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.

id.text: Melihat dunia dalam sebutir pasir dan surga dalam sekuntum bunga liar.
id.english: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.
id.back: Seeing the world in a grain of sand and heaven in a bunch of wild flowers.
id.controlEnglish: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?

id.text: Puncak tebing Italia yang diterpa angin. Shelley menghadapi badai dengan tangan terentang, sementara angin barat merenggut halaman-halaman dari buku catatannya dan menebarkannya ke Laut Tengah.
id.english: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.
id.back: Shelley faced the storm with outstretched arms, as the west winds snatched pages from her notebook and scattered them in the Mediterranean.
id.controlEnglish: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.

id.text: Jika musim dingin datang, mungkinkah musim semi masih jauh?
id.english: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?
id.back: If winter comes, is spring still far away?
id.controlEnglish: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.

id.text: Sebuah kamar yang cerah di Firenze. Elizabeth menulis di jendela yang menghadap Sungai Arno, anjing spanielnya di kakinya. Surat-surat cinta dari Robert terbuka di atas meja.
id.english: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.
id.back: A bright room in Florence, Elizabeth writing at the window overlooking the Arno River, her spaniel dog at her feet, love letters from Robert open on the table.
id.controlEnglish: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.

id.text: Bagaimana aku mencintaimu? Biar kuhitung caranya.
id.english: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
id.back: How do I love you?
id.controlEnglish: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.

id.text: Sebuah taman Pra-Raphael dalam cahaya musim gugur yang memudar. Christina duduk di antara daun-daun gugur, menggubah sajak yang pedih oleh keindahan dan kepasrahan yang tenang.
id.english: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.
id.back: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in the fading autumn light, Christina sitting among the fall leaves, composing a bitter poem of beauty and quiet devotion.
id.controlEnglish: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.

id.text: Ingatlah aku ketika aku telah pergi, pergi jauh ke negeri yang sunyi.
id.english: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.
id.back: Remember me when I was gone, gone far away to a lonely land.
id.controlEnglish: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.

id.text: Gunung Olimpus membelah langit. Zeus duduk di atas takhta awan, petir melompat di antara jari-jarinya. Di bawah, dunia fana gemetar di bawah tatapannya.
id.english: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.
id.back: Mount Olympus splits the sky, Zeus sits on a cloudy throne, lightning leaps between his fingers, beneath, the mortal world quakes before his gaze.
id.controlEnglish: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.

id.text: Akulah pengumpul awan, penguasa langit yang luas.
id.english: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.
id.back: I am the gatherer of clouds, the ruler of the vast skies.
id.controlEnglish: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.

id.text: Parthenon berkilau dalam cahaya keemasan. Athena berdiri berbaju zirah lengkap, burung hantunya bertengger di perisainya, mata kelabunya menembus setiap tipu daya manusia.
id.english: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.
id.back: The Parthenon gleamed in golden light, Athena stood in her full armor, her falcons perched on her shields, her grey eyes piercing every human deceit.
id.controlEnglish: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.

id.text: Burung hantu kebijaksanaan baru terbang ketika senja tiba.
id.english: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.
id.back: The ghost of wisdom flies new when dusk falls.
id.controlEnglish: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.

id.text: Sebuah kereta emas melaju melintasi langit fajar. Apollo memetik liranya sementara cahaya matahari tercurah dari roda-rodanya, mewarnai dunia.
id.english: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.
id.back: A golden carriage races across the dawn sky, Apollo picks his lyre as sunlight shines from its wheels, colouring the world.
id.controlEnglish: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.

id.text: Akulah dewa nyanyian, penyembuhan, dan matahari yang bersinar.
id.english: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.
id.back: I am the god of singing, healing, and the shining sun.
id.controlEnglish: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.

id.text: Pantai Siprus saat fajar. Afrodit bangkit dari buih laut, merpati berputar di atasnya sementara ombak meletakkan mutiara di kakinya. Dunia menahan napas.
id.english: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.
id.back: The coast of Cyprus at dawn, Aphrodite rising from the sea's foam, doves swirling over her as the waves lay pearls on her feet, the world holding its breath.
id.controlEnglish: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.

id.text: Bahkan para dewa tak mampu menolak kuasa cinta.
id.english: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
id.back: Even the gods could not resist the power of love.
id.controlEnglish: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.

id.text: Sekelebat sandal bersayap melintasi langit. Hermes berkelit di antara halilintar, pesan ilahi tergenggam di satu tangan dan seringai pencuri di wajahnya.
id.english: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.
id.back: A winged sandal crosses the sky, Hermes crawls between lightning bolts, a divine message in one hand and a thief's sword on his face.
id.controlEnglish: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.

id.text: Secepat pikiran, kubawa sabda para dewa ke telinga manusia fana.
id.english: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.
id.back: As fast as my mind, I carry the words of the gods to the ears of mortal men.
id.controlEnglish: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.

id.text: Ruang takhta Dunia Bawah, diterangi sungai-sungai api pucat. Hades duduk dengan Kerberos di kakinya, ketopong kegelapannya di sandaran lengan. Orang-orang mati berbaris lewat dalam kesunyian tanpa akhir.
id.english: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.
id.back: The throne room of the underworld, lit by pale rivers of fire, Hades sitting with Kerberos at his feet, his darkness on his armrest, the dead lined up in endless silence.
id.controlEnglish: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.

id.text: Semua jiwa pada akhirnya datang kepadaku. Aku sabar.
id.english: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
id.back: All souls eventually come to me, I am patient.
id.controlEnglish: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.

id.text: Sebuah takhta yang terbelah antara musim semi dan bayangan. Persefone memegang buah delima di satu tangan dan mahkota bunga di tangan lain, ratu dari dua alam.
id.english: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.
id.back: A throne divided between spring and shadow, Persephone holding a fig in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two worlds.
id.controlEnglish: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.

id.text: Enam biji kumakan, dan kuikat diriku selamanya di antara dua dunia.
id.english: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.
id.back: Six seeds of kumakan, and I bind myself forever between the two worlds.
id.controlEnglish: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.

id.text: Sebuah kapal yang dihantam badai mengitari tanjung berbatu. Odisseus mengikat dirinya ke tiang kapal saat para Siren bernyanyi dari tebing. Matanya menyala oleh kenangan akan Ithaka.
id.english: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.
id.back: A storm-hit ship circled a rocky promontory, Odysseus tied himself to the mast as the Sirens sang from the cliffs, his eyes lit by memories of Ithaca.
id.controlEnglish: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.

id.text: Kisahkan kepadaku, wahai Musa, tentang lelaki banyak akal yang mengembara jauh.
id.english: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.
id.back: Tell me, O Moses, of the wise man who went far away.
id.controlEnglish: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.

id.text: Sebuah kuil yang runtuh di tepi dunia. Medusa berpaling, rambut ularnya mendesis. Para prajurit batu berserakan di lantai, membeku dalam serbuan terakhir mereka.
id.english: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.
id.back: A temple collapsed at the edge of the world, Medusa turned around, her snake hair desiccated, stone soldiers scattered on the floor, freezing in their final raid.
id.controlEnglish: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.

id.text: Pandanglah aku, jika kau berani. Tatapanku adalah hal terakhir yang akan kau lihat.
id.english: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.
id.back: Look at me, if you dare, my gaze is the last thing you'll see.
id.controlEnglish: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.

id.text: Dataran Troya saat fajar. Akhilles menyerbu dengan baju zirah yang menyala, pekik perangnya membelah udara. Di belakangnya, kapal-kapal Yunani terbakar di pantai.
id.english: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.
id.back: The plains of Troy at dawn, Achilles storming in his burning armor, his sword splitting the air behind him, Greek ships burning on shore.
id.controlEnglish: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.

id.text: Aku lebih suka hidup singkat penuh kemuliaan daripada hidup panjang yang terlupakan.
id.english: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.
id.back: I'd rather have a short, glorious life than a long, forgotten one.
id.controlEnglish: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?

it.text: Un grande palco prende forma. The Sonnet Man avanza da un riflettore dorato, microfono in mano. Le parole di Shakespeare si trasformano in rime hip-hop mentre la folla esulta.
it.english: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.
it.back: A large stage takes shape. The Sonnet Man advances from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand, Shakespeare’s words turn into hip-hop rhymes as the crowd cheers.
it.controlEnglish: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.

it.text: Dovrò paragonarti a un giorno d’estate?
it.english: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
it.back: Should I compare you to a summer day?
it.controlEnglish: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.

it.text: Si apre la scena di un balcone al chiaro di luna. Romeo tende la mano verso l’alto mentre Giulietta appare di sopra. Petali di rosa fluttuano nell’aria. La scena pulsa di un caldo bagliore cremisi.
it.english: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.
it.back: The scene opens with a moonlit balcony. Romeo reaches upwards while Juliet appears from above. Rose petals float in the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.
it.controlEnglish: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.

it.text: Il giardino dei Capuleti fiorisce al chiaro di luna. Giulietta sta fra le rose, gli occhi accesi di sfida. Un usignolo canta dai rami.
it.english: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.
it.back: The garden of the Capulets blooms in the moonlight. Juliet stands among the roses, her eyes lit with defiance; a hedgehog sings from the branches.
it.controlEnglish: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.

it.text: Il castello di Elsinore emerge dall’ombra. Amleto sta sugli spalti, con il teschio di Yorick sospeso accanto a lui. Una figura spettrale appare sui bastioni.
it.english: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.
it.back: The castle of Elsinore emerges from the shadows. Hamlet is standing in the stands, with Yorick’s skull hanging next to him, and a ghostly figure appears on the ramparts.
it.controlEnglish: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.

it.text: Un ruscello tranquillo serpeggia in un boschetto di salici. Ofelia galleggia tra i fiori di campo, sussurrando versi dimenticati. I petali girano nella corrente.
it.english: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.
it.back: A quiet stream meanders through a grove of willows. Ophelia floats among the field flowers, whispering forgotten verses, and the petals swirl in the current.
it.controlEnglish: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.

it.text: Una strada di Verona esplode nel caos. Mercuzio danza tra le lame, ridendo in faccia al pericolo. Scintille sprizzano dall’acciaio che si scontra.
it.english: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.
it.back: A street in Verona explodes into chaos. Mercuzio dances between the blades, laughing in the face of the danger, sparks splash from the steel that collides.
it.controlEnglish: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.

it.text: La foresta incantata luccica di malizia. Puck guizza tra querce antiche, lasciando scie di polvere di fata. Sotto, i mortali addormentati fanno strani sogni.
it.english: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.
it.back: The enchanted forest glitters with malice. Puck whistles through ancient oaks, leaving trails of fairy dust, and below, sleeping mortals have strange dreams.
it.controlEnglish: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.

it.text: Un trono di rampicanti vivi si leva dal suolo della foresta. Titania comanda la sua corte di fate mentre le lucciole illuminano le fronde. La natura stessa si inchina al suo volere.
it.english: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.
it.back: A throne of living climbers rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her court of fairies while fireflies illuminate the foliage, and nature itself bows to her will.
it.controlEnglish: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.

it.text: Un teschio riposa sul velluto in una cripta in penombra. Una risata spettrale riecheggia mentre i ricordi del buffone di corte tremolano come la fiamma di una candela.
it.english: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.
it.back: A skull rests on the velvet in a darkened crypt, a ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court buffoon tremble like the flame of a candle.
it.controlEnglish: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.

it.text: Un bastone nodoso crepita di energia arcana. La tempesta gli vortica attorno mentre Prospero sussurra il suo ultimo incantesimo. Il fulmine squarcia il cielo.
it.english: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.
it.back: A knotted stick crackling with arcane energy. The storm swirls around him as Prospero whispers his last spell, and lightning rips through the sky.
it.controlEnglish: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.

it.text: Una fiala luminosa pulsa di luce rosata. Cuori salgono dalla sua superficie mentre una dolce melodia riempie l’aria.
it.english: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.
it.back: A luminous vial pulses with pink light, hearts rise from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.
it.controlEnglish: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.

it.text: Un calderone ribollente erutta fumo verde. Tre figure d’ombra gli girano intorno salmodiando. Occhi brillano dal bosco oscuro.
it.english: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.
it.back: A boiling cauldron erupts green smoke. Three shadow figures turn around him singing, eyes shine from the dark wood.
it.controlEnglish: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.

it.text: Il Principe sta sui gradini del palazzo di Verona; la sua voce impone il silenzio alla folla in lotta. Uno scettro d’oro arde di autorità.
it.english: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.
it.back: The Prince stands on the steps of the palace of Verona; his voice imposes silence on the struggling crowd; a golden scepter burns with authority.
it.controlEnglish: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.

it.text: Una cella di monastero a lume di candela. Il frate cura il suo orto di erbe e veleni, con la saggezza incisa sul volto segnato dal tempo.
it.english: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.
it.back: A monastery cell by candlelight, the friar cares for his garden of herbs and poisons, with wisdom engraved on his face marked by time.
it.controlEnglish: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.

it.text: Una cucina calda in casa Capuleti. La balia si affaccenda con feroce devozione, una lettera segreta infilata nel grembiule.
it.english: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.
it.back: A hot kitchen in the Capuleti house.The nanny hurried with ferocious devotion, a secret letter stuffed into her apron.
it.controlEnglish: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.

it.text: Un’isola avvolta dalla tempesta. Prospero alza le mani mentre il fulmine obbedisce al suo volere e il mare ribolle al suo comando.
it.english: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.
it.back: An island enveloped by the storm, Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will and the sea roars at his command.
it.controlEnglish: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.

it.text: Uno spirito scintillante si dissolve in vento e luce, e si ricompone in musica. Ariel danza tra il visibile e l’invisibile.
it.english: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.
it.back: A sparkling spirit dissolves in wind and light, and recomposes itself into music: Ariel dances between the visible and the invisible.
it.controlEnglish: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.

it.text: L’imbocco di una grotta su una costa selvaggia. Calibano sta acquattato fra le rocce, gli occhi ardenti di rancore e di un’intelligenza primordiale.
it.english: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.
it.back: The entrance of a cave on a wild coast, Caliban sits watered between the rocks, his eyes burning with resentment and primordial intelligence.
it.controlEnglish: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.

it.text: Una piazza di Verona all’alba. Benvolio sta fra le spade sguainate; le sue mani aperte sono l’unica arma contro la tempesta che si addensa.
it.english: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.
it.back: A square in Verona at dawn. Benvolio stands among the drawn swords. His open hands are the only weapon against the thickening storm.
it.controlEnglish: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.

it.text: Un vicolo di Verona acceso dalle torce. Tebaldo sguaina lo stocco con grazia letale, gli occhi fissi sul nemico.
it.english: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.
it.back: An alley of Verona lit by torches.Tebaldo unsheaths the stick with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on the enemy.
it.controlEnglish: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.

it.text: La sala del trono di Elsinore, drappeggiata di falso splendore. Claudio stringe la corona, con una fiala di veleno nascosta nelle vesti.
it.english: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.
it.back: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor; Claudius holding the crown, with a vial of poison hidden in his robes.
it.controlEnglish: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.

it.text: Una radura illuminata dalla luna nel folto della foresta incantata. Oberon prende corpo dall’ombra; la sua corona di corna cattura la luce d’argento.
it.english: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.
it.back: A clearing lit by the moon in the thick of the enchanted forest.Oberon takes body from the shadow; his crown of horns captures the silver light.
it.controlEnglish: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.

it.text: Un pugnale spettrale fluttua nel buio, con la lama che gocciola sangue fantasma. La mano di Macbeth si protende, ma non riesce mai ad afferrarlo.
it.english: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.
it.back: A spectral dagger floats in the dark, with the blade dripping ghost blood; Macbeth's hand reaches for it, but never gets hold of it.
it.controlEnglish: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.

it.text: Un fiore purpureo schiacciato stilla nettare iridescente in un palmo in attesa. Ovunque cada, gli occhi cambiano, e i cuori li seguono.
it.english: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.
it.back: A crushed purple flower stills iridescent nectar in a waiting palm.Wherever it falls, eyes change, and hearts follow them.
it.controlEnglish: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.

it.text: Una sala del trono macchiata di sangue a Dunsinane. Macbeth stringe la spada con mani tremanti, la corona pesante sulla fronte. Il bosco di Birnam si muove sul colle lontano.
it.english: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.
it.back: A throne room stained with blood at Dunsinane. Macbeth holds his sword in trembling hands, the crown heavy on his forehead.The wood of Birnam moves on the distant hill.
it.controlEnglish: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.

it.text: Una stanza del castello scozzese a lume di candela. Lady Macbeth percorre le fredde pietre, strofinandosi dalle mani macchie di sangue immaginarie. Le ombre le si attaccano come una seconda pelle.
it.english: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.
it.back: A room of the Scottish castle in candlelight. Lady Macbeth walks through the cold stones, rubbing imaginary blood stains from her hands.The shadows cling to her like a second skin.
it.controlEnglish: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.

it.text: Una brughiera scozzese nebbiosa al crepuscolo. Banquo sta saldo mentre tre figure spettrali sussurrano destini nel vento. Il suo fantasma tormenterà i vivi.
it.english: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.
it.back: A misty Scottish heath at dusk. Banquo stands firm as three ghostly figures whisper destinies in the wind, his ghost haunting the living.
it.controlEnglish: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.

it.text: Una costa dell’Illiria battuta dal vento. Viola si calca un berretto da marinaio sui capelli tagliati corti; due identità le brillano negli occhi. Il mare sussurra segreti del fratello perduto.
it.english: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.
it.back: A coast of Illyria beaten by the wind. Viola wears a sailor’s cap on her short-cut hair; two identities shine in her eyes.The sea whispers secrets about her lost brother.
it.controlEnglish: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.

it.text: Un giardino assolato nella tenuta di Olivia. Malvolio si pavoneggia in sgargianti calze gialle con le giarrettiere incrociate, sorridente, stringendo al petto una falsa lettera d’amore.
it.english: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.
it.back: A sunny garden on Olivia’s estate, Malvolio flaunts in bright yellow stockings with garters crossed, smiling, holding a fake love letter to his chest.
it.controlEnglish: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.

it.text: Una contessa in lutto solleva il velo e rivela una bellezza che toglie il fiato. Il giardino di Olivia fiorisce di gelsomino e lavanda mentre il messaggero travestito le ruba il cuore.
it.english: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
it.back: A mourning countess lifts her veil and reveals a breathtaking beauty, Olivia’s garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
it.controlEnglish: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.

it.text: Il Senato romano, con le colonne di marmo macchiate di cremisi. Bruto sta fra i congiurati, la lama ancora tremante. Il peso della repubblica grava sulle sue mani insanguinate.
it.english: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.
it.back: The Roman Senate, with its marble columns stained in crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling; the weight of the republic weighs on his bloody hands.
it.controlEnglish: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.

it.text: Un vicolo romano a mezzanotte, alla luce delle torce. Cassio si china e sussurra sedizione con il suo aspetto magro e affamato. Lettere false gli scivolano dalla toga.
it.english: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.
it.back: A Roman alley at midnight, in the light of torches. Cassio leans over and whispers sedition with his skinny and hungry appearance.
it.controlEnglish: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.

it.text: Il Foro romano esplode di furia. Marco Antonio leva davanti alla folla il mantello insanguinato di Cesare; le sue parole mutano il lutto in fuoco. La repubblica crolla a ogni sillaba.
it.english: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.
it.back: The Roman Forum explodes in fury. Marcus Antonius raises Caesar’s bloody mantle before the crowd; his words turn mourning into fire, and the republic collapses at every syllable.
it.controlEnglish: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.

it.text: La tenuta dei Montecchi all’alba. Messer Montecchi guarda da un’alta finestra il figlio che vaga nei frutteti nebbiosi, malato d’amore e irraggiungibile.
it.english: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.
it.back: Messer Montecchi looks out of a high window at his son who is wandering in the misty orchards, sick of love and unreachable.
it.controlEnglish: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.

it.text: Il salone dei Capuleti, parato di seta. Madonna Capuleti dispone il destino della figlia come fiori in un vaso; l’ambizione luccica dietro ogni sorriso cortese.
it.english: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.
it.back: The salon of the Capulets, silk-wrapped. Madonna Capuleti arranges her daughter’s destiny like flowers in a vase. Ambition shines behind every courteous smile.
it.controlEnglish: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.

it.text: Gli spalti di Elsinore nell’ora fredda che precede l’alba. Orazio veglia accanto ad Amleto, l’unico vero amico in una corte di serpenti.
it.english: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.
it.back: The stands of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn: Horace watches beside Hamlet, his only true friend in a court of snakes.
it.controlEnglish: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.

it.text: Una radura nel bosco accesa di luce fatata. Bottom porta una testa d’asino con stupefatta dignità mentre Titania lo copre di ghirlande. Le fate soffocano le risa.
it.english: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.
it.back: A clearing in the woods lit with fairy light. Bottom carries a donkey’s head with amazed dignity while Titania covers it with garlands.
it.controlEnglish: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.

it.text: Il cimitero di Verona all’imbrunire. Paride depone fiori sulla tomba di Giulietta, ignaro dell’amante disperato che si avvicina dall’ombra.
it.english: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.
it.back: The cemetery of Verona at dusk: Paride lays flowers on Juliet’s grave, unaware of the desperate lover approaching from the shadow.
it.controlEnglish: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.

it.text: Una spiaggia incontaminata sull’isola di Prospero. Miranda vede per la prima volta i naufraghi, con gli occhi spalancati di meraviglia davanti a un mondo che non sapeva esistesse.
it.english: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.
it.back: A pristine beach on Prospero’s island, Miranda sees the shipwrecked for the first time, with her eyes wide open in wonder at a world she didn’t know existed.
it.controlEnglish: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.

it.text: Un anello d’oro riposa sul davanzale di pietra di un balcone e cattura la luce della luna. All’interno è inciso un voto che sopravvive alla morte stessa. Petali di rosa gli turbinano attorno in un vento invisibile.
it.english: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.
it.back: A golden ring rests on the stone sill of a balcony and catches the moonlight. Inside it is engraved a vow that survives death itself, rose petals swirl around it in an invisible wind.
it.controlEnglish: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.

it.text: Tre scrigni brillano in una stanza a lume di candela: oro, argento e piombo. Lo scrigno di piombo vibra di una quieta verità e premia chi è abbastanza saggio da guardare oltre le apparenze.
it.english: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.
it.back: Three chests shine in a candlelit room: gold, silver and lead.The lead chest vibrates with a quiet truth and rewards those who are wise enough to look beyond appearances.
it.controlEnglish: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.

it.text: Una corona scozzese annerita posa su un cuscino macchiato di sangue. Pulsa di oscura ambizione e sussurra promesse di gloria a ogni mano che osi tendersi verso di lei.
it.english: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
it.back: A blackened Scottish crown sits on a blood-stained pillow, pulsating with dark ambition and whispering promises of glory to every hand that dares reach for it.
it.controlEnglish: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.

it.text: Un antico tomo, rilegato in cuoio consumato dal mare, fluttua sopra un altare di pietra. Le sue pagine si voltano da sole, e ognuna evoca una tempesta diversa.
it.english: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.
it.back: An ancient volume, bound in leather worn by the sea, floats above a stone altar; its pages turn on their own, each evoking a different storm.
it.controlEnglish: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.

it.text: Una fiala di cristallo custodisce lacrime che brillano come luce di stelle imprigionata. Ogni goccia porta il dolore di una figlia che amò con troppa verità e parlò con troppa schiettezza.
it.english: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.
it.back: A crystal vial holds tears that shine like imprisoned starlight, each drop bearing the pain of a daughter who loved with too much truth and spoke with too much frankness.
it.controlEnglish: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.

it.text: Una maschera a testa d’asino pende da un ramo muscoso nel bosco delle fate. Chi la indossa vede il mondo con occhi incantati, e diventa irresistibile per le regine delle fate.
it.english: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.
it.back: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a musky branch in the fairy forest.The wearer sees the world with enchanted eyes, and becomes irresistible for fairy queens.
it.controlEnglish: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.

it.text: Una radice nodosa, a forma di figura urlante, viene dissotterrata a lume di candela. La terra si sgretola e ne rivela il potere antico e contorto. Lo speziale la maneggia con tremante riverenza.
it.english: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.
it.back: A knotty root, in the form of a screaming figure, is unearthed under candlelight. The earth crumbles and reveals its ancient and twisted power.The specialist handles it with trembling reverence.
it.controlEnglish: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.

it.text: Una goccia di rugiada resta sospesa su un’orchidea al chiaro di luna e brilla di una luce violetta ultraterrena. Una goccia sulle palpebre addormentate, e chi sogna s’innamora della prima creatura che vede.
it.english: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.
it.back: A drop of dew remains suspended on an orchid in moonlight and shines with an ultra-earthly violet light; a drop on the sleeping eyelids, and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature he sees.
it.controlEnglish: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.

it.text: Una fiala di vetro nero trasuda vapore verde in un corridoio buio. La tintura che contiene ha rovesciato re e spezzato dinastie, una goccia silenziosa dopo l’altra.
it.english: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.
it.back: A black glass vial exudes green vapor in a dark corridor; the dye it contains has overthrown kings and broken dynasties, one silent drop after another.
it.controlEnglish: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.

it.text: Bacche pallide luccicano tra scure foglie sempreverdi, raccolte sotto una luna d’inverno. L’estratto vibra della magia quieta e tenace del mondo naturale.
it.english: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.
it.back: Pale berries gleam among dark evergreen leaves, gathered under a winter moon.The extract vibrates with the quiet and tenacious magic of the natural world.
it.controlEnglish: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.

it.text: Una fiasca dal tappo di perla custodisce un liquido azzurro luminoso che si muove come un mare vivo. Dentro, minuscoli coralli crescono e si dissolvono. Sa di sale e di viaggi dimenticati.
it.english: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.
it.back: A bottle with a pearl cap holds a bright blue liquid that moves like a living sea. Inside, tiny corals grow and dissolve.It tastes of salt and forgotten travels.
it.controlEnglish: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.

it.text: Una polverosa bottega di speziale nel quartiere più povero di Mantova. Un elisir disperato riluce d’ambra in una fiala incrinata, potente abbastanza da colmare il varco tra la vita e la morte.
it.english: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
it.back: A desperate elixir shines amber in a cracked vial, powerful enough to bridge the gap between life and death, but it isn’t the only one that can help.
it.controlEnglish: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.

it.text: Un tappeto di narcisi dorati si stende lungo le rive di un lago immobile. Wordsworth cammina in mezzo a loro, taccuino in mano, con i monti del Cumberland che si alzano alle sue spalle.
it.english: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.
it.back: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake, Wordsworth walking among them, notebook in hand, with the mountains of Cumberland rising behind him.
it.controlEnglish: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.

it.text: Vagavo solitario come una nuvola che fluttua in alto sopra valli e colline.
it.english: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.
it.back: I wandered lonely like a cloud floating high above valleys and hills.
it.controlEnglish: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.

it.text: Una nave in bonaccia va alla deriva su un oceano dipinto. Il vecchio marinaio fissa l’albatro che ha al collo mentre figure spettrali salgono dal mare di vetro.
it.english: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.
it.back: A calm ship drifts on a painted ocean, the old sailor staring at the albatross around his neck as ghostly figures rise from the sea of glass.
it.controlEnglish: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.

it.text: Acqua, acqua dappertutto, e nemmeno una goccia da bere.
it.english: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.
it.back: Water, water everywhere, and not a drop to drink.
it.controlEnglish: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.

it.text: Un giardino di Hampstead in autunno. Keats siede sotto un susino e scrive febbrilmente mentre un usignolo canta dai rami che si fanno scuri.
it.english: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.
it.back: A Hampstead garden in autumn: Keats sits under a plum tree and writes feverishly while a hornbill sings from the darkening branches.
it.controlEnglish: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.

it.text: Una cosa bella è una gioia per sempre: la sua grazia cresce.
it.english: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.
it.back: A beautiful thing is a joy forever: its grace grows.
it.controlEnglish: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.

it.text: Un palazzo veneziano a mezzanotte. Byron sta sul balcone, il mantello al vento, lo sguardo sul canale buio. Alle sue spalle un manoscritto incompiuto brucia nel camino.
it.english: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.
it.back: A Venetian palace at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, his cloak in the wind, gazing out over the dark canal; behind him an unfinished manuscript burns in the fireplace.
it.controlEnglish: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.

it.text: Ella cammina nella bellezza, come la notte di climi senza nubi e di cieli stellati.
it.english: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.
it.back: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climates and starry skies.
it.controlEnglish: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.

it.text: Uno studio a lume di candela a Ginevra, durante un temporale. Mary scrive al bagliore dei lampi mentre la creatura si muove nell’ombra dietro di lei. Scienza e orrore diventano una cosa sola.
it.english: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.
it.back: A candlelit study in Geneva, during a thunderstorm. Mary writes in the glow of lightning while the creature moves in the shadow behind her.Science and horror become one thing.
it.controlEnglish: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.

it.text: Bada; perché sono senza paura, e perciò potente.
it.english: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.
it.back: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.
it.controlEnglish: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.

it.text: Una stanza in penombra, rischiarata da un fuoco morente. Poe è curvo sulla scrivania quando un corvo si posa sul busto di Pallade. La parola «Mai più» riecheggia nell’ombra.
it.english: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.
it.back: A semi-dark room, lit by a dying fire. Poe is bent over his desk when a crow lands on Pallas’ bust and the word “Never Again” echoes in the shadows.
it.controlEnglish: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.

it.text: Una stamperia di Londra accesa di luce visionaria. Blake incide una tigre nel rame mentre la belva prende corpo dalla lastra, ardendo luminosa nelle foreste della notte.
it.english: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.
it.back: A London printing press lit with visionary light, Blake engraving a tiger in copper as the beast takes shape from the plate, burning brightly in the forests of night.
it.controlEnglish: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.

it.text: Vedere un mondo in un granello di sabbia e un cielo in un fiore selvatico.
it.english: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.
it.back: See a world in a grain of sand and a sky in a wild flower.
it.controlEnglish: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?

it.text: La cima di una scogliera italiana battuta dal vento. Shelley affronta la tempesta a braccia aperte, mentre il vento dell’ovest strappa le pagine dal suo taccuino e le disperde sul Mediterraneo.
it.english: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.
it.back: Shelley faces the storm with open arms, as the wind from the west tears the pages out of her notebook and scatters them over the Mediterranean.
it.controlEnglish: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.

it.text: Se viene l’inverno, può la primavera essere lontana?
it.english: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?
it.back: If winter comes, can spring be far away?
it.controlEnglish: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.

it.text: Una stanza piena di sole a Firenze. Elizabeth scrive a una finestra che dà sull’Arno, con lo spaniel ai suoi piedi. Le lettere d’amore di Robert sono aperte sulla scrivania.
it.english: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.
it.back: A sunny room in Florence. Elizabeth is writing at a window overlooking the Arno, with her spaniel at her feet, and Robert’s love letters are open on her desk.
it.controlEnglish: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.

it.text: Come ti amo? Lascia che ne conti i modi.
it.english: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
it.back: How do I love you? Let me count the ways.
it.controlEnglish: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.

it.text: Un giardino preraffaellita nella luce d’autunno che si spegne. Christina siede tra le foglie cadute e compone versi che dolgono di bellezza e di quieta rassegnazione.
it.english: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.
it.back: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in the autumn light that goes out.Christina sits among the fallen leaves and composes verses that lament of beauty and quiet resignation.
it.controlEnglish: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.

it.text: Ricordati di me quando sarò andata via, lontano, nella terra silenziosa.
it.english: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.
it.back: Remember me when I am gone, far away, in the silent land.
it.controlEnglish: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.

it.text: Il monte Olimpo squarcia il cielo. Zeus siede su un trono di nubi, con il fulmine che gli guizza tra le dita. Sotto, il mondo dei mortali trema al suo sguardo.
it.english: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.
it.back: Mount Olympus rips through the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, with lightning whistling between his fingers; below, the world of mortals tremble at his gaze.
it.controlEnglish: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.

it.text: Io sono l’adunatore di nubi, signore degli ampi cieli.
it.english: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.
it.back: I am the gatherer of clouds, Lord of the wide heavens.
it.controlEnglish: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.

it.text: Il Partenone splende in una luce dorata. Atena sta in piedi in armatura completa, la civetta posata sullo scudo, gli occhi grigi che vedono attraverso ogni inganno mortale.
it.english: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.
it.back: The Parthenon shines in a golden light, Athena standing in full armor, the owl resting on the shield, grey eyes that see through every mortal deception.
it.controlEnglish: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.

it.text: La civetta della saggezza spicca il volo soltanto al crepuscolo.
it.english: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.
it.back: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.
it.controlEnglish: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.

it.text: Un carro d’oro corre nel cielo dell’alba. Apollo suona la lira mentre la luce del sole sgorga dalle ruote e dipinge il mondo di colori.
it.english: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.
it.back: A golden chariot runs through the dawn sky, Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight flows from the wheels and paints the world in colour.
it.controlEnglish: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.

it.text: Io sono il dio del canto, della guarigione e del sole radioso.
it.english: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.
it.back: I am the god of singing, healing and the radiant sun.
it.controlEnglish: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.

it.text: Le coste di Cipro all’alba. Afrodite sorge dalla spuma del mare; le colombe volano in cerchio e le onde le depongono perle ai piedi. Il mondo trattiene il respiro.
it.english: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.
it.back: The coasts of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from the foam of the sea; doves fly in circles and waves deposit pearls at her feet.
it.controlEnglish: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.

it.text: Nemmeno gli dèi possono resistere al potere dell’amore.
it.english: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
it.back: Not even the gods can resist the power of love.
it.controlEnglish: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.

it.text: Un guizzo di sandali alati attraversa il cielo. Ermes sguscia tra i fulmini, con un messaggio divino stretto in una mano e un sorriso da ladro sul volto.
it.english: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.
it.back: A whisper of winged sandals crosses the sky, and Hermes slips through lightning, holding a divine message in one hand and a thief's smile on his face.
it.controlEnglish: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.

it.text: Rapido come il pensiero, porto le parole degli dèi a orecchie mortali.
it.english: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.
it.back: Fast as thought, I bring the words of the gods to mortal ears.
it.controlEnglish: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.

it.text: La sala del trono degli Inferi, illuminata da fiumi di fuoco pallido. Ade siede con Cerbero ai piedi e l’elmo dell’oscurità sul bracciolo. I morti sfilano in un silenzio senza fine.
it.english: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.
it.back: The throne hall of the Underworld, illuminated by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet and the helmet of darkness on his armrest; the dead march in endless silence.
it.controlEnglish: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.

it.text: Tutte le anime vengono a me, alla fine. Sono paziente.
it.english: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
it.back: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
it.controlEnglish: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.

it.text: Un trono diviso tra primavera e ombra. Persefone tiene una melagrana in una mano e una corona di fiori nell’altra, regina di due regni.
it.english: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.
it.back: A throne divided between spring and shadow, Persephone holding a pomegranate in one hand and a wreath of flowers in the other, queen of two kingdoms.
