it.controlEnglish: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.

it.text: Sei semi mangiai, e mi legai per sempre fra due mondi.
it.english: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.
it.back: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself forever between two worlds.
it.controlEnglish: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.

it.text: Una nave sferzata dalla tempesta doppia un promontorio roccioso. Ulisse si lega all’albero mentre le Sirene cantano dalle scogliere. Nei suoi occhi brucia il ricordo di Itaca.
it.english: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.
it.back: A storm-stricken ship ducks over a rocky promontory. Odysseus ties himself to the tree while the Sirens sing from the cliffs, and in his eyes burns the memory of Ithaca.
it.controlEnglish: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.

it.text: Narrami, o Musa, dell’uomo dalle molte vie, che errò lontano.
it.english: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.
it.back: Tell me, O Moses, of the man of many ways, who went far astray.
it.controlEnglish: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.

it.text: Un tempio in rovina ai confini del mondo. Medusa si volta, con la chioma di serpenti che sibila. Guerrieri di pietra coprono il pavimento, immobili nella loro ultima carica.
it.english: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.
it.back: A temple in ruins at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair whistling, and stone warriors cover the floor, still in their last charge.
it.controlEnglish: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.

it.text: Guardami, se osi. Il mio sguardo è l’ultima cosa che vedrai.
it.english: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.
it.back: Look at me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you’ll see.
it.controlEnglish: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.

it.text: Le pianure di Troia all’alba. Achille carica in un’armatura sfolgorante, e il suo grido di guerra squarcia l’aria. Dietro di lui le navi greche bruciano sulla riva.
it.english: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.
it.back: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in dazzling armor, and his cry of war tears the air; behind him the Greek ships are burning on the shore.
it.controlEnglish: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.

it.text: Preferisco vivere una breve vita di gloria che una lunga vita dimenticata.
it.english: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.
it.back: I'd rather live a short life of glory than a long forgotten life.
it.controlEnglish: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?

ja.text: 壮大な舞台が姿を現す。The Sonnet Man がマイクを手に、金色のスポットライトの中から進み出る。シェイクスピアの言葉がヒップホップの詩行に変わり、観客が歓声を上げる。
ja.english: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.
ja.back: The Sonnet Man, with a microphone in his hand, walks through the golden spotlights. Shakespeare's words turn into hip-hop poetry and the audience cheers.
ja.controlEnglish: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.

ja.text: 君を夏の一日にたとえようか。
ja.english: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
ja.back: Let me compare you to a summer day.
ja.controlEnglish: To be, or not to be, that is the question.

ja.text: 月明かりのバルコニーの場面が広がる。ロミオが上へ手を伸ばすと、頭上にジュリエットが現れる。薔薇の花びらが宙を漂う。場面全体があたたかな深紅の光に脈打つ。
ja.english: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.
ja.back: The scene of the moonlit balcony unfolds. When Romeo reaches up, Juliet appears above his head. Rose petals float in the sky. The whole scene pulses in a soft deep red light.
ja.controlEnglish: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.

ja.text: キャピュレット家の庭が月明かりに咲き誇る。ジュリエットは薔薇の中に立ち、その目は反抗の光に輝く。枝の上でナイチンゲールが歌う。
ja.english: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.
ja.back: The Capitole's garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among the roses, her eyes shining with the light of rebellion. Nightingales sing on the branches.
ja.controlEnglish: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.

ja.text: エルシノア城が影の中から浮かび上がる。ハムレットは胸壁に立ち、その傍らにヨリックの髑髏が浮かぶ。城壁の上に亡霊のような姿が現れる。
ja.english: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.
ja.back: Castle Elsinore rises from the shadows. Hamlet stands on the chest wall, and beside him floats Yorick's skull. A ghost-like figure appears on the wall.
ja.controlEnglish: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.

ja.text: 生きるべきか、死ぬべきか、それが問題だ。
ja.english: To be, or not to be, that is the question.
ja.back: Should I live or should I die, that's the question.
ja.controlEnglish: There's rosemary, that's for remembrance.

ja.text: 穏やかな小川が柳の林を縫って流れる。オフィーリアは野の花の間に浮かび、忘れられた詩をささやく。花びらが流れの中で輪を描く。
ja.english: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.
ja.back: A gentle stream flows through a willow forest. Ophelia floats among the flowers of the field, whispering forgotten poems. The petals draw circles in the flow.
ja.controlEnglish: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.

ja.text: これはローズマリー、思い出のしるし。
ja.english: There's rosemary, that's for remembrance.
ja.back: This is rosemary, a reminder.
ja.controlEnglish: Lord, what fools these mortals be!

ja.text: ヴェローナの通りが大混乱に陥る。マキューシオは刃の間で踊り、危険を前に笑い声を上げる。ぶつかり合う鋼から火花が散る。
ja.english: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.
ja.back: The streets of Verona are filled with chaos. Machiavelli dances between the blades, laughing at danger. Sparks burst from the colliding steels.
ja.controlEnglish: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.

ja.text: 魔法の森がいたずらの気配にきらめく。パックは古い樫の木の間を駆け抜け、妖精の粉の跡を残していく。下では眠る人間たちが奇妙な夢を見ている。
ja.english: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.
ja.back: The magical forest is shimmering in a silly mood. Pack runs through the old oak trees, leaving behind traces of fairy powder. Below, sleeping humans have strange dreams.
ja.controlEnglish: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.

ja.text: まったく、人間というのは何と愚かなのだろう！
ja.english: Lord, what fools these mortals be!
ja.back: Oh, my God, how stupid people are!
ja.controlEnglish: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.

ja.text: 生きた蔓でできた玉座が森の地面からせり上がる。タイターニアが妖精の宮廷を従え、蛍が木々の梢を照らす。自然そのものが彼女の意志にひれ伏す。
ja.english: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.
ja.back: A throne made of living twigs rises from the ground in the forest. Titania follows the court of fairies, fireflies illuminate the tops of trees. Nature itself is subject to her will.
ja.controlEnglish: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.

ja.text: さあ、この花の寝床にお座りなさい。
ja.english: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.
ja.back: Come on, sit down on this flower bed.
ja.controlEnglish: Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio.

ja.text: 薄暗い地下墓所で、髑髏がビロードの上に置かれている。亡霊のような笑い声が響き、宮廷道化師の記憶が蝋燭の火のように揺らめく。
ja.english: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.
ja.back: In the dark underground cemetery, a skull is placed on top of a bird's nest; ghostly laughter sounds and the memory of the court dosha shakes like candlelight.
ja.controlEnglish: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.

ja.text: ああ、哀れなヨリック！ 私はこの男を知っていたのだ、ホレイショー。
ja.english: Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio.
ja.back: Oh, poor Yorick!
ja.controlEnglish: Now my charms are all o'erthrown.

ja.text: ヨリックの髑髏
ja.english: Yorick's Skull
ja.back: Yorick's Skull
ja.controlEnglish: Prospero's Staff

ja.text: 節くれだった杖が秘術の力で火花を散らす。プロスペロが最後の呪文をささやくと、嵐がその周りに渦を巻く。稲妻が空を裂く。
ja.english: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.
ja.back: When Prospero whispers the last spell, a storm swirls around it. Lightning tears the sky.
ja.controlEnglish: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.

ja.text: いまや私の魔法はすべて破れた。
ja.english: Now my charms are all o'erthrown.
ja.back: All my magic is now broken.
ja.controlEnglish: The course of true love never did run smooth.

ja.text: プロスペロの杖
ja.english: Prospero's Staff
ja.back: Prospero's staff
ja.controlEnglish: Love Potion

ja.text: 光を放つ小瓶が薔薇色の輝きに脈打つ。その表面から小さなハートが立ちのぼり、甘い旋律があたりに満ちる。
ja.english: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.
ja.back: A small bottle emitting light pulses with rose-colored glow, and a small heart rises from its surface, filled with sweet melody.
ja.controlEnglish: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.

ja.text: まことの恋の道は、けっして平らであったためしがない。
ja.english: The course of true love never did run smooth.
ja.back: The path of Makoto's love was flat.
ja.controlEnglish: Double, double toil and trouble.

ja.text: 惚れ薬
ja.english: Love Potion
ja.back: Passion
ja.controlEnglish: Witches' Brew

ja.text: 煮えたぎる大釜が緑の煙を吐き出す。三つの影のような人影がその周りを巡り、呪文を唱える。向こうの暗い森から目が光っている。
ja.english: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.
ja.back: Green smoke is exhaled from the over-boiling cauldron. Three shadows of people are circling around it and uttering a spell. Eyes shine from the dark forest beyond.
ja.controlEnglish: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.

ja.text: 倍だ、倍だ、苦労も苦しみも。
ja.english: Double, double toil and trouble.
ja.back: Double, double, hard work and suffering.
ja.controlEnglish: We are such stuff as dreams are made on.

ja.text: 魔女の煮汁
ja.english: Witches' Brew
ja.back: Witch's Soup
ja.controlEnglish: Dagger of the Mind

ja.text: 大公はヴェローナの宮殿の石段に立ち、その声が争う群衆を黙らせる。黄金の笏が権威に燃える。
ja.english: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.
ja.back: The Grand Duke stands on the stone steps of the palace in Verona, and his voice silenced the fighting crowds. His golden scepter burns with authority.
ja.controlEnglish: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.

ja.text: 蝋燭の灯る修道院の小部屋。修道士は薬草と毒草の庭の手入れをし、風雪に耐えたその顔には知恵が刻まれている。
ja.english: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.
ja.back: A small room in a monastery lit by candles. The monk cares for the garden of medicinal herbs and poisonous plants, with wisdom engraved on his face that has endured the wind and snow.
ja.controlEnglish: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.

ja.text: キャピュレット家のあたたかな台所。乳母はひたむきな忠義でせわしなく立ち働き、エプロンには秘密の手紙が忍ばせてある。
ja.english: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.
ja.back: In the quiet kitchen of the Capulet family, the nanny works with unwavering loyalty, and secret letters are hidden in her apron.
ja.controlEnglish: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.

ja.text: 嵐に包まれた島。プロスペロが両手を上げると、稲妻は彼の意志に従い、海は彼の命令で逆巻く。
ja.english: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.
ja.back: An island enveloped in a storm. When Prospero raises his hands, the lightning follows his will and the sea rolls back at his command.
ja.controlEnglish: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.

ja.text: 我々は夢と同じ材料でできている。
ja.english: We are such stuff as dreams are made on.
ja.back: We are made of the same material as dreams.
ja.controlEnglish: All hail, great master! Grave sir, hail!

ja.text: きらめく精霊が風と光に溶け、音楽となってふたたび形を結ぶ。エアリエルは見えるものと見えないもののあいだで踊る。
ja.english: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.
ja.back: Aeriel dances between the visible and invisible.
ja.controlEnglish: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.

ja.text: ばんざい、偉大なるご主人さま！ 厳かな殿、ばんざい！
ja.english: All hail, great master! Grave sir, hail!
ja.back: Thank you, my great master!
ja.controlEnglish: This island's mine, by Sycorax my mother.

ja.text: 荒々しい海岸に開いた洞窟の口。キャリバンは岩の間にうずくまり、その目は恨みと原始の知性に燃えている。
ja.english: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.
ja.back: The mouth of a cave opened on the rugged coast. Caliban is hidden among the rocks, his eyes burning with resentment and primitive intelligence.
ja.controlEnglish: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.

ja.text: この島はおれのものだ、母シコラクスから受け継いだ。
ja.english: This island's mine, by Sycorax my mother.
ja.back: This island belongs to me. I inherited it from my mother Sycorax.
ja.controlEnglish: My words fly up, my thoughts remain below.

ja.text: 夜明けのヴェローナの広場。ベンヴォーリオは抜かれた剣の間に立ち、開いた両手だけが迫りくる嵐に立ち向かう武器である。
ja.english: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.
ja.back: The square of Verona at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, with only his open hands as a weapon against the approaching storm.
ja.controlEnglish: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.

ja.text: 松明の光に燃え立つヴェローナの路地。ティボルトは敵を見据えたまま、命を奪うほど優美な手つきで細身の剣を抜く。
ja.english: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.
ja.back: The alleys of Verona are lit by the light of the sunrise. Tibalt draws his thin sword with a hand so beautiful that it takes his life, while still looking at the enemy.
ja.controlEnglish: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.

ja.text: 偽りの華やかさに包まれたエルシノアの玉座の間。クローディアスは王冠を握りしめ、衣の中に毒の小瓶を隠している。
ja.english: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.
ja.back: Among the thrones of Elsinoe, wrapped in false pomp. Clodius holds a crown and hides a vial of poison in his cloak.
ja.controlEnglish: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.

ja.text: 言葉は天へ飛んでいくが、思いは地に残る。
ja.english: My words fly up, my thoughts remain below.
ja.back: Words fly to heaven, but thoughts remain on the ground.
ja.controlEnglish: Ill met by moonlight, proud Titania.

ja.text: 魔法の森の奥深く、月明かりの空き地。オーベロンが影の中から姿を現し、鹿の角の冠が銀色の光を受ける。
ja.english: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.
ja.back: Deep in the magic forest, a moonlit empty space. Oberon appears from the shadows and the crown of deer horns receives silver light.
ja.controlEnglish: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.

ja.text: 月夜に悪い出会いだな、高慢なタイターニア。
ja.english: Ill met by moonlight, proud Titania.
ja.back: Bad encounter in the moonlight, proud Titania.
ja.controlEnglish: Is this a dagger which I see before me?

ja.text: 亡霊のような短剣が闇に浮かび、刃から幻の血がしたたる。マクベスの手は伸びるが、けっしてつかむことができない。
ja.english: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.
ja.back: A ghostly dagger floats in the darkness, and a phantom blood flows from its blade. Macbeth's hand reaches out, but he cannot grasp it.
ja.controlEnglish: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.

ja.text: 目の前に見えるこれは短剣か。
ja.english: Is this a dagger which I see before me?
ja.back: Is this a dagger you see in front of your eyes?
ja.controlEnglish: I'll put a girdle round about the earth in forty minutes.

ja.text: 心の短剣
ja.english: Dagger of the Mind
ja.back: Dagger of the Heart
ja.controlEnglish: Puck's Flower Juice

ja.text: つぶされた紫の花が、待ち受ける手のひらに虹色の蜜をしたたらせる。それが落ちるところでは目が変わり、心もそれに続く。
ja.english: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.
ja.back: When a purple flower is planted, it leaves rainbow-colored nectar on the palm of the waiting hand. When it falls, the eyes change and the mind follows.
ja.controlEnglish: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.

ja.text: 四十分で地球に帯をひと巻きしてみせます。
ja.english: I'll put a girdle round about the earth in forty minutes.
ja.back: I'll show you how to wrap a ribbon around the Earth in 40 minutes.
ja.controlEnglish: I dare do all that may become a man; who dares do more is none.

ja.text: パックの花の汁
ja.english: Puck's Flower Juice
ja.back: Pak's Flower Juice
ja.controlEnglish: Lord Montague

ja.text: ダンシネインの血に染まった玉座の間。マクベスは震える手で剣を握り、王冠が額に重くのしかかる。遠くの丘でバーナムの森が動き出す。
ja.english: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.
ja.back: Between the thrones stained with Dansinein's blood. Macbeth holds his sword in a trembling hand, the crown weighs heavily on his forehead.
ja.controlEnglish: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.

ja.text: 男にふさわしいことなら何でもやってみせる。それ以上をやる者は男ではない。
ja.english: I dare do all that may become a man; who dares do more is none.
ja.back: I will do anything worthy of a man. No man does more than that.
ja.controlEnglish: Come, you spirits that tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here.

ja.text: スコットランドの城の、蝋燭の灯る一室。マクベス夫人は冷たい石の上を行き来し、ありもしない血の染みを手からこすり落とそうとする。影が第二の肌のように彼女にまとわりつく。
ja.english: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.
ja.back: A candlelit chamber in a Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth walks on and off the cold stone, trying to wipe away the stain of blood that could not exist from her hands. The shadow wraps around her like a second skin.
ja.controlEnglish: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.

ja.text: 来い、人殺しの思いに仕える悪霊たちよ、この場で私を女でなくしておくれ。
ja.english: Come, you spirits that tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here.
ja.back: Come, you demons who serve murderous thoughts, make me no longer a woman in this place.
ja.controlEnglish: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.

ja.text: たそがれ時の霧深いスコットランドの荒野。バンクォウは毅然と立ち、三つの亡霊のような人影が運命を風にささやく。彼の亡霊は生者に取り憑くだろう。
ja.english: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.
ja.back: In the misty wilderness of Scotland at dawn, Banquo stands firmly, and three ghostly shadows whisper his fate to the wind. His ghost will possess the living.
ja.controlEnglish: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.

ja.text: おまえは王にはならぬが、王たちを生むだろう。
ja.english: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.
ja.back: You will not be king, but you will bring forth kings.
ja.controlEnglish: I am not what I am.

ja.text: 風の吹きすさぶイリリアの海岸。ヴァイオラは短く切った髪に水夫の帽子を深くかぶり、その目には二つの素性が揺らめく。海は行方知れずの兄の秘密をささやく。
ja.english: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.
ja.back: On the windswept coast of Illyria, Viola wears a sailor's hat deep in her short hair, and two faces shake in her eyes. The sea whispers the secret of her missing brother.
ja.controlEnglish: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.

ja.text: 私は今の私ではありません。
ja.english: I am not what I am.
ja.back: I'm not who I am now.
ja.controlEnglish: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them.

ja.text: オリヴィアの屋敷の日の当たる庭。マルヴォーリオはけばけばしい黄色の靴下に十字の靴下留めをして、にやにやしながら気取って歩き、偽の恋文を胸に抱きしめている。
ja.english: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.
ja.back: In the sunny garden of Olivia's mansion, Malvolio walks carelessly with a cross on his yellow socks, holding a false love letter in his breast.
ja.controlEnglish: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.

ja.text: 生まれながらに偉大な者もあり、努力して偉大になる者もあり、偉大さを押しつけられる者もある。
ja.english: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them.
ja.back: Some people are born great, some people become great by hard work, and some people are forced to be great.
ja.controlEnglish: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.

ja.text: 喪に服す伯爵令嬢がヴェールを上げ、息をのむほどの美しさをあらわにする。オリヴィアの庭にはジャスミンとラベンダーが咲き、変装した使者が彼女の心を奪う。
ja.english: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
ja.back: The mourning Countess lifts her veil and reveals a breathtaking beauty. Jasmine and lavender bloom in Olivia's garden, and a disguised messenger wins her heart.
ja.controlEnglish: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.

ja.text: 求めて得た恋もよいけれど、求めずに与えられた恋はもっとよい。
ja.english: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.
ja.back: It's good to ask for love, but it's better if you don't ask for it.
ja.controlEnglish: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.

ja.text: ローマの元老院、大理石の柱は深紅に染まっている。ブルトゥスは陰謀者たちの中に立ち、その刃はまだ震えている。共和国の重みが血に濡れた彼の手にかかっている。
ja.english: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.
ja.back: The marble columns of Rome's Senate are dyed deep red. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still shaking. The weight of the Republic is in his blood-soaked hand.
ja.controlEnglish: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.

ja.text: シーザーを愛さなかったのではない、ローマをより深く愛したのだ。
ja.english: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.
ja.back: Not that he did not love Caesar, but he loved Rome more deeply.
ja.controlEnglish: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.

ja.text: 真夜中、松明の灯るローマの路地。カッシウスは身を寄せ、痩せて飢えたような顔つきで謀反をささやく。偽造した手紙がトーガからこぼれ落ちる。
ja.english: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.
ja.back: At midnight, the streets of Rome are lit by maple trees. Cassius approaches and whispers his plot with a skinny, hungry face. A forged letter falls from Toga.
ja.controlEnglish: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.

ja.text: ブルータスよ、罪は我々の星にあるのではない、我々自身にあるのだ。
ja.english: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.
ja.back: Brutus, the sin is not on our planet, it's on us.
ja.controlEnglish: Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!

ja.text: ローマのフォルムが怒りに沸き返る。マルクス・アントニウスは群衆の前でカエサルの血染めの外套を高く掲げ、その言葉が悲しみを炎に変える。一音ごとに共和国が崩れていく。
ja.english: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.
ja.back: The forms of Rome boil with anger. Marcus Antonius lifts up Caesar's blood-dyed cloak in front of the crowd, and his words turn grief into fire.
ja.controlEnglish: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.

ja.text: 友よ、ローマ市民よ、同胞よ、耳を貸してくれ！
ja.english: Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!
ja.back: Friend, citizen of Rome, fellow man, listen!
ja.controlEnglish: Now cracks a noble heart. Good night, sweet prince.

ja.text: 夜明けのモンタギュー家の屋敷。モンタギュー卿は高い窓から、霧のかかる果樹園をさまよう息子を見つめる。恋に病み、手の届かない息子を。
ja.english: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.
ja.back: The house of the Montagu family at dawn. Lord Montagu looks out of a high window over the misty orchard to his son, who is sick of love and unreachable.
ja.controlEnglish: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.

ja.text: モンタギュー卿
ja.english: Lord Montague
ja.back: Lord Montagu
ja.controlEnglish: Lady Capulet

ja.text: 絹をめぐらせたキャピュレット家の大広間。キャピュレット夫人は花瓶に花を生けるように娘の運命を整え、しとやかな微笑みの一つ一つの奥に野心がきらめく。
ja.english: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.
ja.back: The grand hall of the Capulet family, surrounded by silk. Madame Capulet arranges her daughter's destiny as if she were a flower in a vase, and behind each gentle smile there is an ambition.
ja.controlEnglish: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.

ja.text: キャピュレット夫人
ja.english: Lady Capulet
ja.back: Madame Capulet
ja.controlEnglish: Romeo's Ring

ja.text: 夜明け前の冷たい時刻、エルシノアの胸壁。ホレイショーはハムレットの傍らで見張りに立つ。蛇ばかりの宮廷でただ一人の真の友である。
ja.english: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.
ja.back: A cold hour before dawn, Elsinore's chest wall. Horatio stands guard beside Hamlet. He is the only true friend in a court full of snakes.
ja.controlEnglish: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.

ja.text: いま気高い心が砕けた。おやすみなさい、優しい王子さま。
ja.english: Now cracks a noble heart. Good night, sweet prince.
ja.back: Good night, gentle prince.
ja.controlEnglish: I have had a most rare vision. I have had a dream, past the wit of man.

ja.text: 妖精の光に輝く森の空き地。ボトムは戸惑いながらも威厳を保ってロバの頭をかぶり、タイターニアが彼を花輪で飾る。妖精たちは笑いをこらえている。
ja.english: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.
ja.back: An open space in the forest glows with the light of fairies. Bottom wears a donkey's head, confounded but dignified, and Titania decorates him with wreaths. The fairies laugh.
ja.controlEnglish: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.

ja.text: 世にも珍しい幻を見た。人間の知恵では測れない夢を見た。
ja.english: I have had a most rare vision. I have had a dream, past the wit of man.
ja.back: I saw a vision rare in the world. I had dreams that cannot be measured by human wisdom.
ja.controlEnglish: O brave new world, that has such people in it!

ja.text: 夕暮れのヴェローナの墓地。パリスはジュリエットの墓に花を手向ける。影の中から近づいてくる必死の恋人には気づかずに。
ja.english: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.
ja.back: The cemetery of Verona at dusk. Paris is placing flowers on Juliet's grave, unaware of her desperate lover approaching from the shadows.
ja.controlEnglish: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.

ja.text: プロスペロの島の汚れのない浜辺。ミランダは難破した船乗りたちを初めて目にし、知らなかった世界への驚きに目を見開く。
ja.english: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.
ja.back: On the pristine shore of Prospero's island, Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time and opens her eyes to a world she had never known.
ja.controlEnglish: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.

ja.text: ああ、すばらしい新世界、こんな人たちがいるなんて！
ja.english: O brave new world, that has such people in it!
ja.back: Oh, what a wonderful new world we have!
ja.controlEnglish: All that glisters is not gold.

ja.text: 金の指輪がバルコニーの石の手すりに置かれ、月の光を受けている。内側には死そのものよりも長く続く誓いが刻まれている。見えない風の中で、薔薇の花びらがその周りを舞う。
ja.english: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.
ja.back: A golden ring is placed on the balcony's stone railing, lit by the moonlight. Inside it is engraved an oath that lasts longer than death itself. Rose petals flutter around it in the invisible wind.
ja.controlEnglish: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.

ja.text: ロミオの指輪
ja.english: Romeo's Ring
ja.back: Romeo's Ring
ja.controlEnglish: Portia's Casket

ja.text: 蝋燭の灯る部屋に三つの小箱が輝く。金、銀、そして鉛。鉛の小箱は静かな真実に低く響き、見かけの奥を見抜く知恵のある者に報いる。
ja.english: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.
ja.back: In a room lit by candles, three small boxes shine: gold, silver and lead. The small box of lead sounds low to the quiet truth and rewards the wise one who sees beyond appearance.
ja.controlEnglish: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.

ja.text: 光るものすべてが金ではない。
ja.english: All that glisters is not gold.
ja.back: Not everything that shines is gold.
ja.controlEnglish: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.

ja.text: ポーシャの小箱
ja.english: Portia's Casket
ja.back: The Box of Porsha
ja.controlEnglish: Macbeth's Crown

ja.text: くすんだスコットランドの王冠が血に染まった枕の上に置かれている。それは暗い野心に脈打ち、手を伸ばす勇気のある者すべてに栄光の約束をささやく。
ja.english: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
ja.back: The scorched crown of Scotland is placed on a blood-stained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering the promise of glory to all who are brave enough to reach out.
ja.controlEnglish: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.

ja.text: 王冠をいただく頭は安らかに眠れない。
ja.english: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.
ja.back: The head that receives the crown cannot sleep in peace.
ja.controlEnglish: I'll drown my book.

ja.text: マクベスの王冠
ja.english: Macbeth's Crown
ja.back: Macbeth's Crown
ja.controlEnglish: The Tempest Codex

ja.text: 海にさらされた革で綴じられた古い書物が、石の祭壇の上に浮かんでいる。頁はひとりでにめくれ、その一枚一枚が別の嵐を呼び起こす。
ja.english: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.
ja.back: An old book written in leather exposed to the sea floats on a stone altar. The pages are turned one at a time, and each page causes another storm.
ja.controlEnglish: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.

ja.text: 私の書物を海に沈めよう。
ja.english: I'll drown my book.
ja.back: Let's sink my books into the sea.
ja.controlEnglish: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.

ja.text: 嵐の古写本
ja.english: The Tempest Codex
ja.back: The Ancient Manuscripts of the Storm
ja.controlEnglish: Cordelia's Tears

ja.text: 水晶の小瓶に、捕らえられた星明かりのようにきらめく涙が収められている。その一滴一滴が、あまりに真実に愛し、あまりに率直に語った娘の悲しみを宿している。
ja.english: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.
ja.back: The crystal jar contains tears shimmering like captured starlight. Each drop of it contains the sadness of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke so frankly.
ja.controlEnglish: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.

ja.text: ああ、お父さま、私が取りかかっているのはあなたのご用なのです。
ja.english: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.
ja.back: Oh, Father, what I'm doing is for your sake.
ja.controlEnglish: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!

ja.text: コーディリアの涙
ja.english: Cordelia's Tears
ja.back: Tears of Cordilia
ja.controlEnglish: Bottom's Mask

ja.text: ロバの頭の仮面が、妖精の森の苔むした枝にかかっている。それをかぶる者は魔法のかかった目で世界を見、妖精の女王たちにとって抗いがたい存在となる。
ja.english: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.
ja.back: The donkey-head mask hangs on the mossy branches of the fairy forest, and its wearer sees the world with magical eyes and becomes an irresistible presence for the fairy queens.
ja.controlEnglish: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.

ja.text: おやおや、ボトム！ おまえは姿が変わってしまった！
ja.english: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!
ja.back: You've changed!
ja.controlEnglish: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.

ja.text: ボトムの仮面
ja.english: Bottom's Mask
ja.back: The Mask of Bottom
ja.controlEnglish: Mandrake Root

ja.text: 叫ぶ人の形をした節くれだった根が、蝋燭の明かりのもとで掘り出される。土が崩れ落ち、ねじれた太古の力があらわになる。薬屋は震えるほどの畏れをもってそれを扱う。
ja.english: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.
ja.back: Under the light of candles, a dead root in the form of a screaming man is dug up. The soil collapses and the twisted ancient power is revealed. The pharmacist handles it with trepidation.
ja.controlEnglish: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.

ja.text: 芥子も、マンドラゴラも、この世のどんな眠り薬も。
ja.english: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.
ja.back: No mustard, no mandragora, no sleeping pills.
ja.controlEnglish: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.

ja.text: マンドレイクの根
ja.english: Mandrake Root
ja.back: Mandrake's root
ja.controlEnglish: Oberon's Dew

ja.text: 月明かりの蘭に一粒の露がとどまり、この世ならぬ紫の光を放つ。眠るまぶたに一滴落とせば、夢見る者は最初に目にした生き物に恋をする。
ja.english: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.
ja.back: A grain of dew remains on a moonlit orchid and emits a purple light that is beyond this world; if one drop falls on a sleeping eyelid, the dreamer will fall in love with the first creature he sees.
ja.controlEnglish: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.

ja.text: あの花を取ってきておくれ。いつかおまえに見せたあの草だ。
ja.english: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.
ja.back: Bring me that flower. It's the grass I showed you one day.
ja.controlEnglish: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.

ja.text: オーベロンの露
ja.english: Oberon's Dew
ja.back: Dew of Oberon
ja.controlEnglish: Hemlock Tincture

ja.text: 暗い廊下で、黒いガラスの小瓶が緑の蒸気をにじませる。中のチンキは、音もない一滴また一滴で、王たちを倒し王朝を砕いてきた。
ja.english: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.
ja.back: In a dark corridor, a small black glass flask emits green vapor. The tincture in it has broken down kings and dynasties with noiseless drops after drops.
ja.controlEnglish: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.

ja.text: 私が安心して眠る時刻に、おまえの叔父は呪わしいヘボナの汁を小瓶に入れて忍び寄った。
ja.english: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.
ja.back: Just as I was sleeping safely, your uncle sneaked in with a vial of cursed hebona juice.
ja.controlEnglish: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.

ja.text: 毒人参のチンキ
ja.english: Hemlock Tincture
ja.back: Ginkgo biloba
ja.controlEnglish: Mistletoe Extract

ja.text: 冬の月の下で摘まれた淡い色の実が、暗い常緑の葉の間で光る。そのエキスは、自然界の静かで粘り強い魔法に低く響く。
ja.english: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.
ja.back: The pale-coloured fruits, harvested under the winter moon, shine among dark evergreen leaves.These extracts resonate lowly with the quiet and tenacious magic of nature.
ja.controlEnglish: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.

ja.text: 大釜で煮えろ、焼けろ。いもりの目に蛙の指。
ja.english: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.
ja.back: Boil in a large pot, cook. Imori's eyes are frog fingers.
ja.controlEnglish: Full fathom five thy father lies; of his bones are coral made.

ja.text: 宿り木のエキス
ja.english: Mistletoe Extract
ja.back: Extract of the tree of shelter
ja.controlEnglish: Mermaid's Tears

ja.text: 真珠の栓をした瓶に、生きた海のように揺れ動く、光る青い液体が収められている。その中で小さな珊瑚が育っては溶けていく。塩と、忘れられた航海の匂いがする。
ja.english: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.
ja.back: A bottle with a pearl stopper contains a shining blue liquid that waves like a living sea. Small corals grow in it and melt away. It smells of salt and forgotten navigation.
ja.controlEnglish: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.

ja.text: 五尋の深みにそなたの父は眠る。その骨は珊瑚となった。
ja.english: Full fathom five thy father lies; of his bones are coral made.
ja.back: His father sleeps in the depths of Gokyo, and his bones have become corals.
ja.controlEnglish: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.

ja.text: 人魚の涙
ja.english: Mermaid's Tears
ja.back: Mermaid's Tear
ja.controlEnglish: Apothecary's Elixir

ja.text: マントヴァの最も貧しい界隈にある、ほこりっぽい薬屋。ひびの入った小瓶の中で、窮余の霊薬が琥珀色に光る。生と死のあいだの隔たりを越えるほどに強い。
ja.english: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
ja.back: A shabby drugstore in one of the poorest quarters of Mantua. In frozen bottles, amber-coloured spirit potions are kept in confinement. They are strong enough to overcome the distance between life and death.
ja.controlEnglish: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.

ja.text: 薬屋の霊薬
ja.english: Apothecary's Elixir
ja.back: 薬屋の霊薬
ja.controlEnglish: Yorick's Skull

ja.text: 金色の水仙の絨毯が、静かな湖の岸辺に沿って広がる。ワーズワースは手帳を手にその中を歩き、背後にはカンバーランドの山々がそびえる。
ja.english: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.
ja.back: A golden carpet of hydrangeas spreads along the shores of a quiet lake. Wordsworth walks through it with his notebook in hand, and behind him are the mountains of Cumberland.
ja.controlEnglish: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.

ja.text: 私は谷や丘の上高く漂う雲のように、ひとりさまよった。
ja.english: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.
ja.back: I flew alone like clouds high above valleys and hills.
ja.controlEnglish: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.

ja.text: 凪で止まった船が、絵に描いたような海の上を漂う。老水夫は首にかけられたアホウドリを見つめ、鏡のような海から亡霊のような人影が立ちのぼる。
ja.english: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.
ja.back: A ship that has stopped in a storm is floating on the sea as if it were painted. The old sailor looks at an owl hanging around his neck, and a ghost-like shadow rises from the mirror-like sea.
ja.controlEnglish: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.

ja.text: 水、水、どこもかしこも水、それなのに飲める水は一滴もない。
ja.english: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.
ja.back: Water, water, water everywhere, yet there is not a drop of drinkable water.
ja.controlEnglish: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.

ja.text: 秋のハムステッドの庭。キーツは李の木の下に座って熱に浮かされたように書き、暗くなっていく枝からナイチンゲールが歌う。
ja.english: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.
ja.back: The garden of Hampstead in autumn. Keats writes as if floating in the heat, sitting under a lilac tree, and Nightingale sings from the darkening branches.
ja.controlEnglish: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.

ja.text: 美しいものは永遠の喜びである。その愛らしさは増していく。
ja.english: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.
ja.back: A beautiful thing is an eternal joy. Its loveliness increases.
ja.controlEnglish: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.

ja.text: 真夜中のヴェネツィアの館。バイロンはバルコニーに立ち、外套をはためかせ、暗い運河を見つめている。背後の暖炉では書きかけの原稿が燃えている。
ja.english: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.
ja.back: A Venetian mansion in the middle of the night. Byron stands on a balcony, taking off his cloak and staring at the dark canal. The fireplace behind him burns drafts of his writings.
ja.controlEnglish: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.

ja.text: 彼女は美しさの中を歩む、雲ひとつない国の星空の夜のように。
ja.english: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.
ja.back: She walks through beauty, like a starry night in a cloudless land.
ja.controlEnglish: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.

ja.text: 雷雨のさなか、蝋燭の灯るジュネーヴの書斎。メアリーは稲光を頼りに書き、背後の影の中であの被造物がうごめく。科学と恐怖がひとつになる。
ja.english: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.
ja.back: In the midst of thunderstorms, in a candlelit Geneva office, Mary writes with lightning, and the objects in the shadow behind her glow. Science and fear become one.
ja.controlEnglish: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.

ja.text: 気をつけるがいい。私は恐れを知らない、それゆえに強いのだ。
ja.english: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.
ja.back: Be careful. I don't know fear, so I'm strong.
ja.controlEnglish: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.

ja.text: 消えかけた火に照らされた薄暗い部屋。ポーが机にかがみ込んでいると、一羽の大鴉がパラスの胸像にとまる。「またとない」という言葉が影の中にこだまする。
ja.english: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.
ja.back: A dark room lit by a fading fire. While Poe is sitting at his desk, a great raven stops on the bust of Pallas. The words "no more" are repeated in the shadows.
ja.controlEnglish: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.

ja.text: あるわびしい真夜中のこと、弱り疲れて思いにふけっていると。
ja.english: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.
ja.back: He was weak and tired, thinking about a terrible midnight.
ja.controlEnglish: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.

ja.text: 幻視の光に燃え立つロンドンの印刷工房。ブレイクが銅板に虎を刻むと、その獣が版から現れ、夜の森で赤々と燃える。
ja.english: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.
ja.back: When Blake carves a tiger on a copper plate, the beast appears from the plate and burns red in the forest at night.
ja.controlEnglish: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.

ja.text: 一粒の砂に世界を見、一輪の野の花に天国を見る。
ja.english: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.
ja.back: We see the world in a grain of sand, and we see heaven in a ring of field flowers.
ja.controlEnglish: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?

ja.text: 風の吹きすさぶイタリアの崖の上。シェリーは両腕を広げて嵐に向かい、西風が手帳から頁を引きちぎって地中海にまき散らす。
ja.english: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.
ja.back: On a cliff in Italy where the wind blows. Shelley stretches out her arms toward the storm, and the west wind pulls pages from her notebook and scatters them over the Mediterranean Sea.
ja.controlEnglish: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.

ja.text: 冬が来たなら、春は遠くないのではないか。
ja.english: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?
ja.back: If winter has come, spring is not far away.
ja.controlEnglish: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.

ja.text: フィレンツェの日の当たる部屋。エリザベスはアルノ川を見下ろす窓辺で書き、足もとにはスパニエル犬がいる。ロバートからの恋文が机の上に開かれている。
ja.english: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.
ja.back: A sunny room in Florence. Elizabeth is writing from a window overlooking the Arno, with a spaniel at her feet. A love letter from Robert opens on the desk.
ja.controlEnglish: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.

ja.text: どのようにあなたを愛しているか。その数々を数えさせてください。
ja.english: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
ja.back: Let me count how much I love you.
ja.controlEnglish: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.

ja.text: 薄れゆく秋の光に包まれたラファエル前派の庭。クリスティーナは落ち葉の中に座り、美しさと静かな諦めに胸の痛む詩を紡ぐ。
ja.english: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.
ja.back: A Pre-Raphaelite garden enveloped in the fading light of autumn. Cristina sits among the fall leaves, weaving a painful poem about beauty and quiet resignation.
ja.controlEnglish: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.

ja.text: 私を思い出してください、私が去ったあと、遠く静かな国へ去ったあとに。
ja.english: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.
ja.back: Remember me, after I'm gone, after I've gone to a far quiet country.
ja.controlEnglish: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.

ja.text: オリュンポス山が空を裂く。ゼウスは雲の玉座に座り、その指の間に稲妻が走る。下では人間の世界が彼のまなざしに震える。
ja.english: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.
ja.back: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a cloudy throne, lightning flies between his fingers. Below, the world of men shakes at his whisper.
ja.controlEnglish: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.

ja.text: 我は雲を集める者、広き天の主である。
ja.english: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.
ja.back: I am the gatherer of clouds, and the Lord of the expansive heaven.
ja.controlEnglish: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.

ja.text: パルテノン神殿が金色の光に輝く。アテーナーは全身に鎧をまとって立ち、盾には梟がとまり、その灰色の目は人間のあらゆる欺きを見抜く。
ja.english: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.
ja.back: The Parthenon shines in a golden light. Athena stands with her entire body wrapped in armor, and on her shield there is an owl whose gray eyes see through all human deceit.
ja.controlEnglish: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.

ja.text: 知恵の梟は夕暮れにのみ飛び立つ。
ja.english: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.
ja.back: The wise owl flies only at dusk.
ja.controlEnglish: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.

ja.text: 黄金の戦車が夜明けの空を駆ける。アポローンが竪琴を奏でると、車輪から陽の光があふれ、世界を色で染めていく。
ja.english: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.
ja.back: A golden chariot races through the dawn sky. When Apollo plays his harp, sunlight flows from the wheels and colours the world.
ja.controlEnglish: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.

ja.text: 我は歌と癒やしと輝く太陽の神である。
ja.english: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.
ja.back: I am the god of song, healing and the shining sun.
ja.controlEnglish: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.

ja.text: 夜明けのキプロスの海岸。アプロディーテーが海の泡から立ち上がり、頭上を鳩が舞い、波が彼女の足もとに真珠を置く。世界が息をひそめる。
ja.english: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.
ja.back: The shore of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from the sea bubbles, doves fly over her head, waves lay pearls at her feet. The world breathes.
ja.controlEnglish: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.

ja.text: 神々でさえ愛の力には逆らえない。
ja.english: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
ja.back: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
ja.controlEnglish: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.

ja.text: 翼のあるサンダルが空をかすめて走る。ヘルメースは雷の間を縫い、片手に神々の伝言を握り、顔には盗人の笑みを浮かべている。
ja.english: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.
ja.back: A winged sandal runs through the sky. Hermes sews through thunder, holds a message from the gods in one hand and smiles like a thief.
ja.controlEnglish: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.

ja.text: 思いのように速く、我は神々の言葉を人の耳に運ぶ。
ja.english: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.
ja.back: As fast as I can, I will carry the words of the gods to the ears of men.
ja.controlEnglish: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.

ja.text: 青白い炎の川に照らされた冥界の玉座の間。ハーデースは足もとにケルベロスを従えて座り、姿を隠す兜が肘掛けに置かれている。死者たちが果てしない沈黙の中を列をなして過ぎていく。
ja.english: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.
ja.back: Between the thrones of Hades, lit by a river of pale flames. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, and the helmet that hides his face is placed on his elbow. The dead line up in endless silence.
ja.controlEnglish: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.

ja.text: すべての魂は最後に我のもとへ来る。我は辛抱強い。
ja.english: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
ja.back: All souls come to Me at last. I am patient.
ja.controlEnglish: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.

ja.text: 春と影とに分かたれた玉座。ペルセポネーは片手に柘榴を、もう片方の手に花の冠を持つ、二つの国の女王である。
ja.english: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.
ja.back: A throne divided between spring and shadow. Persephone is the queen of two countries, holding a cypress in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other.
ja.controlEnglish: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.

ja.text: 私は六粒の種を食べ、二つの世界のあいだに永遠に身を縛った。
ja.english: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.
ja.back: I ate the six seeds and forever bound myself between two worlds.
ja.controlEnglish: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.

ja.text: 嵐に打たれた船が岩だらけの岬を回る。オデュッセウスは帆柱にわが身を縛りつけ、崖の上からセイレーンたちが歌う。その目にはイタケーの記憶が燃えている。
ja.english: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.
ja.back: A storm-hit ship circumnavigates a rocky cape. Odysseus binds himself to a sail post, and the sirens sing from the cliffs. The memory of Itake burns in his eyes.
ja.controlEnglish: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.

ja.text: 語りたまえ、ムーサよ、遠くさすらった知略に富む男のことを。
ja.english: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.
ja.back: Tell me, O Moses, of the man who came from far away and was full of wisdom.
ja.controlEnglish: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.

ja.text: 世界の果ての崩れた神殿。メドゥーサが振り向き、蛇の髪がしゅうしゅうと音を立てる。石の戦士たちが床に散らばり、最後の突撃の姿のまま固まっている。
ja.english: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.
ja.back: A crumbling temple at the end of the world. Medusa turns around, snake hairs make a loud noise. Stone warriors are scattered on the floor, solidified in their last assault.
ja.controlEnglish: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.

ja.text: 勇気があるなら私を見よ。私のまなざしがおまえの見る最後のものとなる。
ja.english: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.
ja.back: If you have the courage, look at me. My face will be your last to see.
ja.controlEnglish: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.

ja.text: 夜明けのトロイアの平原。アキレウスは燃え立つような鎧をまとって突進し、その雄叫びが空気を裂く。背後では、ギリシアの船が岸辺で燃えている。
ja.english: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.
ja.back: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles storms forward in burning armor, his shouting tears the air. Behind him, Greek ships are burning on the shore.
ja.controlEnglish: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.

ja.text: 忘れられた長い生よりも、栄光の短い生を生きたい。
ja.english: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.
ja.back: I want to live a short life of glory rather than a long one that has been forgotten.
ja.controlEnglish: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
