ko.text: 웅장한 무대가 모습을 드러낸다. The Sonnet Man이 마이크를 손에 들고 금빛 조명 속에서 걸어 나온다. 셰익스피어의 말이 힙합 가사로 바뀌고 관객이 환호한다.
ko.english: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.
ko.back: The Sonnet Man walks through the golden lights with a microphone in his hand. Shakespeare's words turn into hip-hop lyrics, and the audience cheers.
ko.controlEnglish: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.

ko.text: 그대를 여름날에 비겨 볼까요?
ko.english: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
ko.back: May I compare you to a summer day?
ko.controlEnglish: But soft, what light through yonder window breaks?

ko.text: 달빛 어린 발코니 장면이 펼쳐진다. 로미오가 위로 손을 뻗자 줄리엣이 위에 나타난다. 장미 꽃잎이 공중에 흩날린다. 장면 전체가 따뜻한 진홍빛으로 고동친다.
ko.english: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.
ko.back: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches up and Juliet appears above him, rose petals flying in the air. The whole scene vibrates in a warm iridescent light.
ko.controlEnglish: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.

ko.text: 가만, 저 창문으로 비쳐 오는 빛은 무엇인가?
ko.english: But soft, what light through yonder window breaks?
ko.back: Wait, what is the light coming through that window?
ko.controlEnglish: What's in a name? That which we call a rose...

ko.text: 캐풀렛 가문의 정원이 달빛 아래 피어난다. 줄리엣은 장미 사이에 서 있고, 그녀의 눈은 반항으로 빛난다. 나뭇가지에서 나이팅게일이 노래한다.
ko.english: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.
ko.back: The Capulet garden blooms in the moonlight. Juliet stands among the roses, her eyes shining with rebellion, and a nightingale sings on the branches.
ko.controlEnglish: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.

ko.text: 이름이 무엇이란 말인가? 우리가 장미라 부르는 그것은...
ko.english: What's in a name? That which we call a rose...
ko.back: What do you mean by a name?
ko.controlEnglish: To be, or not to be, that is the question.

ko.text: 엘시노어 성이 그림자 속에서 떠오른다. 햄릿은 성벽 위에 서 있고, 그 곁에 요릭의 해골이 떠 있다. 성벽 위쪽에 유령 같은 형체가 나타난다.
ko.english: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.
ko.back: Elsinore Castle emerges from the shadows. Hamlet stands on top of the wall, with Yorick's skull floating nearby, and a ghostly figure appears above the wall.
ko.controlEnglish: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.

ko.text: 사느냐 죽느냐, 그것이 문제로다.
ko.english: To be, or not to be, that is the question.
ko.back: It's a matter of life or death.
ko.controlEnglish: There's rosemary, that's for remembrance.

ko.text: 잔잔한 시내가 버드나무 숲 사이로 굽이쳐 흐른다. 오필리아는 들꽃 사이에 떠서 잊힌 시구를 속삭인다. 꽃잎이 물살 속에서 맴돈다.
ko.english: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.
ko.back: A gentle stream winds its way through the birch forest. Ophelia floats among the wildflowers, whispering forgotten poems.
ko.controlEnglish: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.

ko.text: 여기 로즈메리가 있어요, 기억을 위한 것이지요.
ko.english: There's rosemary, that's for remembrance.
ko.back: Here's the rosemary, for your memory.
ko.controlEnglish: A plague on both your houses!

ko.text: 베로나의 거리가 혼란에 휩싸인다. 머큐쇼는 칼날 사이에서 춤추며 위험 앞에서 웃는다. 부딪치는 강철에서 불꽃이 튄다.
ko.english: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.
ko.back: The streets of Verona are in chaos. Mercutio dances between the blades, laughing at danger.
ko.controlEnglish: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.

ko.text: 너희 두 집안에 저주가 내려라!
ko.english: A plague on both your houses!
ko.back: Curse be upon you, both houses!
ko.controlEnglish: Lord, what fools these mortals be!

ko.text: 마법의 숲이 장난기로 반짝인다. 퍽은 오래된 참나무 사이를 쏜살같이 지나가며 요정 가루의 자취를 남긴다. 아래에서는 잠든 인간들이 이상한 꿈을 꾼다.
ko.english: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.
ko.back: The magical forest glows like a toy. Puck flies through the old ash trees, leaving behind a trail of fairy dust.
ko.controlEnglish: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.

ko.text: 아, 인간들이란 얼마나 어리석은가!
ko.english: Lord, what fools these mortals be!
ko.back: Oh, how stupid humans are!
ko.controlEnglish: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.

ko.text: 살아 있는 덩굴로 된 왕좌가 숲 바닥에서 솟아오른다. 티타니아가 요정 궁정을 다스리고, 반딧불이가 나무 꼭대기를 밝힌다. 자연마저 그녀의 뜻에 고개를 숙인다.
ko.english: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.
ko.back: A throne of living vines rises from the bottom of the forest. Titania rules the fairy palace, fireflies illuminate the treetops, and nature bows to her will.
ko.controlEnglish: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.

ko.text: 자, 이 꽃 침대 위에 앉으세요.
ko.english: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.
ko.back: Now, sit on this flower bed.
ko.controlEnglish: Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio.

ko.text: 어둑한 지하 묘실, 벨벳 위에 해골이 놓여 있다. 유령 같은 웃음소리가 울리고, 궁정 광대의 기억이 촛불처럼 흔들린다.
ko.english: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.
ko.back: Dark underground tombs, skulls lying on velvet, ghostly laughs echoing, the memories of court mobs shaking like candles.
ko.controlEnglish: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.

ko.text: 아, 불쌍한 요릭! 나는 그를 알았네, 호레이쇼.
ko.english: Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio.
ko.back: Oh, poor Yorick!
ko.controlEnglish: Now my charms are all o'erthrown.

ko.text: 요릭의 해골
ko.english: Yorick's Skull
ko.back: The Skull of Yorick
ko.controlEnglish: Prospero's Staff

ko.text: 옹이 진 지팡이가 신비한 힘으로 타닥거린다. 프로스페로가 마지막 주문을 속삭이자 폭풍이 그 주위를 휘돈다. 번개가 하늘을 가른다.
ko.english: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.
ko.back: As Prospero whispers his last spell, a storm sweeps around it. Lightning strikes through the skies.
ko.controlEnglish: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.

ko.text: 이제 나의 마법은 모두 무너졌습니다.
ko.english: Now my charms are all o'erthrown.
ko.back: Now all my magic has collapsed.
ko.controlEnglish: The course of true love never did run smooth.

ko.text: 프로스페로의 지팡이
ko.english: Prospero's Staff
ko.back: Prospero's wand
ko.controlEnglish: Love Potion

ko.text: 빛나는 작은 병이 장밋빛으로 고동친다. 그 표면에서 하트들이 떠오르고 달콤한 선율이 공기를 채운다.
ko.english: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.
ko.back: A glittering little bottle vibrates in roses, hearts float on its surface and sweet melodies fill the air.
ko.controlEnglish: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.

ko.text: 참된 사랑의 길은 결코 순탄한 적이 없었다.
ko.english: The course of true love never did run smooth.
ko.back: The path of true love has never been smooth.
ko.controlEnglish: Double, double toil and trouble.

ko.text: 사랑의 묘약
ko.english: Love Potion
ko.back: Potion of Love
ko.controlEnglish: Witches' Brew

ko.text: 부글거리는 가마솥이 초록 연기를 뿜어낸다. 그림자 같은 세 형체가 그 주위를 돌며 주문을 왼다. 저편 어두운 숲에서 눈들이 빛난다.
ko.english: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.
ko.back: Three shadow-like figures circle around it as they cast the spell. Over there, in the dark forest, snow is shining.
ko.controlEnglish: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.

ko.text: 곱절로, 곱절로 고생과 근심.
ko.english: Double, double toil and trouble.
ko.back: Multiplied by, multiplied by trouble and anxiety.
ko.controlEnglish: If ever you disturb our streets again, your lives shall pay the forfeit of the peace.

ko.text: 마녀들의 약
ko.english: Witches' Brew
ko.back: Witches' Medicine
ko.controlEnglish: Dagger of the Mind

ko.text: 영주가 베로나 궁전의 계단에 서 있고, 그의 목소리가 싸우는 군중을 침묵시킨다. 황금 홀이 권위로 타오른다.
ko.english: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.
ko.back: The prince stands on the steps of the palace in Verona, and his voice silenced the fighting crowds.
ko.controlEnglish: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.

ko.text: 또다시 우리 거리를 어지럽힌다면 너희 목숨으로 평화를 깬 값을 치르리라.
ko.english: If ever you disturb our streets again, your lives shall pay the forfeit of the peace.
ko.back: If you disturb our streets again, you will pay with your lives for breaking the peace.
ko.controlEnglish: These violent delights have violent ends.

ko.text: 촛불이 켜진 수도원의 작은 방. 수사는 약초와 독초의 정원을 돌보고, 풍파에 시달린 그의 얼굴에는 지혜가 새겨져 있다.
ko.english: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.
ko.back: A little room in the monastery lit by candles. The monk cares for a garden of herbs and poisonous plants, with wisdom engraved on his windswept face.
ko.controlEnglish: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.

ko.text: 이 격렬한 기쁨은 격렬한 끝을 맞는다.
ko.english: These violent delights have violent ends.
ko.back: This intense joy meets a violent end.
ko.controlEnglish: I am the drudge and toil in your delight.

ko.text: 캐풀렛 집안의 따뜻한 부엌. 유모는 맹렬한 헌신으로 분주히 움직이고, 앞치마에는 비밀 편지가 끼워져 있다.
ko.english: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.
ko.back: In the warm kitchen of the Capulet house, the nanny is busy with fervent devotion, and her apron holds a secret letter.
ko.controlEnglish: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.

ko.text: 저는 아가씨의 기쁨을 위해 고생하는 일꾼이랍니다.
ko.english: I am the drudge and toil in your delight.
ko.back: I am a hardworking worker for your pleasure.
ko.controlEnglish: We are such stuff as dreams are made on.

ko.text: 폭풍에 휩싸인 섬. 프로스페로가 두 손을 들자 번개가 그의 뜻에 복종하고 바다가 그의 명령에 요동친다.
ko.english: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.
ko.back: When Prospero raises his hands, the lightning obeys his will and the sea waves at his command.
ko.controlEnglish: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.

ko.text: 우리는 꿈을 이루는 것과 같은 재료로 되어 있다.
ko.english: We are such stuff as dreams are made on.
ko.back: We are made of the same material that makes dreams come true.
ko.controlEnglish: All hail, great master! Grave sir, hail!

ko.text: 반짝이는 정령이 바람과 빛으로 흩어졌다가 음악으로 다시 모인다. 에어리얼은 보이는 것과 보이지 않는 것 사이에서 춤춘다.
ko.english: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.
ko.back: Glittering spirits are scattered by wind and light, then reunited by music. Aerial dances between the visible and invisible.
ko.controlEnglish: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.

ko.text: 만세, 위대한 주인님! 엄숙하신 어른, 만세!
ko.english: All hail, great master! Grave sir, hail!
ko.back: Long live the Great Master!
ko.controlEnglish: This island's mine, by Sycorax my mother.

ko.text: 거친 바닷가의 동굴 입구. 캘리번은 바위 사이에 웅크리고 있고, 그의 눈은 원한과 원시적인 지성으로 타오른다.
ko.english: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.
ko.back: Caliban is perched between the rocks, his eyes burning with hatred and a primitive mind.
ko.controlEnglish: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.

ko.text: 이 섬은 내 것이다, 내 어머니 시코락스가 물려준.
ko.english: This island's mine, by Sycorax my mother.
ko.back: This island is mine, inherited from my mother Sycorax.
ko.controlEnglish: I do but keep the peace. Put up thy sword.

ko.text: 새벽의 베로나 광장. 벤볼리오는 뽑아 든 칼들 사이에 서 있고, 펼친 두 손만이 몰려오는 폭풍에 맞서는 유일한 무기다.
ko.english: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.
ko.back: Benvolio stands between drawn knives, and his only weapon against the storm is his outstretched hands.
ko.controlEnglish: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.

ko.text: 나는 평화를 지키려는 것뿐이네. 칼을 거두게.
ko.english: I do but keep the peace. Put up thy sword.
ko.back: I'm just trying to keep the peace.
ko.controlEnglish: What, drawn, and talk of peace? I hate the word.

ko.text: 횃불로 환한 베로나의 골목. 티볼트는 적에게 눈을 고정한 채 치명적인 우아함으로 가는 칼을 뽑는다.
ko.english: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.
ko.back: The alleys of Verona are lit by torches. With his eyes fixed on the enemy, Tibolt draws a sword with deadly elegance.
ko.controlEnglish: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.

ko.text: 뭐라고, 칼을 뽑아 들고 평화를 말해? 나는 그 말을 증오한다.
ko.english: What, drawn, and talk of peace? I hate the word.
ko.back: I hate that word.
ko.controlEnglish: My words fly up, my thoughts remain below.

ko.text: 거짓 화려함으로 뒤덮인 엘시노어의 알현실. 클로디어스는 왕관을 움켜쥐고, 옷 속에 독약 병을 숨기고 있다.
ko.english: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.
ko.back: Clodius holds the crown, hiding a poison bottle in his clothes.
ko.controlEnglish: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.

ko.text: 내 말은 위로 날아가나, 내 생각은 아래에 남는구나.
ko.english: My words fly up, my thoughts remain below.
ko.back: My words fly up, but my thoughts stay down.
ko.controlEnglish: Ill met by moonlight, proud Titania.

ko.text: 마법의 숲 깊은 곳, 달빛 어린 빈터. 오베론이 그림자 속에서 모습을 드러내고, 사슴뿔 왕관이 은빛을 받는다.
ko.english: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.
ko.back: Deep in the magical forest, a moonlit young winter. Oberon appears from the shadows, and the deer horn crown shines silvery.
ko.controlEnglish: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.

ko.text: 달빛 아래 잘못 만났군, 오만한 티타니아.
ko.english: Ill met by moonlight, proud Titania.
ko.back: You've met the wrong man under the moon, arrogant Titania.
ko.controlEnglish: Is this a dagger which I see before me?

ko.text: 유령 같은 단검이 어둠 속에 떠 있고, 칼날에서 환영의 피가 떨어진다. 맥베스의 손이 뻗지만 결코 잡을 수 없다.
ko.english: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.
ko.back: The ghostly dagger floats in the darkness, and the blood of illusion drops from its blade. Macbeth's hand reaches out but is never caught.
ko.controlEnglish: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.

ko.text: 내 눈앞에 보이는 이것이 단검인가?
ko.english: Is this a dagger which I see before me?
ko.back: Is this the dagger I see in front of me?
ko.controlEnglish: I'll put a girdle round about the earth in forty minutes.

ko.text: 마음의 단검
ko.english: Dagger of the Mind
ko.back: Dagger of the Mind
ko.controlEnglish: Puck's Flower Juice

ko.text: 으깨진 자줏빛 꽃이 기다리는 손바닥에 무지갯빛 꿀을 떨어뜨린다. 그것이 떨어지는 곳마다 눈이 바뀌고, 마음이 그 뒤를 따른다.
ko.english: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.
ko.back: Wherever it falls, the eyes change, and the heart follows.
ko.controlEnglish: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.

ko.text: 사십 분 안에 지구에 띠를 한 바퀴 두르겠습니다.
ko.english: I'll put a girdle round about the earth in forty minutes.
ko.back: In forty minutes, I'm going to go around the world.
ko.controlEnglish: I dare do all that may become a man; who dares do more is none.

ko.text: 퍽의 꽃즙
ko.english: Puck's Flower Juice
ko.back: Puck's juice.
ko.controlEnglish: Lord Montague

ko.text: 던시네인의 피로 얼룩진 알현실. 맥베스는 떨리는 손으로 칼을 움켜쥐고, 왕관이 이마를 무겁게 누른다. 먼 언덕에서 버남 숲이 움직인다.
ko.english: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.
ko.back: Macbeth holds his sword in a trembling hand, the crown heavily pressing against his forehead. The Burnam Forest moves on a distant hillside.
ko.controlEnglish: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.

ko.text: 사내다운 일이라면 무엇이든 감히 하겠소. 그 이상을 감히 하는 자는 사내가 아니오.
ko.english: I dare do all that may become a man; who dares do more is none.
ko.back: I dare to do anything that is manly, but whoever dares to go beyond that is not a man.
ko.controlEnglish: Come, you spirits that tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here.

ko.text: 스코틀랜드 성의 촛불 켜진 방. 맥베스 부인은 차가운 돌바닥을 서성이며 손에서 있지도 않은 핏자국을 문질러 닦는다. 그림자가 두 번째 살갗처럼 그녀에게 달라붙는다.
ko.english: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.
ko.back: The candlelit room of the Scottish castle. Mrs Macbeth stands on the cold stone floor, rubbing blood that is not even in her hands, and a shadow clings to her like a second skin.
ko.controlEnglish: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.

ko.text: 오라, 죽음의 생각을 시중드는 정령들아, 여기서 나의 여성을 없애 다오.
ko.english: Come, you spirits that tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here.
ko.back: Come, spirits of the thoughts of death, take away my women from here.
ko.controlEnglish: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.

ko.text: 해 질 녘 안개 낀 스코틀랜드 황야. 뱅코는 굳게 서 있고, 유령 같은 세 형체가 운명을 바람 속에 속삭인다. 그의 유령은 산 자들을 따라다닐 것이다.
ko.english: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.
ko.back: Misty Scottish wilderness at sunset. Banko stands firm, three ghostly bodies whispering destiny in the wind. His ghost will follow the living.
ko.controlEnglish: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.

ko.text: 그대는 왕이 되지 못하나 왕들을 낳으리라.
ko.english: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.
ko.back: Thou shalt not be king, but thou shalt bring forth kings.
ko.controlEnglish: I am not what I am.

ko.text: 바람이 휘몰아치는 일리리아의 바닷가. 바이올라는 짧게 자른 머리 위로 선원 모자를 눌러쓰고, 그녀의 눈에는 두 개의 정체가 어른거린다. 바다는 잃어버린 오빠의 비밀을 속삭인다.
ko.english: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.
ko.back: On the windswept shores of Illyria, Viola holds a sailor's hat over her short-cut hair, and in her eyes she sees two identities. The sea whispers the secrets of her lost brother.
ko.controlEnglish: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.

ko.text: 나는 지금의 내가 아닙니다.
ko.english: I am not what I am.
ko.back: I'm not who I am.
ko.controlEnglish: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them.

ko.text: 올리비아 저택의 햇살 가득한 정원. 말볼리오는 요란한 노란 스타킹에 십자 대님을 매고 히죽거리며 으스대고, 위조된 연애편지를 가슴에 꼭 안고 있다.
ko.english: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.
ko.back: In the sunny gardens of Olivia's mansion, Malvolio sits in his noisy yellow stockings with a crucifix hanging from him and holds a fake love letter on his chest.
ko.controlEnglish: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.

ko.text: 어떤 이는 위대하게 태어나고, 어떤 이는 위대함을 이루며, 어떤 이는 위대함을 떠안게 된다.
ko.english: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them.
ko.back: Some are born great, some attain greatness, and some embrace greatness.
ko.controlEnglish: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.

ko.text: 상복을 입은 백작 영애가 베일을 들어 올려 숨 막히는 아름다움을 드러낸다. 올리비아의 정원에는 재스민과 라벤더가 피고, 변장한 전령이 그녀의 마음을 훔친다.
ko.english: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
ko.back: Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender, and a disguised messenger steals her heart.
ko.controlEnglish: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.

ko.text: 구해서 얻은 사랑도 좋지만, 구하지 않았는데 주어진 사랑은 더 좋습니다.
ko.english: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.
ko.back: It is good to ask for love, but it is better not to ask for love.
ko.controlEnglish: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.

ko.text: 로마 원로원, 대리석 기둥이 진홍으로 물들어 있다. 브루투스는 공모자들 사이에 서 있고, 그의 칼날은 아직 떨린다. 공화국의 무게가 피 묻은 그의 두 손에 얹혀 있다.
ko.english: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.
ko.back: The marble columns of the Roman Senate are covered in crimson. Brutus is standing among the conspirators, his sword still shaking, the weight of the Republic on his blood-stained hands.
ko.controlEnglish: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.

ko.text: 내가 시저를 덜 사랑해서가 아니라 로마를 더 사랑했기 때문입니다.
ko.english: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.
ko.back: Not because I loved Caesar less, but because I loved Rome more.
ko.controlEnglish: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.

ko.text: 한밤중 횃불이 밝힌 로마의 골목. 카시우스는 여위고 굶주린 표정으로 가까이 몸을 기울여 반역을 속삭인다. 위조된 편지들이 그의 토가에서 쏟아진다.
ko.english: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.
ko.back: The alleys of Rome are lit by torches in the middle of the night. Cassius leans near, with a hungry face, and whispers his treachery.
ko.controlEnglish: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.

ko.text: 친애하는 브루투스, 잘못은 우리의 별에 있는 것이 아니라 우리 자신에게 있네.
ko.english: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.
ko.back: Dear Brutus, the fault is not in our stars but in ourselves.
ko.controlEnglish: Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!

ko.text: 로마 광장이 분노로 들끓는다. 마르쿠스 안토니우스는 군중 앞에서 카이사르의 피 묻은 망토를 높이 들고, 그의 말은 슬픔을 불로 바꾼다. 음절 하나하나에 공화국이 무너진다.
ko.english: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.
ko.back: The squares of Rome are filled with rage. Marcus Antonius lifts up Caesar's bloody cloak in front of the crowd, his words turn grief into fire.
ko.controlEnglish: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.

ko.text: 친구들이여, 로마인들이여, 동포들이여, 귀를 빌려 주시오!
ko.english: Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!
ko.back: Friends, Romans, compatriots, listen!
ko.controlEnglish: Many a morning hath he there been seen, with tears augmenting the fresh morning dew.

ko.text: 새벽의 몬터규 저택. 몬터규 경은 높은 창에서, 사랑에 병들어 다가갈 수 없는 아들이 안개 낀 과수원을 헤매는 것을 지켜본다.
ko.english: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.
ko.back: From a high window, Lord Montagu watches his unapproachable son, sick of love, wander through the foggy orchard.
ko.controlEnglish: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.

ko.text: 여러 날 아침 그 애가 거기 있는 것이 보였소, 눈물로 싱그러운 아침 이슬을 더하면서.
ko.english: Many a morning hath he there been seen, with tears augmenting the fresh morning dew.
ko.back: Many mornings I saw him there, with tears adding to the morning dew.
ko.controlEnglish: Marry, that marry is the very theme I came to talk of.

ko.text: 몬터규 경
ko.english: Lord Montague
ko.back: Sir Montegy.
ko.controlEnglish: Lady Capulet

ko.text: 비단으로 장식된 캐풀렛 가문의 대연회장. 캐풀렛 부인은 꽃병에 꽃을 꽂듯 딸의 운명을 배치하고, 우아한 미소마다 그 뒤에서 야망이 반짝인다.
ko.english: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.
ko.back: Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's destiny like flowers in a vase, and behind every elegant smile there is an ambition.
ko.controlEnglish: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.

ko.text: 결혼, 바로 그 결혼 이야기를 하러 왔단다.
ko.english: Marry, that marry is the very theme I came to talk of.
ko.back: I'm here to talk about marriage.
ko.controlEnglish: Now cracks a noble heart. Good night, sweet prince.

ko.text: 캐풀렛 부인
ko.english: Lady Capulet
ko.back: Madame Capulet.
ko.controlEnglish: Romeo's Ring

ko.text: 동트기 전 차가운 시간의 엘시노어 성벽. 호레이쇼는 햄릿 곁에서 밤을 지킨다. 뱀들의 궁정에서 단 하나뿐인 참된 벗이다.
ko.english: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.
ko.back: The walls of Elsinore in the cold days before Frost. Horatio watches over Hamlet at night, the only true friend in the court of snakes.
ko.controlEnglish: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.

ko.text: 이제 고귀한 심장이 부서지는구나. 편히 잠드소서, 다정한 왕자님.
ko.english: Now cracks a noble heart. Good night, sweet prince.
ko.back: Sleep in peace, my dear prince.
ko.controlEnglish: I have had a most rare vision. I have had a dream, past the wit of man.

ko.text: 요정의 빛으로 환한 숲속 빈터. 보텀은 어리둥절하면서도 위엄 있게 당나귀 머리를 쓰고 있고, 티타니아는 그를 화환으로 꾸민다. 요정들은 웃음을 참는다.
ko.english: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.
ko.back: A forest hive lit up by the lights of fairies. Bottom wears a donkey's head, embarrassing but majestic, and Titania adorns him with a wreath.
ko.controlEnglish: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.

ko.text: 참으로 희한한 환상을 보았네. 사람의 지혜로는 알 수 없는 꿈을 꾸었네.
ko.english: I have had a most rare vision. I have had a dream, past the wit of man.
ko.back: I have seen a strange vision, and dreamed of things which man's wisdom cannot understand.
ko.controlEnglish: These times of woe afford no time to woo.

ko.text: 해 질 녘 베로나의 묘지. 패리스는 줄리엣의 무덤에 꽃을 놓는다. 그림자 속에서 다가오는 절박한 연인을 알지 못한 채.
ko.english: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.
ko.back: The cemetery of Verona at sunset. Paris lays flowers on Juliet's grave, unaware of the desperate lover approaching in the shadows.
ko.controlEnglish: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.

ko.text: 이런 슬픔의 때에는 구애할 시간이 없군요.
ko.english: These times of woe afford no time to woo.
ko.back: There's no time to spare in this time of sorrow.
ko.controlEnglish: O brave new world, that has such people in it!

ko.text: 프로스페로의 섬에 있는 때 묻지 않은 해변. 미란다는 난파한 선원들을 처음으로 보고, 있는 줄도 몰랐던 세상에 대한 경이로 눈을 크게 뜬다.
ko.english: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.
ko.back: When Miranda sees the wreckage of her crew for the first time, she opens her eyes wide in wonder at a world she had never known existed.
ko.controlEnglish: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.

ko.text: 오, 멋진 신세계여, 이런 사람들이 살고 있다니!
ko.english: O brave new world, that has such people in it!
ko.back: Oh, wonderful New World, these people live there!
ko.controlEnglish: My bounty is as boundless as the sea, my love as deep.

ko.text: 금반지가 발코니의 돌난간 위에 놓여 달빛을 받고 있다. 안쪽에는 죽음보다 오래가는 맹세가 새겨져 있다. 보이지 않는 바람 속에서 장미 꽃잎이 그 주위를 맴돈다.
ko.english: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.
ko.back: The golden ring is placed in the moonlight on top of the balcony's porch. Within it is an oath that lasts longer than death, and rose petals swirl around it in the invisible wind.
ko.controlEnglish: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.

ko.text: 내 너그러움은 바다처럼 끝이 없고, 내 사랑도 그만큼 깊어요.
ko.english: My bounty is as boundless as the sea, my love as deep.
ko.back: My generosity is endless like the sea, and my love is as deep.
ko.controlEnglish: All that glisters is not gold.

ko.text: 로미오의 반지
ko.english: Romeo's Ring
ko.back: Romeo's Ring
ko.controlEnglish: Portia's Casket

ko.text: 촛불이 켜진 방에서 세 개의 상자가 빛난다. 금, 은, 그리고 납. 납 상자는 조용한 진실로 나직이 울리며, 겉모습 너머를 볼 만큼 지혜로운 이에게 보답한다.
ko.english: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.
ko.back: In a room lit by candles, three boxes shine: gold, silver and lead. The tin box rings with quiet truth, rewarding the wise enough to see beyond appearance.
ko.controlEnglish: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.

ko.text: 반짝이는 것이 모두 금은 아니다.
ko.english: All that glisters is not gold.
ko.back: Not everything that shines is gold.
ko.controlEnglish: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.

ko.text: 포샤의 상자
ko.english: Portia's Casket
ko.back: The Box of Posha
ko.controlEnglish: Macbeth's Crown

ko.text: 빛바랜 스코틀랜드 왕관이 피 묻은 베개 위에 놓여 있다. 그것은 어두운 야망으로 고동치며, 감히 손을 뻗는 모든 이에게 영광의 약속을 속삭인다.
ko.english: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
ko.back: The shining crown of Scotland lies on a bloody pillow, stirring with dark ambition and whispering promises of glory to all who dare reach for it.
ko.controlEnglish: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.

ko.text: 왕관을 쓴 머리는 편히 눕지 못한다.
ko.english: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.
ko.back: The head of the crown is not comfortable to lie.
ko.controlEnglish: I'll drown my book.

ko.text: 맥베스의 왕관
ko.english: Macbeth's Crown
ko.back: The Crown of Macbeth
ko.controlEnglish: The Tempest Codex

ko.text: 바닷물에 닳은 가죽으로 장정한 오래된 책이 돌 제단 위에 떠 있다. 책장은 저절로 넘어가고, 장마다 다른 폭풍을 불러낸다.
ko.english: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.
ko.back: An old book floats on a stone altar, covered in leather worn by the sea. The bookshelves roll over of themselves, each chapter evoking a different storm.
ko.controlEnglish: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.

ko.text: 나의 책을 물에 빠뜨리겠다.
ko.english: I'll drown my book.
ko.back: I'm going to sink my book.
ko.controlEnglish: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.

ko.text: 폭풍의 고서
ko.english: The Tempest Codex
ko.back: Book of Storms
ko.controlEnglish: Cordelia's Tears

ko.text: 수정 병에 붙잡힌 별빛처럼 반짝이는 눈물이 담겨 있다. 방울마다, 너무 진실하게 사랑하고 너무 솔직하게 말한 딸의 슬픔이 실려 있다.
ko.english: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.
ko.back: In each drop there is the sadness of a daughter who loved her so truly and spoke to her with such sincerity.
ko.controlEnglish: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.

ko.text: 오, 사랑하는 아버지, 제가 하는 일은 아버지의 일입니다.
ko.english: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.
ko.back: Oh, my dear Father, what I do is your work.
ko.controlEnglish: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!

ko.text: 코델리아의 눈물
ko.english: Cordelia's Tears
ko.back: Tears of Cordelia
ko.controlEnglish: Bottom's Mask

ko.text: 당나귀 머리 가면이 요정 숲의 이끼 낀 가지에 걸려 있다. 그것을 쓰는 이는 마법에 걸린 눈으로 세상을 보고, 요정 여왕들이 거부할 수 없는 존재가 된다.
ko.english: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.
ko.back: The donkey-headed mask hangs on a twisted branch in the fairy forest, and its wearer sees the world with enchanted eyes, making him an unrepeatable creature for the fairy queens.
ko.controlEnglish: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.

ko.text: 맙소사, 보텀! 자네 모습이 바뀌었네!
ko.english: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!
ko.back: Oh, my God, Bottom!
ko.controlEnglish: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.

ko.text: 보텀의 가면
ko.english: Bottom's Mask
ko.back: Mask of the Bottom
ko.controlEnglish: Mandrake Root

ko.text: 비명을 지르는 사람 모양의 옹이 진 뿌리가 촛불 아래에서 캐내어진다. 흙이 부서져 내리며 뒤틀린 태고의 힘이 드러난다. 약제사는 떨리는 경외심으로 그것을 다룬다.
ko.english: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.
ko.back: Screaming man-shaped roots are dug up from under the candle. The earth breaks down, revealing the distorted power of antiquity, and the paramedic handles it with trembling awe.
ko.controlEnglish: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.

ko.text: 양귀비도, 맨드레이크도, 세상의 어떤 졸음 오는 시럽도.
ko.english: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.
ko.back: No gingerbread, no mandelake, no sleepy syrup in the world.
ko.controlEnglish: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.

ko.text: 맨드레이크 뿌리
ko.english: Mandrake Root
ko.back: Mandrake Roots
ko.controlEnglish: Oberon's Dew

ko.text: 이슬 한 방울이 달빛 어린 난초에 맺혀 이 세상 것이 아닌 보랏빛으로 빛난다. 잠든 눈꺼풀에 한 방울 떨어뜨리면, 꿈꾸는 이는 처음 보는 존재와 사랑에 빠진다.
ko.english: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.
ko.back: A drop of dew on a moonlit young orchid glows with a purple that is not of this world. Drop one drop on a sleeping eyelid, and the dreamer falls in love with the being he sees for the first time.
ko.controlEnglish: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.

ko.text: 그 꽃을 가져오너라. 내가 전에 네게 보여 준 그 풀이다.
ko.english: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.
ko.back: Bring the flower, the grass that I showed you before.
ko.controlEnglish: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.

ko.text: 오베론의 이슬
ko.english: Oberon's Dew
ko.back: Dew of Oberon
ko.controlEnglish: Hemlock Tincture

ko.text: 어두운 복도에서 검은 유리병이 초록 증기를 흘린다. 그 안의 팅크는 소리 없는 한 방울 한 방울로 왕들을 쓰러뜨리고 왕조를 무너뜨렸다.
ko.english: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.
ko.back: In a dark corridor, black glass bottles emit green vapor. The tincture in them has overthrown kings and destroyed dynasties with silent drops.
ko.controlEnglish: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.

ko.text: 내가 마음 놓고 쉬던 시간에 네 숙부가 저주받은 헤보나 즙을 병에 담아 몰래 다가왔다.
ko.english: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.
ko.back: While I was relaxing, your uncle sneaked in with a bottle of cursed hebonah.
ko.controlEnglish: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.

ko.text: 독미나리 팅크
ko.english: Hemlock Tincture
ko.back: Pomegranate tincture
ko.controlEnglish: Mistletoe Extract

ko.text: 겨울 달 아래에서 거둔 창백한 열매가 짙은 상록 잎 사이에서 반짝인다. 그 추출액은 자연의 조용하고 끈질긴 마법으로 나직이 울린다.
ko.english: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.
ko.back: The pale fruits harvested under the winter moon gleam among the dark evergreen leaves.These extracts ring with the quiet and persistent magic of nature.
ko.controlEnglish: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.

ko.text: 가마솥에서 끓고 익어라. 영원의 눈과 개구리의 발가락.
ko.english: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.
ko.back: The eyes of eternity and the toes of a frog.
ko.controlEnglish: Full fathom five thy father lies; of his bones are coral made.

ko.text: 겨우살이 추출액
ko.english: Mistletoe Extract
ko.back: Honeysuckle Extract
ko.controlEnglish: Mermaid's Tears

ko.text: 진주 마개를 한 병에 살아 있는 바다처럼 일렁이는 빛나는 푸른 액체가 담겨 있다. 그 안에서 작은 산호들이 자라났다가 녹아 사라진다. 소금과 잊힌 항해의 냄새가 난다.
ko.english: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.
ko.back: A bottle with a pearl stopper is filled with a shimmering blue liquid that swirls like a living sea, where small corals grow and melt. It smells of salt and forgotten sailing.
ko.controlEnglish: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.

ko.text: 다섯 길 물속에 그대 아버지 누워 있네. 그의 뼈는 산호가 되었네.
ko.english: Full fathom five thy father lies; of his bones are coral made.
ko.back: Your father is lying in the waters, and his bones have become corals.
ko.controlEnglish: Put this in any liquid thing you will, and drink it off; and, if you had the strength of twenty men, it would dispatch you straight.

ko.text: 인어의 눈물
ko.english: Mermaid's Tears
ko.back: Tears of the Mermaid
ko.controlEnglish: Apothecary's Elixir

ko.text: 만토바의 가장 가난한 구역에 있는 먼지투성이 약방. 금 간 병 속에서 절박한 영약이 호박빛으로 빛난다. 삶과 죽음 사이의 틈을 잇기에 충분할 만큼 강하다.
ko.english: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
ko.back: The dusty streets of one of Mantua's poorest neighborhoods are filled with a pumpkin-coloured, desperately needed medicine in a golden liver bottle. Strong enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
ko.controlEnglish: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.

ko.text: 이것을 아무 액체에나 타서 다 마시시오. 스무 사람의 힘이 있더라도 곧바로 저세상으로 보낼 것이오.
ko.english: Put this in any liquid thing you will, and drink it off; and, if you had the strength of twenty men, it would dispatch you straight.
ko.back: Burn it in any liquid and drink it all. Even if you have the power of twenty men, it will send you straight to hell.
ko.controlEnglish: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.

ko.text: 약제사의 영약
ko.english: Apothecary's Elixir
ko.back: The Holy Testament of the Pharmacists
ko.controlEnglish: Yorick's Skull

ko.text: 황금빛 수선화가 융단처럼 잔잔한 호숫가를 따라 펼쳐져 있다. 워즈워스는 공책을 손에 들고 그 사이를 걷고, 그의 뒤로 컴벌랜드의 산들이 솟아 있다.
ko.english: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.
ko.back: Wartworth walks among them with a notebook in his hand, and the mountains of Cumberland rise behind him.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â
ko.controlEnglish: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.

ko.text: 나는 골짜기와 언덕 위 높이 떠도는 구름처럼 외로이 헤매었네.
ko.english: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.
ko.back: I was wandering alone like a cloud high above the valleys and hills.
ko.controlEnglish: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.

ko.text: 바람이 멎어 멈춘 배가 그림 같은 바다 위를 떠돈다. 늙은 뱃사람은 자기 목에 걸린 앨버트로스를 응시하고, 유리 같은 바다에서 유령 같은 형체들이 떠오른다.
ko.english: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.
ko.back: The old sailor stares at the albatross that hangs around his neck, and ghostly figures emerge from the crystalline sea.
ko.controlEnglish: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.

ko.text: 물, 물, 어디에나 물, 그러나 마실 물은 한 방울도 없네.
ko.english: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.
ko.back: Water, water, water everywhere, but not a drop to drink.
ko.controlEnglish: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.

ko.text: 가을의 햄스테드 정원. 키츠는 자두나무 아래 앉아 열에 들뜬 듯 쓰고, 어두워지는 가지에서 나이팅게일이 노래한다.
ko.english: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.
ko.back: Autumn in the Hampstead Garden. Kitty is sitting under a mulberry tree, writing in the heat, and a nightingale sings from the darkening branches.
ko.controlEnglish: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.

ko.text: 아름다운 것은 영원한 기쁨이다. 그 사랑스러움은 더해 간다.
ko.english: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.
ko.back: What is beautiful is eternal joy, and its loveliness increases.
ko.controlEnglish: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.

ko.text: 한밤중의 베네치아 저택. 바이런은 발코니에 서서 망토를 휘날리며 어두운 운하를 바라본다. 그의 뒤 벽난로에서는 쓰다 만 원고가 타고 있다.
ko.english: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.
ko.back: A Venetian mansion in the middle of the night. Byron stands on a balcony, waving his cloak over the dark canal, with a manuscript burning in the fireplace behind him.
ko.controlEnglish: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.

ko.text: 그녀는 아름다움 속을 걷는다, 구름 없는 땅과 별이 빛나는 하늘의 밤처럼.
ko.english: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.
ko.back: She walks in beauty, like a cloudless land and a starry night sky.
ko.controlEnglish: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.

ko.text: 천둥 번개가 치는 밤, 촛불이 켜진 제네바의 서재. 메리는 번갯불에 의지해 글을 쓰고, 그녀 뒤의 그림자 속에서 피조물이 꿈틀거린다. 과학과 공포가 하나가 된다.
ko.english: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.
ko.back: On a night of thunder and lightning, in a candlelit library in Geneva, Mary writes on the flashes of lightning, and behind her shadows creatures swirl. Science and terror become one.
ko.controlEnglish: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.

ko.text: 조심하라. 나는 두려움이 없고, 그래서 강하다.
ko.english: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.
ko.back: I am not afraid, so I am strong.
ko.controlEnglish: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.

ko.text: 꺼져 가는 불빛이 비추는 어둑한 방. 포가 책상에 웅크리고 앉아 있을 때 까마귀 한 마리가 팔라스의 흉상 위에 내려앉는다. "이제는 없으리"라는 말이 그림자 속에 메아리친다.
ko.english: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.
ko.back: A dark room lit by fading lights. As Poe sits crouched on his desk, a raven lands on Pallas' bust and the words "No more" echo in the shadows.
ko.controlEnglish: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.

ko.text: 어느 음울한 한밤중, 내가 지치고 약해져 생각에 잠겨 있을 때.
ko.english: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.
ko.back: In the middle of a gloomy night, when I was tired and weak and immersed in thoughts.
ko.controlEnglish: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.

ko.text: 환상의 빛으로 타오르는 런던의 인쇄 공방. 블레이크가 동판에 호랑이를 새기자 그 짐승이 판에서 걸어 나와 밤의 숲속에서 환히 타오른다.
ko.english: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.
ko.back: When Blake carves a tiger on a bronze plate, the beast walks out of the plate and glows brightly in the forest of night.
ko.controlEnglish: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.

ko.text: 한 알의 모래에서 세계를 보고 한 송이 들꽃에서 천국을 본다.
ko.english: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.
ko.back: He sees the world in a grain of sand and heaven in a bunch of flowers.
ko.controlEnglish: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?

ko.text: 바람이 휘몰아치는 이탈리아의 절벽 꼭대기. 셸리는 두 팔을 벌려 폭풍에 맞서고, 서풍은 그의 공책에서 책장을 뜯어내 지중해 위로 흩뿌린다.
ko.english: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.
ko.back: Shelley's arms stretched out against the storm, and the west wind snatched a page from his notebook and scattered it over the Mediterranean.
ko.controlEnglish: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.

ko.text: 겨울이 오면 봄이 멀 수 있으랴?
ko.english: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?
ko.back: If winter comes, can spring be far away?
ko.controlEnglish: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.

ko.text: 피렌체의 햇살 가득한 방. 엘리자베스는 아르노강이 내려다보이는 창가에서 글을 쓰고, 발치에는 스패니얼이 있다. 로버트가 보낸 연애편지가 책상 위에 펼쳐져 있다.
ko.english: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.
ko.back: A sunny room in Florence. Elizabeth is writing from a window overlooking the Arno, a spaniel sits at her feet and Robert's love letters are spread out on the desk.
ko.controlEnglish: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.

ko.text: 내가 그대를 어떻게 사랑하느냐고요? 그 방법을 세어 볼게요.
ko.english: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
ko.back: How do I love you?
ko.controlEnglish: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.

ko.text: 스러져 가는 가을빛 속의 라파엘 전파풍 정원. 크리스티나는 낙엽 사이에 앉아, 아름다움과 고요한 체념으로 가슴 아린 시를 짓는다.
ko.english: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.
ko.back: Christina sits among the fall leaves and writes a heart-warming poem of beauty and quiet contemplation.
ko.controlEnglish: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.

ko.text: 내가 떠나거든 나를 기억해 주세요, 멀리 고요한 땅으로 떠나거든.
ko.english: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.
ko.back: Remember me when I leave, for I'm leaving to a far quiet land.
ko.controlEnglish: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.

ko.text: 올림포스산이 하늘을 가른다. 제우스는 구름의 왕좌에 앉아 있고, 그의 손가락 사이로 번개가 튄다. 아래에서는 인간 세상이 그의 시선에 떤다.
ko.english: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.
ko.back: Mount Olympus divides the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning flashes between his fingers, and beneath him the human world is in his gaze.
ko.controlEnglish: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.

ko.text: 나는 구름을 모으는 자, 넓은 하늘의 주인이다.
ko.english: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.
ko.back: I am the gatherer of clouds, the Lord of the wide heavens.
ko.controlEnglish: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.

ko.text: 파르테논 신전이 금빛 속에 빛난다. 아테나는 완전 무장을 하고 서 있고, 방패 위에는 올빼미가 앉아 있으며, 그녀의 잿빛 눈은 인간의 모든 속임수를 꿰뚫어 본다.
ko.english: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.
ko.back: The Parthenon shines in gold. Athena stands fully armed, with an owl sitting on her shield, and her brown eyes penetrate all human deceit.
ko.controlEnglish: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.

ko.text: 지혜의 올빼미는 황혼에야 날아오른다.
ko.english: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.
ko.back: The owl of wisdom flies only at dusk.
ko.controlEnglish: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.

ko.text: 황금 전차가 새벽 하늘을 가로질러 달린다. 아폴론이 리라를 타자 바퀴에서 햇빛이 쏟아져 세상을 색으로 물들인다.
ko.english: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.
ko.back: A golden chariot races through the dawn sky, and when Apollo rides on the lira, sunlight shines from its wheels and fills the world with colour.
ko.controlEnglish: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.

ko.text: 나는 노래와 치유와 빛나는 태양의 신이다.
ko.english: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.
ko.back: I am the god of song, healing and the shining sun.
ko.controlEnglish: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.

ko.text: 새벽의 키프로스 해안. 아프로디테가 바다 거품에서 솟아오르고, 비둘기들이 위를 맴돌며, 파도가 그녀의 발치에 진주를 놓는다. 세상이 숨을 죽인다.
ko.english: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.
ko.back: The coast of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from the sea bubbles, doves swim above her, waves lay pearls at her feet.
ko.controlEnglish: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.

ko.text: 신들조차 사랑의 힘을 거스르지 못한다.
ko.english: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
ko.back: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
ko.controlEnglish: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.

ko.text: 날개 달린 샌들이 하늘을 스쳐 지나간다. 헤르메스는 벼락 사이를 누비고, 한 손에는 신의 전언을 움켜쥐고 얼굴에는 도둑의 웃음을 띠고 있다.
ko.english: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.
ko.back: Winged sandals touch the sky. Hermes wanders through lightning, holding a message from the gods in one hand and smiling like a thief on his face.
ko.controlEnglish: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.

ko.text: 생각처럼 빠르게, 나는 신들의 말을 인간의 귀에 전한다.
ko.english: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.
ko.back: As fast as thought, I convey the words of the gods to human ears.
ko.controlEnglish: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.

ko.text: 창백한 불의 강들이 비추는 저승의 알현실. 하데스는 발치에 케르베로스를 두고 앉아 있고, 어둠의 투구는 팔걸이에 놓여 있다. 죽은 자들이 끝없는 침묵 속에 줄지어 지나간다.
ko.english: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.
ko.back: Hades sits with Cerberus at his heels, the sword of darkness on his armrest. The dead line up in an endless silence.
ko.controlEnglish: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.

ko.text: 모든 영혼은 끝내 내게로 온다. 나는 참을성이 있다.
ko.english: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
ko.back: All souls in the end come to me. I am patient.
ko.controlEnglish: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.

ko.text: 봄과 그림자로 반씩 나뉜 왕좌. 페르세포네는 한 손에 석류를, 다른 손에 화관을 들고 있다. 두 세계의 여왕이다.
ko.english: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.
ko.back: A throne divided in half by spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a wreath in the other, queen of both worlds.
ko.controlEnglish: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.

ko.text: 나는 씨앗 여섯 알을 먹고 두 세계 사이에 영원히 묶였다.
ko.english: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.
ko.back: I ate six seed eggs and was forever bound between the two worlds.
ko.controlEnglish: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.

ko.text: 폭풍에 시달린 배가 바위투성이 곶을 돌아간다. 오디세우스는 자신을 돛대에 묶고, 절벽에서는 세이렌들이 노래한다. 그의 눈에는 이타카의 기억이 타오른다.
ko.english: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.
ko.back: Odysseus binds himself to his mast, and the sirens sing on the cliffs. The memory of Ithaca is burning in his eyes.
ko.controlEnglish: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.

ko.text: 무사 여신이여, 멀리 떠돌았던 꾀 많은 사내의 이야기를 들려주소서.
ko.english: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.
ko.back: Goddess of War, tell me the story of a wise man who wandered far away.
ko.controlEnglish: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.

ko.text: 세상 끝의 무너진 신전. 메두사가 돌아서고, 뱀으로 된 머리카락이 쉿쉿거린다. 돌이 된 전사들이 바닥에 널려 있다. 마지막 돌격의 모습 그대로 굳은 채.
ko.english: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.
ko.back: The ruined temple at the end of the world. Medusa turns, her snake-haired head whistles. Stoned warriors lie on the ground, solid as they were in the final assault.
ko.controlEnglish: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.

ko.text: 용기가 있다면 나를 보아라. 내 눈길이 네가 보는 마지막이 될 것이다.
ko.english: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.
ko.back: If you have the courage, look at me; my gaze will be your last.
ko.controlEnglish: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.

ko.text: 새벽의 트로이 평원. 아킬레우스가 눈부신 갑옷을 입고 돌격하고, 그의 함성이 공기를 가른다. 그의 뒤로 그리스의 배들이 해안에서 불타고 있다.
ko.english: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.
ko.back: The Trojan Plain at dawn. Achilles storms in dazzling armor, his blast sweeps the air. Behind him, Greek ships are burning on the shores.
ko.controlEnglish: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.

ko.text: 잊힌 긴 삶보다 영광의 짧은 삶을 살겠다.
ko.english: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.
ko.back: I will live a short life of glory rather than a long, forgotten life.
ko.controlEnglish: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
