pl.text: Materializuje się wielka scena. The Sonnet Man wychodzi ze złotego światła reflektora z mikrofonem w dłoni. Słowa Szekspira zmieniają się w hip-hopowe wersy, a tłum wiwatuje.
pl.english: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.
pl.back: The Sonnet Man emerges from the golden spotlight with a microphone in his hand. Shakespeare’s words turn into hip-hop verses, and the crowd cheers.
pl.controlEnglish: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.

pl.text: Czy mam cię porównać do letniego dnia?
pl.english: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
pl.back: Should I compare you to a summer day?
pl.controlEnglish: Lord, what fools these mortals be!

pl.text: Rozwija się scena balkonowa w blasku księżyca. Romeo wyciąga rękę ku górze, gdy nad nim pojawia się Julia. W powietrzu unoszą się płatki róż. Scena pulsuje ciepłą, karmazynową poświatą.
pl.english: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.
pl.back: The balcony scene unfolds in the moonlight. Romeo stretches his hand upwards when Juliet appears above him, rose petals float in the air and the scene pulses with a warm, crimson glow.
pl.controlEnglish: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.

pl.text: Ogród Kapuletów kwitnie w świetle księżyca. Julia stoi wśród róż, a jej oczy błyszczą przekorą. W gałęziach śpiewa słowik.
pl.english: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.
pl.back: The garden of the Capulets blossoms in the moonlight. Juliet stands among the roses, and her eyes shine with resentment.
pl.controlEnglish: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.

pl.text: Zamek Elsynor wyłania się z cienia. Hamlet stoi na blankach, a obok niego unosi się czaszka Yorika. Na murach pojawia się widmowa postać.
pl.english: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.
pl.back: Castle Elsynor emerges from the shadows. Hamlet stands on the blanks, and Yorik’s skull floats next to him.
pl.controlEnglish: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.

pl.text: Łagodny strumień wije się przez wierzbowy gaj. Ofelia unosi się wśród polnych kwiatów, szepcząc zapomniane wiersze. Płatki wirują w nurcie.
pl.english: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.
pl.back: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among the field flowers, whispering forgotten poems.
pl.controlEnglish: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.

pl.text: Ulica Werony wybucha chaosem. Merkucjo tańczy między ostrzami, śmiejąc się niebezpieczeństwu w twarz. Ze zderzającej się stali sypią się iskry.
pl.english: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.
pl.back: The streets of Verona erupt in chaos. Mercutio dances between the blades, laughing in the face of the danger.
pl.controlEnglish: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.

pl.text: Zaczarowany las skrzy się psotą. Puk przemyka między starymi dębami, zostawiając smugi czarodziejskiego pyłu. W dole śpiący śmiertelnicy śnią dziwne sny.
pl.english: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.
pl.back: The enchanted forest is full of rottenness. Puck creeps through the old oaks, leaving trails of magical dust behind him.
pl.controlEnglish: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.

pl.text: Panie, jacyż głupcy z tych śmiertelników!
pl.english: Lord, what fools these mortals be!
pl.back: Lord, how foolish these mortals are!
pl.controlEnglish: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.

pl.text: Z leśnego poszycia wyrasta tron z żywych pnączy. Tytania włada swoim dworem wróżek, a świetliki rozjaśniają korony drzew. Sama natura kłania się jej woli.
pl.english: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.
pl.back: A throne of living creepers rises from the forest cover. Titania rules her court of fairies, and fireflies illuminate the crowns of trees.
pl.controlEnglish: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.

pl.text: Chodź, usiądź na tym kwiecistym łożu.
pl.english: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.
pl.back: Come, sit on this flower bed.
pl.controlEnglish: The course of true love never did run smooth.

pl.text: Czaszka spoczywa na aksamicie w mrocznej krypcie. Rozlega się upiorny śmiech, a wspomnienia nadwornego błazna migocą jak płomień świecy.
pl.english: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.
pl.back: The skull rests on the velvet in a dark crypt, ghostly laughter is heard, and the memories of the court fool twinkle like a candle flame.
pl.controlEnglish: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.

pl.text: Czaszka Yorika
pl.english: Yorick's Skull
pl.back: Yorika's Skull
pl.controlEnglish: Prospero's Staff

pl.text: Sękata laska trzeszczy od tajemnej mocy. Burza wiruje wokół niej, gdy Prospero szepcze swoje ostatnie zaklęcie. Błyskawica rozdziera niebo.
pl.english: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.
pl.back: A storm swirls around her as Prospero whispers his last spell. Lightning tears the sky, and a giant monster appears in the sky.
pl.controlEnglish: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.

pl.text: Laska Prospera
pl.english: Prospero's Staff
pl.back: Laska Prospera
pl.controlEnglish: Love Potion

pl.text: Świetlista fiolka pulsuje różanym blaskiem. Z jej powierzchni unoszą się serca, a powietrze wypełnia słodka melodia.
pl.english: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.
pl.back: Hearts float from its surface, and the air is filled with a sweet melody.
pl.controlEnglish: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.

pl.text: Droga prawdziwej miłości nigdy nie była gładka.
pl.english: The course of true love never did run smooth.
pl.back: The road of true love has never been smooth.
pl.controlEnglish: Double, double toil and trouble.

pl.text: Napój miłosny
pl.english: Love Potion
pl.back: Love Drink
pl.controlEnglish: Witches' Brew

pl.text: Bulgoczący kocioł bucha zielonym dymem. Krążą wokół niego trzy mroczne postacie, zawodząc zaklęcia. Z ciemnego lasu błyszczą oczy.
pl.english: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.
pl.back: A bulging cauldron is bursting with green smoke. Three dark figures circle around it, casting spells, and eyes shine from the dark forest.
pl.controlEnglish: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.

pl.text: Podwój, podwój trud i znój.
pl.english: Double, double toil and trouble.
pl.back: Double, double effort and fatigue.
pl.controlEnglish: We are such stuff as dreams are made on.

pl.text: Wywar czarownic
pl.english: Witches' Brew
pl.back: Witch potion
pl.controlEnglish: Dagger of the Mind

pl.text: Książę stoi na stopniach pałacu w Weronie; jego głos nakazuje milczenie zwaśnionemu tłumowi. Złote berło płonie władzą.
pl.english: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.
pl.back: The prince stands on the steps of the palace in Verona; his voice commands silence to a quarrelsome crowd.
pl.controlEnglish: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.

pl.text: Klasztorna cela w blasku świec. Zakonnik dogląda ogródka ziół i trucizn, a mądrość wyryta jest na jego ogorzałej twarzy.
pl.english: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.
pl.back: The monk watches over the garden of herbs and poisons, and wisdom is engraved on his fierce face.
pl.controlEnglish: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.

pl.text: Ciepła kuchnia w domu Kapuletów. Niania krząta się z zaciętym oddaniem, z tajnym listem wsuniętym za fartuch.
pl.english: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.
pl.back: A warm kitchen in the house of the Capulets. The nanny is turning around with fervent devotion, with a secret letter slid behind her apron.
pl.controlEnglish: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.

pl.text: Wyspa spowita burzą. Prospero wznosi ręce, a błyskawica słucha jego woli i morze kipi na jego rozkaz.
pl.english: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.
pl.back: Prospero raises his hands, and the lightning obeys his will, and the sea boils at his command.
pl.controlEnglish: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.

pl.text: Jesteśmy z tej samej materii, z której zrobione są sny.
pl.english: We are such stuff as dreams are made on.
pl.back: We are made of the same material as dreams.
pl.controlEnglish: All hail, great master! Grave sir, hail!

pl.text: Migotliwy duch rozpływa się w wiatr i światło, po czym odradza się jako muzyka. Ariel tańczy między widzialnym a niewidzialnym.
pl.english: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.
pl.back: The sparkling spirit dissolves into the wind and light, then rebirths as music.Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.
pl.controlEnglish: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.

pl.text: Witaj, wielki mistrzu! Czcigodny panie, witaj!
pl.english: All hail, great master! Grave sir, hail!
pl.back: Hello, great master! Venerable lord, welcome!
pl.controlEnglish: This island's mine, by Sycorax my mother.

pl.text: Wylot jaskini na dzikim brzegu. Kaliban przyczaja się wśród skał, a jego oczy płoną urazą i pierwotną inteligencją.
pl.english: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.
pl.back: Kaliban sits down among the rocks, his eyes burning with indignation and primitive intelligence.
pl.controlEnglish: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.

pl.text: Ta wyspa jest moja, po Sykoraks, mojej matce.
pl.english: This island's mine, by Sycorax my mother.
pl.back: This island is mine, after Sycorax, my mother.
pl.controlEnglish: My words fly up, my thoughts remain below.

pl.text: Plac w Weronie o świcie. Benvolio staje między dobytymi mieczami; jego otwarte dłonie to jedyna broń przeciw nadciągającej burzy.
pl.english: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.
pl.back: Benvolio stands between the swords he has captured; his open hands are his only weapon against the storm that is approaching.
pl.controlEnglish: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.

pl.text: Zaułek Werony rozświetlony pochodniami. Tybalt dobywa rapiera ze śmiertelnym wdziękiem, z oczami utkwionymi we wrogu.
pl.english: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.
pl.back: Tybalt captures the raptor with deadly grace, with his eyes fixed on the enemy.
pl.controlEnglish: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.

pl.text: Sala tronowa Elsynoru, udrapowana fałszywym przepychem. Klaudiusz ściska koronę, a w szatach kryje fiolkę trucizny.
pl.english: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.
pl.back: Claudius holds the crown, and in his robes he hides a vial of poison.
pl.controlEnglish: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.

pl.text: Moje słowa ulatują w górę, moje myśli zostają w dole.
pl.english: My words fly up, my thoughts remain below.
pl.back: My words fly up, my thoughts stay down.
pl.controlEnglish: Ill met by moonlight, proud Titania.

pl.text: Oświetlona księżycem polana w głębi zaczarowanego lasu. Oberon wyłania się z cienia, a jego korona z poroża chwyta srebrne światło.
pl.english: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.
pl.back: Oberon emerges from the shadow, and his crown of horns catches the silver light.
pl.controlEnglish: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.

pl.text: Złe to spotkanie przy księżycu, dumna Tytanio.
pl.english: Ill met by moonlight, proud Titania.
pl.back: Evil is a meeting at the moon, proud Titano.
pl.controlEnglish: Is this a dagger which I see before me?

pl.text: Widmowy sztylet unosi się w ciemności, z ostrza kapie zjawiskowa krew. Ręka Makbeta sięga po niego, lecz nigdy nie może go uchwycić.
pl.english: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.
pl.back: The spectral dagger hovers in the darkness, from the blade drops phenomenal blood. Macbeth's hand reaches for it, but can never grasp it.
pl.controlEnglish: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.

pl.text: Czy to sztylet widzę przed sobą?
pl.english: Is this a dagger which I see before me?
pl.back: Is it a dagger I see in front of me?
pl.controlEnglish: I dare do all that may become a man; who dares do more is none.

pl.text: Sztylet umysłu
pl.english: Dagger of the Mind
pl.back: Dagger of Mind
pl.controlEnglish: Puck's Flower Juice

pl.text: Zgnieciony purpurowy kwiat sączy opalizujący nektar w czekającą dłoń. Gdziekolwiek spadnie, oczy się zmieniają, a serca idą za nimi.
pl.english: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.
pl.back: Wherever it falls, the eyes change and the hearts follow them.
pl.controlEnglish: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.

pl.text: Sok z kwiatu Puka
pl.english: Puck's Flower Juice
pl.back: Juice of Puka flower
pl.controlEnglish: Lord Montague

pl.text: Zbryzgana krwią sala tronowa w Dunsinane. Makbet ściska miecz drżącymi dłońmi, korona ciąży mu na czole. Na dalekim wzgórzu porusza się las Birnam.
pl.english: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.
pl.back: The throne room at Dunsinane is splashed with blood. Macbeth holds his sword in trembling hands, the crown weighs on his forehead, and the forest of Birnam moves on a distant hill.
pl.controlEnglish: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.

pl.text: Ważę się na wszystko, co przystoi mężowi; kto waży się na więcej, ten nim nie jest.
pl.english: I dare do all that may become a man; who dares do more is none.
pl.back: I weigh myself to all that befits a husband; he who weighs himself to more is not a husband.
pl.controlEnglish: Come, you spirits that tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here.

pl.text: Komnata szkockiego zamku w blasku świec. Lady Makbet przemierza zimne kamienie, ścierając z rąk urojone plamy krwi. Cienie lgną do niej jak druga skóra.
pl.english: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.
pl.back: Candle-lit chamber of a Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth walks through the cold stones, wiping imaginary blood stains from her hands, and the shadows cling to her like a second skin.
pl.controlEnglish: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.

pl.text: Przybądźcie, duchy, co służycie myślom morderczym, odbierzcie mi tutaj moją płeć.
pl.english: Come, you spirits that tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here.
pl.back: Come, spirits who serve murderous thoughts, take away from me my sex here.
pl.controlEnglish: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.

pl.text: Mgliste szkockie wrzosowisko o zmierzchu. Banko stoi niewzruszony, gdy trzy widmowe postacie szepczą przeznaczenia na wiatr. Jego duch będzie nawiedzał żywych.
pl.english: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.
pl.back: Misty Scottish heathland at dusk. Banko stands unmoved as three ghostly figures whisper destiny to the wind, and his spirit will haunt the living.
pl.controlEnglish: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.

pl.text: Spłodzisz królów, choć sam nim nie będziesz.
pl.english: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.
pl.back: You will beget kings, but you won't be one.
pl.controlEnglish: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.

pl.text: Smagany wiatrem brzeg Ilirii. Wiola naciąga marynarską czapkę na krótko ścięte włosy; w jej oczach migocą dwie tożsamości. Morze szepcze tajemnice o jej zaginionym bracie.
pl.english: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.
pl.back: The wind-swept shore of Illyria. Viola puts her sailor’s hat over her short hair; two identities flash in her eyes, the sea whispering secrets about her missing brother.
pl.controlEnglish: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.

pl.text: Słoneczny ogród w posiadłości Oliwii. Malwolio kroczy dumnie w jaskrawożółtych pończochach z podwiązkami na krzyż, uśmiechnięty, przyciskając do piersi sfałszowany list miłosny.
pl.english: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.
pl.back: Malvolio walks proudly in bright yellow stockings with garters on the cross, smiling, pressing against his chest a forged love letter.
pl.controlEnglish: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.

pl.text: Hrabina w żałobie unosi welon i odsłania urodę, która zapiera dech. Ogród Oliwii kwitnie jaśminem i lawendą, gdy przebrany posłaniec kradnie jej serce.
pl.english: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
pl.back: Olivia’s garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as a disguised messenger steal her heart, but the Countess is unable to resist.
pl.controlEnglish: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.

pl.text: Miłość szukana jest dobra, lecz dana bez szukania jest lepsza.
pl.english: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.
pl.back: Love sought is good, but given without seeking is better.
pl.controlEnglish: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.

pl.text: Senat rzymski, marmurowe kolumny splamione karmazynem. Brutus stoi wśród spiskowców, a jego ostrze wciąż drży. Ciężar republiki spoczywa na jego zakrwawionych rękach.
pl.english: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.
pl.back: The Roman Senate, the marble columns stained with crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling, the weight of the republic resting on his bloody hands.
pl.controlEnglish: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.

pl.text: Nie dlatego, że mniej kochałem Cezara, lecz dlatego, że bardziej kochałem Rzym.
pl.english: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.
pl.back: Not because I loved Caesar less, but because I loved Rome more.
pl.controlEnglish: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.

pl.text: Rzymski zaułek o północy, w świetle pochodni. Kasjusz nachyla się i szepcze bunt, chudy i głodny z wejrzenia. Z jego togi wysypują się sfałszowane listy.
pl.english: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.
pl.back: A Roman alley at midnight, in the light of a torch. Cassius leans over and whispers rebellion, skinny and hungry to look at.
pl.controlEnglish: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.

pl.text: Wina, drogi Brutusie, nie leży w naszych gwiazdach, lecz w nas samych.
pl.english: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.
pl.back: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.
pl.controlEnglish: O brave new world, that has such people in it!

pl.text: Forum Romanum wybucha wściekłością. Marek Antoniusz unosi przed tłumem zakrwawiony płaszcz Cezara; jego słowa zmieniają żałobę w ogień. Republika rozpada się z każdą sylabą.
pl.english: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.
pl.back: The Roman Forum bursts out in fury. Marcus Antonius raises Caesar’s bloody cloak before the crowd; his words turn mourning into fire.
pl.controlEnglish: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.

pl.text: Posiadłość Montekich o świcie. Pan Monteki patrzy z wysokiego okna, jak jego syn błąka się po zamglonych sadach, chory z miłości i nieosiągalny.
pl.english: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.
pl.back: Mr. Monteki watches from a high window as his son wanders through the misty orchards, sick of love and unreachable.
pl.controlEnglish: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.

pl.text: Pan Monteki
pl.english: Lord Montague
pl.back: Mr. Monteki
pl.controlEnglish: Lady Capulet

pl.text: Wielka sala Kapuletów, udrapowana jedwabiem. Pani Kapulet układa los córki jak kwiaty w wazonie; za każdym łaskawym uśmiechem lśni ambicja.
pl.english: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.
pl.back: Madame Capulet arranges the fate of her daughter like flowers in a vase; behind every graceful smile shines an ambition.
pl.controlEnglish: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.

pl.text: Pani Kapulet
pl.english: Lady Capulet
pl.back: Madame Capulet
pl.controlEnglish: Romeo's Ring

pl.text: Blanki Elsynoru w zimnej godzinie przed świtem. Horacy czuwa u boku Hamleta, jedyny prawdziwy przyjaciel na dworze pełnym węży.
pl.english: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.
pl.back: Horace watches by the side of Hamlet, the only true friend in a court full of snakes.
pl.controlEnglish: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.

pl.text: Leśna polana jaśniejąca czarodziejskim światłem. Spodek nosi oślą głowę z oszołomioną godnością, a Tytania stroi go w girlandy. Wróżki tłumią śmiech.
pl.english: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.
pl.back: A forest clearing shining with magical light. Spodek wears a donkey head with stunned dignity, and Titania dresses him in garlands.
pl.controlEnglish: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.

pl.text: Cmentarz w Weronie o zmierzchu. Parys składa kwiaty na grobie Julii, nieświadom zrozpaczonego kochanka, który zbliża się z cienia.
pl.english: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.
pl.back: Paris lays flowers on Juliet's grave, unaware of the desperate lover who is approaching from the shadows.
pl.controlEnglish: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.

pl.text: Nieskalana plaża na wyspie Prospera. Miranda po raz pierwszy widzi rozbitków, a jej oczy są szeroko otwarte ze zdumienia nad światem, o którego istnieniu nie wiedziała.
pl.english: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.
pl.back: Miranda sees the shipwrecked for the first time, and her eyes are wide open in amazement at a world she had never known existed.
pl.controlEnglish: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.

pl.text: O wspaniały nowy świecie, w którym żyją tacy ludzie!
pl.english: O brave new world, that has such people in it!
pl.back: O wonderful new world in which such people live!
pl.controlEnglish: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.

pl.text: Złoty pierścień leży na kamiennej balustradzie balkonu i chwyta blask księżyca. Wewnątrz wyryto przysięgę, która przetrwa samą śmierć. Płatki róż wirują wokół niego w niewidzialnym wietrze.
pl.english: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.
pl.back: The golden ring lies on the stone balustrade of the balcony and catches the moonlight. Inside it is engraved an oath that will survive even death, and rose petals swirl around it in the invisible wind.
pl.controlEnglish: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.

pl.text: Pierścień Romea
pl.english: Romeo's Ring
pl.back: Rome's Ring
pl.controlEnglish: Portia's Casket

pl.text: Trzy szkatułki lśnią w komnacie oświetlonej świecami: złota, srebrna i ołowiana. Ołowiana szkatułka brzmi cichą prawdą i nagradza tych, którzy są dość mądrzy, by spojrzeć poza pozory.
pl.english: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.
pl.back: Three coffins shine in the candlelit chamber: gold, silver and lead.The lead coffin sounds like a quiet truth and rewards those who are wise enough to look beyond appearances.
pl.controlEnglish: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.

pl.text: Szkatułka Porcji
pl.english: Portia's Casket
pl.back: The Box of Portions
pl.controlEnglish: Macbeth's Crown

pl.text: Zmatowiała szkocka korona leży na zakrwawionej poduszce. Pulsuje mroczną ambicją i szepcze obietnice chwały każdej ręce, która ośmieli się po nią sięgnąć.
pl.english: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
pl.back: The dull Scottish crown lies on a bloody pillow, pulsating with dark ambition and whispering promises of glory to every hand that dares reach for it.
pl.controlEnglish: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.

pl.text: Niespokojnie spoczywa głowa, która nosi koronę.
pl.english: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.
pl.back: Restlessly rests the head, which wears a crown.
pl.controlEnglish: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!

pl.text: Korona Makbeta
pl.english: Macbeth's Crown
pl.back: Crown of Macbeth
pl.controlEnglish: The Tempest Codex

pl.text: Pradawna księga, oprawna w skórę zniszczoną przez morze, unosi się nad kamiennym ołtarzem. Jej karty przewracają się same, a każda przywołuje inną burzę.
pl.english: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.
pl.back: An ancient book, wrapped in a skin destroyed by the sea, floats above a stone altar; its pages roll over on their own and each one evokes a different storm.
pl.controlEnglish: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.

pl.text: Kodeks burzy
pl.english: The Tempest Codex
pl.back: Code of the Storm
pl.controlEnglish: Cordelia's Tears

pl.text: Kryształowa fiolka kryje łzy, które migocą jak uwięzione światło gwiazd. Każda kropla niesie smutek córki, która kochała zbyt prawdziwie i mówiła zbyt otwarcie.
pl.english: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.
pl.back: Every drop carries the sadness of a daughter who has loved too truly and spoken too openly.
pl.controlEnglish: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.

pl.text: Łzy Kordelii
pl.english: Cordelia's Tears
pl.back: Tears of Cordelia
pl.controlEnglish: Bottom's Mask

pl.text: Maska z oślą głową wisi na omszałej gałęzi w lesie wróżek. Kto ją włoży, widzi świat zaczarowanymi oczami i staje się nieodparty dla królowych wróżek.
pl.english: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.
pl.back: Whoever puts it on sees the world with enchanted eyes and becomes irresistible for the fairy queens.
pl.controlEnglish: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.

pl.text: Niech cię Bóg strzeże, Spodku! Jesteś przemieniony!
pl.english: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!
pl.back: God bless you, Spock! You're transformed.
pl.controlEnglish: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.

pl.text: Maska Spodka
pl.english: Bottom's Mask
pl.back: Mask Spodka
pl.controlEnglish: Mandrake Root

pl.text: Sękaty korzeń w kształcie krzyczącej postaci zostaje wykopany przy świetle świecy. Ziemia osypuje się i odsłania jego poskręcaną, pradawną moc. Aptekarz ujmuje go z drżącą czcią.
pl.english: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.
pl.back: The cracked root in the shape of a screaming figure is dug up by candlelight. The earth collapses and reveals its twisted, ancient power.
pl.controlEnglish: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.

pl.text: Ani mak, ani mandragora, ani wszystkie usypiające syropy świata.
pl.english: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.
pl.back: Neither poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the sleeping syrups in the world.
pl.controlEnglish: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.

pl.text: Korzeń mandragory
pl.english: Mandrake Root
pl.back: Mandragory root
pl.controlEnglish: Oberon's Dew

pl.text: Kropla rosy trzyma się storczyka w blasku księżyca i jarzy się nieziemskim fioletowym światłem. Jedna kropla na uśpione powieki, a śniący zakocha się w pierwszym stworzeniu, które zobaczy.
pl.english: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.
pl.back: A drop of dew clings to an orchid in the moonlight and shines with an unearthly violet light.One drop on a sleepy eyelid, and the dreamer will fall in love with the first creature he sees.
pl.controlEnglish: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.

pl.text: Rosa Oberona
pl.english: Oberon's Dew
pl.back: Rosa Oberona
pl.controlEnglish: Hemlock Tincture

pl.text: Fiolka z czarnego szkła sączy zielone opary w ciemnym korytarzu. Nalewka w jej wnętrzu obalała królów i kruszyła dynastie, jedna cicha kropla po drugiej.
pl.english: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.
pl.back: The tincture inside it has overthrown kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop after the other.
pl.controlEnglish: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.

pl.text: W godzinie mego spokoju twój stryj zakradł się z sokiem przeklętego lulka we flaszce.
pl.english: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.
pl.back: In my quiet hour, your uncle sneaked in with a bottle of damn pussy juice.
pl.controlEnglish: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.

pl.text: Nalewka z cykuty
pl.english: Hemlock Tincture
pl.back: Ginger tincture
pl.controlEnglish: Mistletoe Extract

pl.text: Blade jagody lśnią wśród ciemnych, wiecznie zielonych liści, zebrane pod zimowym księżycem. Wyciąg tętni cichą, wytrwałą magią świata przyrody.
pl.english: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.
pl.back: Blades of berries glisten among the dark evergreen leaves, gathered under the winter moon.The extract pulses with the quiet, enduring magic of the natural world.
pl.controlEnglish: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.

pl.text: W kotle wrzyj i piecz się; oko traszki i palec żaby.
pl.english: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.
pl.back: In the cauldron boil and cook yourself; eye of a snake and finger of a frog.
pl.controlEnglish: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.

pl.text: Wyciąg z jemioły
pl.english: Mistletoe Extract
pl.back: Extract of mistletoe
pl.controlEnglish: Mermaid's Tears

pl.text: Flakon z perłowym korkiem kryje świetlisty błękitny płyn, który porusza się jak żywe morze. Wewnątrz rosną i rozpuszczają się maleńkie koralowce. Pachnie solą i zapomnianymi podróżami.
pl.english: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.
pl.back: The bottle with a pearl cork hides a bright blue liquid that moves like a living sea. Inside, tiny corals grow and dissolve.It smells of salt and forgotten travels.
pl.controlEnglish: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.

pl.text: Łzy syreny
pl.english: Mermaid's Tears
pl.back: Tears of a Siren
pl.controlEnglish: Apothecary's Elixir

pl.text: Zakurzona apteka w najuboższej dzielnicy Mantui. Eliksir rozpaczy jarzy się bursztynowo w pękniętej fiolce, dość mocny, by przerzucić most między życiem a śmiercią.
pl.english: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
pl.back: A dusty pharmacy in the poorest district of Mantua.The elixir of despair sizzles amber in a cracked vial, strong enough to bridge between life and death.
pl.controlEnglish: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.

pl.text: Eliksir aptekarza
pl.english: Apothecary's Elixir
pl.back: Elixir of the Pharmacist
pl.controlEnglish: Yorick's Skull

pl.text: Dywan złotych żonkili ciągnie się wzdłuż brzegów cichego jeziora. Wordsworth idzie wśród nich z notatnikiem w ręku, a za nim wznoszą się wzgórza Cumberlandu.
pl.english: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.
pl.back: A carpet of golden ladybirds stretches along the shores of a quiet lake, Wordsworth walking among them with his notebook in hand, and behind him rise the hills of Cumberland.
pl.controlEnglish: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.

pl.text: Wędrowałem samotny jak obłok, co płynie wysoko nad dolinami i wzgórzami.
pl.english: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.
pl.back: I wandered alone like a cloud that floats high over valleys and hills.
pl.controlEnglish: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.

pl.text: Unieruchomiony ciszą statek dryfuje po malowanym oceanie. Stary marynarz wpatruje się w albatrosa na swojej szyi, a ze szklistego morza wyłaniają się widmowe postacie.
pl.english: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.
pl.back: The old sailor stares at the albatross on his neck, and ghostly figures emerge from the glassy sea.
pl.controlEnglish: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.

pl.text: Woda, woda, wszędzie woda, a ani kropli do picia.
pl.english: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.
pl.back: Water, water, water everywhere and no drops to drink.
pl.controlEnglish: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.

pl.text: Ogród w Hampstead jesienią. Keats siedzi pod śliwą i pisze gorączkowo, a słowik śpiewa z ciemniejących gałęzi.
pl.english: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.
pl.back: Keats sits under the plum tree and writes feverishly, while a woodpecker sings from the darkening branches.
pl.controlEnglish: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.

pl.text: Rzecz piękna jest radością na zawsze: jej urok wciąż rośnie.
pl.english: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.
pl.back: A beautiful thing is a joy forever: its charm continues to grow.
pl.controlEnglish: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.

pl.text: Wenecki pałac o północy. Byron stoi na balkonie w powiewającej pelerynie i patrzy na ciemny kanał. Za nim w kominku płonie niedokończony rękopis.
pl.english: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.
pl.back: A Venetian palace at midnight. Byron is standing on the balcony in a blowing cape and looking out over a dark canal, behind him an unfinished manuscript burning in the fireplace.
pl.controlEnglish: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.

pl.text: Kroczy w piękności jak noc bezchmurnych krain i gwiaździstych niebios.
pl.english: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.
pl.back: He walks in beauty like the night of cloudless lands and starry skies.
pl.controlEnglish: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.

pl.text: Gabinet w Genewie w blasku świec, podczas burzy. Mary pisze przy świetle błyskawic, a w cieniu za nią porusza się stwór. Nauka i groza stają się jednym.
pl.english: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.
pl.back: A candlelit office in Geneva during a storm. Mary writes in the light of lightning, and in the shadow behind her a creature moves.Science and terror become one.
pl.controlEnglish: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.

pl.text: Strzeż się; bo jestem nieustraszony, a przeto potężny.
pl.english: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.
pl.back: Beware, for I am fearless and therefore mighty.
pl.controlEnglish: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.

pl.text: Mroczna komnata oświetlona dogasającym ogniem. Poe siedzi zgarbiony przy biurku, gdy kruk siada na popiersiu Pallady. Słowo „Nigdy więcej” rozbrzmiewa w cieniach.
pl.english: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.
pl.back: A dark chamber lit by a fading fire. Poe sits grumpy at his desk as a crow sits on Pallady’s bust, and the word “Never Again” echoes in the shadows.
pl.controlEnglish: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.

pl.text: Raz, o posępnej północy, gdy dumałem, słaby i znużony.
pl.english: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.
pl.back: Once, at gloomy midnight, when I thought, weak and tired.
pl.controlEnglish: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.

pl.text: Londyńska pracownia drukarska rozjarzona wizjonerskim światłem. Blake ryje tygrysa w miedzi, a bestia wyłania się z płyty, płonąc jasno w lasach nocy.
pl.english: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.
pl.back: Blake carves a tiger in copper, and the beast emerges from the plate, burning brightly in the woods of the night.
pl.controlEnglish: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.

pl.text: Zobaczyć świat w ziarenku piasku i niebo w polnym kwiecie.
pl.english: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.
pl.back: See the world in a grain of sand and the sky in a field flower.
pl.controlEnglish: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?

pl.text: Smagany wiatrem szczyt włoskiego klifu. Shelley stawia czoło burzy z rozpostartymi ramionami, a zachodni wiatr wyrywa kartki z jego notatnika i rozsiewa je nad Morzem Śródziemnym.
pl.english: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.
pl.back: Shelley faces the storm with outstretched arms, and the west wind tears away the pages from his notebook and scatters them over the Mediterranean Sea.
pl.controlEnglish: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.

pl.text: Jeśli nadchodzi zima, czy wiosna może być daleko?
pl.english: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?
pl.back: If winter is coming, can spring be far away?
pl.controlEnglish: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.

pl.text: Słoneczny pokój we Florencji. Elizabeth pisze przy oknie z widokiem na Arno, ze spanielem u stóp. Listy miłosne od Roberta leżą otwarte na biurku.
pl.english: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.
pl.back: A sunny room in Florence. Elizabeth is writing by the window overlooking the Arno, with a spaniel at her feet and love letters from Robert lying open on her desk.
pl.controlEnglish: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.

pl.text: Jak cię kocham? Pozwól, że policzę sposoby.
pl.english: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
pl.back: How I love you? Let me count the ways.
pl.controlEnglish: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.

pl.text: Prerafaelicki ogród w gasnącym jesiennym świetle. Christina siedzi wśród opadłych liści i układa wiersze, które bolą pięknem i cichą rezygnacją.
pl.english: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.
pl.back: Christina sits among the fallen leaves and composes poems that hurt with beauty and quiet resignation.
pl.controlEnglish: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.

pl.text: Pamiętaj o mnie, gdy odejdę, odejdę daleko, do cichej krainy.
pl.english: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.
pl.back: Remember me when I go, I will go far away to a quiet land.
pl.controlEnglish: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.

pl.text: Olimp rozcina niebo. Zeus zasiada na tronie z chmur, a błyskawica przeskakuje mu między palcami. W dole świat śmiertelnych drży pod jego spojrzeniem.
pl.english: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.
pl.back: Olympus divides the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, and lightning leaps between his fingers.Below, the world of mortals shakes under his gaze.
pl.controlEnglish: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.

pl.text: Jestem tym, który gromadzi chmury, panem szerokich niebios.
pl.english: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.
pl.back: I am the one who gathers the clouds, the lord of the wide skies.
pl.controlEnglish: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.

pl.text: Partenon lśni w złotym świetle. Atena stoi w pełnej zbroi, z sową na tarczy, a jej szare oczy przenikają każdy ludzki podstęp.
pl.english: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.
pl.back: Athena stands in her full armor, with an owl on her shield, and her gray eyes penetrate every human cunning.
pl.controlEnglish: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.

pl.text: Sowa mądrości wzlatuje dopiero o zmierzchu.
pl.english: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.
pl.back: The owl of wisdom flies only at dusk.
pl.controlEnglish: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.

pl.text: Złoty rydwan pędzi po niebie o świcie. Apollo gra na lirze, a światło słońca leje się z kół i maluje świat barwami.
pl.english: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.
pl.back: A golden chariot races through the sky at dawn, Apollo plays on his lyre and sunlight pours from the wheels and paints the world in colour.
pl.controlEnglish: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.

pl.text: Jestem bogiem pieśni, uzdrawiania i promiennego słońca.
pl.english: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.
pl.back: I am the god of song, healing and sunshine.
pl.controlEnglish: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.

pl.text: Brzegi Cypru o świcie. Afrodyta wyłania się z morskiej piany; nad nią krążą gołębie, a fale składają perły u jej stóp. Świat wstrzymuje oddech.
pl.english: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.
pl.back: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite emerges from the foam of the sea; doves circle over her, and waves lay pearls at her feet.
pl.controlEnglish: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.

pl.text: Nawet bogowie nie mogą oprzeć się potędze miłości.
pl.english: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
pl.back: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
pl.controlEnglish: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.

pl.text: Smuga skrzydlatych sandałów na niebie. Hermes lawiruje między piorunami, z boską wiadomością w jednej ręce i złodziejskim uśmiechem na twarzy.
pl.english: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.
pl.back: Hermes wanders among the thunder, with a divine message in one hand and a thief's smile on his face.
pl.controlEnglish: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.

pl.text: Szybki jak myśl, niosę słowa bogów do uszu śmiertelnych.
pl.english: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.
pl.back: Fast as thought, I carry the words of the gods to mortal ears.
pl.controlEnglish: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.

pl.text: Sala tronowa Podziemia, oświetlona rzekami bladego ognia. Hades siedzi z Cerberem u stóp, a hełm ciemności leży na poręczy tronu. Umarli suną w nieskończonym milczeniu.
pl.english: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.
pl.back: The throne hall of the underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, and the helmet of darkness lies on the railing of the throne.
pl.controlEnglish: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.

pl.text: Wszystkie dusze przychodzą w końcu do mnie. Jestem cierpliwy.
pl.english: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
pl.back: All souls eventually come to me. I am patient.
pl.controlEnglish: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.

pl.text: Tron rozdzielony między wiosnę i cień. Persefona trzyma w jednej ręce granat, a w drugiej wieniec z kwiatów, królowa dwóch królestw.
pl.english: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.
pl.back: Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a wreath of flowers in the other, she is the queen of two kingdoms.
pl.controlEnglish: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.

pl.text: Zjadłam sześć ziaren i związałam się na zawsze między dwoma światami.
pl.english: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.
pl.back: I ate six seeds and bound myself forever between the two worlds.
pl.controlEnglish: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.

pl.text: Poszarpany sztormem statek opływa skalisty przylądek. Odyseusz przywiązuje się do masztu, gdy syreny śpiewają z klifów. W jego oczach płonie wspomnienie Itaki.
pl.english: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.
pl.back: Odysseus attaches himself to the mast as the sirens sing from the cliffs. The memory of Ithaca is burning in his eyes.
pl.controlEnglish: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.

pl.text: Opowiedz mi, Muzo, o mężu wielu dróg, który błąkał się daleko.
pl.english: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.
pl.back: Tell me, Muzo, about the man of many roads who wandered far.
pl.controlEnglish: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.

pl.text: Zrujnowana świątynia na krańcu świata. Meduza odwraca się, a jej wężowe włosy syczą. Kamienni wojownicy zaścielają posadzkę, zastygli w ostatniej szarży.
pl.english: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.
pl.back: A ruined temple at the end of the world. The medusa turns around, her snake-like hair sizzling.The stone warriors cover the floor, frozen in their final assault.
pl.controlEnglish: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.

pl.text: Spójrz na mnie, jeśli śmiesz. Mój wzrok jest ostatnią rzeczą, jaką zobaczysz.
pl.english: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.
pl.back: Look at me if you dare, my gaze is the last thing you'll see.
pl.controlEnglish: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.

pl.text: Równiny Troi o świcie. Achilles naciera w płonącej zbroi, a jego okrzyk bojowy rozdziera powietrze. Za nim na brzegu płoną greckie okręty.
pl.english: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.
pl.back: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles rubs his burning armor, and his battle cry tears the air.
pl.controlEnglish: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.

pl.text: Wolę żyć krótko w chwale niż długo w zapomnieniu.
pl.english: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.
pl.back: I'd rather live a short life in glory than a long one in oblivion.
pl.controlEnglish: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
