ru.text: Возникает огромная сцена. The Sonnet Man выходит из золотого луча прожектора с микрофоном в руке. Слова Шекспира превращаются в хип-хоп строки под ликование толпы.
ru.english: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.
ru.back: The Sonnet Man emerges from the golden beam of a spotlight with a microphone in his hand. Shakespeare’s words turn into hip-hop lines under the cheering of the crowd.
ru.controlEnglish: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.

ru.text: Разворачивается сцена у балкона в лунном свете. Ромео тянет руку вверх, а наверху появляется Джульетта. В воздухе кружатся лепестки роз. Сцена пульсирует тёплым багряным сиянием.
ru.english: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.
ru.back: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo stretches his hand upwards, and Juliet appears at the top. Rose petals circle in the air. The scene pulses with a warm purple glow.
ru.controlEnglish: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.

ru.text: Сад Капулетти цветёт в лунном свете. Джульетта стоит среди роз, её глаза горят вызовом. В ветвях поёт соловей.
ru.english: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.
ru.back: Capulet's garden blooms in the moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes burning with challenge.
ru.controlEnglish: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.

ru.text: Замок Эльсинор выступает из тени. Гамлет стоит на зубчатой стене, рядом с ним парит череп Йорика. На валу появляется призрачная фигура.
ru.english: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.
ru.back: Castle Elsinore emerges from the shadows. Hamlet stands on a serrated wall, next to him floats the skull of Yorick. A ghostly figure appears on the wall.
ru.controlEnglish: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.

ru.text: Тихий ручей вьётся через ивовую рощу. Офелия плывёт среди полевых цветов, шепча забытые стихи. Лепестки кружатся в потоке.
ru.english: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.
ru.back: A quiet stream winds through the willow grove. Ophelia swims among field flowers, whispering forgotten poems. Petals circle in the flow.
ru.controlEnglish: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.

ru.text: Улица Вероны взрывается хаосом. Меркуцио танцует между клинками, смеясь в лицо опасности. От скрещённой стали летят искры.
ru.english: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.
ru.back: The streets of Verona explode in chaos. Mercuzio dances between the blades, laughing in the face of danger.
ru.controlEnglish: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.

ru.text: Зачарованный лес мерцает озорством. Пак мелькает между древними дубами, оставляя за собой следы волшебной пыльцы. Внизу спящим смертным снятся странные сны.
ru.english: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.
ru.back: The enchanted forest glows with magic. Pak glimpses between ancient oaks, leaving behind traces of magical pollen. Below sleeping mortals dream strange dreams.
ru.controlEnglish: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.

ru.text: Господи, как глупы эти смертные!
ru.english: Lord, what fools these mortals be!
ru.back: God, how foolish these mortals are!
ru.controlEnglish: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.

ru.text: Из лесной земли поднимается трон из живых лоз. Титания повелевает своим двором фей, а светлячки озаряют кроны. Сама природа склоняется перед её волей.
ru.english: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.
ru.back: From the forest land rises a throne of living vines. Titania commands her court of fairies, and fireflies illuminate the crowns. Nature itself bows before her will.
ru.controlEnglish: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.

ru.text: Приди, сядь на это цветущее ложе.
ru.english: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.
ru.back: Come, sit on this flower bed.
ru.controlEnglish: Now my charms are all o'erthrown.

ru.text: Череп покоится на бархате в сумрачном склепе. Раздаётся призрачный смех, и воспоминания о придворном шуте мерцают, как пламя свечи.
ru.english: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.
ru.back: The skull rests on the velvet in a twilight vault. Ghostly laughter is heard, and memories of the court joke glow like candle flames.
ru.controlEnglish: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.

ru.text: Череп Йорика
ru.english: Yorick's Skull
ru.back: Yorick's skull
ru.controlEnglish: Prospero's Staff

ru.text: Узловатый посох потрескивает тайной силой. Буря кружит вокруг него, пока Просперо шепчет своё последнее заклинание. Молния раскалывает небо.
ru.english: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.
ru.back: The knotted staff shakes with mysterious power. A storm swirls around it as Prospero whisperes his last spell. Lightning splits the sky.
ru.controlEnglish: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.

ru.text: Теперь все мои чары разрушены.
ru.english: Now my charms are all o'erthrown.
ru.back: Now all my spells are destroyed.
ru.controlEnglish: The course of true love never did run smooth.

ru.text: Посох Просперо
ru.english: Prospero's Staff
ru.back: Prospero's Pooch
ru.controlEnglish: Love Potion

ru.text: Светящийся флакон пульсирует розовым светом. С его поверхности поднимаются сердца, а воздух наполняет нежная мелодия.
ru.english: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.
ru.back: The luminous vial pulses with pink light. Hearts rise from its surface and a gentle melody fills the air.
ru.controlEnglish: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.

ru.text: Путь истинной любви никогда не был гладким.
ru.english: The course of true love never did run smooth.
ru.back: The path of true love has never been smooth.
ru.controlEnglish: Double, double toil and trouble.

ru.text: Любовное зелье
ru.english: Love Potion
ru.back: Love Potion
ru.controlEnglish: Witches' Brew

ru.text: Кипящий котёл изрыгает зелёный дым. Вокруг него кружат три тёмные фигуры, бормоча заклинания. Из тёмного леса светятся глаза.
ru.english: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.
ru.back: A boiling cauldron ejects green smoke. Three dark figures circle around it, murmuring spells. Eyes shine from the dark forest.
ru.controlEnglish: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.

ru.text: Вдвойне, вдвойне труд и беда.
ru.english: Double, double toil and trouble.
ru.back: Double, double labor and trouble.
ru.controlEnglish: Ill met by moonlight, proud Titania.

ru.text: Ведьмино варево
ru.english: Witches' Brew
ru.back: Witch Warrior
ru.controlEnglish: Dagger of the Mind

ru.text: Князь стоит на ступенях веронского дворца; его голос повелевает враждующей толпе умолкнуть. Золотой скипетр пылает властью.
ru.english: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.
ru.back: The prince stands on the steps of the palace of Verona; his voice commands the hostile crowd to silence.
ru.controlEnglish: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.

ru.text: Монастырская келья при свечах. Монах ухаживает за своим садом трав и ядов, мудрость отпечаталась на его обветренном лице.
ru.english: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.
ru.back: Monastery cell by candlelight. The monk cares for his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom imprinted on his windswept face.
ru.controlEnglish: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.

ru.text: Тёплая кухня в доме Капулетти. Кормилица хлопочет с яростной преданностью, спрятав тайное письмо в передник.
ru.english: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.
ru.back: Warm kitchen in Capulet's house. The maid serves with fierce devotion, hiding a secret letter in the front door.
ru.controlEnglish: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.

ru.text: Остров, окутанный бурей. Просперо воздевает руки, и молния повинуется его воле, а море вскипает по его приказу.
ru.english: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.
ru.back: An island enveloped in a storm. Prospero waves his hands, and the lightning obeys his will, and the sea boils at his command.
ru.controlEnglish: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.

ru.text: Мерцающий дух растворяется в ветре и свете и вновь возникает музыкой. Ариэль танцует между видимым и невидимым.
ru.english: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.
ru.back: The twinkling spirit dissolves in the wind and light and reappears with music. Ariel dances between visible and invisible.
ru.controlEnglish: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.

ru.text: Вход в пещеру на диком берегу. Калибан притаился среди скал, его глаза горят обидой и первобытным умом.
ru.english: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.
ru.back: The entrance to a cave on the wild shore. Caliban is hiding among the rocks, his eyes burning with resentment and primitive mind.
ru.controlEnglish: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.

ru.text: Площадь Вероны на рассвете. Бенволио стоит между обнажёнными мечами; его раскрытые ладони, единственное оружие против надвигающейся грозы.
ru.english: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.
ru.back: Piazza di Verona at dawn. Benvolio stands between bare swords; his open palms, the only weapon against the approaching storm.
ru.controlEnglish: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.

ru.text: Переулок Вероны, залитый светом факелов. Тибальт выхватывает рапиру со смертоносным изяществом, не сводя глаз с врага.
ru.english: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.
ru.back: The alley of Verona, lit by torches. Tybalt picks up a raptor with deadly grace, without taking his eyes off the enemy.
ru.controlEnglish: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.

ru.text: Тронный зал Эльсинора, убранный ложным великолепием. Клавдий сжимает корону, в его одеждах спрятан пузырёк с ядом.
ru.english: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.
ru.back: The throne hall of Elsinore, adorned with false splendor. Claudius squeezes the crown, a bubble of poison hidden in his clothes.
ru.controlEnglish: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.

ru.text: Залитая луной поляна в глубине зачарованного леса. Оберон выступает из тени, его корона из оленьих рогов ловит серебряный свет.
ru.english: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.
ru.back: A moonlit meadow in the depths of an enchanted forest. Oberon emerges from the shadow, his crown of deer horns catches silver light.
ru.controlEnglish: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.

ru.text: Недобрая встреча при лунном свете, гордая Титания.
ru.english: Ill met by moonlight, proud Titania.
ru.back: Unlucky moonlight meeting, proud Titania.
ru.controlEnglish: Is this a dagger which I see before me?

ru.text: Призрачный кинжал парит во тьме, с его клинка каплет призрачная кровь. Рука Макбета тянется к нему, но никогда не может схватить.
ru.english: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.
ru.back: A ghostly dagger floats in the dark, dropping ghostly blood from its blade. Macbeth's hand reaches for it but can never grasp it.
ru.controlEnglish: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.

ru.text: Кинжал ли это, что я вижу перед собой?
ru.english: Is this a dagger which I see before me?
ru.back: Is this a dagger that I see before me?
ru.controlEnglish: I'll put a girdle round about the earth in forty minutes.

ru.text: Кинжал воображения
ru.english: Dagger of the Mind
ru.back: Dagger of Imagination
ru.controlEnglish: Puck's Flower Juice

ru.text: Раздавленный пурпурный цветок роняет радужный нектар в подставленную ладонь. Куда бы он ни упал, меняются глаза, а за ними и сердца.
ru.english: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.
ru.back: The crushed purple flower pours rainbow nectar into the palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change and hearts follow.
ru.controlEnglish: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.

ru.text: Я опояшу землю за сорок минут.
ru.english: I'll put a girdle round about the earth in forty minutes.
ru.back: I'll be on the ground in forty minutes.
ru.controlEnglish: I dare do all that may become a man; who dares do more is none.

ru.text: Сок цветка Пака
ru.english: Puck's Flower Juice
ru.back: Pak Flower Juice
ru.controlEnglish: Lord Montague

ru.text: Залитый кровью тронный зал в Дунсинане. Макбет сжимает меч дрожащими руками, корона тяжела на его челе. На дальнем холме приходит в движение Бирнамский лес.
ru.english: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.
ru.back: Macbeth holds his sword in trembling hands, the crown heavy on his forehead. On a distant hill the Birnam Forest is moving.
ru.controlEnglish: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.

ru.text: Я смею всё, что подобает мужчине; кто смеет больше, тот не человек.
ru.english: I dare do all that may become a man; who dares do more is none.
ru.back: I laugh all that befits a man; whoever dares more is not a man.
ru.controlEnglish: Come, you spirits that tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here.

ru.text: Покой в шотландском замке при свечах. Леди Макбет шагает по холодным камням, стирая с рук призрачные пятна крови. Тени льнут к ней, как вторая кожа.
ru.english: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.
ru.back: Rest in a Scottish castle by candlelight. Lady Macbeth walks on the cold stones, wiping ghostly blood stains from her hands. The shadows cling to her like second skin.
ru.controlEnglish: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.

ru.text: Придите, духи, что служите смертельным мыслям, лишите меня здесь моего пола.
ru.english: Come, you spirits that tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here.
ru.back: Come, spirits who serve mortal thoughts, strip me of my sex here.
ru.controlEnglish: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.

ru.text: Туманная шотландская пустошь в сумерках. Банко стоит твёрдо, пока три призрачные фигуры шепчут судьбы ветру. Его призрак будет преследовать живых.
ru.english: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.
ru.back: A foggy Scottish void at dusk. Banquo stands firm as three ghostly figures whisper destiny to the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.
ru.controlEnglish: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.

ru.text: Ты породишь королей, хотя сам не будешь королём.
ru.english: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.
ru.back: Thou shalt bring forth kings, though thou shalt not be a king.
ru.controlEnglish: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.

ru.text: Открытый ветрам берег Иллирии. Виола натягивает матросскую шапку на коротко остриженные волосы; в её глазах мерцают две личности. Море шепчет тайны о её пропавшем брате.
ru.english: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.
ru.back: The windswept coast of Illyria. Viola puts her sailor’s hat on her short-cut hair; in her eyes twinkle two personalities. The sea whispers secrets about her missing brother.
ru.controlEnglish: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.

ru.text: Залитый солнцем сад в поместье Оливии. Мальволио вышагивает в кричащих жёлтых чулках с подвязками крест-накрест, ухмыляясь и прижимая к груди поддельное любовное письмо.
ru.english: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.
ru.back: The sun-drenched garden at Olivia's mansion. Malvolio walks out in screaming yellow stockings with garters crossed, smiling and holding a fake love letter against his chest.
ru.controlEnglish: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.

ru.text: Графиня в трауре поднимает вуаль и открывает красоту, от которой захватывает дух. Сад Оливии цветёт жасмином и лавандой, пока переодетый посланец похищает её сердце.
ru.english: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
ru.back: Olivia’s garden blooms with jasmine and lavender, while a disguised messenger kidnaps her heart.
ru.controlEnglish: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.

ru.text: Любовь искомая хороша, но данная без исканий лучше.
ru.english: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.
ru.back: Love sought is good, but given without searching is better.
ru.controlEnglish: I have had a most rare vision. I have had a dream, past the wit of man.

ru.text: Римский сенат, мраморные колонны в багряных пятнах. Брут стоит среди заговорщиков, его клинок ещё дрожит. Бремя республики лежит на его окровавленных руках.
ru.english: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.
ru.back: The Roman Senate, marble columns in crimson stains. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his dagger still trembling. The burden of the republic lies on his bloody hands.
ru.controlEnglish: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.

ru.text: Римский переулок в полночь, при свете факелов. Кассий склоняется ближе и шепчет о мятеже, худой и голодный на вид. Из его тоги сыплются поддельные письма.
ru.english: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.
ru.back: A Roman alley at midnight, in the light of torches. Cassius leans closer and whispers about the uprising, skinny and hungry in appearance. Fake letters pour from his toga.
ru.controlEnglish: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.

ru.text: Римский форум взрывается яростью. Марк Антоний поднимает перед толпой окровавленный плащ Цезаря; его слова обращают скорбь в огонь. С каждым слогом республика рушится.
ru.english: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.
ru.back: The Roman Forum explodes in rage. Marcus Antonius raises Caesar's bloody cloak before the crowd; his words turn grief into fire.
ru.controlEnglish: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.

ru.text: Поместье Монтекки на рассвете. Синьор Монтекки смотрит из высокого окна, как его сын бродит внизу по туманным садам, больной любовью и недосягаемый.
ru.english: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.
ru.back: Montecchi Manor at dawn. Signore Montecchi looks out of a high window as his son wanders down through the hazy gardens, sick of love and unreachable.
ru.controlEnglish: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.

ru.text: Синьор Монтекки
ru.english: Lord Montague
ru.back: Signor Montecchi
ru.controlEnglish: Lady Capulet

ru.text: Большой зал Капулетти, убранный шёлком. Синьора Капулетти расставляет судьбу дочери, как цветы в вазе; за каждой любезной улыбкой блестит честолюбие.
ru.english: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.
ru.back: Signora Capuleti arranges the fate of her daughter like flowers in a vase; behind every kind smile shines ambition.
ru.controlEnglish: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.

ru.text: Синьора Капулетти
ru.english: Lady Capulet
ru.back: Signora Capuleti
ru.controlEnglish: Romeo's Ring

ru.text: Стены Эльсинора в холодный час перед рассветом. Горацио несёт стражу рядом с Гамлетом, единственный верный друг при дворе змей.
ru.english: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.
ru.back: The walls of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio is guarding beside Hamlet, the only faithful friend at the court of snakes.
ru.controlEnglish: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.

ru.text: Лесная поляна, озарённая светом фей. Основа носит ослиную голову с растерянным достоинством, пока Титания украшает его гирляндами. Феи сдерживают смех.
ru.english: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.
ru.back: A forest meadow illuminated by fairy lights. The base carries a donkey's head with disoriented dignity, while Titania adorns it with garlands.
ru.controlEnglish: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.

ru.text: Мне было редчайшее видение. Мне приснился сон, который выше человеческого разумения.
ru.english: I have had a most rare vision. I have had a dream, past the wit of man.
ru.back: I had a rare vision. I dreamed a dream that is beyond human understanding.
ru.controlEnglish: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.

ru.text: Кладбище Вероны в сумерках. Парис возлагает цветы к гробнице Джульетты, не зная об отчаявшемся влюблённом, который приближается из тени.
ru.english: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.
ru.back: Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover approaching from the shadows.
ru.controlEnglish: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.

ru.text: Нетронутый берег на острове Просперо. Миранда впервые видит потерпевших кораблекрушение, её глаза широко раскрыты от изумления перед миром, о котором она не знала.
ru.english: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.
ru.back: Miranda sees the shipwreck victims for the first time, her eyes wide open in amazement at a world she had never known about.
ru.controlEnglish: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.

ru.text: Золотое кольцо лежит на каменных перилах балкона и ловит лунный свет. Внутри выгравирована клятва, которая переживёт саму смерть. Лепестки роз кружат вокруг него в невидимом ветре.
ru.english: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.
ru.back: The golden ring lies on the stone railings of the balcony and catches the moonlight. Inside it is engraved an oath that will survive death itself. Rose petals circle around it in the invisible wind.
ru.controlEnglish: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.

ru.text: Кольцо Ромео
ru.english: Romeo's Ring
ru.back: Romeo's Ring
ru.controlEnglish: Portia's Casket

ru.text: Три ларца мерцают в покое при свечах: золотой, серебряный и свинцовый. Свинцовый ларец гудит тихой правдой и награждает тех, кому хватает мудрости смотреть глубже видимости.
ru.english: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.
ru.back: Three chests twinkle quietly by the candles: gold, silver and lead. The lead chest hums with silent truth and rewards those who have the wisdom to look beyond sight.
ru.controlEnglish: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.

ru.text: Ларец Порции
ru.english: Portia's Casket
ru.back: Laretz Porcia
ru.controlEnglish: Macbeth's Crown

ru.text: Потускневшая шотландская корона лежит на залитой кровью подушке. Она пульсирует тёмным честолюбием и шепчет обещания славы любой руке, что осмелится к ней потянуться.
ru.english: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
ru.back: The withered Scottish crown lies on a bloody pillow, pulsating with dark ambition and whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
ru.controlEnglish: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.

ru.text: Беспокойно лежит голова, носящая корону.
ru.english: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.
ru.back: Anxiously lies the head wearing a crown.
ru.controlEnglish: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.

ru.text: Корона Макбета
ru.english: Macbeth's Crown
ru.back: Macbeth's Crown
ru.controlEnglish: The Tempest Codex

ru.text: Древний фолиант в переплёте из кожи, выдубленной морем, парит над каменным алтарём. Его страницы переворачиваются сами, и каждая призывает иную бурю.
ru.english: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.
ru.back: An ancient folio in a weave of leather excavated by the sea floats over a stone altar. Its pages turn themselves, each calling for a different storm.
ru.controlEnglish: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.

ru.text: Кодекс бури
ru.english: The Tempest Codex
ru.back: Storm Code
ru.controlEnglish: Cordelia's Tears

ru.text: Хрустальный флакон хранит слёзы, мерцающие, как пойманный звёздный свет. Каждая капля несёт скорбь дочери, которая любила слишком верно и говорила слишком прямо.
ru.english: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.
ru.back: Each drop bears the grief of a daughter who loved too faithfully and spoke too straightforwardly.
ru.controlEnglish: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.

ru.text: О дорогой отец, я занята твоим делом.
ru.english: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.
ru.back: Oh, dear father, I'm busy with your business.
ru.controlEnglish: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!

ru.text: Слёзы Корделии
ru.english: Cordelia's Tears
ru.back: Cordelia's Tears
ru.controlEnglish: Bottom's Mask

ru.text: Маска с ослиной головой висит на мшистой ветке в лесу фей. Кто наденет её, увидит мир зачарованными глазами и станет неотразим для королев фей.
ru.english: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.
ru.back: The mask with the donkey's head hangs on a mossy branch in the fairy forest. Whoever wears it will see the world with enchanted eyes and become irresistible for the fairy queens.
ru.controlEnglish: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.

ru.text: Господь с тобой, Основа! Ты преображён!
ru.english: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!
ru.back: The LORD is with thee, O foundation!
ru.controlEnglish: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.

ru.text: Маска Основы
ru.english: Bottom's Mask
ru.back: Base Mask
ru.controlEnglish: Mandrake Root

ru.text: Узловатый корень в виде кричащей фигуры выкапывают при свете свечи. Земля осыпается и открывает его искривлённую древнюю силу. Аптекарь берёт его с трепетным благоговением.
ru.english: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.
ru.back: The nodular root in the form of a screaming figure is dug up under candlelight. The earth collapses and reveals its crooked ancient power.
ru.controlEnglish: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.

ru.text: Корень мандрагоры
ru.english: Mandrake Root
ru.back: Mandragora root
ru.controlEnglish: Oberon's Dew

ru.text: Капля росы держится на орхидее в лунном свете и светится неземным фиолетовым сиянием. Одна капля на спящие веки, и спящий влюбится в первое существо, которое увидит.
ru.english: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.
ru.back: A drop of dew holds on an orchid in the moonlight and shines with an unearthly violet radiance. One drop on a sleeping eyelid, and the sleeper will fall in love with the first creature he sees.
ru.controlEnglish: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.

ru.text: Принеси мне тот цветок; траву, что я тебе однажды показывал.
ru.english: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.
ru.back: Bring me that flower, the grass I once showed you.
ru.controlEnglish: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.

ru.text: Роса Оберона
ru.english: Oberon's Dew
ru.back: Rosa Oberon
ru.controlEnglish: Hemlock Tincture

ru.text: Пузырёк чёрного стекла источает зелёный пар в тёмном коридоре. Настойка в нём свергала королей и рушила династии, одна бесшумная капля за другой.
ru.english: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.
ru.back: A bubble of black glass emits a green vapor in the dark corridor. The infusion in it has overthrown kings and destroyed dynasties, one silent drop after another.
ru.controlEnglish: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.

ru.text: Настойка болиголова
ru.english: Hemlock Tincture
ru.back: Bolygol infusion
ru.controlEnglish: Mistletoe Extract

ru.text: Бледные ягоды блестят среди тёмных вечнозелёных листьев, собранные под зимней луной. Вытяжка гудит тихим, упорным волшебством природы.
ru.english: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.
ru.back: Pale berries shine among the dark evergreen leaves, gathered under the winter moon. The extractor hums the quiet, persistent magic of nature.
ru.controlEnglish: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.

ru.text: В котле кипи и варись; глаз тритона и палец лягушки.
ru.english: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.
ru.back: In the cauldron boil and cook; eye of a triton and finger of a frog.
ru.controlEnglish: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.

ru.text: Вытяжка омелы
ru.english: Mistletoe Extract
ru.back: Omela extract
ru.controlEnglish: Mermaid's Tears

ru.text: Фляга с жемчужной пробкой хранит светящуюся голубую жидкость, которая движется, как живое море. В ней растут и растворяются крошечные кораллы. Она пахнет солью и забытыми странствиями.
ru.english: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.
ru.back: The bottle with the pearl cork holds a glowing blue liquid that moves like a living sea. Tiny corals grow and dissolve in it. It smells of salt and forgotten wanderings.
ru.controlEnglish: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.

ru.text: Слёзы русалки
ru.english: Mermaid's Tears
ru.back: Tears of a Mermaid
ru.controlEnglish: Apothecary's Elixir

ru.text: Пыльная аптека в беднейшем квартале Мантуи. Эликсир отчаяния светится янтарём в треснувшем пузырьке, достаточно сильный, чтобы перекинуть мост между жизнью и смертью.
ru.english: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
ru.back: A dusty pharmacy in the poorest neighborhood of Mantua. The elixir of despair shines amber in a cracked bubble, strong enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
ru.controlEnglish: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.

ru.text: Эликсир аптекаря
ru.english: Apothecary's Elixir
ru.back: The Pharmacist's Elixir
ru.controlEnglish: Yorick's Skull

ru.text: Ковёр золотых нарциссов тянется вдоль берегов тихого озера. Вордсворт идёт среди них с записной книжкой в руке, а за его спиной поднимаются холмы Камберленда.
ru.english: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.
ru.back: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a quiet lake. Wordsworth walks among them with his notebook in hand, and behind him rise the hills of Cumberland.
ru.controlEnglish: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.

ru.text: Я бродил одиноко, как облако, что плывёт высоко над долинами и холмами.
ru.english: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.
ru.back: I wandered alone, like a cloud that floats high over valleys and hills.
ru.controlEnglish: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.

ru.text: Застигнутый штилем корабль дрейфует по нарисованному океану. Старый мореход смотрит на альбатроса у себя на шее, а из стеклянного моря поднимаются призрачные фигуры.
ru.english: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.
ru.back: The old sailor looks at the albatross on his neck, and ghostly figures rise from the glass sea.
ru.controlEnglish: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.

ru.text: Сад в Хэмпстеде осенью. Китс сидит под сливой и лихорадочно пишет, а в темнеющих ветвях поёт соловей.
ru.english: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.
ru.back: The garden in Hempstead in autumn. Keats sits under the plum tree and writes feverishly, and in the darkening branches sings the flute.
ru.controlEnglish: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.

ru.text: Прекрасное есть радость навсегда: его очарование растёт.
ru.english: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.
ru.back: The beautiful is joy forever: its charm grows.
ru.controlEnglish: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.

ru.text: Венецианское палаццо в полночь. Байрон стоит на балконе, плащ развевается, взгляд устремлён на тёмный канал. За его спиной в камине горит недописанная рукопись.
ru.english: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.
ru.back: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, his cloak waving, his gaze fixed on a dark canal. Behind him in the fireplace burns an unwritten manuscript.
ru.controlEnglish: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.

ru.text: Она идёт во всей красе, как ночь безоблачных краёв и звёздных небес.
ru.english: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.
ru.back: She goes in all her beauty, like a night of cloudless edges and starry skies.
ru.controlEnglish: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.

ru.text: Кабинет в Женеве при свечах, во время грозы. Мэри пишет при вспышках молний, а в тенях за её спиной шевелится создание. Наука и ужас становятся одним.
ru.english: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.
ru.back: A candlelit office in Geneva, during a thunderstorm. Mary writes with lightning flashes, and in the shadows behind her back a creature moves. Science and horror become one.
ru.controlEnglish: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.

ru.text: Берегись; ибо я бесстрашен и потому могуч.
ru.english: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.
ru.back: Beware, for I am fearless and therefore mighty.
ru.controlEnglish: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.

ru.text: Сумрачная комната, освещённая угасающим огнём. Эдгар По сидит, сгорбившись, за столом, когда ворон садится на бюст Паллады. Слово «Никогда» отдаётся эхом в тенях.
ru.english: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.
ru.back: A dark room lit by a fading fire. Edgar Poe sits crouched at the table when a crow sits on Pallas’ bust. The word “never” echoes in the shadows.
ru.controlEnglish: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.

ru.text: Лондонская печатная мастерская, пылающая светом видений. Блейк гравирует тигра на меди, и зверь выходит из пластины, светло горя в лесах ночи.
ru.english: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.
ru.back: Blake engraves a tiger on copper, and the beast emerges from the plate, brightly mourning in the woods of night.
ru.controlEnglish: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.

ru.text: Увидеть мир в одной песчинке и небо в полевом цветке.
ru.english: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.
ru.back: To see the world in one grain of sand and the sky in a field flower.
ru.controlEnglish: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?

ru.text: Открытая ветрам вершина итальянского утёса. Шелли встречает бурю, раскинув руки, а западный ветер вырывает страницы из его записной книжки и разносит их над Средиземным морем.
ru.english: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.
ru.back: On the top of an Italian cliff, open to the winds. Shelley meets the storm with his hands outstretched, and the west wind tears pages from his notebook and blows them over the Mediterranean Sea.
ru.controlEnglish: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.

ru.text: Если пришла зима, может ли весна быть далеко?
ru.english: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?
ru.back: If winter has come, can spring be far away?
ru.controlEnglish: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.

ru.text: Залитая солнцем комната во Флоренции. Элизабет пишет у окна с видом на Арно, у её ног лежит спаниель. Любовные письма Роберта раскрыты на столе.
ru.english: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.
ru.back: A sunny room in Florence. Elizabeth is writing at the window overlooking the Arno, a spaniel lying at her feet. Robert's love letters are unfolded on the desk.
ru.controlEnglish: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.

ru.text: Как я люблю тебя? Позволь мне сосчитать пути.
ru.english: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
ru.back: How do I love you? Let me count the ways.
ru.controlEnglish: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.

ru.text: Сад прерафаэлитов в угасающем осеннем свете. Кристина сидит среди опавших листьев и слагает стихи, которые болят красотой и тихим смирением.
ru.english: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.
ru.back: Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among the fallen leaves and composes poems that hurt with beauty and quiet humility.
ru.controlEnglish: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.

ru.text: Вспомни обо мне, когда я уйду, уйду далеко, в безмолвный край.
ru.english: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.
ru.back: Remember me when I go, when I go far away into a land of silence.
ru.controlEnglish: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.

ru.text: Гора Олимп рассекает небо. Зевс восседает на троне из облаков, между его пальцами проскакивает молния. Внизу мир смертных трепещет под его взглядом.
ru.english: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.
ru.back: Mount Olympus cuts through the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning leaps between his fingers. The mortal world beneath trembles under his gaze.
ru.controlEnglish: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.

ru.text: Я собиратель туч, владыка широких небес.
ru.english: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.
ru.back: I am the gatherer of clouds, the lord of wide heavens.
ru.controlEnglish: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.

ru.text: Парфенон сияет в золотом свете. Афина стоит в полном вооружении, сова сидит на её щите, её серые глаза видят насквозь всякий обман смертных.
ru.english: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.
ru.back: The Parthenon shines in a golden light. Athena stands fully armed, the owl sits on her shield, her gray eyes see through every mortal deception.
ru.controlEnglish: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.

ru.text: Сова мудрости вылетает только в сумерки.
ru.english: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.
ru.back: The owl of wisdom flies only at dusk.
ru.controlEnglish: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.

ru.text: Золотая колесница мчится по рассветному небу. Аполлон играет на лире, а солнечный свет льётся с колёс и раскрашивает мир.
ru.english: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.
ru.back: A golden chariot races through the dawn sky. Apollo plays on his lyre, and sunlight pours from the wheels and colours the world.
ru.controlEnglish: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.

ru.text: Я бог песни, исцеления и лучезарного солнца.
ru.english: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.
ru.back: I am the god of song, healing and the radiant sun.
ru.controlEnglish: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.

ru.text: Берега Кипра на рассвете. Афродита поднимается из морской пены; над ней кружат голуби, а волны кладут жемчуг к её ногам. Мир затаил дыхание.
ru.english: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.
ru.back: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from the sea foam; doves circle over her, and waves lay pearls to her feet.
ru.controlEnglish: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.

ru.text: Даже боги не могут устоять перед силой любви.
ru.english: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
ru.back: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
ru.controlEnglish: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.

ru.text: Мелькание крылатых сандалий в небе. Гермес лавирует между молниями, сжимая в одной руке божественное послание, с воровской усмешкой на лице.
ru.english: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.
ru.back: Hermes wanders between the lightnings, holding a divine message in one hand, with a thief's smile on his face.
ru.controlEnglish: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.

ru.text: Быстрый, как мысль, я несу слова богов к ушам смертных.
ru.english: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.
ru.back: Fast as thought, I carry the words of the gods to the ears of mortals.
ru.controlEnglish: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.

ru.text: Тронный зал Подземного царства, освещённый реками бледного огня. Аид сидит с Цербером у ног, шлем тьмы лежит на подлокотнике. Мёртвые проходят мимо в бесконечном молчании.
ru.english: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.
ru.back: The throne hall of the underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, the helmet of darkness lying on his armrest.
ru.controlEnglish: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.

ru.text: Все души в конце приходят ко мне. Я терпелив.
ru.english: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
ru.back: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
ru.controlEnglish: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.

ru.text: Трон, разделённый между весной и тенью. Персефона держит в одной руке гранат, а в другой венок из цветов, царица двух царств.
ru.english: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.
ru.back: A throne divided between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a wreath of flowers in the other, queen of two kingdoms.
ru.controlEnglish: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.

ru.text: Шесть зёрен я съела и навек связала себя между двумя мирами.
ru.english: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.
ru.back: I ate six seeds and forever bound myself between the two worlds.
ru.controlEnglish: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.

ru.text: Потрёпанный бурей корабль огибает скалистый мыс. Одиссей привязывает себя к мачте, пока сирены поют с утёсов. В его глазах горит память об Итаке.
ru.english: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.
ru.back: Odysseus binds himself to the mast while the sirens sing from the cliffs. The memory of Ithaca burns in his eyes.
ru.controlEnglish: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.

ru.text: Расскажи мне, о Муза, о муже многих путей, что странствовал далеко.
ru.english: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.
ru.back: Tell me, O Musa, about the man of many ways who traveled far.
ru.controlEnglish: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.

ru.text: Разрушенный храм на краю света. Медуза оборачивается, её змеиные волосы шипят. Каменные воины устилают пол, застывшие в последнем броске.
ru.english: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.
ru.back: A ruined temple on the edge of the world. A jellyfish turns around, her snake-haired hair sizzling. Stone warriors lined the floor, frozen in the last throw.
ru.controlEnglish: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.

ru.text: Взгляни на меня, если смеешь. Мой взгляд будет последним, что ты увидишь.
ru.english: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.
ru.back: Look at me, if you dare. My gaze will be the last you see.
ru.controlEnglish: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.

ru.text: Равнины Трои на рассвете. Ахилл мчится в сверкающих доспехах, его боевой клич раскалывает воздух. За ним на берегу горят греческие корабли.
ru.english: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.
ru.back: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles rush in shining armor, his battle cry splits the air. Behind him on the shore are burning Greek ships.
ru.controlEnglish: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.

ru.text: Лучше прожить короткую жизнь в славе, чем долгую в забвении.
ru.english: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.
ru.back: It is better to live a short life in glory than a long one in oblivion.
ru.controlEnglish: Lord, what fools these mortals be!
