vi.text: Một sân khấu lớn hiện ra. The Sonnet Man bước ra từ vầng đèn vàng rực, tay cầm micro. Lời của Shakespeare biến thành những câu hip-hop trong tiếng reo hò của khán giả.
vi.english: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.
vi.back: A huge stage appears, the Sonnet Man steps out of the glowing yellow lights with a microphone in his hand, Shakespeare's words turn into hip-hop phrases in the roar of the audience.
vi.controlEnglish: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.

vi.text: Ta có nên ví nàng với một ngày hè?
vi.english: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
vi.back: Should I compare you to a summer day?
vi.controlEnglish: But soft, what light through yonder window breaks?

vi.text: Cảnh ban công dưới ánh trăng mở ra. Romeo vươn tay lên khi Juliet xuất hiện phía trên. Những cánh hoa hồng bay lả tả trong không trung, và cả khung cảnh rực lên một sắc đỏ thắm ấm áp.
vi.english: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.
vi.back: The moonlit balcony opens, Romeo reaches up when Juliet appears above him, the rose petals flutter in the air, and the scene glows in a warm red.
vi.controlEnglish: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.

vi.text: Nhưng khoan, ánh sáng nào vừa lóe lên nơi cửa sổ kia?
vi.english: But soft, what light through yonder window breaks?
vi.back: But wait, what's the light that just flashed through that window?
vi.controlEnglish: What's in a name? That which we call a rose...

vi.text: Khu vườn nhà Capulet nở rộ dưới ánh trăng. Juliet đứng giữa những khóm hồng, đôi mắt ánh lên vẻ thách thức. Một con chim họa mi hót trên cành cao.
vi.english: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.
vi.back: Capulet's garden blooms in the moonlight, Juliet stands amidst the rose buds, her eyes shining with defiance, and an eagle-winged bird sings on a high branch.
vi.controlEnglish: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.

vi.text: Cái tên thì có nghĩa gì? Thứ ta gọi là hoa hồng...
vi.english: What's in a name? That which we call a rose...
vi.back: What does that name mean?
vi.controlEnglish: To be, or not to be, that is the question.

vi.text: Lâu đài Elsinore hiện ra từ bóng tối. Hamlet đứng trên tường thành, chiếc đầu lâu của Yorick lơ lửng bên cạnh. Một bóng ma xuất hiện trên lũy thành phía trên.
vi.english: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.
vi.back: Castle Elsinore emerges from the dark, Hamlet stands on the wall, Yorick's long head floats by, a ghost appears on the mound above.
vi.controlEnglish: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.

vi.text: Tồn tại hay không tồn tại, đó là vấn đề.
vi.english: To be, or not to be, that is the question.
vi.back: To exist or not to exist, that's the question.
vi.controlEnglish: There's rosemary, that's for remembrance.

vi.text: Một dòng suối hiền hòa uốn quanh lùm liễu. Ophelia trôi giữa những đóa hoa dại, thì thầm những câu thơ đã bị lãng quên. Cánh hoa xoay tròn theo dòng nước.
vi.english: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.
vi.back: Ophelia floats among the wild flowers, whispering forgotten poems, her petals swirling with the water.
vi.controlEnglish: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.

vi.text: Đây là hương thảo, để mà tưởng nhớ.
vi.english: There's rosemary, that's for remembrance.
vi.back: This is incense, for remembrance.
vi.controlEnglish: A plague on both your houses!

vi.text: Một con phố ở Verona bùng lên hỗn loạn. Mercutio nhảy múa giữa những lưỡi kiếm, cười vào mặt hiểm nguy. Tia lửa tóe ra từ thép va vào nhau.
vi.english: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.
vi.back: A street in Verona bursts into chaos, Mercutio dances between the blades of his swords, smiling at the danger, sparks erupt from the steels that collide.
vi.controlEnglish: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.

vi.text: Tai ương giáng xuống cả hai nhà các người!
vi.english: A plague on both your houses!
vi.back: Let the storm fall on both of you!
vi.controlEnglish: Lord, what fools these mortals be!

vi.text: Khu rừng phù phép lấp lánh vẻ tinh nghịch. Puck lướt vụt giữa những cây sồi cổ thụ, để lại những vệt bụi tiên. Bên dưới, những người phàm say ngủ mơ những giấc mơ kỳ lạ.
vi.english: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.
vi.back: The enchanted forest glows playfully, Puck glides through the ancient oak trees, leaving behind trails of fairy dust, and beneath, ghosts dream strange dreams.
vi.controlEnglish: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.

vi.text: Trời ơi, người trần mới dại dột làm sao!
vi.english: Lord, what fools these mortals be!
vi.back: Oh, my God, what a crazy new man!
vi.controlEnglish: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.

vi.text: Một ngai vàng bằng dây leo sống vươn lên từ nền rừng. Titania ra lệnh cho triều đình tiên của mình trong khi đom đóm thắp sáng tán lá. Chính thiên nhiên cũng cúi đầu trước ý nàng.
vi.english: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.
vi.back: A throne of living willows rises from the forest, Titania commands her fairy court while fireflies light up the leaves, and nature itself bows to her will.
vi.controlEnglish: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.

vi.text: Lại đây, hãy ngồi xuống chiếc giường đầy hoa này.
vi.english: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.
vi.back: Come here, sit down on this flower bed.
vi.controlEnglish: Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio.

vi.text: Một chiếc đầu lâu nằm trên nền nhung trong hầm mộ tối mờ. Tiếng cười ma quái vang vọng khi ký ức về chàng hề cung đình chập chờn như ánh nến.
vi.english: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.
vi.back: A long head lying on the velvet floor in a dark dungeon, ghostly laughs echoing as memories of his courtier flash like candlelight.
vi.controlEnglish: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.

vi.text: Than ôi, Yorick tội nghiệp! Ta từng biết hắn, Horatio ạ.
vi.english: Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio.
vi.back: Oh, poor Yorick, I knew him, Horatio.
vi.controlEnglish: Now my charms are all o'erthrown.

vi.text: Đầu lâu của Yorick
vi.english: Yorick's Skull
vi.back: Yorick's long head.
vi.controlEnglish: Prospero's Staff

vi.text: Một cây trượng xương xẩu tóe lửa năng lượng huyền bí. Cơn giông xoáy quanh nó khi Prospero thì thầm câu thần chú cuối cùng. Tia chớp xé toạc bầu trời.
vi.english: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.
vi.back: A tree of bones erupted, bursting with mysterious energy, a storm swirled around it as Prospero whispered his final spell, lightning broke through the sky.
vi.controlEnglish: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.

vi.text: Giờ đây mọi phép thuật của ta đã tan hết.
vi.english: Now my charms are all o'erthrown.
vi.back: Now all my magic is gone.
vi.controlEnglish: The course of true love never did run smooth.

vi.text: Cây trượng của Prospero
vi.english: Prospero's Staff
vi.back: Prospero's tree.
vi.controlEnglish: Love Potion

vi.text: Một lọ thuốc phát sáng, nhịp nhàng tỏa ánh hồng. Những trái tim bay lên từ mặt lọ khi một giai điệu ngọt ngào lan khắp không gian.
vi.english: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.
vi.back: A vial of medicine glows, the beats light up the pink hearts flying from the bottle as a sweet melody spreads throughout the space.
vi.controlEnglish: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.

vi.text: Đường đi của tình yêu chân thật chưa bao giờ êm ả.
vi.english: The course of true love never did run smooth.
vi.back: The path of true love has never been smooth.
vi.controlEnglish: Double, double toil and trouble.

vi.text: Tình dược
vi.english: Love Potion
vi.back: Love medicine.
vi.controlEnglish: Witches' Brew

vi.text: Một chiếc vạc sôi sùng sục phun khói xanh lục. Ba bóng người mờ tối vây quanh nó, tụng niệm. Những con mắt sáng rực từ khu rừng tối phía xa.
vi.english: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.
vi.back: There was a boiling torch blazing green smoke, three dark shadows of men surrounding it, singing praises, bright eyes shining from the dark forest in the distance.
vi.controlEnglish: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.

vi.text: Gấp đôi, gấp đôi nhọc nhằn và rắc rối.
vi.english: Double, double toil and trouble.
vi.back: Double, double the hassle and trouble.
vi.controlEnglish: If ever you disturb our streets again, your lives shall pay the forfeit of the peace.

vi.text: Nồi thuốc của phù thủy
vi.english: Witches' Brew
vi.back: Witch's pot.
vi.controlEnglish: Dagger of the Mind

vi.text: Vị Thân vương đứng trên bậc thềm cung điện Verona, giọng nói của ngài khiến đám đông đang thù hằn im bặt. Cây quyền trượng vàng rực cháy uy quyền.
vi.english: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.
vi.back: The King stands on the threshold of the palace of Verona, his voice silenced the crowds that were in awe.
vi.controlEnglish: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.

vi.text: Nếu các ngươi còn quấy rối đường phố của ta lần nữa, mạng sống các ngươi sẽ phải đền cho sự yên bình bị phá vỡ.
vi.english: If ever you disturb our streets again, your lives shall pay the forfeit of the peace.
vi.back: If you disturb my streets again, your lives will have to pay for the breach of peace.
vi.controlEnglish: These violent delights have violent ends.

vi.text: Một phòng tu thắp nến trong tu viện. Vị tu sĩ chăm sóc khu vườn thảo dược và độc dược của mình, sự minh triết in hằn trên gương mặt dãi dầu.
vi.english: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.
vi.back: A candlelit chamber in a monastery, the monk cares for his garden of herbs and potions, the philosophy imprinted on his oily face.
vi.controlEnglish: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.

vi.text: Những niềm vui cuồng nhiệt này sẽ có kết cục cuồng nhiệt.
vi.english: These violent delights have violent ends.
vi.back: These frenzied joys will have a frenzied ending.
vi.controlEnglish: I am the drudge and toil in your delight.

vi.text: Một gian bếp ấm áp trong nhà Capulet. Bà vú tất bật với lòng tận tụy mãnh liệt, một bức thư bí mật giắt trong tạp dề.
vi.english: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.
vi.back: A warm kitchen in Capulet's house, a mother busy with passionate devotion, a secret letter stuck on the cover.
vi.controlEnglish: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.

vi.text: Tôi là kẻ tôi đòi nhọc nhằn vì niềm vui của cô.
vi.english: I am the drudge and toil in your delight.
vi.back: I'm the one I've been demanding for your pleasure.
vi.controlEnglish: We are such stuff as dreams are made on.

vi.text: Một hòn đảo chìm trong giông tố. Prospero giơ hai tay lên và tia chớp tuân theo ý ông, biển cả cuộn sóng theo lệnh ông.
vi.english: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.
vi.back: An island submerged in a storm, Prospero raised his hands and the lightning obeyed him, the sea rolled at his command.
vi.controlEnglish: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.

vi.text: Chúng ta là thứ chất liệu dệt nên những giấc mơ.
vi.english: We are such stuff as dreams are made on.
vi.back: We are the fabric of dreams.
vi.controlEnglish: All hail, great master! Grave sir, hail!

vi.text: Một linh hồn lấp lánh tan vào gió và ánh sáng, rồi tái hiện thành âm nhạc. Ariel nhảy múa giữa cõi hữu hình và vô hình.
vi.english: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.
vi.back: A soul glows in the wind and light, then reappears as music. Ariel dances between visible and invisible realms.
vi.controlEnglish: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.

vi.text: Kính chào chủ nhân vĩ đại! Kính chào ngài tôn nghiêm!
vi.english: All hail, great master! Grave sir, hail!
vi.back: Welcome, my great master!
vi.controlEnglish: This island's mine, by Sycorax my mother.

vi.text: Một miệng hang trên bờ biển hoang dã. Caliban thu mình giữa những tảng đá, đôi mắt rực cháy oán hận và một trí khôn nguyên sơ.
vi.english: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.
vi.back: A cave mouth on a wild seashore, Caliban hidden among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and an untouched mind.
vi.controlEnglish: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.

vi.text: Hòn đảo này là của ta, do Sycorax mẹ ta để lại.
vi.english: This island's mine, by Sycorax my mother.
vi.back: This island is mine, left to me by my mother Sycorax.
vi.controlEnglish: I do but keep the peace. Put up thy sword.

vi.text: Một quảng trường ở Verona lúc rạng đông. Benvolio đứng giữa những thanh kiếm đã tuốt, đôi bàn tay mở là vũ khí duy nhất của chàng trước cơn bão đang kéo đến.
vi.english: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.
vi.back: A square in Verona at dawn, Benvolio standing among sharpened swords, his open arms being his only weapon against the storm that drew near.
vi.controlEnglish: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.

vi.text: Tôi chỉ giữ hòa khí thôi. Hãy tra gươm vào vỏ.
vi.english: I do but keep the peace. Put up thy sword.
vi.back: I'm just keeping the peace.
vi.controlEnglish: What, drawn, and talk of peace? I hate the word.

vi.text: Một con hẻm ở Verona rực sáng ánh đuốc. Tybalt rút thanh kiếm mảnh với vẻ uyển chuyển chết người, mắt dán chặt vào kẻ thù.
vi.english: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.
vi.back: An alley in Verona was lit by a torchlight, Tybalt drew his sword with deadly prowess, his eyes fixed on the enemy.
vi.controlEnglish: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.

vi.text: Sao, gươm đã tuốt mà còn nói chuyện hòa bình? Ta ghét cái từ ấy.
vi.english: What, drawn, and talk of peace? I hate the word.
vi.back: I hate that word.
vi.controlEnglish: My words fly up, my thoughts remain below.

vi.text: Phòng ngai vàng ở Elsinore khoác vẻ lộng lẫy giả dối. Claudius nắm chặt vương miện, một lọ thuốc độc giấu trong áo choàng.
vi.english: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.
vi.back: The throne room at Elsinore is adorned with false splendor, Claudius holding the crown, a poison bottle hidden in his cloak.
vi.controlEnglish: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.

vi.text: Lời ta bay lên cao, ý nghĩ ta vẫn nằm lại dưới thấp.
vi.english: My words fly up, my thoughts remain below.
vi.back: My words fly high, my thoughts remain low.
vi.controlEnglish: Ill met by moonlight, proud Titania.

vi.text: Một khoảng rừng trống dưới ánh trăng nằm sâu trong khu rừng phù phép. Oberon hiện ra từ bóng tối, vương miện bằng gạc hươu bắt lấy ánh bạc.
vi.english: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.
vi.back: An empty forest under the moonlight, deep in the enchanted forest, Oberon emerges from the darkness, his crown of deer's hair catching the silver glow.
vi.controlEnglish: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.

vi.text: Gặp nhau dưới ánh trăng thật chẳng lành, Titania kiêu hãnh.
vi.english: Ill met by moonlight, proud Titania.
vi.back: It's not good to meet in the moonlight, Titania proud.
vi.controlEnglish: Is this a dagger which I see before me?

vi.text: Một con dao găm ma quái lơ lửng trong bóng tối, lưỡi dao nhỏ những giọt máu hư ảo. Bàn tay Macbeth vươn tới nhưng không bao giờ nắm được nó.
vi.english: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.
vi.back: A ghostly knife hovers in the dark, its blade tiny drops of imaginary blood, Macbeth's hand reaches for it but never gets hold of it.
vi.controlEnglish: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.

vi.text: Có phải con dao găm ta đang thấy trước mặt đây không?
vi.english: Is this a dagger which I see before me?
vi.back: Is this the knife I'm seeing in front of me?
vi.controlEnglish: I'll put a girdle round about the earth in forty minutes.

vi.text: Con dao găm của tâm trí
vi.english: Dagger of the Mind
vi.back: The knife of the mind
vi.controlEnglish: Puck's Flower Juice

vi.text: Một bông hoa tím bị nghiền nát nhỏ những giọt mật óng ánh vào lòng bàn tay đang chờ. Rơi xuống nơi đâu, đôi mắt đổi thay ở đó — và trái tim cũng theo sau.
vi.english: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.
vi.back: A violet blossom is crushed, droplets of nectar gleam in the waiting palm. Where it drops down, eyes change there - and hearts follow.
vi.controlEnglish: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.

vi.text: Tôi sẽ quấn một vòng đai quanh trái đất trong bốn mươi phút.
vi.english: I'll put a girdle round about the earth in forty minutes.
vi.back: I'm going to wrap a belt around the earth in forty minutes.
vi.controlEnglish: I dare do all that may become a man; who dares do more is none.

vi.text: Nhựa hoa của Puck
vi.english: Puck's Flower Juice
vi.back: Puck's flower plastic.
vi.controlEnglish: Lord Montague

vi.text: Một phòng ngai vàng nhuốm máu ở Dunsinane. Macbeth nắm chặt thanh kiếm bằng đôi tay run rẩy, vương miện nặng trĩu trên trán. Rừng Birnam lay động trên ngọn đồi xa.
vi.english: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.
vi.back: A bloody throne room in Dunsinane, Macbeth holding his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his forehead, the forest of Birnam shaking on a distant hill.
vi.controlEnglish: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.

vi.text: Ta dám làm mọi điều xứng với một con người; kẻ dám làm hơn thế thì không còn là người.
vi.english: I dare do all that may become a man; who dares do more is none.
vi.back: I dare to do everything worthy of a man; whoever dares to do more than that is no longer a man.
vi.controlEnglish: Come, you spirits that tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here.

vi.text: Một căn phòng thắp nến trong lâu đài Scotland. Lady Macbeth đi đi lại lại trên nền đá lạnh, cố chà những vết máu hư ảo khỏi đôi tay. Bóng tối bám lấy bà như một lớp da thứ hai.
vi.english: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.
vi.back: A candlelit room in a Scottish castle, Lady Macbeth walking around on the cold rocky floor, trying to wipe off the fake blood from her hands, darkness clinging to her like a second skin.
vi.controlEnglish: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.

vi.text: Hãy đến đây, hỡi các hồn ma phục vụ ý nghĩ giết chóc, hãy tước bỏ nữ tính của ta ngay tại đây.
vi.english: Come, you spirits that tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here.
vi.back: Come here, you ghosts of murderous thoughts, take away my femininity right here.
vi.controlEnglish: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.

vi.text: Một vùng đồng hoang Scotland mù sương lúc hoàng hôn. Banquo đứng vững vàng khi ba bóng ma thì thầm những định mệnh vào trong gió. Hồn ma của ông sẽ ám ảnh người sống.
vi.english: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.
vi.back: A misty Scottish wilderness at sunset, Banquo standing golden as three ghosts whisper their destinies into the wind, his ghost haunting the living.
vi.controlEnglish: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.

vi.text: Ngươi sẽ sinh ra các vị vua, dù ngươi chẳng phải là vua.
vi.english: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.
vi.back: You will give birth to kings, even though you are not a king.
vi.controlEnglish: I am not what I am.

vi.text: Một bờ biển Illyria lộng gió. Viola kéo chiếc mũ thủy thủ trùm lên mái tóc cắt ngắn, hai thân phận song sinh lấp lánh trong mắt nàng. Biển cả thì thầm những bí mật về người anh trai đã mất.
vi.english: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.
vi.back: On a windy Illyrian shore, Viola pulls her sailor's cap over her short hair, the twin bodies gleam in her eyes, the sea whispering the secrets of her lost brother.
vi.controlEnglish: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.

vi.text: Tôi không phải là tôi như người ta thấy.
vi.english: I am not what I am.
vi.back: I'm not the me that people see.
vi.controlEnglish: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them.

vi.text: Một khu vườn ngập nắng trong dinh thự của Olivia. Malvolio vênh váo trong đôi tất vàng lòe loẹt, buộc dây chéo, nhe răng cười, ôm chặt một bức thư tình giả mạo vào ngực.
vi.english: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.
vi.back: A sun-drenched garden in Olivia's mansion, Malvolio crouching in glittering golden stockings, cross-tie, grinning teeth, holding a fake love letter against his chest.
vi.controlEnglish: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.

vi.text: Có người sinh ra đã vĩ đại, có người đạt tới vĩ đại, và có người bị sự vĩ đại ấn vào tay.
vi.english: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them.
vi.back: Some are born great, some attain greatness, and some have greatness stamped on their hands.
vi.controlEnglish: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.

vi.text: Một nữ bá tước đang để tang khẽ vén mạng che mặt, để lộ vẻ đẹp khiến người ta nín thở. Khu vườn của Olivia nở rộ hoa nhài và oải hương khi người đưa tin cải trang đánh cắp trái tim nàng.
vi.english: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
vi.back: A baroness in a funeral dress uncovers her face, revealing breathtaking beauty Olivia's garden blooms with calendula and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
vi.controlEnglish: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.

vi.text: Tình yêu tìm mà có là tốt, nhưng được trao khi chẳng tìm thì còn tốt hơn.
vi.english: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.
vi.back: It's good to seek love, but it's even better to be given without seeking.
vi.controlEnglish: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.

vi.text: Viện Nguyên lão La Mã, những cột đá cẩm thạch nhuốm màu đỏ thẫm. Brutus đứng giữa những kẻ mưu phản, lưỡi kiếm vẫn còn run rẩy. Sức nặng của nền cộng hòa đè lên đôi bàn tay đẫm máu của ông.
vi.english: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.
vi.back: The Roman senate, the marble columns covered in deep red, Brutus standing among his conspirators, the blade of his sword still shaking, the weight of the republic on his blood-stained hands.
vi.controlEnglish: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.

vi.text: Không phải tôi yêu Caesar ít hơn, mà là tôi yêu thành Roma nhiều hơn.
vi.english: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.
vi.back: It's not that I love Caesar less, it's that I love Rome more.
vi.controlEnglish: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.

vi.text: Một con hẻm La Mã sáng ánh đuốc lúc nửa đêm. Cassius ghé sát, thì thầm lời xúi giục nổi loạn với vẻ mặt gầy gò và thèm khát. Những lá thư giả mạo tuột ra từ vạt áo toga.
vi.english: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.
vi.back: A torch-lit Roman alley in the middle of the night, Cassius walks by, whispering rebellious words with a skinny, thirsty face, fake letters leaping from his toga.
vi.controlEnglish: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.

vi.text: Lỗi, Brutus thân mến, không nằm ở các vì sao của chúng ta, mà ở chính chúng ta.
vi.english: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.
vi.back: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in us.
vi.controlEnglish: Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!

vi.text: Quảng trường La Mã bùng lên phẫn nộ. Marcus Antonius giơ cao tấm áo choàng đẫm máu của Caesar trước đám đông, lời lẽ của ông biến nỗi đau thành lửa. Nền cộng hòa sụp đổ theo từng âm tiết.
vi.english: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.
vi.back: The squares of Rome were filled with fury, Marcus Antonius raised Caesar's bloody cloak in front of the crowd, his words turned grief into fire, the republic collapsed syllable by syllable.
vi.controlEnglish: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.

vi.text: Hỡi bạn bè, hỡi người La Mã, hỡi đồng bào, hãy cho tôi mượn đôi tai!
vi.english: Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!
vi.back: My friends, my Romans, my compatriots, lend me your ears!
vi.controlEnglish: Many a morning hath he there been seen, with tears augmenting the fresh morning dew.

vi.text: Dinh thự nhà Montague lúc rạng đông. Lãnh chúa Montague nhìn từ ô cửa sổ cao khi con trai ông lang thang giữa những vườn cây mờ sương bên dưới, tương tư và xa vời.
vi.english: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.
vi.back: Lord Montague watches from the high window as his son wanders through the misty gardens beneath, private and distant.
vi.controlEnglish: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.

vi.text: Đã nhiều buổi sáng người ta thấy nó ở đó, lấy nước mắt thêm vào sương sớm tinh khôi.
vi.english: Many a morning hath he there been seen, with tears augmenting the fresh morning dew.
vi.back: For many mornings it has been seen there, tears added to the pure early mist.
vi.controlEnglish: Marry, that marry is the very theme I came to talk of.

vi.text: Lãnh chúa Montague
vi.english: Lord Montague
vi.back: Lord Montague.
vi.controlEnglish: Lady Capulet

vi.text: Đại sảnh nhà Capulet phủ lụa. Phu nhân Capulet sắp đặt số phận con gái như cắm hoa vào bình, tham vọng lấp lánh sau mỗi nụ cười nhã nhặn.
vi.english: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.
vi.back: The grand hall of Capulet's house is covered in silk. Lady Capulet has arranged the fate of her daughter like flowers in a vase, with ambition shimmering behind every graceful smile.
vi.controlEnglish: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.

vi.text: Cưới xin, đó chính là chuyện mẹ đến để nói.
vi.english: Marry, that marry is the very theme I came to talk of.
vi.back: Proposal, that's what I came here to talk about.
vi.controlEnglish: Now cracks a noble heart. Good night, sweet prince.

vi.text: Phu nhân Capulet
vi.english: Lady Capulet
vi.back: Madame Capulet.
vi.controlEnglish: Romeo's Ring

vi.text: Tường thành Elsinore trong giờ lạnh giá trước bình minh. Horatio đứng canh bên Hamlet, người bạn chân thành duy nhất giữa một triều đình đầy rắn độc.
vi.english: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.
vi.back: The walls of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn, Horatio standing guard by Hamlet, his only true friend in a court full of venomous snakes.
vi.controlEnglish: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.

vi.text: Giờ đây một trái tim cao quý đã vỡ. Chúc ngủ ngon, hoàng tử dịu hiền.
vi.english: Now cracks a noble heart. Good night, sweet prince.
vi.back: Now that a noble heart has broken, good night, gentle prince.
vi.controlEnglish: I have had a most rare vision. I have had a dream, past the wit of man.

vi.text: Một khoảng rừng trống rực sáng ánh tiên. Bottom đội đầu lừa với vẻ đường hoàng ngơ ngác trong khi Titania quàng vòng hoa lên người anh ta. Các nàng tiên cố nén tiếng cười.
vi.english: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.
vi.back: A vacant forest glows in the light of fairies, Bottom is dressed up with a delusional look as Titania wraps her wreath around him, and the fairies try to keep their laughter down.
vi.controlEnglish: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.

vi.text: Tôi vừa có một thị kiến hiếm có. Tôi vừa có một giấc mơ, vượt quá trí khôn con người.
vi.english: I have had a most rare vision. I have had a dream, past the wit of man.
vi.back: I've just had a rare vision, I've just had a dream, beyond the human intellect.
vi.controlEnglish: These times of woe afford no time to woo.

vi.text: Nghĩa trang nhà thờ Verona lúc chạng vạng. Paris đặt hoa lên mộ Juliet, không hay biết chàng tình nhân tuyệt vọng đang tiến đến từ trong bóng tối.
vi.english: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.
vi.back: Paris laid flowers on Juliet's grave, unaware that a desperate lover was coming from the darkness.
vi.controlEnglish: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.

vi.text: Những ngày tang tóc này chẳng còn thì giờ cho chuyện tỏ tình.
vi.english: These times of woe afford no time to woo.
vi.back: These wedding days, there's no time for flirting.
vi.controlEnglish: O brave new world, that has such people in it!

vi.text: Một bãi biển hoang sơ trên hòn đảo của Prospero. Miranda lần đầu tiên nhìn thấy những thủy thủ bị đắm tàu, đôi mắt mở to kinh ngạc trước một thế giới nàng chưa từng biết là có thật.
vi.english: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.
vi.back: On a picturesque beach on Prospero's island, Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide open in amazement at a world she never knew existed.
vi.controlEnglish: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.

vi.text: Ôi thế giới mới tươi đẹp, có những con người như thế này!
vi.english: O brave new world, that has such people in it!
vi.back: Oh, what a beautiful new world, with people like this!
vi.controlEnglish: My bounty is as boundless as the sea, my love as deep.

vi.text: Một chiếc nhẫn vàng nằm trên gờ ban công bằng đá, bắt lấy ánh trăng. Khắc bên trong là một lời thề bền lâu hơn cả cái chết. Những cánh hoa hồng xoay tròn quanh nó trong một làn gió vô hình.
vi.english: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.
vi.back: A golden ring lying on a stone balcony, catching the moonlight, engraved with an oath to last longer than death, rose petals swirling around it in an invisible breeze.
vi.controlEnglish: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.

vi.text: Lòng hào phóng của em mênh mông như biển, tình em cũng sâu như thế.
vi.english: My bounty is as boundless as the sea, my love as deep.
vi.back: Your generosity is as vast as the sea, and your love is as deep.
vi.controlEnglish: All that glisters is not gold.

vi.text: Chiếc nhẫn của Romeo
vi.english: Romeo's Ring
vi.back: Romeo's ring.
vi.controlEnglish: Portia's Casket

vi.text: Ba chiếc tráp lấp lánh trong căn phòng thắp nến — vàng, bạc và chì. Chiếc tráp chì ngân nga một sự thật lặng lẽ, ban thưởng cho những ai đủ khôn ngoan để nhìn thấu vẻ bề ngoài.
vi.english: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.
vi.back: Three candlesticks gleam in the candlelit room -- gold, silver and lead. The silver candlestick swallowes a silent truth, rewarded to those wise enough to see through the appearance.
vi.controlEnglish: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.

vi.text: Không phải mọi thứ lấp lánh đều là vàng.
vi.english: All that glisters is not gold.
vi.back: Not everything that shines is gold.
vi.controlEnglish: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.

vi.text: Chiếc tráp của Portia
vi.english: Portia's Casket
vi.back: Portia's shovel.
vi.controlEnglish: Macbeth's Crown

vi.text: Một chiếc vương miện Scotland xỉn màu nằm trên chiếc gối nhuốm máu. Nó rung động với tham vọng đen tối, thì thầm những lời hứa vinh quang với bất kỳ bàn tay nào dám vươn tới.
vi.english: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
vi.back: A pale Scottish crown lies on a bloody pillow, vibrating with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
vi.controlEnglish: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.

vi.text: Mái đầu đội vương miện chẳng bao giờ nằm yên.
vi.english: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.
vi.back: The crowned head never rests.
vi.controlEnglish: I'll drown my book.

vi.text: Vương miện của Macbeth
vi.english: Macbeth's Crown
vi.back: Macbeth's crown.
vi.controlEnglish: The Tempest Codex

vi.text: Một cuốn sách cổ bọc da dãi dầu sóng gió lơ lửng trên bệ thờ bằng đá. Những trang sách tự lật, mỗi trang lại gọi về một cơn bão khác.
vi.english: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.
vi.back: An ancient book covered in oil-waved leather floats on a stone pedestal, the pages turning over, each page calling for another storm.
vi.controlEnglish: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.

vi.text: Ta sẽ dìm cuốn sách của ta.
vi.english: I'll drown my book.
vi.back: I'll hide my book.
vi.controlEnglish: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.

vi.text: Sách phép của Giông tố
vi.english: The Tempest Codex
vi.back: Storm's Book of Magic.
vi.controlEnglish: Cordelia's Tears

vi.text: Một lọ pha lê chứa những giọt nước mắt lấp lánh như ánh sao bị giam giữ. Mỗi giọt mang nỗi buồn của một người con gái đã yêu quá chân thành và nói quá thẳng thắn.
vi.english: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.
vi.back: A crystal jar filled with tears shimmering like stars imprisoned, each one carrying the sadness of a girl loved too sincerely and spoken so frankly.
vi.controlEnglish: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.

vi.text: Ôi cha yêu dấu, con đang lo liệu chính việc của cha.
vi.english: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.
vi.back: Oh, my dear father, I'm worried about your own business.
vi.controlEnglish: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!

vi.text: Nước mắt của Cordelia
vi.english: Cordelia's Tears
vi.back: Cordelia's tears.
vi.controlEnglish: Bottom's Mask

vi.text: Một chiếc mặt nạ đầu lừa treo trên cành cây phủ rêu trong khu rừng tiên. Ai đeo nó sẽ nhìn thế giới bằng đôi mắt bị phù phép — và trở nên không thể cưỡng lại đối với các nữ hoàng tiên.
vi.english: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.
vi.back: A false-headed mask hung on a moss-covered branch in the fairy forest, whoever wears it sees the world with enchanted eyes — and becomes irresistible to fairies.
vi.controlEnglish: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.

vi.text: Cầu trời phù hộ anh, Bottom! Anh đã bị biến hình rồi!
vi.english: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!
vi.back: God bless you, Bottom!
vi.controlEnglish: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.

vi.text: Mặt nạ của Bottom
vi.english: Bottom's Mask
vi.back: Bottom's mask.
vi.controlEnglish: Mandrake Root

vi.text: Một chiếc rễ xương xẩu có hình một người đang thét gào được đào lên dưới ánh nến. Đất vụn rơi ra, để lộ sức mạnh cổ xưa vặn vẹo của nó. Người bào chế cầm nó với lòng tôn kính run rẩy.
vi.english: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.
vi.back: A broken bone root in the shape of a screaming man is dug up under candlelight, the earth falls out, revealing its ancient twisted strength, and the maker holds it with trembling veneration.
vi.controlEnglish: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.

vi.text: Không phải thuốc phiện, không phải khoai ma, cũng không phải mọi thứ xi-rô ru ngủ trên đời.
vi.english: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.
vi.back: It's not opium, it's not potatoes, it's not all the syrup that sleeps in the world.
vi.controlEnglish: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.

vi.text: Rễ khoai ma
vi.english: Mandrake Root
vi.back: Root potato.
vi.controlEnglish: Oberon's Dew

vi.text: Một giọt sương bám trên đóa lan dưới ánh trăng, phát ra ánh tím huyền ảo của thế giới khác. Chỉ một giọt trên mí mắt đang ngủ, và người mơ sẽ phải lòng sinh vật đầu tiên mà họ nhìn thấy.
vi.english: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.
vi.back: A drop of mist clings to the orchid in the moonlight, emitting a hallucinatory violet of another world... just one drop on the eyelids of those who are asleep, and the dreamer will fall in love with the first creature they see.
vi.controlEnglish: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.

vi.text: Hãy lấy cho ta bông hoa ấy; thứ cỏ ta đã chỉ cho ngươi một lần.
vi.english: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.
vi.back: Bring me that flower; the herb I showed you once.
vi.controlEnglish: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.

vi.text: Sương của Oberon
vi.english: Oberon's Dew
vi.back: Oberon's Fog
vi.controlEnglish: Hemlock Tincture

vi.text: Một lọ thủy tinh đen rỉ ra làn hơi xanh lục trong hành lang tối. Thứ cồn thuốc bên trong đã lật đổ các vị vua và làm tan nát các triều đại, từng giọt lặng lẽ một.
vi.english: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.
vi.back: A black glass jar rusted out a green vapour in the dark corridor, the spirit inside which overthrew kings and melted dynasty after dynasty, one drop at a time.
vi.controlEnglish: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.

vi.text: Vào giờ ta yên giấc, chú của con lẻn tới, mang theo nhựa hebona đáng nguyền rủa trong một chiếc lọ.
vi.english: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.
vi.back: While I'm asleep, my uncle the loner comes in, bringing some damn hebona plastic in a jar.
vi.controlEnglish: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.

vi.text: Cồn thuốc độc cần
vi.english: Hemlock Tincture
vi.back: Alcoholic poison needed.
vi.controlEnglish: Mistletoe Extract

vi.text: Những quả mọng nhạt màu lấp lánh giữa tán lá xanh thẫm, được hái dưới vầng trăng mùa đông. Tinh chất ngân nga thứ phép màu lặng lẽ, bền bỉ của thế giới tự nhiên.
vi.english: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.
vi.back: Pale berries shimmering among the dark green foliage, harvested under the winter moonlight. The silver swan essence is the silent, enduring magic of the natural world.
vi.controlEnglish: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.

vi.text: Trong vạc hãy sôi và nướng; mắt sa giông và ngón chân ếch.
vi.english: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.
vi.back: In the cauldron, boil and cook; sage eyes and frog toes.
vi.controlEnglish: Full fathom five thy father lies; of his bones are coral made.

vi.text: Tinh chất tầm gửi
vi.english: Mistletoe Extract
vi.back: Essential fuel.
vi.controlEnglish: Mermaid's Tears

vi.text: Một chiếc bình nút ngọc trai chứa chất lỏng xanh lam phát sáng, chuyển động như một vùng biển sống. Bên trong, những khối san hô tí hon mọc lên rồi tan biến. Nó mang mùi muối và những chuyến hải hành đã bị lãng quên.
vi.english: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.
vi.back: A pearl vase filled with a shimmering blue liquid, moving like a living sea. Inside, tiny coral blocks grow up and melt away. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.
vi.controlEnglish: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.

vi.text: Năm sải sâu cha ngươi nằm đó; xương người đã hóa thành san hô.
vi.english: Full fathom five thy father lies; of his bones are coral made.
vi.back: Your father lies five feet deep; his bones have been transformed into corals.
vi.controlEnglish: Put this in any liquid thing you will, and drink it off; and, if you had the strength of twenty men, it would dispatch you straight.

vi.text: Nước mắt nàng tiên cá
vi.english: Mermaid's Tears
vi.back: Mermaid's tears
vi.controlEnglish: Apothecary's Elixir

vi.text: Một hiệu thuốc phủ bụi trong khu nghèo nhất của Mantua. Một thứ thuốc tiên tuyệt vọng phát ánh hổ phách trong chiếc lọ nứt, đủ mạnh để bắc cầu qua khoảng cách giữa sự sống và cái chết.
vi.english: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
vi.back: A dust-covered drugstore in the poorest quarter of Mantua, a desperate fairy potion shining like sapphire in a cracked vial, powerful enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
vi.controlEnglish: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.

vi.text: Hãy đổ thứ này vào bất cứ chất lỏng nào anh muốn rồi uống cạn; dù anh có sức mạnh của hai mươi người, nó cũng tiễn anh đi ngay.
vi.english: Put this in any liquid thing you will, and drink it off; and, if you had the strength of twenty men, it would dispatch you straight.
vi.back: Pour this into whatever liquid you want and drink it out; even if you have the strength of twenty men, it will drive you away.
vi.controlEnglish: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.

vi.text: Thuốc tiên của người bào chế
vi.english: Apothecary's Elixir
vi.back: The creator's magic cure.
vi.controlEnglish: Yorick's Skull

vi.text: Một thảm hoa thủy tiên vàng trải dài dọc bờ hồ phẳng lặng. Wordsworth dạo bước giữa những đóa hoa, tay cầm sổ tay, những dãy đồi Cumberland nhô lên sau lưng ông.
vi.english: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.
vi.back: A golden fairy carpet stretches along the quiet, flat lake shore. Wordsworth strolls through the blossoms, his notebook in hand, the Cumberland hills protruding behind him.
vi.controlEnglish: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.

vi.text: Tôi lang thang cô đơn như đám mây trôi trên cao qua thung lũng và đồi núi.
vi.english: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.
vi.back: I wander alone like clouds floating high over valleys and hills.
vi.controlEnglish: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.

vi.text: Một con tàu lặng gió trôi trên đại dương như được vẽ. Người thủy thủ già nhìn chằm chằm con hải âu lớn đeo trên cổ khi những bóng ma trồi lên từ mặt biển phẳng như gương.
vi.english: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.
vi.back: A windless ship floats on the ocean as painted. The old sailor stares at the huge whale he wears around his neck as ghosts rise from the mirror-flat sea surface.
vi.controlEnglish: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.

vi.text: Nước, nước, khắp nơi, mà chẳng có một giọt để uống.
vi.english: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.
vi.back: Water, water, everywhere, not a drop to drink.
vi.controlEnglish: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.

vi.text: Một khu vườn ở Hampstead mùa thu. Keats ngồi dưới gốc cây mận, viết như lên cơn sốt trong khi một con chim họa mi hót trên những cành cây đang sẫm tối.
vi.english: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.
vi.back: A garden in Hampstead in autumn, Keats sitting under the trunk of an apple tree, writing like he's on fever whilst a bird chirping from the dark branches.
vi.controlEnglish: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.

vi.text: Một vật đẹp là niềm vui mãi mãi: vẻ yêu kiều của nó càng thêm.
vi.english: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.
vi.back: A beautiful thing is a joy forever: its loveliness increases.
vi.controlEnglish: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.

vi.text: Một tòa lâu đài ở Venezia lúc nửa đêm. Byron đứng trên ban công, áo choàng tung bay, đăm đăm nhìn qua con kênh tối. Sau lưng ông, một bản thảo dang dở cháy trong lò sưởi.
vi.english: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.
vi.back: A castle in Venice at midnight, Byron standing on the balcony, his cloak flying, staring over a dark canal, behind him a manuscript burning in the stove.
vi.controlEnglish: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.

vi.text: Nàng bước đi trong vẻ đẹp, như đêm của miền không mây và trời đầy sao.
vi.english: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.
vi.back: She walks in beauty, like the night of a cloudless land and a starry sky.
vi.controlEnglish: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.

vi.text: Một phòng làm việc thắp nến ở Genève giữa cơn giông. Mary viết dưới ánh chớp lóe trong khi sinh vật kia cựa mình trong bóng tối sau lưng bà. Khoa học và kinh hoàng hòa làm một.
vi.english: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.
vi.back: A candlelit study in Geneva in the midst of a thunderstorm, Mary writing under flashes of lightning while the creature hides in the darkness behind her back, science and horror fused into one.
vi.controlEnglish: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.

vi.text: Hãy coi chừng; vì ta không biết sợ, và vì thế mà mạnh mẽ.
vi.english: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.
vi.back: Beware; for I am not afraid, and therefore strong.
vi.controlEnglish: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.

vi.text: Một căn phòng tối mờ được soi bởi ngọn lửa sắp tàn. Poe ngồi khom người bên bàn khi một con quạ đáp xuống bức tượng bán thân của Pallas. Tiếng "Nevermore" vang vọng trong bóng tối.
vi.english: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.
vi.back: In a dark room lit by an extinguishing fire, Poe sits bent over at his desk as a crow lands on Pallas' half-dead statue and the sound of "Nevermore" echoes in the darkness.
vi.controlEnglish: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.

vi.text: Một lần vào nửa đêm ảm đạm, khi tôi trầm ngâm, yếu ớt và mỏi mệt.
vi.english: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.
vi.back: Once in a gloomy midnight, when I was depressed, weak and tired.
vi.controlEnglish: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.

vi.text: Một xưởng in ở London rực sáng ánh linh thị. Blake khắc hình con hổ lên tấm đồng khi con thú hiện hình từ bản khắc, rực cháy trong những cánh rừng đêm.
vi.english: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.
vi.back: A print shop in London glows in the luminous light. Blake engraves a tiger on a bronze plate as the beast appears from the engraving, glowing in the forest at night.
vi.controlEnglish: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.

vi.text: Thấy một thế giới trong hạt cát và một thiên đường trong đóa hoa dại.
vi.english: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.
vi.back: See a world in a grain of sand and a paradise in a wildflower.
vi.controlEnglish: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?

vi.text: Một đỉnh vách đá lộng gió ở Ý. Shelley đối mặt với cơn bão, dang rộng hai tay, khi ngọn gió tây giật tung những trang sổ của ông và rải chúng khắp Địa Trung Hải.
vi.english: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.
vi.back: On a windy clifftop in Italy, Shelley faces the storm with his arms outstretched, as the west wind blows up his windows and scatters them all over the Mediterranean.
vi.controlEnglish: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.

vi.text: Nếu mùa đông đến, mùa xuân liệu có còn xa?
vi.english: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?
vi.back: If winter has come, is spring far away?
vi.controlEnglish: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.

vi.text: Một căn phòng ngập nắng ở Firenze. Elizabeth viết bên khung cửa sổ nhìn ra sông Arno, chú chó spaniel nằm dưới chân bà. Những bức thư tình của Robert mở trên bàn.
vi.english: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.
vi.back: A sunny room in Florence, Elizabeth writing by the window overlooking the Arno, a spaniel lying at her feet, Robert's love letters open on the table.
vi.controlEnglish: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.

vi.text: Em yêu anh thế nào? Hãy để em đếm những cách.
vi.english: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
vi.back: How do you love me?
vi.controlEnglish: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.

vi.text: Một khu vườn kiểu Tiền Raphael trong ánh thu nhạt dần. Christina ngồi giữa những chiếc lá rụng, sáng tác những vần thơ nhức nhối vẻ đẹp và sự cam chịu lặng lẽ.
vi.english: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.
vi.back: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in the fading autumn sun, Christina sitting among the falling leaves, composing painful verses of beauty and silence.
vi.controlEnglish: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.

vi.text: Hãy nhớ em khi em đã đi xa, đi thật xa vào miền đất lặng im.
vi.english: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.
vi.back: Remember me when I've gone far, far into the land of silence.
vi.controlEnglish: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.

vi.text: Đỉnh Olympus xé toạc bầu trời. Zeus ngự trên ngai mây, tia chớp lóe lên giữa những ngón tay. Bên dưới, thế giới người phàm run rẩy trước ánh nhìn của thần.
vi.english: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.
vi.back: The summit of Olympus rips the sky apart, Zeus sits on his cloudy throne, lightning flashes between his fingers, and beneath him, the world of men shakes at his gaze.
vi.controlEnglish: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.

vi.text: Ta là kẻ gom mây, chúa tể của bầu trời rộng lớn.
vi.english: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.
vi.back: I am the gatherer of clouds, the lord of the vast skies.
vi.controlEnglish: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.

vi.text: Đền Parthenon rực rỡ trong ánh vàng. Athena đứng trong bộ giáp trụ đầy đủ, con cú đậu trên khiên, đôi mắt xám nhìn thấu mọi mưu mẹo của người phàm.
vi.english: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.
vi.back: The Parthenon glows in the golden light, Athena standing in her full armor, the owl landing on her shield, her gray eyes seeing through all the tricks of the philosopher.
vi.controlEnglish: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.

vi.text: Con cú của trí tuệ chỉ cất cánh lúc hoàng hôn.
vi.english: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.
vi.back: The owl of intelligence only takes off at sunset.
vi.controlEnglish: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.

vi.text: Một cỗ xe vàng lao vút qua bầu trời bình minh. Apollo gảy đàn lia khi ánh mặt trời tuôn ra từ bánh xe, tô màu cho cả thế gian.
vi.english: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.
vi.back: A golden chariot raced through the dawn sky, Apollo played his harp as the sunshine poured out of the wheels, colouring the world.
vi.controlEnglish: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.

vi.text: Ta là thần của bài ca, của sự chữa lành và của mặt trời rực rỡ.
vi.english: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.
vi.back: I am the god of song, healing and the bright sun.
vi.controlEnglish: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.

vi.text: Bờ biển đảo Síp lúc rạng đông. Aphrodite trồi lên từ bọt biển, đàn bồ câu lượn trên cao khi sóng đặt những viên ngọc trai dưới chân nàng. Cả thế gian nín thở.
vi.english: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.
vi.back: The coast of Cyprus at dawn, Aphrodite rising from the sea's sponges, a flock of doves hovering high as the waves lay pearls under her feet, the whole world breathes.
vi.controlEnglish: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.

vi.text: Ngay cả các vị thần cũng không cưỡng nổi sức mạnh của tình yêu.
vi.english: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
vi.back: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
vi.controlEnglish: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.

vi.text: Một vệt mờ của đôi dép có cánh vút qua bầu trời. Hermes luồn lách giữa những tiếng sét, một tay nắm chặt thông điệp thần thánh, trên mặt nở nụ cười của kẻ trộm.
vi.english: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.
vi.back: A faint trace of a pair of shoes with wings swept through the sky, Hermes swirling among the thunders, one hand holding the divine message, on his face the smile of a thief.
vi.controlEnglish: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.

vi.text: Nhanh như ý nghĩ, ta mang lời các thần đến tai người trần.
vi.english: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.
vi.back: Fast as thought, I brought the words of the gods to the ears of naked men.
vi.controlEnglish: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.

vi.text: Phòng ngai vàng của Âm phủ, được soi sáng bởi những dòng sông lửa nhợt nhạt. Hades ngồi đó, Cerberus nằm dưới chân, chiếc mũ trụ bóng tối đặt trên tay vịn. Người chết lần lượt đi qua trong sự im lặng vô tận.
vi.english: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.
vi.back: The throne hall of the underworld, lit by the faint streams of fire. Hades sits there, Cerberus lies at his feet, the dark pillar hat placed on his armrests. The dead pass one after another in endless silence.
vi.controlEnglish: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.

vi.text: Mọi linh hồn rồi cũng đến với ta. Ta kiên nhẫn.
vi.english: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
vi.back: All souls come to me, I'm patient.
vi.controlEnglish: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.

vi.text: Một ngai vàng chia đôi giữa mùa xuân và bóng tối. Persephone cầm một quả lựu trong tay này và một vương miện hoa trong tay kia, nữ hoàng của hai cõi.
vi.english: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.
vi.back: A throne divided between spring and darkness, Persephone holding a pomegranate in one hand and a crown in the other, queen of both realms.
vi.controlEnglish: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.

vi.text: Ta đã ăn sáu hạt, và tự trói mình mãi mãi giữa hai thế giới.
vi.english: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.
vi.back: I ate six seeds, and tied myself forever between the two worlds.
vi.controlEnglish: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.

vi.text: Một con tàu bị bão đánh tơi tả vòng qua mũi đất đá lởm chởm. Odysseus tự trói mình vào cột buồm khi các nàng Siren cất tiếng hát từ vách đá. Đôi mắt ông rực cháy ký ức về Ithaca.
vi.english: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.
vi.back: A ship swept by a storm over a rocky promontory, Odysseus tied himself to the mast as the sirens sang from the cliffs, his eyes burning with memories of Ithaca.
vi.controlEnglish: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.

vi.text: Hỡi Nàng Thơ, hãy kể cho ta về người đàn ông lắm mưu nhiều kế, kẻ đã lang thang rất xa.
vi.english: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.
vi.back: O Poetess, tell me about the wise man who has wandered so far.
vi.controlEnglish: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.

vi.text: Một ngôi đền đổ nát nơi tận cùng thế giới. Medusa quay lại, mái tóc rắn rít lên. Những chiến binh hóa đá nằm ngổn ngang trên nền, đông cứng trong đợt xung phong cuối cùng.
vi.english: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.
vi.back: A temple in ruins at the end of the world, Medusa returning with her snake-haired head, stone warriors lying flat on the ground, frozen in their final assault.
vi.controlEnglish: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.

vi.text: Hãy nhìn ta, nếu ngươi dám. Ánh mắt ta là thứ cuối cùng ngươi thấy.
vi.english: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.
vi.back: Look at me, if you dare, my eyes are the last thing you see.
vi.controlEnglish: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.

vi.text: Đồng bằng thành Troia lúc rạng đông. Achilles xông lên trong bộ giáp rực lửa, tiếng hô xung trận xé toạc không trung. Sau lưng chàng, những chiến thuyền Hy Lạp bốc cháy trên bờ.
vi.english: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.
vi.back: On the plains of Troy at dawn, Achilles storming in his burning armor, the cries of battle tearing through the air, and behind him the Greek warships burning on the shore.
vi.controlEnglish: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.

vi.text: Ta thà sống một đời ngắn ngủi vinh quang còn hơn một đời dài bị lãng quên.
vi.english: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.
vi.back: I'd rather live a short life of glory than a long one of oblivion.
vi.controlEnglish: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
