zh.text: 一座宏大的舞台渐渐成形。The Sonnet Man 手持麦克风，从金色的聚光灯中走出。莎士比亚的词句化作嘻哈的节拍，观众欢呼不已。
zh.english: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.
zh.back: The Sonnet Man, holding a microphone, emerged from the golden spotlights. Shakespeare’s words were turned into hip-hop beats, and the audience cheered.
zh.controlEnglish: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.

zh.text: 我可否把你比作夏日的一天？
zh.english: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
zh.back: May I compare you to a summer day?
zh.controlEnglish: But soft, what light through yonder window breaks?

zh.text: 月光下的阳台一幕徐徐展开。罗密欧向上伸出手，朱丽叶出现在上方。玫瑰花瓣在空中飘荡。整个场景闪动着温暖的绯红光芒。
zh.english: A moonlit balcony scene unfolds. Romeo reaches upward as Juliet appears above. Rose petals drift through the air. The scene pulses with a warm crimson glow.
zh.back: A scene unfolds on the moonlit balcony. Romeo reaches up and Juliet appears above him. Rose petals hover in the air.
zh.controlEnglish: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.

zh.text: 轻声！那边窗子里亮起来的是什么光？
zh.english: But soft, what light through yonder window breaks?
zh.back: What is the light in that window?
zh.controlEnglish: What's in a name? That which we call a rose...

zh.text: 凯普莱特家的花园在月光下盛开。朱丽叶站在玫瑰丛中，眼里闪着倔强的光。一只夜莺在枝头歌唱。
zh.english: The Capulet garden blooms in moonlight. Juliet stands among roses, her eyes bright with defiance. A nightingale sings from the branches above.
zh.back: The Capellates' garden blossoms in the moonlight. Juliet stands among the rose bushes with a stubborn glimmer in her eyes. A nightingale sings on the branches.
zh.controlEnglish: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.

zh.text: 名字里有什么呢？我们叫做玫瑰的那一种花……
zh.english: What's in a name? That which we call a rose...
zh.back: What is in the name? The flower we call a rose...
zh.controlEnglish: To be, or not to be, that is the question.

zh.text: 埃尔西诺城堡从阴影中浮现。哈姆雷特站在城垛上，约里克的骷髅悬浮在他身旁。城墙上方出现了一个幽灵般的身影。
zh.english: The castle of Elsinore emerges from shadow. Hamlet stands at the battlements, Yorick's skull hovering beside him. A spectral figure appears on the ramparts above.
zh.back: Castle Elsinore emerged from the shadows. Hamlet stood on a pile, with Yorick's skull hanging by him.
zh.controlEnglish: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.

zh.text: 生存还是毁灭，这是一个问题。
zh.english: To be, or not to be, that is the question.
zh.back: Survival or destruction is a question.
zh.controlEnglish: There's rosemary, that's for remembrance.

zh.text: 一条平缓的小溪蜿蜒穿过柳林。奥菲莉娅漂浮在野花之间，低声念着被遗忘的诗句。花瓣在水流中打转。
zh.english: A gentle stream winds through a willow grove. Ophelia floats among wildflowers, whispering forgotten verses. Petals circle in the current.
zh.back: A gentle stream winds through the willows. Ophelia floats among wild flowers, whispering forgotten verses.
zh.controlEnglish: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.

zh.text: 这是迷迭香，是表示记忆的。
zh.english: There's rosemary, that's for remembrance.
zh.back: It is a miracle, it is a reminder.
zh.controlEnglish: A plague on both your houses!

zh.text: 维罗纳的一条街道陷入混乱。茂丘西奥在刀剑之间起舞，当着危险的面大笑。相击的钢刃迸出火花。
zh.english: A Verona street erupts in chaos. Mercutio dances between blades, laughing in the face of danger. Sparks fly from clashing steel.
zh.back: One of Verona’s streets is in chaos. Machiavelli dances between his swords, laughing at the danger.
zh.controlEnglish: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.

zh.text: 你们两家都遭瘟疫去吧！
zh.english: A plague on both your houses!
zh.back: Go both of you to the plague!
zh.controlEnglish: Lord, what fools these mortals be!

zh.text: 魔法森林里闪动着恶作剧的光。帕克在古老的橡树间穿梭，留下一道道仙尘。下方沉睡的凡人做着奇异的梦。
zh.english: The enchanted forest shimmers with mischief. Puck darts between ancient oaks, leaving trails of pixie dust. Sleeping mortals dream strange dreams below.
zh.back: In the magical forest, there is a flash of mischievous light. Parker wanders through the ancient oaks, leaving behind an enchanted dust.
zh.controlEnglish: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.

zh.text: 天哪，这些凡人多么愚蠢！
zh.english: Lord, what fools these mortals be!
zh.back: God, how stupid these mortals are!
zh.controlEnglish: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.

zh.text: 一座由活藤蔓编成的王座从林地升起。提泰妮娅统率着她的仙子宫廷，萤火虫照亮了树冠。大自然也向她的意志低头。
zh.english: A throne of living vines rises from the forest floor. Titania commands her fairy court as fireflies illuminate the canopy. Nature itself bows to her will.
zh.back: A throne of living twigs rises from the forest. Titania rules her fairy court, fireflies illuminate the treetops, and nature bows to her will.
zh.controlEnglish: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.

zh.text: 来，在这铺满鲜花的床上坐下。
zh.english: Come, sit thee down upon this flowery bed.
zh.back: Come, sit down on this bed of flowers.
zh.controlEnglish: Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio.

zh.text: 一颗骷髅安放在昏暗墓穴的天鹅绒上。幽灵般的笑声回荡，关于宫廷小丑的记忆像烛光一样摇曳。
zh.english: A skull rests on velvet in a dim crypt. Ghostly laughter echoes as memories of the court jester flicker like candlelight.
zh.back: A skeleton is laid on the velvet of a dark tomb. Ghostly laughter echoes, and memories of the palace clown waver like candlelight.
zh.controlEnglish: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.

zh.text: 唉，可怜的约里克！我认识他，赫瑞修。
zh.english: Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio.
zh.back: Oh, poor Yorick! I know him, Hercule.
zh.controlEnglish: Now my charms are all o'erthrown.

zh.text: 约里克的骷髅
zh.english: Yorick's Skull
zh.back: Skeleton of Yorick
zh.controlEnglish: Prospero's Staff

zh.text: 一根多节的魔杖噼啪作响，迸发奥术之力。普洛斯彼罗低声念出最后的咒语，暴风雨在它周围盘旋。闪电劈开天空。
zh.english: A gnarled staff crackles with arcane energy. The tempest swirls around it as Prospero whispers his final spell. Lightning splits the sky.
zh.back: A multi-legged wand cracks, unleashing the power of occult magic. Prospyro whisperes his final spell, and a storm swirls around it.
zh.controlEnglish: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.

zh.text: 现在我的魔法已经全部破除。
zh.english: Now my charms are all o'erthrown.
zh.back: Now my magic has all been broken.
zh.controlEnglish: The course of true love never did run smooth.

zh.text: 普洛斯彼罗的魔杖
zh.english: Prospero's Staff
zh.back: Proserpina's wand
zh.controlEnglish: Love Potion

zh.text: 一只发光的小瓶跳动着玫瑰色的光。一颗颗心从瓶面升起，甜美的旋律弥漫在空气中。
zh.english: A glowing vial pulses with rose-colored light. Hearts drift upward from its surface as a sweet melody fills the air.
zh.back: A glow-in-the-dark little bottle beats with a pink light. A heart rises from the bottle, and a sweet melody permeates the air.
zh.controlEnglish: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.

zh.text: 真爱的道路从来不曾平坦。
zh.english: The course of true love never did run smooth.
zh.back: The road of true love is never flat.
zh.controlEnglish: Double, double toil and trouble.

zh.text: 爱情魔药
zh.english: Love Potion
zh.back: Love Potion
zh.controlEnglish: Witches' Brew

zh.text: 一口翻滚的大锅喷出绿烟。三个阴暗的身影绕着它念念有词。远处漆黑的树林里有眼睛在发光。
zh.english: A bubbling cauldron belches green smoke. Three shadowy figures circle it, chanting. Eyes glow from the dark woods beyond.
zh.back: A rolling pot of green smoke erupted. Three shadowy figures surrounded it, thinking words. In the dark forest in the distance there were eyes shining.
zh.controlEnglish: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.

zh.text: 加倍，加倍，辛劳和烦恼。
zh.english: Double, double toil and trouble.
zh.back: Double, double, hard work and trouble.
zh.controlEnglish: If ever you disturb our streets again, your lives shall pay the forfeit of the peace.

zh.text: 女巫的汤药
zh.english: Witches' Brew
zh.back: Witch's Soup
zh.controlEnglish: Dagger of the Mind

zh.text: 亲王站在维罗纳宫殿的台阶上，他的声音让争斗的人群安静下来。一柄金色权杖燃烧着威严。
zh.english: The Prince stands on the steps of Verona's palace, his voice commanding silence over the feuding crowd. A golden scepter burns with authority.
zh.back: The prince stood on the steps of Verona’s palace, his voice quieting the fighting crowd. A golden scepter burned majesty.
zh.controlEnglish: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.

zh.text: 你们若再扰乱我们的街道，就要用性命抵偿破坏和平的罪过。
zh.english: If ever you disturb our streets again, your lives shall pay the forfeit of the peace.
zh.back: If you disturb our streets again, you will pay with your lives for the sin of disrupting peace.
zh.controlEnglish: These violent delights have violent ends.

zh.text: 修道院里一间烛光摇曳的小室。神父照料着他种满草药与毒草的园子，智慧刻在他饱经风霜的脸上。
zh.english: A candlelit cell in a monastery. The Friar tends his garden of herbs and poisons, wisdom etched into his weathered face.
zh.back: A candlelit chamber in the monastery. The priest cares for his garden of herbs and poisonous weeds, with wisdom engraved on his frosty face.
zh.controlEnglish: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.

zh.text: 这些狂暴的欢乐必有狂暴的结局。
zh.english: These violent delights have violent ends.
zh.back: These violent joys must have a violent end.
zh.controlEnglish: I am the drudge and toil in your delight.

zh.text: 凯普莱特家温暖的厨房。奶妈怀着炽烈的忠心忙前忙后，围裙里塞着一封密信。
zh.english: A warm kitchen in the Capulet house. The Nurse bustles with fierce devotion, a secret letter tucked in her apron.
zh.back: In the warm kitchen of the Capellates, a secret letter was wrapped in an apron by her mother-in-law, who was busy with fierce devotion.
zh.controlEnglish: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.

zh.text: 我是个苦工，为了您的快乐而奔忙。
zh.english: I am the drudge and toil in your delight.
zh.back: I am a hard worker, working for your happiness.
zh.controlEnglish: We are such stuff as dreams are made on.

zh.text: 一座被暴风雨笼罩的岛屿。普洛斯彼罗举起双手，闪电听从他的意志，大海随他的号令翻腾。
zh.english: An island shrouded in tempest. Prospero raises his hands as lightning obeys his will, the sea churning at his command.
zh.back: An island overwhelmed by a storm. Prospyros raised his hands, the lightning obeyed his will, and the sea revolved at his command.
zh.controlEnglish: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.

zh.text: 我们都是构成梦幻的材料。
zh.english: We are such stuff as dreams are made on.
zh.back: We are all the material of dreams.
zh.controlEnglish: All hail, great master! Grave sir, hail!

zh.text: 一个闪烁的精灵化作风与光，又重新聚成音乐。爱丽儿在可见与不可见之间起舞。
zh.english: A shimmering spirit dissolves into wind and light, reforming as music. Ariel dances between the visible and invisible.
zh.back: A twinkling elf transforms wind and light into music. Ariel dances between the visible and the invisible.
zh.controlEnglish: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.

zh.text: 万福，伟大的主人！尊严的先生，万福！
zh.english: All hail, great master! Grave sir, hail!
zh.back: Blessed be the great Lord! Blessed be the noble Lord!
zh.controlEnglish: This island's mine, by Sycorax my mother.

zh.text: 荒凉海岸上的一个洞口。凯列班蹲伏在岩石间，眼里燃烧着怨恨与原始的智慧。
zh.english: A cave mouth on a wild shore. Caliban crouches among the rocks, eyes burning with resentment and primal intelligence.
zh.back: A cave on a desolate coast.
zh.controlEnglish: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.

zh.text: 这岛是我的，是我母亲西考拉克斯传给我的。
zh.english: This island's mine, by Sycorax my mother.
zh.back: The island is mine, and it was given to me by my mother Sicolax.
zh.controlEnglish: I do but keep the peace. Put up thy sword.

zh.text: 黎明时分维罗纳的一座广场。班伏里奥站在出鞘的刀剑之间，他摊开的双手是抵挡这场风暴的唯一武器。
zh.english: A Verona plaza at dawn. Benvolio stands between drawn swords, his open hands the only weapon against the gathering storm.
zh.back: A square in Verona at dawn. Banville stands between drawn swords, his open hands being the only weapon against the storm.
zh.controlEnglish: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.

zh.text: 我只是在维持和平。收起你的剑。
zh.english: I do but keep the peace. Put up thy sword.
zh.back: I'm just keeping the peace. Take your sword.
zh.controlEnglish: What, drawn, and talk of peace? I hate the word.

zh.text: 维罗纳一条被火把照得通明的小巷。提伯尔特以致命的优雅拔出长剑，目光紧盯着他的仇敌。
zh.english: A Verona alley ablaze with torchlight. Tybalt draws his rapier with lethal grace, his eyes fixed on his enemy.
zh.back: A torch-lit alley in Verona. Tiberius drew his long sword with deadly grace, staring at his enemy.
zh.controlEnglish: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.

zh.text: 什么，拔出了剑还谈和平？我痛恨这个字眼。
zh.english: What, drawn, and talk of peace? I hate the word.
zh.back: What, draw the sword and talk about peace? I hate that word.
zh.controlEnglish: My words fly up, my thoughts remain below.

zh.text: 埃尔西诺的王座厅，披挂着虚假的华丽。克劳狄斯紧握王冠，袍子里藏着一小瓶毒药。
zh.english: The throne room of Elsinore, draped in false splendor. Claudius grips the crown, a vial of poison hidden in his robes.
zh.back: The throne hall of Elsinoe, clad in false splendor. Claudius holds his crown tightly and hides a small vial of poison in his robe.
zh.controlEnglish: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.

zh.text: 我的言语飞上天去，我的思想却留在地下。
zh.english: My words fly up, my thoughts remain below.
zh.back: My words fly to the sky, but my thoughts remain underground.
zh.controlEnglish: Ill met by moonlight, proud Titania.

zh.text: 魔法森林深处一片月光下的空地。奥伯伦从阴影中显形，他的鹿角王冠映着银光。
zh.english: A moonlit glade deep in the enchanted forest. Oberon materializes from shadow, his crown of antlers catching silver light.
zh.back: Deep in the enchanted forest, an empty space under the moonlight. Oberon emerges from the shadows, his crown of deer horns shining silvery.
zh.controlEnglish: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.

zh.text: 月光下相遇真是不巧，骄傲的提泰妮娅。
zh.english: Ill met by moonlight, proud Titania.
zh.back: What a misfortune to meet you in the moonlight, proud Titania.
zh.controlEnglish: Is this a dagger which I see before me?

zh.text: 一把幽灵般的匕首悬浮在黑暗里，刀刃滴着虚幻的血。马克白伸手去抓，却永远握不住它。
zh.english: A spectral dagger floats in darkness, its blade dripping with phantom blood. Macbeth's hand reaches but can never grasp it.
zh.back: A ghostly knife hovered in the dark, dripping from a fanciful bloody blade. Macbeth reached for it, but could never hold it.
zh.controlEnglish: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.

zh.text: 在我面前的是一把匕首吗？
zh.english: Is this a dagger which I see before me?
zh.back: Is that a knife in front of me?
zh.controlEnglish: I'll put a girdle round about the earth in forty minutes.

zh.text: 心中的匕首
zh.english: Dagger of the Mind
zh.back: The Dagger in the Heart
zh.controlEnglish: Puck's Flower Juice

zh.text: 一朵被揉碎的紫花，把虹彩般的花蜜滴进一只等待的手掌。花蜜落在哪里，哪里的眼睛就改变，心也随之改变。
zh.english: A crushed purple flower drips iridescent nectar into a waiting palm. Wherever it falls, eyes change — and hearts follow.
zh.back: A crushed purple flower, dropping nectar like an iris into a waiting hand. Wherever the nectar falls, the eyes change and so does the heart.
zh.controlEnglish: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.

zh.text: 我要在四十分钟内给地球围上一条腰带。
zh.english: I'll put a girdle round about the earth in forty minutes.
zh.back: I'm going to give the Earth a belt in forty minutes.
zh.controlEnglish: I dare do all that may become a man; who dares do more is none.

zh.text: 帕克的花汁
zh.english: Puck's Flower Juice
zh.back: Parker's Juice
zh.controlEnglish: Lord Montague

zh.text: 邓西嫩一间血迹斑斑的王座厅。马克白双手颤抖地握着剑，王冠沉沉地压在额上。远处山丘上，勃南森林开始移动。
zh.english: A bloodstained throne room in Dunsinane. Macbeth grips his sword with trembling hands, the crown heavy on his brow. Birnam Wood stirs on the distant hill.
zh.back: The throne hall of Dunsinane was stained with blood. Mark Twain’s hands trembled as he held his sword, the crown firmly pressed against his forehead.
zh.controlEnglish: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.

zh.text: 凡是男子汉该做的事我都敢做；敢做得更多的就不是人了。
zh.english: I dare do all that may become a man; who dares do more is none.
zh.back: I dare to do all that a man ought to do; whoever dares to do more is no longer a man.
zh.controlEnglish: Come, you spirits that tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here.

zh.text: 苏格兰城堡里一间烛光摇曳的房间。马克白夫人在冰冷的石地上踱步，搓洗着手上并不存在的血迹。阴影像第二层皮肤一样贴着她。
zh.english: A candlelit chamber in the Scottish castle. Lady Macbeth paces the cold stones, wringing phantom bloodstains from her hands. Shadows cling to her like a second skin.
zh.back: A candlelit room in a Scottish castle. Madame Macbeth walks on the icy stone floor, rubbing blood that does not exist on her hands.
zh.controlEnglish: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.

zh.text: 来吧，侍奉杀人念头的精灵们，在这里除去我的女性。
zh.english: Come, you spirits that tend on mortal thoughts, unsex me here.
zh.back: Come, you jinn who serve the murderous minds of men, and separate my females from here.
zh.controlEnglish: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.

zh.text: 黄昏时分雾气弥漫的苏格兰荒原。班柯坚定地站着，三个幽灵般的身影把命运低语进风里。他的鬼魂将纠缠活人。
zh.english: A misty Scottish heath at twilight. Banquo stands resolute as three spectral figures whisper destinies into the wind. His ghost will haunt the living.
zh.back: At dusk, the misty wilderness of Scotland. Banquo stands firmly, three ghostly figures whispering destiny to the wind.
zh.controlEnglish: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.

zh.text: 你虽然不是君王，却要生下许多君王。
zh.english: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.
zh.back: Though you are not a king, you will give birth to many kings.
zh.controlEnglish: I am not what I am.

zh.text: 伊利里亚一处风吹浪打的海岸。薇奥拉把水手帽压在剪短的头发上，两重身份在她眼中闪烁。大海低诉着她失散兄长的秘密。
zh.english: A windswept Illyrian shore. Viola pulls a sailor's cap over her cropped hair, twin identities shimmering in her eyes. The sea whispers secrets of her lost brother.
zh.back: On the windswept shore of Illyria, Viola pressed her sailor's hat over her short-cut hair, twinkling with a double identity in her eyes. The sea murmured the secret of her separated brother.
zh.controlEnglish: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.

zh.text: 我并不是我现在的样子。
zh.english: I am not what I am.
zh.back: I'm not what I am.
zh.controlEnglish: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them.

zh.text: 奥丽维娅庄园里一座阳光明媚的花园。马伏里奥穿着刺眼的黄袜子、扎着十字交叉的袜带，得意洋洋地踱步，把一封伪造的情书紧紧按在胸前。
zh.english: A sunlit garden in Olivia's estate. Malvolio struts in garish yellow stockings, cross-gartered and grinning, clutching a forged love letter to his chest.
zh.back: A sunny garden at Olivia’s manor. Mavroglio, wearing eye-catching yellow socks and a cross-stitched garter belt, walked happily, holding a fake love letter tightly to his chest.
zh.controlEnglish: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.

zh.text: 有的人生来伟大，有的人挣得伟大，有的人是伟大硬加在他们身上的。
zh.english: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them.
zh.back: Some are born great, some have earned greatness, and some have been made great by hard work.
zh.controlEnglish: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.

zh.text: 一位服丧的伯爵小姐掀起面纱，露出令人屏息的美貌。奥丽维娅的花园里茉莉与薰衣草盛开，乔装的信使偷走了她的心。
zh.english: A veiled countess in mourning lifts her veil to reveal breathtaking beauty. Olivia's garden blooms with jasmine and lavender as the disguised messenger steals her heart.
zh.back: A mourning Countess lifts her veil, revealing a breathtaking beauty. Olivia’s garden blooms with jasmine and lavender, and the adorned messenger steal her heart.
zh.controlEnglish: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.

zh.text: 求来的爱是好的，不求而得的爱更好。
zh.english: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.
zh.back: It is good to ask for love, and it is better not to ask for it.
zh.controlEnglish: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.

zh.text: 罗马元老院，大理石柱染成了绯红。布鲁图站在密谋者中间，手中的刀刃仍在颤抖。共和国的重量压在他沾血的双手上。
zh.english: The Roman Senate, marble pillars stained crimson. Brutus stands among the conspirators, his blade still trembling. The weight of the republic rests on his bloodied hands.
zh.back: In the Roman Senate, the marble columns were stained with crimson. Brutus stood among the conspirators, his blade still trembling.
zh.controlEnglish: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.

zh.text: 不是我爱恺撒少，而是我爱罗马更多。
zh.english: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.
zh.back: It is not that I love Caesar less, but that I love Rome more.
zh.controlEnglish: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.

zh.text: 午夜时分火把照亮的罗马小巷。卡西乌斯凑近身来，带着一副消瘦而饥饿的神情，低声煽动叛乱。伪造的信件从他的长袍里滑落。
zh.english: A torchlit Roman alley at midnight. Cassius leans close, whispering sedition with a lean and hungry look. Forged letters spill from his toga.
zh.back: At midnight, the alleys of Rome were lit up by fireflies. Cassius drew closer, with a skinny and hungry appearance, whispering to incite rebellion.
zh.controlEnglish: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.

zh.text: 亲爱的布鲁图，过错不在我们的星辰，而在我们自己。
zh.english: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.
zh.back: Dear Brutus, the fault is not in our stars but in ourselves.
zh.controlEnglish: Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!

zh.text: 罗马广场爆发出怒火。马克·安东尼在人群面前高举恺撒染血的披风，他的话把悲痛化为烈火。每一个音节都让共和国崩塌一分。
zh.english: The Roman Forum erupts in fury. Mark Antony holds Caesar's bloodied cloak aloft before the mob, his words turning grief into fire. The republic crumbles with every syllable.
zh.back: Fury broke out in the squares of Rome. Mark Antony held up Caesar’s blood-stained cloak before the crowd, and his words turned grief into fire.
zh.controlEnglish: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.

zh.text: 朋友们，罗马人，同胞们，请借给我你们的耳朵！
zh.english: Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!
zh.back: Friends, Romans, compatriots, lend me your ears!
zh.controlEnglish: Many a morning hath he there been seen, with tears augmenting the fresh morning dew.

zh.text: 黎明时分的蒙太古庄园。蒙太古老爷从高高的窗口望着儿子在雾气笼罩的果园里游荡，害着相思，无法靠近。
zh.english: The Montague estate at dawn. Lord Montague watches from a high window as his son wanders the misty orchards below, lovesick and unreachable.
zh.back: At dawn at the Montego Manor, Montego watched his son roam through a fog-covered orchard from a high window and couldn't get close enough to him.
zh.controlEnglish: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.

zh.text: 好多个早晨有人看见他在那里，用眼泪增添清晨新鲜的露水。
zh.english: Many a morning hath he there been seen, with tears augmenting the fresh morning dew.
zh.back: Many mornings he was seen there, adding tears to the fresh morning dew.
zh.controlEnglish: Marry, that marry is the very theme I came to talk of.

zh.text: 蒙太古老爷
zh.english: Lord Montague
zh.back: Monte Cristo
zh.controlEnglish: Lady Capulet

zh.text: 悬挂着丝绸的凯普莱特大厅。凯普莱特夫人像在花瓶里插花一样安排女儿的命运，每一个得体的微笑背后都闪着野心。
zh.english: The Capulet great hall draped in silk. Lady Capulet arranges her daughter's fate like flowers in a vase, ambition glittering behind every gracious smile.
zh.back: Madame Capet arranged the fate of her daughters like flowers in a vase, with ambition shimmering behind every graceful smile.
zh.controlEnglish: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.

zh.text: 结婚，我正是为了谈结婚这件事来的。
zh.english: Marry, that marry is the very theme I came to talk of.
zh.back: I'm here to talk about marriage.
zh.controlEnglish: Now cracks a noble heart. Good night, sweet prince.

zh.text: 凯普莱特夫人
zh.english: Lady Capulet
zh.back: Madame Capet
zh.controlEnglish: Romeo's Ring

zh.text: 黎明前寒冷时刻的埃尔西诺城垛。赫瑞修守在哈姆雷特身旁，在这满是毒蛇的宫廷里，他是唯一真正的朋友。
zh.english: The battlements of Elsinore in the cold hour before dawn. Horatio stands vigil beside Hamlet, the one true friend in a court of serpents.
zh.back: Hercules stands by Hamlet, the only true friend in a court filled with venomous serpents.
zh.controlEnglish: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.

zh.text: 一颗高贵的心现在碎裂了。晚安，亲爱的王子。
zh.english: Now cracks a noble heart. Good night, sweet prince.
zh.back: A noble heart is now shattered.
zh.controlEnglish: I have had a most rare vision. I have had a dream, past the wit of man.

zh.text: 一片被仙子之光照亮的林间空地。波顿顶着一个驴头，神情茫然却不失庄重，提泰妮娅给他披上花环。仙子们忍着笑。
zh.english: A forest clearing aglow with fairy light. Bottom wears an ass's head with bewildered dignity as Titania drapes him in garlands. The fairies stifle their laughter.
zh.back: It was an open forest, lit up by the light of fairies. Button was riding a donkey, in a state of uncertainty but still solemn, and Titania placed a wreath on his head.
zh.controlEnglish: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.

zh.text: 我看见了一个极其稀奇的幻象。我做了一个梦，超出人的智慧所能说明。
zh.english: I have had a most rare vision. I have had a dream, past the wit of man.
zh.back: I saw a most strange vision. I had a dream beyond the scope of human wisdom.
zh.controlEnglish: These times of woe afford no time to woo.

zh.text: 黄昏时分维罗纳的墓园。帕里斯在朱丽叶的墓前献上鲜花，全然不知那个绝望的恋人正从阴影中走近。
zh.english: The churchyard of Verona at dusk. Paris lays flowers at Juliet's tomb, unaware of the desperate lover who approaches from the shadows.
zh.back: At dusk in Verona's cemetery, Paris lays flowers at Juliet's grave, unaware that the desperate lover is approaching from the shadows.
zh.controlEnglish: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.

zh.text: 这样悲伤的时候没有工夫谈情求爱。
zh.english: These times of woe afford no time to woo.
zh.back: There is no such thing as a broken heart.
zh.controlEnglish: O brave new world, that has such people in it!

zh.text: 普洛斯彼罗岛上一片洁净的海滩。米兰达第一次看见遇难的水手，睁大了眼睛，惊叹于一个她从不知道存在的世界。
zh.english: A pristine beach on Prospero's island. Miranda sees the shipwrecked sailors for the first time, her eyes wide with wonder at a world she never knew existed.
zh.back: A clean beach on the island of Proserpine. When Miranda saw the wreckage for the first time, she opened her eyes and wondered at a world that she had never known existed.
zh.controlEnglish: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.

zh.text: 啊，美丽的新世界，有这样的人在里头！
zh.english: O brave new world, that has such people in it!
zh.back: Oh, beautiful new world, there are people like that in it!
zh.controlEnglish: My bounty is as boundless as the sea, my love as deep.

zh.text: 一枚金戒指放在阳台的石栏上，映着月光。戒指内侧刻着一句比死亡更长久的誓言。玫瑰花瓣在看不见的风里绕着它旋转。
zh.english: A golden ring rests on a stone balcony ledge, catching moonlight. Inscribed inside is a vow that outlasts death itself. Rose petals spiral around it in an unseen wind.
zh.back: A golden ring was placed on the balcony's stone bar, reflecting the moonlight. On the inside of the ring was engraved an oath that lasted longer than death. Rose petals revolved around it in the invisible wind.
zh.controlEnglish: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.

zh.text: 我的慷慨像海一样无边，我的爱也像海一样深。
zh.english: My bounty is as boundless as the sea, my love as deep.
zh.back: My generosity is as boundless as the sea, and my love as deep as the sea.
zh.controlEnglish: All that glisters is not gold.

zh.text: 罗密欧的戒指
zh.english: Romeo's Ring
zh.back: Romeo's Ring
zh.controlEnglish: Portia's Casket

zh.text: 烛光下的房间里，三只匣子闪闪发亮：金的、银的和铅的。铅匣低鸣着沉静的真理，奖赏那些有智慧看透表象的人。
zh.english: Three caskets gleam in a candlelit chamber -- gold, silver, and lead. The lead casket hums with quiet truth, rewarding those wise enough to see past appearances.
zh.back: In the candlelit room, three chests sparkled: one of gold, one of silver, and one of lead. The lead chest murmured quiet truths that rewarded those who were wise enough to see through appearances.
zh.controlEnglish: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.

zh.text: 闪光的不都是金子。
zh.english: All that glisters is not gold.
zh.back: Not all flashes are gold.
zh.controlEnglish: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.

zh.text: 波西亚的匣子
zh.english: Portia's Casket
zh.back: The Box of Perseus
zh.controlEnglish: Macbeth's Crown

zh.text: 一顶失去光泽的苏格兰王冠放在染血的枕垫上。它跳动着黑暗的野心，向每一只敢于伸向它的手低语荣耀的许诺。
zh.english: A tarnished Scottish crown sits on a bloodstained pillow. It pulses with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to any hand that dares reach for it.
zh.back: A faded Scottish crown on a blood-stained pillowcase beats with dark ambition, whispering promises of glory to every hand that dares reach for it.
zh.controlEnglish: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.

zh.text: 戴王冠的头是不能安睡的。
zh.english: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.
zh.back: The crowned head cannot sleep.
zh.controlEnglish: I'll drown my book.

zh.text: 马克白的王冠
zh.english: Macbeth's Crown
zh.back: Crown of Macbeth
zh.controlEnglish: The Tempest Codex

zh.text: 一部用海水侵蚀过的皮革装订的古书，悬浮在石坛之上。书页自行翻动，每一页都召来一场不同的风暴。
zh.english: An ancient tome bound in sea-weathered leather floats above a stone altar. Its pages turn by themselves, each one summoning a different storm.
zh.back: An ancient book, bound in seawater-eroded leather, hangs above a stone altar. The pages turn on their own, each one calling forth a different storm.
zh.controlEnglish: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.

zh.text: 我要把我的书沉入海底。
zh.english: I'll drown my book.
zh.back: I'm going to sink my book into the sea.
zh.controlEnglish: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.

zh.text: 暴风雨魔法书
zh.english: The Tempest Codex
zh.back: The Storm Magic Book
zh.controlEnglish: Cordelia's Tears

zh.text: 一只水晶小瓶盛着泪水，像被捕获的星光一样闪烁。每一滴都带着一个女儿的悲伤，她爱得太真，说得太直。
zh.english: A crystal vial holds tears that shimmer like captured starlight. Each drop carries the sorrow of a daughter who loved too truly and spoke too plainly.
zh.back: A crystal bottle filled with tears, shimmering like captured starlight. Each drop carried the sadness of a daughter who loved too much and spoke too frankly.
zh.controlEnglish: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.

zh.text: 啊，亲爱的父亲，我奔走的正是您的事情。
zh.english: O dear father, it is thy business that I go about.
zh.back: Oh, dear Father, I'm running for your sake.
zh.controlEnglish: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!

zh.text: 寇蒂莉亚的眼泪
zh.english: Cordelia's Tears
zh.back: The Tears of Cordelia
zh.controlEnglish: Bottom's Mask

zh.text: 一副驴头面具挂在仙林里长满青苔的树枝上。戴上它的人会用被施了魔法的眼睛看世界，也会让仙后们无法抗拒。
zh.english: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a mossy branch in the fairy wood. Whoever dons it sees the world through enchanted eyes -- and becomes irresistible to fairy queens.
zh.back: A donkey-headed mask hangs from a branch of a moss-covered tree in the fairy forest. Its wearer sees the world with enchanted eyes, and it is irresistible to fairies.
zh.controlEnglish: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.

zh.text: 天保佑你，波顿！你变了样子了！
zh.english: Bless thee, Bottom! Thou art translated!
zh.back: God bless you, Barton! You've changed!
zh.controlEnglish: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.

zh.text: 波顿的面具
zh.english: Bottom's Mask
zh.back: Bolton's Mask
zh.controlEnglish: Mandrake Root

zh.text: 烛光下，一条形如尖叫人形的多节根茎被挖出土来。泥土剥落，露出它扭曲而古老的力量。药剂师怀着颤抖的敬畏捧着它。
zh.english: A gnarled root shaped like a screaming figure is unearthed by candlelight. Soil crumbles away to reveal its twisted, ancient power. The apothecary handles it with trembling reverence.
zh.back: Under the candlelight, a screaming man-shaped stem was dug up from the earth. The clay peeled off, revealing its distorted and ancient powers.
zh.controlEnglish: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.

zh.text: 无论罂粟、曼陀罗，还是世上一切催眠的药水。
zh.english: Not poppy, nor mandragora, nor all the drowsy syrups of the world.
zh.back: Whether it is opium poppy, mandala or all the hypnotics in the world.
zh.controlEnglish: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.

zh.text: 曼德拉草根
zh.english: Mandrake Root
zh.back: Mandelbaum
zh.controlEnglish: Oberon's Dew

zh.text: 一滴露珠挂在月光下的兰花上，发出不属于人间的紫色光芒。滴一滴在沉睡者的眼皮上，做梦的人就会爱上醒来看见的第一个生灵。
zh.english: A dewdrop clings to a moonlit orchid, glowing with otherworldly violet light. One drop upon sleeping eyelids and the dreamer falls in love with the first creature they see.
zh.back: A drop of dew on an orchid in the moonlight gives off a purple glow that does not belong to humans. A drop on the skin of a sleeping man’s eye makes a dreamer fall in love with the first creature he sees when he wakes up.
zh.controlEnglish: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.

zh.text: 给我把那朵花采来；我曾经指给你看过的那种草。
zh.english: Fetch me that flower; the herb I showed thee once.
zh.back: Bring me that flower; the grass I showed you.
zh.controlEnglish: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.

zh.text: 奥伯伦的露水
zh.english: Oberon's Dew
zh.back: Dew of Oberon
zh.controlEnglish: Hemlock Tincture

zh.text: 昏暗的走廊里，一只黑玻璃小瓶渗出绿色的雾气。瓶中的酊剂曾一滴一滴、无声无息地推翻君王，粉碎王朝。
zh.english: A black glass vial weeps green vapor in a darkened corridor. The tincture within has toppled kings and shattered dynasties, one silent drop at a time.
zh.back: In the dark corridor, a green mist leaked from a black glass vial. The arsenic in it had dropped down kings and shattered dynasties one drop at a time, silently.
zh.controlEnglish: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.

zh.text: 在我安心熟睡的时候，你的叔父带着一小瓶可诅咒的毒草汁偷偷走来。
zh.english: Upon my secure hour thy uncle stole, with juice of cursed hebona in a vial.
zh.back: When I was asleep, your uncle sneaked in with a little bottle of cursed poison.
zh.controlEnglish: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.

zh.text: 毒芹酊
zh.english: Hemlock Tincture
zh.back: Toxocara canis
zh.controlEnglish: Mistletoe Extract

zh.text: 苍白的浆果在深色的常青叶间闪光，采于冬夜的月下。这萃取液低鸣着自然界安静而持久的魔力。
zh.english: Pale berries glisten among dark evergreen leaves, harvested under a winter moon. The extract hums with the quiet, persistent magic of the natural world.
zh.back: The pale berries glitter among the dark evergreens, picked in the moonlight of a winter night. This extract whispers about the quiet and enduring magic of nature.
zh.controlEnglish: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.

zh.text: 在大锅里煮吧，烤吧；蝾螈的眼睛，青蛙的脚趾。
zh.english: In the cauldron boil and bake; eye of newt and toe of frog.
zh.back: Boil in a pot, roast; the eyes of a moth, the toes of a frog.
zh.controlEnglish: Full fathom five thy father lies; of his bones are coral made.

zh.text: 槲寄生萃取液
zh.english: Mistletoe Extract
zh.back: Parasitic extraction
zh.controlEnglish: Mermaid's Tears

zh.text: 一只珍珠塞子的瓶子盛着发光的蓝色液体，像活的海洋一样流转。瓶中细小的珊瑚生长又消融。它闻起来有盐和被遗忘的航行的气味。
zh.english: A pearl-stoppered flask holds luminous blue liquid that shifts like a living sea. Within it, tiny coral formations grow and dissolve. It smells of salt and forgotten voyages.
zh.back: A bottle with a pearl stopper filled with shimmering blue liquid, flowing like a living sea. Tiny corals grew and melted in it. It smelled of salt and forgotten navigation.
zh.controlEnglish: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.

zh.text: 五噚深处躺着你的父亲；他的骨头已化成珊瑚。
zh.english: Full fathom five thy father lies; of his bones are coral made.
zh.back: Your father lies in the depths; his bones have become corals.
zh.controlEnglish: Put this in any liquid thing you will, and drink it off; and, if you had the strength of twenty men, it would dispatch you straight.

zh.text: 美人鱼的眼泪
zh.english: Mermaid's Tears
zh.back: The tears of the mermaid
zh.controlEnglish: Apothecary's Elixir

zh.text: 曼图亚最贫穷的街区里一间落满灰尘的药铺。一瓶孤注一掷的灵药在裂了纹的小瓶中泛着琥珀色的光，药力足以跨越生与死的界限。
zh.english: A dusty apothecary shop in Mantua's poorest quarter. A desperate elixir glows amber in a cracked vial, potent enough to bridge the gap between life and death.
zh.back: A dusty drugstore in one of Mantua’s poorest neighborhoods. A single dose of an amber-lit, cracked vial of spirit medicine that is powerful enough to cross the line between life and death.
zh.controlEnglish: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.

zh.text: 把这个放进随便什么液体里喝下去；即使你有二十个人的力气，它也会立刻送你上路。
zh.english: Put this in any liquid thing you will, and drink it off; and, if you had the strength of twenty men, it would dispatch you straight.
zh.back: Put this in whatever liquid you want to drink; even if you have the strength of twenty people, it will get you on your way right away.
zh.controlEnglish: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.

zh.text: 药剂师的灵药
zh.english: Apothecary's Elixir
zh.back: The spirit medicine of the pharmacist
zh.controlEnglish: Yorick's Skull

zh.text: 金色的水仙像地毯一样沿着平静的湖岸铺开。华兹华斯手拿笔记本走在花间，身后耸立着坎伯兰的山岭。
zh.english: A carpet of golden daffodils stretches along the shores of a still lake. Wordsworth walks among them, notebook in hand, the Cumberland fells rising behind him.
zh.back: Golden water lilies spread like a carpet along the calm lakeshore. Wartburg walked among flowers with his notebook in hand, Cumberland’s hills towering behind him.
zh.controlEnglish: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.

zh.text: 我独自漫游，像一朵云高高飘过山谷和丘陵。
zh.english: I wandered lonely as a cloud that floats on high o'er vales and hills.
zh.back: I wander alone, like a cloud hovering high over valleys and hills.
zh.controlEnglish: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.

zh.text: 一艘无风停驶的船漂在画一般的海面上。老水手盯着挂在自己颈上的信天翁，幽灵般的身影从镜面似的海中升起。
zh.english: A becalmed ship drifts on a painted ocean. The Ancient Mariner stares at the albatross around his neck as spectral figures rise from the glassy sea.
zh.back: A windless ship floats on a picturesque sea. The old sailor stares at the cyclops hanging around his neck, whose ghostly figure rises from the mirror-like sea.
zh.controlEnglish: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.

zh.text: 水，水，到处是水，却没有一滴可以喝。
zh.english: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.
zh.back: Water, water, water everywhere, but not a drop to drink.
zh.controlEnglish: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.

zh.text: 秋天汉普斯特德的一座花园。济慈坐在李子树下奋笔疾书，一只夜莺在渐暗的枝头歌唱。
zh.english: A Hampstead garden in autumn. Keats sits beneath a plum tree, writing feverishly as a nightingale sings from the darkening branches above.
zh.back: Autumn in a garden in Hampstead. A nightingale sings on the darkening branches of a lotus tree, where Zizi is sitting and writing.
zh.controlEnglish: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.

zh.text: 美的事物是永恒的喜悦：它的可爱与日俱增。
zh.english: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: its loveliness increases.
zh.back: Beauty is an eternal delight: its loveliness increases with each passing day.
zh.controlEnglish: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.

zh.text: 午夜的威尼斯宫殿。拜伦站在阳台上，斗篷翻飞，凝望着幽暗的运河。他身后的壁炉里烧着一份写了一半的手稿。
zh.english: A Venetian palazzo at midnight. Byron stands on the balcony, cape billowing, gazing across the dark canal. A half-finished manuscript burns in the fireplace behind him.
zh.back: Byron stood on the balcony, his cloak fluttering, staring at the dark canal. A half-written manuscript was burning in the fireplace behind him.
zh.controlEnglish: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.

zh.text: 她走在美的光彩中，像无云的地方繁星满天的夜晚。
zh.english: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.
zh.back: She walked in the splendor of beauty, like a starry night in a cloudless place.
zh.controlEnglish: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.

zh.text: 暴风雨中，日内瓦一间点着蜡烛的书房。玛丽借着闪电的光写作，那个造物在她身后的阴影里蠢动。科学与恐怖合而为一。
zh.english: A candlelit study in Geneva during a thunderstorm. Mary writes by lightning flash as the creature stirs in the shadows behind her. Science and horror become one.
zh.back: During a storm, in a candlelit library in Geneva, Mary writes with the light of lightning and the creature moves in the shadow behind her. Science meets terror.
zh.controlEnglish: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.

zh.text: 当心；因为我无所畏惧，所以强大。
zh.english: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.
zh.back: Beware; I am strong because I fear nothing.
zh.controlEnglish: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.

zh.text: 一间昏暗的房间，只有将熄的炉火照着。爱伦·坡伏在书桌前，一只乌鸦落在帕拉斯的半身像上。“永不复还”这个词在阴影中回响。
zh.english: A dim chamber lit by a dying fire. Poe sits hunched at his desk as a raven alights on the bust of Pallas. The word "Nevermore" echoes in the shadows.
zh.back: A dark room, lit only by an extinguished fire. Poe lying at his desk, a crow falling on Pallas’ demi-figure.
zh.controlEnglish: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.

zh.text: 从前一个阴郁的午夜，我独自沉思，虚弱而疲倦。
zh.english: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary.
zh.back: On a gloomy midnight before, I was alone, weak and tired.
zh.controlEnglish: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.

zh.text: 伦敦一间印刷作坊，燃烧着幻象般的光。布莱克在铜版上蚀刻一只老虎，那猛兽从版中现身，在黑夜的森林里灼灼燃烧。
zh.english: A London printing workshop ablaze with visionary light. Blake etches a tiger into copper as the beast materializes from the plate, burning bright in the forests of the night.
zh.back: In a London print shop, an illusory light burned. Black etched a tiger on a bronze plate, and the beast emerged from it, blazing in the darkness of the forest.
zh.controlEnglish: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.

zh.text: 在一粒沙里看见一个世界，在一朵野花里看见一座天堂。
zh.english: To see a World in a Grain of Sand and a Heaven in a Wild Flower.
zh.back: He sees a world in a grain of sand and a paradise in a wild flower.
zh.controlEnglish: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?

zh.text: 意大利一处狂风呼啸的崖顶。雪莱张开双臂迎向风暴，西风从他的笔记本里撕下书页，撒向地中海。
zh.english: A windswept Italian clifftop. Shelley faces the storm, arms wide, as the west wind tears pages from his notebook and scatters them across the Mediterranean.
zh.back: Shelley opened his arms to the storm, and the wind from the west tore away pages from his notebook and threw them into the Mediterranean Sea.
zh.controlEnglish: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.

zh.text: 冬天来了，春天还会远吗？
zh.english: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?
zh.back: Winter has arrived, is spring far away?
zh.controlEnglish: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.

zh.text: 佛罗伦萨一间洒满阳光的房间。伊丽莎白在俯瞰阿诺河的窗前写作，她的西班牙猎犬卧在脚边。罗伯特的情书摊开在书桌上。
zh.english: A sunlit room in Florence. Elizabeth writes at a window overlooking the Arno, her spaniel at her feet. Love letters from Robert lie open on the desk.
zh.back: A sunny room in Florence. Elizabeth is writing from a window overlooking the Arno, her Spanish dog lying at her feet.
zh.controlEnglish: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.

zh.text: 我怎样爱你？让我一一细数。
zh.english: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
zh.back: How do I love you? Let me tell you.
zh.controlEnglish: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.

zh.text: 秋光渐暗的一座拉斐尔前派花园。克里斯蒂娜坐在落叶之间，写着因美与平静的顺从而令人心痛的诗句。
zh.english: A Pre-Raphaelite garden in fading autumn light. Christina sits among fallen leaves, composing verses that ache with beauty and quiet resignation.
zh.back: A Raphaelite garden in autumn’s darkness. Christina sits among the falling leaves, writing poems heartbreaking in their beauty and serene submission.
zh.controlEnglish: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.

zh.text: 请记着我，当我已经离去，远远地去了那寂静的国度。
zh.english: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.
zh.back: Remember me when I am gone, far away to that silent land.
zh.controlEnglish: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.

zh.text: 奥林匹斯山劈开天空。宙斯坐在云的王座上，闪电在他指间跳跃。下方的凡人世界在他的注视下颤抖。
zh.english: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning arcing between his fingers. Below, the mortal world trembles at his gaze.
zh.back: Mount Olympus splits the sky. Zeus sits on a throne of clouds, lightning leaps between his fingers. The mortal world beneath trembles under his gaze.
zh.controlEnglish: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.

zh.text: 我是聚集云朵的神，广阔天空的主宰。
zh.english: I am the cloud-gatherer, lord of the wide heavens.
zh.back: I am the God who gathers the clouds, and the Lord of the expansive heavens.
zh.controlEnglish: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.

zh.text: 帕特农神庙在金光中闪耀。雅典娜全副武装地站着，猫头鹰栖在她的盾上，她灰色的眼睛看穿凡人的一切欺骗。
zh.english: The Parthenon gleams in golden light. Athena stands in full armor, her owl perched on her shield, her grey eyes seeing through every mortal deception.
zh.back: Athena stood fully armed, with owls on her shields and grey eyes that saw through mortal deception.
zh.controlEnglish: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.

zh.text: 智慧的猫头鹰只在黄昏时起飞。
zh.english: The owl of wisdom takes flight only at dusk.
zh.back: The wise owl takes off only at dusk.
zh.controlEnglish: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.

zh.text: 一辆金色的战车驰过黎明的天空。阿波罗弹着里拉琴，阳光从车轮倾泻而下，把世界染上颜色。
zh.english: A golden chariot races across the dawn sky. Apollo plays his lyre as sunlight pours from the wheels, painting the world in color.
zh.back: A golden chariot raced through the dawning sky. Apollo played the lira, and sunlight poured down from the wheels to colour the world.
zh.controlEnglish: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.

zh.text: 我是歌唱、医治和灿烂太阳的神。
zh.english: I am the god of song, of healing, and of the radiant sun.
zh.back: I am the God of singing, healing and sunshine.
zh.controlEnglish: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.

zh.text: 黎明时分的塞浦路斯海岸。阿佛洛狄忒从海的泡沫中升起，鸽子在上空盘旋，海浪把珍珠送到她脚边。世界屏住了呼吸。
zh.english: The shores of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from sea foam, doves circling above as waves lay pearls at her feet. The world holds its breath.
zh.back: The coast of Cyprus at dawn. Aphrodite rises from the bubbles of the sea, pigeons circle over her, and waves bring pearls to her feet.
zh.controlEnglish: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.

zh.text: 连众神也无法抗拒爱的力量。
zh.english: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
zh.back: Even the gods cannot resist the power of love.
zh.controlEnglish: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.

zh.text: 带翼的凉鞋在天空划过一道模糊的影子。赫耳墨斯在雷霆之间穿梭，一只手紧握神的讯息，脸上挂着窃贼的笑。
zh.english: A blur of winged sandals across the sky. Hermes weaves between thunderbolts, a divine message clutched in one hand and a thief's grin on his face.
zh.back: A fuzzy shadow of winged sandals swept through the sky. Hermes wandered among the thunder, holding God’s message in one hand and smiling like a thief on his face.
zh.controlEnglish: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.

zh.text: 快如思想，我把众神的话带到凡人的耳边。
zh.english: Swift as thought, I carry the words of gods to mortal ears.
zh.back: As soon as I thought of it, I brought the words of the gods to the ears of mortals.
zh.controlEnglish: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.

zh.text: 冥界的王座厅，由苍白的火河照亮。哈得斯端坐其上，刻耳柏洛斯伏在他脚边，隐身头盔放在扶手上。亡者在无尽的沉默中列队走过。
zh.english: The throne room of the Underworld, lit by rivers of pale fire. Hades sits with Cerberus at his feet, his helm of darkness on the armrest. The dead file past in endless silence.
zh.back: The throne hall of the underworld, lit by a pale river of fire. Hades sits on it, Cerberus lying at his feet with his helmet hidden in his armrests.
zh.controlEnglish: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.

zh.text: 所有的灵魂最终都来到我这里。我有耐心。
zh.english: All souls come to me in the end. I am patient.
zh.back: All the souls eventually come to me. I have patience.
zh.controlEnglish: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.

zh.text: 一座在春天与阴影之间一分为二的王座。珀耳塞福涅一手拿着石榴，一手拿着花冠，是两个国度的王后。
zh.english: A throne split between spring and shadow. Persephone holds a pomegranate in one hand and a crown of flowers in the other, queen of two realms.
zh.back: A throne divided between spring and shadow. Persephone, with a pomegranate in one hand and a crown in the other, is queen of two kingdoms.
zh.controlEnglish: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.

zh.text: 我吃下六颗种子，把自己永远系在两个世界之间。
zh.english: Six seeds I ate, and bound myself between two worlds forever.
zh.back: I ate the six seeds and tied myself between two worlds forever.
zh.controlEnglish: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.

zh.text: 一艘被风暴摧残的船绕过嶙峋的海岬。奥德修斯把自己绑在桅杆上，塞壬在悬崖上歌唱。他的眼中燃烧着对伊萨卡的思念。
zh.english: A storm-battered ship rounds a rocky headland. Odysseus lashes himself to the mast as the Sirens sing from the cliffs. His eyes burn with the memory of Ithaca.
zh.back: Odysseus tied himself to the mast, and the Sirens sang on the cliffs. His eyes were burning with nostalgia for Isaac.
zh.controlEnglish: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.

zh.text: 缪斯啊，请为我讲述那个足智多谋、漂泊远方的人。
zh.english: Tell me, O Muse, of the man of many ways, who wandered far.
zh.back: O Muse, tell me about the wise man who wandered far away.
zh.controlEnglish: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.

zh.text: 世界尽头一座倾颓的神庙。美杜莎转过身来，她的蛇发嘶嘶作响。石化的战士倒满地面，凝固在最后一次冲锋里。
zh.english: A ruined temple at the edge of the world. Medusa turns, her serpent hair hissing. Stone warriors litter the floor, frozen in their final charge.
zh.back: At the end of the world, there was a temple in ruins. Medusa turned around, her snake-hair whistling. The petrified warrior fell to the ground, solidified in a final assault.
zh.controlEnglish: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.

zh.text: 你若敢，就看着我。我的目光是你最后看见的东西。
zh.english: Look upon me, if you dare. My gaze is the last thing you will see.
zh.back: If you dare, look at me. My gaze is the last thing you see.
zh.controlEnglish: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.

zh.text: 黎明时分的特洛伊平原。阿喀琉斯身披耀眼的铠甲冲锋，他的战吼撕裂长空。在他身后，希腊人的战船在岸边燃烧。
zh.english: The plains of Troy at dawn. Achilles charges in blazing armor, his war cry splitting the air. Behind him, Greek ships burn on the shore.
zh.back: The Trojan Plain at dawn. Achilles, in his brilliant armor, storms forward with a roar that tears the sky apart. Behind him, the Greek ships are burning on the shore.
zh.controlEnglish: A grand stage materializes. The Sonnet Man steps forward from a golden spotlight, microphone in hand. Shakespeare's words transform into hip-hop bars as the crowd cheers.

zh.text: 我宁愿过短暂而光荣的一生，也不愿过漫长而被遗忘的一生。
zh.english: I would rather live a short life of glory than a long life forgotten.
zh.back: I would rather live a short and glorious life than a long and forgotten one.
zh.controlEnglish: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
